local _registry = {}
local _cache = {}
local _loading = {}

local function requireModule(name: string)
	if _cache[name] ~= nil then
		return _cache[name]
	end
	if _loading[name] then
		error('Circular dependency detected while requiring ' .. tostring(name), 2)
	end
	local factory = _registry[name]
	if not factory then
		error('Module ' .. tostring(name) .. ' not found in registry', 2)
	end
	if name == 'main' then
		_cache[name] = factory
		return factory
	end
	_loading[name] = true
	local ok, result = pcall(factory, requireModule)
	_loading[name] = false
	if not ok then
		error('Error while running module ' .. tostring(name) .. ': ' .. tostring(result), 2)
	end
	_cache[name] = result
	return result
end

_registry["core/boot"] = (function()



return function(requireModule)
	local config = requireModule("core/config")
	local cloak = requireModule("game/cloak")
	local boot = {}
	boot.HANDLE = config.NAME:gsub("%W", "")
	boot.SLOT = boot.HANDLE .. "_BOOT"
	boot.WINDOW = 0.5
	local token, cachedEnvironment

	local function environment()
		if cachedEnvironment then
			return cachedEnvironment
		end
		local getter = cloak.real.getgenv or getgenv
		if typeof(getter) ~= "function" then
			return nil
		end
		local ok, value = pcall(getter)
		cachedEnvironment = ok and value or nil
		return cachedEnvironment
	end

	function boot.claim()
		local env = environment()
		if not env then
			return true
		end
		local previous = env[boot.HANDLE]
		if typeof(previous) == "table" and typeof(previous.destroy) == "function" then
			pcall(previous.destroy)
		end
		env[boot.HANDLE] = nil
		token = tostring({})
		env[boot.SLOT] = token
		task.wait(boot.WINDOW)
		return env[boot.SLOT] == token
	end

	function boot.publish(application)
		local env = environment()
		if not env then
			return
		end
		env[boot.HANDLE] = application
	end

	function boot.owns()
		if token == nil then
			return true
		end
		local env = environment()
		if not env then
			return true
		end
		return env[boot.SLOT] == token
	end

	function boot.release()
		local env = environment()
		if not env then
			return
		end
		env[boot.HANDLE] = nil
		if env[boot.SLOT] == token then
			env[boot.SLOT] = nil
		end
	end

	return boot
end
end)()

_registry["core/flags"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J, O, u, F = math, ipairs, typeof, tostring
				local f = p("ui/library")
				local o, Z, i, y = p("core/log"), {}, {}, 1
				Z.generation = function()
					local p = y
					return p
				end
				Z.touch = function()
					y += 1
				end
				local p = {}
				local function P(b)
					if not p[b] then
						if f.options[b] ~= nil or f.flags[b] ~= nil then
							p[b] = true
						elseif not i[b] then
							i[b] = true
							o.warn("flags", "unknown flag: %s", F(b))
						end
					end
					return f.flags[b]
				end
				Z.bool = function(p, o)
					local i = P(p)
					if i == nil then
						return o == true
					end
					return i == true
				end
				Z.num = function(p, o)
					local i = P(p)
					return u(i) == "number" and i or o
				end
				Z.str = function(p, o)
					local i = P(p)
					return u(i) == "string" and i or o
				end
				Z.color = function(p, o)
					local i = P(p)
					return u(i) == "Color3" and i or o
				end
				Z.opacity = function(p)
					local o = f.flags[p .. "_alpha"]
					return u(o) == "number" and J.clamp(o, 0, 1) or 1
				end
				Z.transparency = function(p)
					return 1 - Z.opacity(p)
				end
				Z.list = function(p)
					local J = P(p)
					return u(J) == "table" and J or {}
				end
				local p, J = {}, 0
				Z.set = function(u)
					local o = J ~= y
					if o then
						p, J = {}, y
					end
					o = p[u]
					if o then
						return o
					end
					o = {}
					for J, J in O(Z.list(u)) do
						o[F(J)] = true
					end
					p[u] = o
					return o
				end
				Z.bind = function(p)
					local J = f.options[p]
					if not J or not J.bind then
						return nil
					end
					return J.bind.key, J.bind.mode
				end
				f.onFlagWrite = Z.touch
				return Z
			end
end)()

_registry["core/rng"] = (function()

return function()
    local UINT32 = 4294967296
    local function pack32(value)
        value = math.floor(value) % UINT32
        return string.char(
            bit32.band(bit32.rshift(value, 24), 255),
            bit32.band(bit32.rshift(value, 16), 255),
            bit32.band(bit32.rshift(value, 8), 255),
            bit32.band(value, 255)
        )
    end

    local function mix(text, seed)
        for index = 1, #text do
            seed = bit32.bxor(seed, string.byte(text, index))
            seed = bit32.bxor(seed, bit32.lshift(seed, 13))
            seed = bit32.bxor(seed, bit32.rshift(seed, 17))
            seed = bit32.bxor(seed, bit32.lshift(seed, 5))
        end
        return seed
    end

    local function contextBytes(clockValue, randomValue, addressValue)
        local text = tostring(clockValue) .. "|" .. tostring(randomValue) .. "|" .. tostring(addressValue)
        return pack32(mix(text, 2166136261)) .. pack32(mix(text, 668265263))
    end

    return {
        new = function(options)
            options = options or {}
            local clock = options.clock or function() return 0 end
            local random = options.rand or function() return 0 end
            local address = options.addr or function() return "" end
            local counter = 0
            return {
                nonce16 = function()
                    counter += 1
                    return pack32(math.floor(counter / UINT32)) .. pack32(counter % UINT32)
                        .. contextBytes(clock(), random(), address())
                end,
            }
        end,
    }
end
end)()

_registry["crypto/chacha20poly1305"] = (function()


return function(requireModule)

	local dependencies = {}

	F[1861] = function(key, message)
		local base=8192
		local function limbs(bytes, appendBit)
			local out=table.create(10,0)
			for i=1,#bytes do
				local bit=(i-1)*8
				local at=math.floor(bit/13)+1
				out[at]+=string.byte(bytes,i)*2^(bit%13)
			end
			if appendBit then
				local bit=#bytes*8
				out[math.floor(bit/13)+1]+=2^(bit%13)
			end
			for i=1,9 do
				out[i+1]+=math.floor(out[i]/base)
				out[i]%=base
			end
			return out
		end
		local clamped={string.byte(key,1,16)}
		for _,i in ipairs({4,8,12,16}) do clamped[i]=bit32.band(clamped[i],15) end
		for _,i in ipairs({5,9,13}) do clamped[i]=bit32.band(clamped[i],252) end
		local r=limbs(string.char(table.unpack(clamped)),false)
		local accumulator=table.create(10,0)
		for offset=1,#message,16 do
			local m=limbs(string.sub(message,offset,offset+15),true)
			local product=table.create(19,0)
			for i=1,10 do
				for j=1,10 do product[i+j-1]+=(accumulator[i]+m[i])*r[j] end
			end
			for i=19,11,-1 do product[i-10]+=5*product[i] end
			repeat
				for i=1,9 do
					product[i+1]+=math.floor(product[i]/base)
					product[i]%=base
				end
				local carry=math.floor(product[10]/base)
				product[10]%=base
				product[1]+=5*carry
			until carry==0
			local reduce=product[1]>=base-5
			for i=2,10 do reduce=reduce and product[i]==base-1 end
			if reduce then
				product[1]-=base-5
				for i=2,10 do product[i]=0 end
			end
			accumulator=product
		end
		local output=table.create(16)
		local carry=0
		for i=1,16 do
			local bit=(i-1)*8
			local at=math.floor(bit/13)+1

		end

						a * fH + j * FH + V * uH + N * OH,

					Q += 38 * eH

				local function H(Q, Y)
					w(Q, Y, Y)
				end
				local function Q(Y, E)
					local s = 0
					for v = 0, 31, 1 do
						s = J(s, O(Y[v], E[v]))
					end
					return s == 0
				end
				local function Y(E, s)
					local v, m = P(), P()
					for B = 0, 15, 1 do
						m[B] = s[B]
					end
					R(m)
					R(m)
					R(m)
					for R = 1, 2, 1 do
						v[0] = m[0] - 65517
						for s = 1, 14, 1 do
							v[s] = m[s] - 65535 - (v[s - 1] < 0 and 1 or 0)
							v[s - 1] = v[s - 1] % 65536
						end
						v[15] = m[15] - 32767 - (v[14] < 0 and 1 or 0)
						R = v[15] < 0 and 1 or 0
						v[14] = v[14] % 65536
						e(m, v, 1 - R)
					end
					for R = 0, 15, 1 do
						E[2 * R] = m[R] % 256
						E[2 * R + 1] = o(m[R] / 256)
					end
				end
				local function R(E, s)
					local v, m = {}, {}
					Y(v, E)
					Y(m, s)
					return not Q(v, m)
				end
				local function E(s)
					local v = {}
					Y(v, s)
					return v[0] % 2
				end
				local function s(v, m)
					for B = 0, 15, 1 do
						v[B] = m[2 * B] + m[2 * B + 1] * 256
					end
					v[15] = v[15] % 32768
				end
				local function v(m, B)
					local g = P()
					for k = 0, 15, 1 do
						g[k] = B[k]
					end
					for k = 253, 0, -1 do
						H(g, g)
						if k ~= 2 and k ~= 4 then
							w(g, g, B)
						end
					end
					for B = 0, 15, 1 do
						m[B] = g[B]
					end
				end
				local function m(B, g)
					local k = P()
					for z = 0, 15, 1 do
						k[z] = g[z]
					end
					for z = 250, 0, -1 do
						H(k, k)
						if z ~= 1 then
							w(k, k, g)
						end
					end
					for g = 0, 15, 1 do
						B[g] = k[g]
					end

				local function B()
					return { [0] = P(), [1] = P(), [2] = P(), [3] = P() }
				end
				local function g(k, z)
					local l, D, K, C, a, j, V, N, W = P(), P(), P(), P(), P(), P(), P(), P(), P()
					q(l, k[1], k[0])
					q(W, z[1], z[0])
					w(l, l, W)
					G(D, k[0], k[1])
					G(W, z[0], z[1])
					w(D, D, W)
					w(K, k[3], z[3])
					w(K, K, A)
					w(C, k[2], z[2])
					G(C, C, C)
					q(a, D, l)
					q(j, C, K)
					G(V, C, K)
					G(N, D, l)
					w(k[0], a, j)
					w(k[1], N, V)
					w(k[2], V, j)
					w(k[3], a, N)
				end
				local function A(k, z, l)
					for D = 0, 3, 1 do
						e(k[D], z[D], l)
					end
				end
				local function e(k, z)
					local l, D, K = P(), P(), P()
					v(K, z[2])
					w(l, z[0], K)
					w(D, z[1], K)
					Y(k, D)
					k[31] = O(k[31], E(l) * 128)
				end
				y.SHARE = 0.5
				y.MIN_SLICE = 0.002
				y.MAX_SLICE = 0.012
				local function Y()
					local v = y.MIN_SLICE
					local k = i() + v
					if type(task) ~= "table" or type(task.wait) ~= "function" then
						return function() end
					end
					local function z()
						local l, D = i(), k
						if l < D then
							return
						end
						if not coroutine.isyieldable() then
							return
						end
						l = i()
						task.wait()
						D = i() - l
						l = D > 0
						if l then
							v = math.clamp(D * y.SHARE, y.MIN_SLICE, y.MAX_SLICE)
						end
						k = i() + v
					end
					return z
				end
				local function i(v, k, z)
					c(v[0], b)
					c(v[1], I)
					c(v[2], I)
					c(v[3], b)
					local l = Y()
					for Y = 255, 0, -1 do
						local D = p(f(z[o(Y / 8)], Y % 8), 1)
						A(v, k, D)
						g(k, v)
						g(v, v)
						A(v, k, D)
						l()
					end
				end
				local function A(Y, v)
					local k = B()
					c(k[0], T)
					c(k[1], r)
					c(k[2], I)
					w(k[3], T, r)
					i(Y, k, v)
				end

				local function r(Y, v)
					local k
					for z = 63, 32, -1 do
						local l, D = z - 32, z - 12
						k = 0
						while l < D do
							v[l] = v[l] + (k - 16 * v[z] * T[l - (z - 32)])
							k = o((v[l] + 128) / 256)
							v[l] = v[l] - k * 256
							l = l + 1
						end
						v[l] = v[l] + k
						v[z] = 0
					end
					k = 0
					for z = 0, 31, 1 do
						v[z] = v[z] + (k - o(v[31] / 16) * T[z])
						k = o(v[z] / 256)
						v[z] = v[z] % 256
					end
					for z = 0, 31, 1 do
						v[z] = v[z] - k * T[z]
					end
					for T = 0, 31, 1 do
						v[T + 1] = v[T + 1] + o(v[T] / 256)
						Y[T] = v[T] % 256
					end
				end
				local function T(Y)

					for k = 0, 63, 1 do
						v[k] = Y[k]
					end
					for k = 0, 63, 1 do
						Y[k] = 0
					end
					r(Y, v)
				end

				local function l(D, K, C, a)
					local j, V = K + a, 0
					if j >= z then
						j, V = j - z, 1
					else
					end
					K = D + C + V
					return if K >= z then K - z else K, j
				end
				local function D(K, C)
					local a, j = 0, 0
					for V = 1, #K, 1 do
						a, j = l(a, j, K[V], C[V])
					end
					return a, j
				end
				local function K(C, a, j)
					if j == 32 then
						return a, C
					elseif j < 32 then
						return J(f(C, j), F(a, 32 - j)), J(f(a, j), F(C, 32 - j))
					else
						local V = j - 32
						return J(f(a, V), F(C, 32 - V)), J(f(C, V), F(a, 32 - V))
					end
				end
				local function C(a, j, V)
					return f(a, V), J(f(j, V), F(a, 32 - V))
				end
				local function J(F, a, j, V, N, W)
					return O(p(F, j), p(u(F), N)), O(p(a, V), p(u(a), W))
				end
				local function u(F, a, j, V, N, W)
					return O(p(F, j), p(F, N), p(j, N)), O(p(a, V), p(a, W), p(V, W))
				end
				local function F(a, j)
					local V, N = K(a, j, 28)
					local W, U = K(a, j, 34)
					local _, x = K(a, j, 39)
					return O(V, W, _), O(N, U, x)
				end
				local function a(j, V)
					local N, W = K(j, V, 14)
					local U, _ = K(j, V, 18)
					local x, d = K(j, V, 41)
					return O(N, U, x), O(W, _, d)
				end
				local function j(V, N)
					local W, U = K(V, N, 1)
					local _, x = K(V, N, 8)
					local d, L = C(V, N, 7)
					return O(W, _, d), O(U, x, L)
				end
				local function V(N, W)
					local U, _ = K(N, W, 19)
					local x, d = K(N, W, 61)
					local K, L = C(N, W, 6)
					return O(U, x, K), O(_, d, L)
				end
				local function O(K, C, N, W)
					K[C] = p(f(N, 24), 255)
					K[C + 1] = p(f(N, 16), 255)
					K[C + 2] = p(f(N, 8), 255)
					K[C + 3] = p(N, 255)
					K[C + 4] = p(f(W, 24), 255)
					K[C + 5] = p(f(W, 16), 255)
					K[C + 6] = p(f(W, 8), 255)
					K[C + 7] = p(W, 255)
				end
				local function p(K, C, N, W, U)
					local _, x = {}, {}
					for d = 0, 7, 1 do
						_[d] = K[d]
						x[d] = C[d]
					end
					local d, L, n, M = {}, {}, {}, {}
					while W >= 128 do
						for t = 0, 15, 1 do
							local X = U + 8 * t
							n[t] = N[X] * 16777216 + N[X + 1] * 65536 + N[X + 2] * 256 + N[X + 3]
							M[t] = N[X + 4] * 16777216 + N[X + 5] * 65536 + N[X + 6] * 256 + N[X + 7]
						end
						for N = 0, 79, 1 do
							for t = 0, 7, 1 do
								d[t] = _[t]
								L[t] = x[t]
							end
							local t, X = a(_[4], x[4])
							local a, pH = J(_[4], x[4], _[5], x[5], _[6], x[6])
							local J, JH = D(
								{ _[7], t, a, r[N + 1], n[N % 16] },
								{ x[7], X, pH, Y[N + 1], M[N % 16] }
							)
							t, a = F(_[0], x[0])
							X, pH = u(_[0], x[0], _[1], x[1], _[2], x[2])
							d[7], L[7] = D({ J, t, X }, { JH, a, pH })
							d[3], L[3] = l(d[3], L[3], J, JH)
							for u = 0, 7, 1 do
								_[(u + 1) % 8] = d[u]
								x[(u + 1) % 8] = L[u]
							end
							if N % 16 == 15 then
								for u = 0, 15, 1 do
									J, pH = j(n[(u + 1) % 16], M[(u + 1) % 16])
									JH, a = V(n[(u + 14) % 16], M[(u + 14) % 16])
									n[u], M[u] = D(
										{ n[u], n[(u + 9) % 16], J, JH },
										{ M[u], M[(u + 9) % 16], pH, a }
									)
								end
							end
						end
						for J = 0, 7, 1 do
							_[J], x[J] = l(_[J], x[J], K[J], C[J])
							K[J] = _[J]
							C[J] = x[J]
						end
						U += 128
						W = W - 128
					end
				end
				local function J(u, F)
					local r, Y = {}, {}
					for l = 0, 7, 1 do
						r[l] = v[l + 1]
						Y[l] = k[l + 1]
					end
					p(r, Y, u, F, 0)
					local v, k = F % 128, {}
					for l = 0, 255, 1 do
						k[l] = 0
					end
					for l = 0, v - 1, 1 do
						k[l] = u[F - v + l]
					end
					k[v] = 128
					local u, l, D = v < 112 and 128 or 256, o(F / 536870912), F * 8 % z
					O(k, u - 8, l, D)
					p(r, Y, k, u, 0)
					l = {}
					for p = 0, 7, 1 do
						O(l, 8 * p, r[p], Y[p])
					end
					return l
				end
				local function p(O, u)
					local F, o, r, Y, v, k, z = P(), P(), P(), P(), P(), P(), P()
					c(O[2], I)
					s(O[1], u)
					H(r, O[1])
					w(Y, r, h)
					q(r, r, O[2])
					G(Y, O[2], Y)
					H(v, Y)
					H(k, v)
					w(z, k, v)
					w(F, z, r)
					w(F, F, Y)
					m(F, F)
					w(F, F, r)
					w(F, F, Y)
					w(F, F, Y)
					w(O[0], F, Y)
					H(o, O[0])
					w(o, o, Y)
					if R(o, r) then
						w(O[0], O[0], S)
					end
					H(o, O[0])
					w(o, o, Y)
					if R(o, r) then
						return false
					end
					if E(O[0]) == f(u[31], 7) then
						q(O[0], b, O[0])
					end
					w(O[3], O[0], O[1])
					return true
				end
				local function O(u)
					local F = {}
					for f = 1, #u, 1 do
						F[f - 1] = Z(u, f)
					end
					return F
				end
				local function u(F, f, o)
					if #F ~= 32 or #o ~= 64 then
						return false
					end
					local Z, P, b, I = O(F), O(o .. f), 64 + #f, B()
					if not p(I, Z) then
						return false
					end
					F = {}
					for p = 0, b - 1, 1 do
						F[p] = P[p]
					end
					for p = 0, 31, 1 do
						F[p + 32] = Z[p]
					end
					Z = J(F, b)
					T(Z)
					f = B()
					i(f, I, Z)
					F = {}
					for p = 0, 31, 1 do
						F[p] = P[32 + p]
					end
					A(I, F)
					g(f, I)
					I = {}
					e(I, f)
					return Q(P, I)
				end
				y.verify = function(p, J, O)
					local F, f = pcall(u, p, J, O)
					return F and f == true
				end
				return y

_registry["crypto/hkdf"] = (function()


return function(requireModule)
    local sha256 = requireModule("crypto/sha256")
    local HASH_LENGTH = 32
    local BLOCK_LENGTH = 64
    local INFO_HANDSHAKE = "neuro/c2s-hs/v1"
    local INFO_SESSION = "neuro/session/v1"
    local INFO_DIR_PREFIX = "neuro/dir/v1/"

    local function xorPad(key, value)
        local bytes = table.create(BLOCK_LENGTH)
        for index = 1, BLOCK_LENGTH do
            bytes[index] = string.char(bit32.bxor(string.byte(key, index), value))
        end
        return table.concat(bytes)
    end

    local function hmac(key, message)
        if #key > BLOCK_LENGTH then key = sha256.bytes(key) end
        if #key < BLOCK_LENGTH then
            key ..= string.rep(string.char(0), BLOCK_LENGTH - #key)
        end
        local inner = sha256.bytes(xorPad(key, 0x36) .. message)
        return sha256.bytes(xorPad(key, 0x5c) .. inner)
    end

    local function hkdf(inputKey, salt, info, length)
        assert(length >= 0 and length <= 255 * HASH_LENGTH and length == length,
            "hkdf: length out of range")
        if #salt == 0 then salt = string.rep(string.char(0), HASH_LENGTH) end
        local pseudorandomKey = hmac(salt, inputKey)
        local blocks, previous = {}, ""
        for index = 1, math.ceil(length / HASH_LENGTH) do
            previous = hmac(pseudorandomKey, previous .. info .. string.char(index))
            blocks[index] = previous
        end
        return string.sub(table.concat(blocks), 1, length)
    end

    return {
        hkdf = hkdf,
        deriveHandshakeKey = function(inputKey, salt)
            return hkdf(inputKey, salt, INFO_HANDSHAKE, HASH_LENGTH)
        end,
        deriveSessionKey = function(inputKey, firstSalt, secondSalt, context)
            return hkdf(inputKey, firstSalt .. secondSalt, INFO_SESSION .. context, HASH_LENGTH)
        end,
        deriveDirectional = function(inputKey, direction)
            return hkdf(inputKey, "", INFO_DIR_PREFIX .. direction, HASH_LENGTH)
        end,
        INFO_HANDSHAKE = INFO_HANDSHAKE,
        INFO_SESSION = INFO_SESSION,
        INFO_DIR_PREFIX = INFO_DIR_PREFIX,
    }
end
end)()

					if E then
						local s = q
						for m, m in u(s) do
							b(m, "Visible", false)
						end
					end
					E = e
					if E then
						local E = e
						for s, s in u(E) do
							b(s, "Visible", false)
						end
					end
				end
				local function E()
					if h.inMainMenu() then
						f()
						return
					end
					if not y.bool("aim_show_accuracy_fov") then
						return f()
					end
					local h = F.CurrentCamera
					if not h then
						return f()
					end
					local F = Q
					if not F or F <= 0 then
						return f()
					end
					local s, m = h.ViewportSize, J.rad(h.FieldOfView)
					if m <= 0 then
						return f()
					end
					h = J.min(F, o.CONE_CAP)
					F = nil
					if y.str("aim_accuracy_fov_mode", A.SPREAD) == A.INACCURACY then
						local B = y.bool("aim_show_fov") and y.num("aim_fov", 120) or p
						F = h / o.CONE_CAP * B * T
					else
						local p = s.Y * 0.5 / J.tan(m * 0.5)
						F = J.tan(J.rad(h) * 0.5) * p
					end
					m = O.clock()
					h = H > 0 and J.min(m - H, 0.1) or 0.016666666666666666
					H = m
					m = w
					w = m + (F - m) * J.min(1, h / R)
					if not Y() then
						return
					end
					local p, O, T, R =
						s * 0.5,
						J.max(w, 1),
						y.color("aim_accuracy_fov_color", A.DEFAULT_COLOR),
						y.opacity("aim_accuracy_fov_color")
					m = 1 - c * R
					for J = 1, S, 1 do
						F = q[J]
						Z.placeMarked(F, I(F), p, O * (1 - (J - 1) / S))
						b(F, "BackgroundTransparency", m)
						b(F, "Visible", true)
					end
					m = v(T)
					for J, F in u(r) do
						T, h = e[J], G[J]
						Z.placeRingMarked(T, h, I(T), p, O, F.thick)
						b(h, "Color", m[J])
						b(h, "Transparency", 1 - F.alpha * R)
						b(T, "Visible", true)
					end
				end
				A.refresh = function()
					if not y.bool("aim_show_accuracy_fov") then
						P.stop(A.VALUE)
						P.stop(A.BIND)
						f()
						return A
					end
					i.start()
					P.onDraw(A.VALUE, function()
						Q = o.current()
					end)
					P.onDraw(A.BIND, E)
					return A
				end
				A.reset = function()
					P.stop(A.VALUE)
					P.stop(A.BIND)
					f()
					w, H, Q = 0, 0, nil
				end
				return A
			end
end)()


_registry["features/affected"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J, O, u, F, f, o, Z, i, y, P, b, I, h, A, T =
					math,
					table,
					string,
					os,
					ipairs,
					pairs,
					next,
					pcall,
					workspace,
					Vector3,
					Vector2,
					Color3,
					UDim2,
					UDim,
					Enum
				local r = p("services/canvas")
				local S = p("ui/create")
				local c = p("services/effects")
				local R = p("core/flags")
				local e = p("services/frame")
				local G = p("services/gamedata")
				local q = p("services/roster")
				local w = p("services/grenadedb")
				local H = p("services/project")
				local Q = p("features/prediction")
				local Y = p("ui/theme")
				local E = p("ui/thumb")
				local s, v =
					{
						BIND = "esp/affected",
						ZBASE = p("ui/zindex").WORLD,
						BLAST_PEAK = 55,
						BLAST_SPREAD = 112.5,
						ROOT_TO_FEET = 3,
						FIRE_BAND = 4,
						RING = 44,
						LABEL_H = 14,
						LABEL_SIZE = 12,
						LABEL_GAP = 3,
						RING_THICK = 2,
						LABEL_SHADE = 0.6,
						ARC_RADIUS = 104,
						ARC_SPREAD = 1.9198621771937625,
						FLY_TIME = 0.38,
						FADE_IN = 0.16,
						FADE_OUT = 0.22,
						RISE = 16,
						REST_PANEL = 0.35,
						MAX_BADGES = 8,
						RESCAN = 0.08333333333333333,
						LETHAL = I.fromRGB(255, 64, 64),
						NEAR = 1,
					},
					{
						["HE Grenade"] = "blast",
						Flashbang = "flash",
						["Smoke Grenade"] = "smoke",
						Molotov = "fire",
						["Incendiary Grenade"] = "fire",
					}
				local function p(m)
					return m.Position - P.new(0, s.ROOT_TO_FEET, 0)
				end
				local function P(m, B)
					local g = (m - B).Magnitude
					m = s.BLAST_PEAK * J.exp(-(g * g) / s.BLAST_SPREAD)
					if m < 0.5 then
						return 0
					end
					return J.floor(m + 0.5)
				end
				local function m(B, g)
					return b.new(B.X - g.X, B.Z - g.Z).Magnitude
				end
				local function B(g, k, z, l, D, K)
					if g == "blast" then
						local C = P(z, p(D))
						if C <= 0 then
							return nil
						end
						if not K or K <= 0 then
							return u.format("-%d", C), nil
						end
						if C >= K then
							return "Lethal", true
						end
						return u.format("-%d", C), false
					end
					if g == "flash" then
						K = c.blindSeconds(z, l, D)
						if K < c.BLIND_FLOOR then
							return nil
						end
						return u.format("%.1fs", K)
					end
					l = w.area(k)
					if not l then
						return nil
					end
					K = p(D)
					if m(z, K) > l.radius then
						return nil
					end
					if g == "smoke" then
						k = z.Y + (l.base or 0)
						local p = k + (l.height or 12)
						if D.Position.Y + D.Size.Y / 2 < k or p < K.Y then
							return nil
						end
						return "smoked"
					end
					if J.abs(K.Y - z.Y) > s.FIRE_BAND then
						return nil
					end
					return "burning"
				end
				local p, u = {}, 0
				s.SIDE_BOTH = "both"
				s.SIDE_ENEMIES = "enemies"
				s.SIDE_ALLIES = "allies"
				s.SIDES = { s.SIDE_BOTH, s.SIDE_ENEMIES, s.SIDE_ALLIES }
				local function P(w, m)
					if w == s.SIDE_BOTH then
						return true
					end
					if w == s.SIDE_ALLIES then
						return m
					end
					return not m
				end
				local function w(m, g)
					O.clear(p)
					local k = v[m]
					if not k then
						return
					end
					local v, z, l = R.str("pred_affected_side", s.SIDE_BOTH), q.get()
					for D = 1, l, 1 do
						if #p >= s.MAX_BADGES then
							break
						end
						local l = z[D]
						local z, K = l.player, l.alive and l.character or nil
						D = K and (K:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
						if D and P(v, l.ally) then
							local v = l.health
							local l, C = B(k, m, g, K, D, v)
							if l then
								v = z and z.UserId or -(tonumber(K:GetAttribute("CombatantId")) or 0)
								O.insert(
									p,
									{ userId = v, player = z, character = K, root = D, text = l, lethal = C
										== true }
								)
							end
						end
					end
					O.sort(p, function(v, m)
						return v.userId < m.userId
					end)
				end
				local v, m
				local B, g = {}, {}
				local function k()
					local z = v
					if not z then
						return nil
					end
					z = S.new(
						"ImageLabel",
						{
							Name = "Affected",
							AnchorPoint = b.new(0.5, 0.5),
							Size = h.fromOffset(s.RING, s.RING),
							BackgroundColor3 = I.new(),
							BackgroundTransparency = s.REST_PANEL,
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							Visible = false,
							ZIndex = s.ZBASE + 5,
							Parent = v,
						}
					)
					if not z then
						return nil
					end
					local l, D = S.new, {}
					D.CornerRadius, D.Parent = A.new(1, 0), z
					l("UICorner", D)
					return { avatar = z, mark = {}, at = nil, shown = nil }
				end
				local function A()
					local z = O.remove(B)
					if z then
						return z
					end
					return k()
				end
				local function k(z, l, D)
					local K = z.mark
					if K[l] == D then
						return
					end
					K[l] = D
					z.avatar[l] = D
				end
				local function z(l, D, K)
					local C = l.at
					if C then
						if C[1] == D and C[2] == K then
							return
						end
					else
						C = { 0, 0 }
						l.at = C
					end
					C[1] = D
					C[2] = K
					l.avatar.Position = h.fromOffset(D, K)
				end
				local function h(l)
					k(l, "Visible", false)
					O.insert(B, l)
				end
				local function l()
					local D = g
					for K, C in o(D) do
						h(C.badge)
						g[K] = nil
					end
				end
				local function D(K, C, a)
					local j = if C > 1 then -s.ARC_SPREAD / 2 + s.ARC_SPREAD * ((K - 1) / (C - 1)) else 0
					return a + b.new(J.sin(j), J.cos(j)) * s.ARC_RADIUS
				end
				local function K(C, a, j, V, N, W)
					local U, _, x = C.badge, (1 - N) * s.RISE * (W and 1 or 1), J.round(a.X)
					W = J.round(a.Y - _)
					z(U, x, W)
					k(U, "BackgroundTransparency", 1 - (1 - s.REST_PANEL) * N)
					k(U, "ImageTransparency", 1 - N)
					C = N > 0.01
					k(U, "Visible", C)
					if not C then
						return
					end
					a = m
					a:circle(x, W, s.RING / 2, j, N, s.RING_THICK)
					_ = m
					_:textShaded(
						x,
						W + s.RING / 2 + s.LABEL_GAP + (s.LABEL_H - s.LABEL_SIZE) // 2,
						s.LABEL_SIZE,
						V,
						j,
						N,
						true,
						s.LABEL_SHADE * N
					)
				end
				local z = {}
				local function C(a)
					local j = z[a]
					if j then
						i(function()
							j.node:Destroy()
						end)
						z[a] = nil
					end
				end
				local function i(a, j)
					local V = z[a]
					if not V or not V.node.Parent then
						local N = S.new(
							"Highlight",
							{
								FillTransparency = 0.62,
								OutlineTransparency = 0,
								DepthMode = T.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop,
								Parent = a,
							}
						)
						if not N then
							return
						end
						V = { node = N, color = nil }
						z[a] = V
					else
					end
					if V.color == j then
						return
					end
					V.color = j
					V.node.FillColor = j
					V.node.OutlineColor = j
				end
				local function T()
					for S in o(z) do
						C(S)
					end
				end
				local function S(a)
					if c.blindOf(a) >= c.BLIND_FLOOR then
						return true
					end
					if c.smoked(a) then
						return true
					end
					return c.burning(a)
				end
				local function a()
					if not R.bool("pred_affected_mark") then
						if Z(z) ~= nil then
							T()
						end
						return
					end
					local j, V = R.color("pred_affected_mark_color", I.fromRGB(255, 200, 90)), {}
					for I, I in f(p) do
						if I.character and I.character.Parent then
							V[I.character] = true
							i(I.character, I.lethal and s.LETHAL or j)
						end
					end
					local I, N, W = R.str("pred_affected_side", s.SIDE_BOTH), q.get()
					for q = 1, W, 1 do
						local W = N[q]
						local q, N = W.player, W.alive and W.character or nil
						if N and not V[N] and P(I, W.ally) and q and S(q) then
							V[N] = true
							i(N, j)
						end
					end
					for i in o(z) do
						if not V[i] then
							C(i)
						end
					end
				end
				local function i(P, I, S, q)
					local C = I.Position
					if S then
						local I, j, V = H.at(C.X, C.Y, C.Z)
						if I == nil or V <= s.NEAR then
							return 0, 0, false
						end
						return I, j, I >= 0 and I <= q.X and j >= 0 and j <= q.Y
					end
					S, q = P:WorldToViewportPoint(C)
					return S.X, S.Y, q and S.Z > s.NEAR
				end
				local function P()
					local I = G.inMainMenu()
					if I then
						local S = m
						if S then
							m:begin()
							m:finish()
						end
						return
					end
					I = y.CurrentCamera
					local y = not v or not I or not m or not R.bool("pred_affected")
					if y then
						if Z(z) ~= nil then
							T()
						end
						l()
						local Z = m
						if Z then
							m:begin()
							m:finish()
						end
						return
					end
					m:begin()
					local Z, S, G, q, z = H.beginFrame(I, e.stamp), Q.target()
					y = F.clock()
					local F = S and G and y - u >= s.RESCAN
					if F then
						u = y
						w(S, G)
					elseif not S then
						O.clear(p)
					end
					a()
					G = 0
					if q and z then
						F = J.clamp((y - z) / s.FLY_TIME, 0, 1)
						G = F * F * (3 - 2 * F)
					else
					end
					F = I.ViewportSize
					q, z, S = b.new(F.X / 2, F.Y / 2), Y.get(), {}
					for u, w in f(p) do
						S[w.userId] = true
						local f = g
						local H = f[w.userId]
						f = not H
						if f then
							local f = A()
							if f then
								H = { badge = f, bornAt = y }
								local f = g
								f[w.userId] = H
							else
							end
						else
						end
						if H then
							H.entry = w
							H.slot = u
							H.dyingAt = nil
						end
					end
					local u = g
					for f, A in o(u) do
						if not S[f] and not A.dyingAt then
							A.dyingAt = y
						end
					end
					S, u = #p, g
					for f, A in o(u) do
						local u = A.entry
						local o = not u
						if o then
							h(A.badge)
							g[f] = nil
						else
							local o = if A.dyingAt
								then 1 - (y - A.dyingAt) / s.FADE_OUT
								else J.min(1, (y - A.bornAt) / s.FADE_IN)
							local y = A.dyingAt and o <= 0
							if y then
								h(A.badge)
								g[f] = nil
							else
								o = J.max(o, 0)
								local f, y = D(A.slot or 1, J.max(S, 1), q), true
								if G > 0 then
									local J, h, S = i(I, u.root, Z, F)
									if S then
										f = f:Lerp(b.new(J, h), G)
									else
										y = G < 1
									end
								else
								end
								local J = A.badge
								if J.shown ~= u.userId then
									J.shown = u.userId
									k(J, "Image", E.headshot(u.userId))
								end
								K(A, f, u.lethal and s.LETHAL or z, u.text, y and o or 0, A.dyingAt == nil)
							end
						end
					end
					m:finish()
				end
				s.attach = function(J)
					v = J
					m = r.layer(s.BIND, s.ZBASE + 6, { parent = J })
					return s
				end
				s.refresh = function()
					c.demand("affected", R.bool("pred_enabled") and R.bool("pred_affected_mark"))
					local J = R.bool("pred_enabled")
					if J then
						e.onDraw(s.BIND, P)
					else
						e.stop(s.BIND)
						l()
						T()
						local J = m
						if J then
							m:clear()
						end
					end
					return s
				end
				s.reset = function()
					e.stop(s.BIND)
					c.demand("affected", false)
					T()
					g, B, v = {}, {}, nil
					O.clear(p)
				end
				return s
			end
end)()


_registry["features/agentskin"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("services/agentdb")
				local O = p("services/agentrig")
				local u = p("ui/connect")
				local F = p("services/frame")
				local f = p("services/gamedata")
				local o = p("core/log")
				local Z = p("services/modelsource")
				local i = p("core/service").get("Players")
				local y, P, b, I, h, A, T =
					i and i.LocalPlayer, { BIND = "world/agentskin" }, 0.25, {}, {}, {}, {}
				local r, S, c, R, e = -1, 0, true, false, false
				local function G(q, ...)
					local w = e
					if w then
						return
					end
					e = true
					o.warn("agentskin", q, ...)
				end
				P.bodyOf = function(o)
					local q = I[o]
					if q and q.handle then
						return q.handle.copy
					end
					return nil
				end
				P.wanted = function()
					for o, o in ipairs(J.SLOTS) do
						if J.assigned(o.key) then
							return true
						end
					end
					return false
				end
				local function o(q)
					if q and typeof(P.onDress) == "function" then
						pcall(P.onDress, q)
					end
				end
				local function q(w)
					local H = I[w]
					if not H then
						return
					end
					I[w] = nil
					o(H.handle and H.handle.copy)
					O.drop(H.handle)
				end
				local function w(H)
					local Q = A[H]
					if not Q then
						return
					end
					A[H] = nil
					o(Q.handle and Q.handle.copy)
					O.drop(Q.handle)
				end
				i, p = setmetatable, { __mode = "k" }
				local H = i({}, p)
				local function p(i)
					local Q = workspace:FindFirstChild("Debris")
					if not Q then
						return nil
					end
					for Y, E in ipairs(Q:GetChildren()) do
						if E:IsA("Model") and E.Name == i.Name then
							Y = H[E]
							if Y == nil then
								Y = E:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Constraint", true) ~= nil
								H[E] = Y
							else
							end
							if Y then
								return E
							end
						end
					end
					return nil
				end
				local function i(Q, Y, E)
					if Z.request(Y.source, Y.ref) ~= "ready" then
						return nil
					end
					local s = Z.clone(Y.source, Y.ref)
					if not s then
						return nil
					end
					Y = O.liveHost()
					if not Y then
						pcall(function()
							s:Destroy()
						end)
						G("workspace has no Terrain, so there is nowhere to host a body")
						return nil
					end
					return O.apply(Q, s, Y, E)
				end
				P.onDress = nil
				local function G(Q, Y)
					q(Q)
					o(Q)
					local E = i(Q, Y, false)
					if not E then
						return
					end
					I[Q] = { handle = E, rowId = Y.id }
				end
				local function Q(Y, E)
					w(Y)
					o(Y)
					local o = i(Y, E, true)
					if not o then
						return
					end
					A[Y] = { handle = o, rowId = E.id }
				end
				local function o()
					table.clear(h)
					table.clear(T)
					local i, Y = f.everyone()
					for E = 1, Y, 1 do
						local Y = i[E]
						local i, s = f.characterOf(Y), Y == y
						E = J.forPlayer(s, f.teamOf(Y))
						if E then
							Z.request(E.source, E.ref)
							if i and f.isAliveOf(i) then
								h[i] = true
								s = I[i]
								if not s or s.rowId ~= E.id then
									G(i, E)
								end
							end
							local Z = p(Y)
							if Z then
								T[Z] = true
								local p = A[Z]
								if not p or p.rowId ~= E.id then
									Q(Z, E)
								end
							end
						end
					end
					for p in pairs(I) do
						if not h[p] then
							q(p)
						end
					end
					for p in pairs(A) do
						if not T[p] or not p.Parent then
							w(p)
						end
					end
				end
				local function p()
					local Z = R
					if Z then
						return
					end
					local Z, i = workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters"), workspace:FindFirstChild("Debris")
					if not Z or not i then
						return
					end
					R = true
					local function y()
						c = true
					end
					u.signal(Z.ChildAdded, y, "agentskin/spawn")
					u.signal(Z.ChildRemoved, y, "agentskin/leave")
					u.signal(i.ChildAdded, y, "agentskin/corpse")
				end
				local function u()
					p()
					local p = os.clock()
					local Z = c or p - S >= b or J.version ~= r
					if Z then
						c, S = false, p
						r = J.version
						o()
					end
					p = workspace.CurrentCamera
					Z = p and p.CFrame.Position or nil
					p = Z and f.viewedCharacter() or nil
					for J, f in pairs(I) do
						local o = J == p and O.inside(f.handle, Z)
						if not O.step(f.handle, o) then
							q(J)
						end
					end
					for p, J in pairs(A) do
						if not O.step(J.handle) then
							w(p)
						end
					end
				end
				P.refresh = function()
					local p = not P.wanted()
					if p then
						F.stop(P.BIND)
						for p in pairs(I) do
							q(p)
						end
						for p in pairs(A) do
							w(p)
						end
						r, S = -1, 0
						return P
					end
					S, r = 0, -1
					F.onDraw(P.BIND, u)
					return P
				end
				P.reset = function()
					F.stop(P.BIND)
					for p in pairs(I) do
						q(p)
					end
					for p in pairs(A) do
						w(p)
					end
					table.clear(I)
					table.clear(h)
					table.clear(A)
					table.clear(T)
					table.clear(H)
					r, S, c, e = -1, 0, true, false
					P.onDress = nil
				end
				return P
			end
end)()


_registry["features/aimbot"] = (function()

local J = isrbxactive

return function(p)
				local O = p("services/aim")
				local u = p("ui/circle")
				local F = p("ui/create")
				local f = p("ui/line")
				local o = p("core/flags")
				local Z = p("services/frame")
				local i = p("services/gamedata")
				local y = p("services/lethality")
				local P = p("services/trace")
				local b = p("ui/library")
				local I = p("services/motion")
				local h = p("services/seed")
				local A = p("services/targeting")
				local T = p("services/vision")
				local r, S, c = p("ui/zindex"), {}
				S.target = function()
					local p = c
					return p
				end
				S.BIND = "aim/legit"
				local p, R, e, G, q, w, H
				local Q = {}
				local function Y(E)
					local s = Q[E]
					if not s then
						s = {}
						Q[E] = s
					else
					end
					return s
				end
				local function Q(E, s, v)
					local m = Y(E)
					if m[s] == v then
						return
					end
					m[s] = v
					E[s] = v
				end
				local E, s, v, m, B, g, k, z, l, D = Color3.new(), 1, 2, 2, 0.55, 0.16, 3, 0.55, 0
				local function K()
					local C = p
					if C then
						local a = p
						return a
					end
					C = b.base
					if not C then
						return nil
					end
					H = u.disc(C, r.HUD)
					e, G = u.ring(C, r.HUD + 1)
					p, R = u.ring(C, r.HUD + 2)
					local a = not p or not e
					if a then
						return nil
					end
					G.Color = E
					a = H
					if a then
						Q(H, "BackgroundColor3", E)
					end
					w = f.new(C, r.HUD + 2)
					q = u.disc(C, r.HUD + 2)
					a = q
					if a then
						F.new("UIStroke", { Color = E, Thickness = 1, Parent = q })
					end
					a = p
					return a
				end
				local function F()
					local r = p
					if r then
						Q(p, "Visible", false)
					end
					r = e
					if r then
						Q(e, "Visible", false)
					end
					r = H
					if r then
						Q(H, "Visible", false)
					end
					r = q
					if r then
						Q(q, "Visible", false)
					end
					r = w
					if r then
						Q(w, "Visible", false)
					end
					l = 0
				end
				local function p(r)
					local E = o.list(r)
					local C, a = tonumber(E[1]), tonumber(E[2])
					if not C then
						return o.num(r, 0) / 1000
					end
					if not a or a <= C then
						return C / 1000
					end
					return (C + math.random() * (a - C)) / 1000
				end
				local r
				local E, C = 0
				local a, j, V = 0.15
				local N, W = 0, 0
				local function U()
					r, j, V = nil, nil, nil
				end
				local function _()
					U()
					C = nil
				end
				local function x(d, L, n)
					local M, t = n == j, V and V.Parent and j
					local X = not M
					t = X and t
					M = t and d - N < W
					if M then
						local M, t = V, j
						return M, t
					end
					if X then
						N = d
						W = p("aim_switch_delay")
					end
					j, V = n, L
					return L, n
				end
				local j = { "chest", "pelvis", "center" }
				local function V(N)
					return I.offset(N, nil, true)
				end
				local I
				local N = -1
				local function W()
					local d = o.generation()
					local L = N == d and I
					if L then
						local n = I
						return n
					end
					N = d
					I = {
						fov = o.num("aim_fov", 120),
						hitbox = o.set("aim_hitbox"),
						teamCheck = o.bool("aim_team_check"),
						aliveCheck = o.bool("aim_alive_check"),
						visibleCheck = o.bool("aim_visible_check"),
						offsetOf = V,
						smoked = o.bool("filter_smoke") and T.smoked or nil,
					}
					L = I
					return L
				end
				local function I(N, d, L)
					if not o.bool("aim_prefer_body_lethal") then
						return nil
					end
					if not d or typeof(L) ~= "Instance" then
						return nil
					end
					if i.hitboxLabelOf(L.Name) ~= "head" then
						return nil
					end
					local n = i.characterOf(d)
					if not n then
						return nil
					end
					local M, t = h.aim(N), V(n)
					for h, X in ipairs(j) do
						h = i.aimPart(n, X, M)
						if h and h ~= L then
							X = y.at(d, h, M, t)
							if X and X.kills and A.canSee(N, h, n, t) then
								return h
							end
						end
					end
					return nil
				end
				local function y()
					local h = c
					local j = h
					c = nil
					h = workspace.CurrentCamera
					if not h then
						return
					end
					local N = o.bool("aim_show_fov")
					if N then
						local d = K()
						if d then
							local K, L, n, M, t =
								h.ViewportSize * 0.5,
								o.num("aim_fov", 120),
								o.color("aim_fov_color", Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65)),
								o.transparency("aim_fov_color"),
								os.clock()
							local X = D and t - D or 0
							D = t
							t = l
							l = t + ((j and 1 or 0) - t) * math.clamp(X / g, 0, 1)
							t = l < 0.001
							if t then
								l = 0
							else
								X = l > 0.999
								if X then
									l = 1
								end
							end
							local g, D, t = s + (m - s) * l, 1 - (1 - M) * (B + (1 - B) * l), H
							if t then
								u.placeMarked(H, Y(H), K, L)
								Q(H, "BackgroundTransparency", z)
								Q(H, "Visible", true)
							end
							u.placeRingMarked(d, R, Y(d), K, L, g)
							Q(R, "Color", n)
							Q(R, "Transparency", D)
							Q(d, "Visible", true)
							u.placeRingMarked(e, G, Y(e), K, L, g + v)
							Q(G, "Transparency", D)
							Q(e, "Visible", true)
							X = nil
							if j and j.Parent then
								L, D = h:WorldToViewportPoint(j.Position)
								X = if D then Vector2.new(L.X, L.Y) else X
							else
							end
							if X then
								u.placeMarked(q, Y(q), X, k)
								Q(q, "BackgroundColor3", n)
								Q(q, "BackgroundTransparency", M)
								Q(q, "Visible", true)
								f.placeMarked(w, Y(w), K, X, 1)
								Q(w, "BackgroundColor3", n)
								Q(w, "BackgroundTransparency", 1 - (1 - M) * 0.35 * l)
								Q(w, "Visible", true)
							else
								D = q
								if D then
									Q(q, "Visible", false)
								end
								g = w
								if g then
									Q(w, "Visible", false)
								end
							end
						end
					else
						F()
					end
					if not o.bool("aim_enabled") then
						_()
						return O.idle(h)
					end
					if not O.available then
						_()
						return
					end
					if b.open or i.isTyping() or i.viewedCharacter() then
						_()
						return O.idle(h)
					end
					if not i.localAlive() then
						_()
						return O.idle(h)
					end
					local u
					local u, u, f = J, typeof(J) == "function"
					if u then
						N = J
						f = not N()
					else
						f = u
					end
					if f then
						return
					end
					if o.bool("filter_flash") and T.blinded() then
						return
					end
					j, N = W(), os.clock()
					u, f = A.find(h, j)
					j = not u
					if j then
						P.every("semalvo", 0.5, "aimbot", "nenhum candidato passou os filtros")
						C = C or N
						local J = N - C
						if J >= a then
							U()
						end
						return O.idle(h)
					end
					C = nil
					j = not r
					if j then
						r = N
						E = p("aim_delay")
					end
					j = N - r < E
					if j then
						P.every(
							"atraso",
							0.25,
							"aimbot",
							"esperando atraso de entrada: %.0f de %.0f ms",
							(N - r) * 1000,
							E * 1000
						)
						return O.idle(h)
					end
					local p, J = x(N, u, f)
					u = I(h, J, p) or p
					c = u
					if P.on then
						j, f, N = V(u.Parent), A.angleTo(h, u.Position)
						local i, b = A.angleTo(h, u.Position + j)
						P.every(
							"assumido",
							0.2,
							"aimbot",
							"alvo=%s peca=%s dist=%.1f  erro_desenhado=(%.2f,%.2f)  erro_adiantado=(%.2f,%.2f)  lead=%.2f  silent=%s",
							tostring(J and J.Name),
							u.Name,
							(u.Position - h.CFrame.Position).Magnitude,
							f or 0,
							N or 0,
							i or 0,
							b or 0,
							j.Magnitude,
							tostring(o.bool("aim_silent"))
						)
					end
					p, j = A.angleTo(h, u.Position)
					if not p then
						return
					end
					if o.bool("aim_silent") then
						P.every(
							"silencioso",
							0.5,
							"aimbot",
							"silent aim ligado: a camera NAO gira, quem decide o tiro e o Bullet"
						)
						return O.idle(h)
					end
					O.turn(h, p, j, o.num("aim_smooth", 25))
				end
				S.refresh = function()
					if not (o.bool("aim_enabled") or o.bool("aim_show_fov")) then
						Z.stop(S.BIND)
						F()
						return S
					end
					T.start()
					Z.onDraw(S.BIND, y)
					return S
				end
				S.reset = function()
					Z.stop(S.BIND)
					F()
					_()
				end
				return S
			end
end)()


_registry["features/ambience"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("core/flags")
				local O = p("game/guard")
				local u = p("game/modules")
				local F, f = p("core/service"), O.CLOCKED
				local p = F.get("Lighting")
				local o, Z, i =
					F.get("RunService"),
					{ PARENT_TO_CAMERA = true },
					{ "Grade", "Tone", "Correction", "Filter", "Levels" }
				local F = i[Random.new():NextInteger(1, #i)]
				local y = i[Random.new():NextInteger(1, #i)]
				local P, b, I, h = i[Random.new():NextInteger(1, #i)]
				Z.DEFAULT_LIGHT = 100
				local i, A
				local T, r = false
				Z.BLOOM_FLOOR = 0.4
				Z.BLOOM_THRESHOLD = 0.95
				local S, c
				local R = { "Ambient", "OutdoorAmbient", "ClockTime", "ExposureCompensation" }
				Z.DEFAULT_INDOOR = Color3.fromRGB(40, 36, 35)
				Z.DEFAULT_OUTDOOR = Color3.fromRGB(107, 97, 81)
				Z.DEFAULT_CLOCK = 110
				Z.DEFAULT_EXPOSURE = 0
				local e, G, q, w, H
				Z.enabled = false
				local function Q()
					if Z.PARENT_TO_CAMERA then
						local Y = workspace.CurrentCamera
						if Y then
							return Y
						end
					end
					return p
				end
				local function Y(E, s, v)
					local m = Q()
					if not m then
						return nil
					end
					if E and E.Parent == m then
						return E
					end
					if E then
						if pcall(function()
							E.Parent = m
						end) and E.Parent == m then
							return E
						end
						pcall(function()
							E:Destroy()
						end)
					end
					local Q
					pcall(function()
						Q = Instance.new(s)
						Q.Name = v
						Q.Parent = m
					end)
					return Q
				end
				local function Q()
					if not p then
						return nil
					end
					return p:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
				end
				local function E()
					if not p then
						return nil
					end
					return p:FindFirstChildOfClass("BloomEffect")
				end
				local s, v, m, B = {}, {}, {}, {}
				local function g()
					table.clear(s)
					table.clear(v)
					table.clear(m)
					table.clear(B)
				end
				local function k()
					local z, l = { shadows = p and p.GlobalShadows, atmosphere = nil }, Q()
					if l then
						z.atmosphere = { object = l, Density = l.Density, Haze = l.Haze, Glare = l.Glare }
					end
					return z
				end
				local function z()
					local l = S
					if l then
						pcall(function()
							if not p then
								return
							end
							local D = A ~= nil and i ~= nil
							if D then
								p.Brightness = i
							end
							D = T and S.shadows ~= nil
							if D then
								p.GlobalShadows = S.shadows
							end
						end)
						i, A, T = nil, nil, false
						local D = S.atmosphere
						if D and D.object and D.object.Parent then
							pcall(function()
								D.object.Density = D.Density
								D.object.Haze = D.Haze
								D.object.Glare = D.Glare
							end)
						end
					end
					l = r and not r.mine and r.object and r.object.Parent
					if l then
						pcall(function()
							r.object.Intensity = r.Intensity
							r.object.Threshold = r.Threshold
						end)
					end
					l = b
					if l then
						pcall(function()
							b:Destroy()
						end)
					end
					b, r = nil, nil
					l = I
					if l then
						pcall(function()
							I:Destroy()
						end)
					end
					l = h
					if l then
						pcall(function()
							h:Destroy()
						end)
					end
					I, h, S = nil, nil, nil
					g()
				end
				local function g()
					local l = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
					if not l then
						return nil
					end
					local D = l:GetAttribute("MapName")
					return typeof(D) == "string" and D or nil
				end
				local function l(D)
					local K = u.get("Database", "Custom", "GameStats", "Maps", D)
					if typeof(K) ~= "table" then
						return nil
					end
					D = K.Lighting
					if typeof(D) ~= "table" then
						return nil
					end
					K = D.Properties
					if typeof(K) ~= "table" then
						return nil
					end
					return D, K
				end
				local function u()
					local D = e and G
					if D then
						pcall(function()
							e.Properties = G
						end)
						local D = q
						if D then
							local function D()
								if not p then
									return
								end
								for K, C in ipairs(R) do
									K = G[C] ~= nil
									if K then
										p[C] = G[C]
									end
								end
							end
							pcall(D)
						end
					end
					e, G, q = nil, nil, nil
				end
				local function R()
					local D = g()
					local g, K
					if D then
						g, K = l(D)
					else
					end
					D = e
					if g == D then
						return
					end
					u()
					if not (g and K) then
						return
					end
					e, G, q = g, K, nil
				end
				local function g()
					local l = H
					if l then
						H:Disconnect()
						H = nil
					end
					task.defer(O.safe(R, "ambience/preset"))
				end
				local function l(D)
					if D.Name ~= "Map" then
						return
					end
					task.defer(O.safe(R, "ambience/preset"))
					local K = H
					if K then
						H:Disconnect()
						H = nil
					end
					K = D:GetAttributeChangedSignal("MapName")
					H = K:Connect(O.safe(g, "ambience/named"))
				end
				local function g()
					return {
						Ambient = J.color("amb_indoor", Z.DEFAULT_INDOOR),
						OutdoorAmbient = J.color("amb_outdoor", Z.DEFAULT_OUTDOOR),
						ClockTime = J.num("amb_clocktime", Z.DEFAULT_CLOCK) / 10,
						ExposureCompensation = J.num("amb_exposure", Z.DEFAULT_EXPOSURE) / 100,
					}
				end
				local function D()
					local K = e
					if not K then
						return
					end
					K = not J.bool("amb_map")
					if K then
						local C = q
						if C then
							u()
						end
						return
					end
					local C, a = g(), q
					if a then
						K = true
						for g, a in pairs(C) do
							local j = q[g]
							if j ~= a then
								K = false
								break
							end
						end
						if K then
							return
						end
					end
					local g, a = {}, G
					for j, V in pairs(a) do
						g[j] = V
					end
					for j, V in pairs(C) do
						a = G[j]
						if a ~= nil then
							g[j] = V
						end
					end
					pcall(table.freeze, g)
					K = pcall(function()
						e.Properties = g
					end)
					if not K then
						return
					end
					local function e()
						if not p then
							return
						end
						for g, K in pairs(C) do
							local a = G[g]
							if a ~= nil then
								p[g] = K
							end
						end
					end
					pcall(e)
					q = C
				end
				local function e(G)
					local q, g, K, C =
						J.num("amb_brightness", 0) / 100,
						J.num("amb_contrast", 0) / 100,
						J.num("amb_saturation", 0) / 100,
						J.color("amb_tint", Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
					if
						s.object == G
						and s.brightness == q
						and s.contrast == g
						and s.saturation == K
						and s.tint == C
					then
						return
					end
					G.Brightness = q
					G.Contrast = g
					G.Saturation = K
					G.TintColor = C
					s.object = G
					s.brightness = q
					s.contrast = g
					s.saturation = K
					s.tint = C
				end
				local function G(q, s)
					if v.object == q and v.size == s then
						return
					end
					q.Size = s
					v.object = q
					v.size = s
				end
				local function q(s)
					local g, K, C =
						J.num("amb_haze_density", 30) / 100,
						J.num("amb_haze_amount", 0) / 10,
						J.num("amb_haze_glare", 0) / 10
					if m.object == s and m.density == g and m.haze == K and m.glare == C then
						return
					end
					s.Density = g
					s.Haze = K
					s.Glare = C
					m.object = s
					m.density = g
					m.haze = K
					m.glare = C
				end
				local function s(m)
					local g = r.Intensity
					local K, C =
						(if g < Z.BLOOM_FLOOR then Z.BLOOM_FLOOR else g)
							* (J.num("amb_bloom_intensity", 100) / 100),
						r.Threshold * (J.num("amb_bloom_threshold", 100) / 100)
					if B.object == m and B.intensity == K and B.threshold == C then
						return
					end
					m.Intensity = K
					m.Threshold = C
					B.object = m
					B.intensity = K
					B.threshold = C
				end
				local function m()
					if not p then
						return
					end

						end
					end

_registry["features/autofire"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("services/accuracy")
				local O = p("services/aimpoint")
				local u = p("features/autokill")
				local F = p("features/bullet")
				local f = p("services/equipped")
				local o = p("core/flags")
				local Z = p("services/frame")
				local i = p("services/gamedata")
				local y = p("services/latency")
				local P = p("services/lethality")
				local b = p("ui/library")
				local I = p("services/penetration")
				local h = p("features/ragebot")
				local A = p("services/seed")
				local T, r = p("core/service"), p("services/trace")
				local p = T.get("Players")
				local T, S, c, R, e = p.LocalPlayer, { BIND = "aim/autofire" }, 0.06, 0.2, 1.5
				local function G()
					return math.clamp(y.ours() / 1000 * e, c, R)
				end
				local y
				local c, R = 0, 0
				local function e(q)
					if not q then
						return nil
					end
					local w, H = pcall(function()
						return q:GetAttribute("Health")
					end)
					return w and typeof(H) == "number" and H or nil
				end
				local function q(w)
					if u.set() then
						return true
					end
					local H = y
					if not H then
						return true
					end
					H = not y.Parent
					if H then
						y = nil
						return true
					end
					H = e(y) ~= c
					if H then
						y = nil
						return true
					end
					H = w - R >= G()
					if H then
						y = nil
						return true
					end
					return false
				end
				local function G(w)
					local H = workspace.CurrentCamera
					if not H then
						return false
					end
					local Q, Y = O.aimOrigin(w.Parent, A.aim(H)), i.equippedInfoOf(T)
					H = Y and i.weapon(Y.Name)
					local Y, E = H and tonumber(H.Penetration) or 0, w.Parent
					H = O.aimOffset(E)
					local s, v = I.reachesPoint(Q, w.Position + H + O.spotFor(E, w), Y + F.bonus(), E)
					if s and v ~= 0 and not o.bool("rage_autowall", true) then
						return false
					end
					return s
				end
				local function I(w)
					local H = o.num("autofire_hitchance", 0)
					if H <= 0 then
						return true
					end
					if F.magic() then
						return true
					end
					if o.bool("rage_silent") then
						return true
					end
					local F = workspace.CurrentCamera
					if not F then
						return false
					end
					local Q = i.equippedInfoOf(T)
					local T, Y = Q and J.charged(Q.Name) or J.current() or 0, O.aimOrigin(w.Parent, A.aim(F))
					Q = (w.Position + O.aimOffset(w.Parent) + O.spotFor(w.Parent, w) - Y).Magnitude
					return J.chance(T, J.radiusOf(w), Q) * 100 >= H
				end
				local function J(F, T)
					local w = o.num("autofire_mindamage", 0)
					if w <= 0 then
						return true
					end
					local H = workspace.CurrentCamera
					if not H or not T then
						return false
					end
					local Q = P.at(
						T,
						F,
						O.aimOrigin(F.Parent, A.aim(H)),
						O.aimOffset(F.Parent),
						O.spotFor(F.Parent, F)
					)
					if not Q then
						return false
					end
					return P.meets(Q.health, w, i.healthOf(T) or 100)
				end
				local function O()
					if not (o.bool("autofire_enabled") or u.set()) then
						return
					end
					local F = h.target()
					if not F or not F.Parent then
						r.every("gatilho", 0.5, "fogo", "parado: o ragebot nao entregou alvo")
						return
					end
					if b.open or i.isTyping() or i.viewedCharacter() then
						return
					end
					local P = os.clock()
					if not f.canSend(P) then
						return
					end
					if not q(P) then
						return
					end
					local b = p:GetPlayerFromCharacter(F.Parent)
					if b and i.isImmune(b) then
						return
					end
					if not G(F) then
						r.every("gatilho", 0.5, "fogo", "recusa: a bala NAO CHEGA no ponto escolhido")
						return
					end
					local p = f.of("weapon")
					if not p then
						return
					end
					if not I(F) then
						r.every("gatilho", 0.5, "fogo", "recusa: hit chance abaixo do pedido")
						return
					end
					if not J(F, b) then
						r.every("gatilho", 0.5, "fogo", "recusa: dano minimo nao alcancado")
						return
					end
					r.every("gatilho", 0.5, "fogo", "ATIRA")
					b = F.Parent
					F = e(b)
					if F then
						y, c, R = b, F, P
					else
						y = nil
					end
					f.shoot(p, f.isRevolver(p) and "Secondary" or nil, "autofire")
				end
				S.refresh = function()
					local p = not (o.bool("autofire_enabled") or u.set())
					if p then
						Z.stop(S.BIND)
						y = nil
						return S
					end
					f.start()
					Z.onDraw(S.BIND, O)
					return S
				end
				S.reset = function()
					Z.stop(S.BIND)

_registry["features/autokill"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("services/gamedata")
				local O = p("game/guard")
				local u = p("services/marks")
				local F, f, o, Z = p("core/service").get("RunService"), {}
				f.enabled = false
				f.set = function()
					local p = o
					return p
				end
				local function p()
					local i = u.players(u.KILL)
					local y = not i
					if y then
						o = nil
						return
					end
					y = nil
					for P in pairs(i) do
						if J.isAlive(P) then
							y = y or {}
							y[P] = true
						else
						end
					end
					o = y
				end
				f.refresh = function()
					local J = u.any(u.KILL)
					f.enabled = J
					if J then
						p()
						local u = not Z
						if u then
							Z = F.Heartbeat:Connect(O.safe(p, "autokill"))
						end
						return f
					end
					J = Z
					if J then
						Z:Disconnect()
						Z = nil
					end
					o = nil
					return f
				end
				f.reset = function()
					local p = Z
					if p then
						Z:Disconnect()
						Z = nil
					end
					o = nil
					f.enabled = false
				end
				return f
			end
end)()

		end)
	end

_registry["features/bunnyhop"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("core/flags")
				local O, u, F, f = p("services/usercmd"), { enabled = false }, 1
				local function p(o, Z, i, y, y, P, b)
					if not u.enabled then
						return
					end
					o = not (bit32.band(y, F) ~= 0)
					if o then
						f = nil
						return
					end
					Z = P ~= true
					if Z then
						f = false
						return nil, nil, bit32.band(y, bit32.bnot(F))
					end
					i = f == false
					if i then
						f = true
						return nil, nil, bit32.bor(y, F)
					end
					f = false
					return nil, nil, bit32.band(y, bit32.bnot(F))
				end
				u.refresh = function()
					local F = J.bool("bhop_enabled")
					u.enabled = F
					if F then
						O.register("bunnyhop", 10, p)
					else
						O.unregister("bunnyhop")
						f = nil
					end
					return u
				end
				u.reset = function()
					O.unregister("bunnyhop")
					f = nil
					u.enabled = false
				end
				return u
			end
end)()


_registry["features/camera"] = (function()

return function(p)
				p("ui/connect")
				local J = p("services/equipped")
				local O = p("core/flags")
				local u = p("services/frame")
				local F = p("game/guard")
				local f = p("game/modules")
				local o = p("game/patcher")
				local Z, i, y =
					p("core/service").get("RunService"),
					{},
					{ "Scope", "Inspect", "Killcam", "Spectate", "Zoom", "Freecam" }
				local p = y[Random.new():NextInteger(1, #y)]
				i.BIND = "camera/fov"
				i.PRIORITY = Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2
				i.FOV_MIN = 1
				local y, P = 80
				i.FOV_MAX = 160
				local b, I, h = 100, false, 70
				local function A(T, r)
					local S = f.controller("CameraController")
					if typeof(S) ~= "table" or typeof(S.setFOVLock) ~= "function" then
						return
					end
					F.call(S.setFOVLock, p, T, r)
					I = T
				end
				local function p()
					local T, r, S = J.isScoped(), workspace.CurrentCamera, O.bool("cam_fov_enabled")
					local c = r and not T and not S
					if c then
						h = r.FieldOfView
					end
					local r
					if T then
						c = O.bool("cam_remove_zoom")
						if c then
							r = S and O.num("cam_fov", 70) or h
						else
						end
					else
						if S then
							r = O.num("cam_fov", 70)
						else
						end
					end
					T = not r
					if T then
						P = nil
						c = I
						if c then
							A(false)
						end
						return
					end
					r = math.clamp(r, i.FOV_MIN, i.FOV_MAX)
					A(true, math.min(r, y))
					T = r <= y
					if T then
						P = nil
						return
					end
					local h = workspace.CurrentCamera
					if h then
						pcall(function()
							h.FieldOfView = r
						end)
					end
					P = r
				end
				local function h()
					local T = f.get("Classes", "WeaponComponent", "Classes", "Viewmodel")
					if typeof(T) ~= "table" then
						return
					end
					local r = T.hide
					if typeof(r) ~= "function" then
						return
					end
					o.set("camera_viewmodel", T, "hide", function(T, ...)
						if O.bool("cam_keep_viewmodel") and J.isScoped() then
							return
						end
						return r(T, ...)
					end)
				end
				i.viewmodelBlocked = nil
				local function T()
					local r = O.bool("cam_keep_viewmodel")
					o.sync("camera_viewmodel", r, h)
					if not r then
						return
					end
					if typeof(i.viewmodelBlocked) == "function" and i.viewmodelBlocked() then
						return
					end
					if not J.isScoped() then
						return
					end
					r = J.get()
					local h = r and r.Viewmodel
					if h and h.Hidden then
						pcall(function()
							h:unhide()
						end)
					end
				end
				local function h()
					local r, S, c, R =
						O.num("cam_vm_x", 0) / b,
						O.num("cam_vm_y", 0) / b,
						O.num("cam_vm_z", 0) / b,
						math.rad(O.num("cam_vm_roll", 0))
					if r == 0 and S == 0 and c == 0 and R == 0 then
						return nil
					end
					return CFrame.new(r, S, c) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, R)
				end
				local function b()
					local r = f.get("Classes", "WeaponComponent", "Classes", "Viewmodel")
					if typeof(r) ~= "table" then
						return
					end
					local S = r.render
					if typeof(S) ~= "function" then
						return
					end
					o.set("camera_vm_offset", r, "render", function(r, ...)
						local c = S(r, ...)
						if O.bool("cam_vm_enabled") then
							local S = h()
							local h = r.Model
							if S and h then
								pcall(function()
									h:PivotTo(h:GetPivot() * S)
								end)
							end
						end
						return c
					end)
				end
				local function h()
					local r = f.controller("CameraController")
					if typeof(r) ~= "table" then
						return
					end
					local f = r.toWeaponFirePosition
					if typeof(f) ~= "function" then
						return
					end
					o.set("camera_fov_hold", r, "toWeaponFirePosition", function(...)
						local r = f(...)
						i.reassert()
						return r
					end)
				end
				local function f()
					p()
					T()
					o.sync("camera_vm_offset", O.bool("cam_vm_enabled"), b)
					o.sync("camera_fov_hold", i.needsReassert(), h)
				end
				local p = false
				local function b()
					return O.bool("cam_fov_enabled")
						or O.bool("cam_remove_zoom")
						or O.bool("cam_keep_viewmodel")
						or O.bool("cam_vm_enabled")
				end
				i.reassert = function()
					local h = P
					if not h then
						return
					end
					local h = workspace.CurrentCamera
					if not h then
						return
					end
					pcall(function()
						h.FieldOfView = P
					end)
				end
				i.needsReassert = function()
					if not O.bool("cam_fov_enabled") then
						return false
					end
					return math.clamp(O.num("cam_fov", 70), i.FOV_MIN, i.FOV_MAX) > y
				end
				i.refresh = function()
					if not b() then
						i.reset()
						return i
					end
					J.start()
					local J = not p
					if J then
						p = true
						Z:BindToRenderStep(u.id(i.BIND), i.PRIORITY, F.safe(f, "camera"))
					end
					return i
				end
				i.reset = function()
					local J = p
					if J then
						p = false
						pcall(function()
							Z:UnbindFromRenderStep(u.id(i.BIND))
						end)
					end
					J = I
					if J then
						A(false)
					end
					o.clear("camera_viewmodel")
					o.clear("camera_vm_offset")
				end
				return i
			end
end)()

local Runtime = { [14] = table.pack }
function Runtime:oh(values) return table.unpack(values, 1, values.n) end

function Runtime:Lh(destination, offset, values)
    table.move(values, 1, values.n, offset + 1, destination)
    destination.n = offset + values.n

				end

					local x = z.BLEND_STEPS
					return f.floor(_ * x + 0.5) / x
				end
				local function _(x, d, L)
					local n, M = d and 1 or 0, W[x]
					d = M == nil
					if d then
						W[x] = n
						return n
					end
					if M == n then
						return M

					d = L / z.BLEND
					M = n > M and f.min(n, M + d) or f.max(n, M - d)
					W[x] = M
					return z.quantize(M)

						end

						rH.fade = hH

								hH.shown = true
