					end)
					if not T or typeof(PH) ~= "Instance" then
						j:Destroy()
						return nil
					end
					s.own(j)
					j.Parent = t
					return { node = j, shadow = PH, adornee = X, at = 0 }
				end
				local function T(r, G)
					local l, D
					if G:IsA("BasePart") then
						l, D = G.CFrame, G.Size
					else
						local j, t, X = b(G.GetBoundingBox, G)
						if not j then
							return
						end
						l, D = t, X
					end
					if typeof(D) ~= "Vector3" then
						return
					end
					G = f.max(D.X, D.Z)
					if r.width ~= G or r.height ~= D.Y then
						r.width = G
						r.height = D.Y
						r.node.Size = S.fromScale(G * K, D.Y * K)
					end
					G = l.Position.Y - r.adornee.Position.Y
					if r.lift ~= G then
						r.lift = G
						r.node.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = A.new(0, G, 0)
					end
				end
				local function A(r, S)
					local G = JH[r]
					if G and (G.node.Parent == nil or G.adornee.Parent == nil) then
						bH(r)
						G = nil
					else
					end
					if not G then
						G = C(r)
						if not G then
							return nil
						end
						JH[r] = G
					else
					end
					if S - G.at >= z.REFRESH then
						G.at = S
						T(G, r)
					end
					return G
				end
				local function T(r, S, G, l)
					local D = A(r, l)
					if not D then
						return
					end
					if D.color ~= S then
						D.color = S
						D.shadow.Color = S
					end
					if D.fade ~= G then
						D.fade = G
						D.shadow.Transparency = G
					end
					if D.on ~= true then
						D.on = true
						D.node.Enabled = true
					end
				end
				local function A(r)
					local S = JH[r]
					if not S or S.on == false then
						return
					end
					S.on = false
					b(function()
						S.node.Enabled = false
					end)
				end
				local function b(r)
					return r ~= z.PAINT and r ~= z.SILHOUETTE and r ~= z.GLOW
				end
				local function r(S, G)
					return S == z.SILHOUETTE or S == z.GLOW or G > 0, S == z.GLOW or G > 0, b(S) and G < 1
				end
				local function S(G, l, D, K, C, j)
					if not b(l) then
						R(G)
					end
					if not j then
						if not D then
							uH(G)
						end
						if not K then
							bH(G)
						end
					end
					if not C then
						N(G)
					end
					if not K then
						A(G)
					end
					if not D then
						FH(G)
						return nil
					end
					return OH(G)
				end
				local function b(A, G)
					local l = x[A]
					if not l then
						l = {}
						x[A] = l
					else
					end
					if l.glow ~= G then
						o.clear(l)
						l.glow = G
					end
					return l
				end
				local function A(G, l, D, K, C)
					if l.fillColor ~= D then
						l.fillColor = D
						G.FillColor = D
					end
					if l.outline ~= K then
						l.outline = K
						G.OutlineColor = K
					end
					if l.fill ~= C then
						l.fill = C
						G.FillTransparency = C
					end
					if not l.outlined then
						l.outlined = true
						G.OutlineTransparency = 0
					end
				end
				local function G(l, D, K, C, j, N, x)
					K[l] = true
					K = D.material
					local t, X, OH, FH = p(D.seenFade, K), r(D.style, 0)
					local oH = S(l, D.style, X, OH, FH, false)
					if oH then
						X = D.style == z.GLOW and D.seen or D.outline
						A(oH, b(l, oH), D.seen, X, t)
					end
					if OH then
						T(l, D.seen, D.seenFade, C)
					end
					if FH then
						ZH(l, D.style, D.shape, D.seen, t, C, j)
					end
					if not K then
						return
					end
					j = Q.skinFor(K, D.pattern)
					for t, t in i(N or (F(l, C))) do
						d[t] = true
						yH(t, K, D.seen, j, x, D.seenFade)
					end
				end
				local function l(D, K, C, j)
					local N = F(D, j)
					G(D, K, C, j, N, N)
				end
				local D, K = false
				local function C()
					o.clear(d)
					local j = Z.clock()
					local N = K and f.min(j - K, 0.5) or 0
					K = j
					o.clear(B)
					local f = hH()
					local K = f[z.LOCAL] ~= nil
					if P(f) then
						local P = h.CurrentCamera
						local h, x, t, X = P and P.CFrame.Position, Y.localCharacter(), E.get()
						for E = 1, X, 1 do
							P = t[E]
							local t, t = P.player, P.alive and f[P.ally and z.ALLY or z.ENEMY] or nil
							E = t and P.character
							if E then
								B[E] = true
								if g then
									s.enter("chams/sight")
								end
								local P = m.get(E)
								if P == nil then
									local m, X = Z.clock(), M[E]
									if X and m - X.cast <= n then
										P = X.seen
									else
										local Z = E:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
										P = false
										if h and Z then
											L[1] = x
											L[2] = E
											P = v.clear(h, Z.Position, L)
										else
										end
										if X then
											X.cast = m
											X.seen = P
										else
											M[E] = { cast = m, seen = P }
										end
									end
								else
								end
								if g then
									s.leave("chams/sight")
								end
								local Z, h, v =
									P and t.seen or t.hidden, P and t.seenFade or t.hiddenFade, _(E, not P, N)
								local m, _, x = r(t.style, v)
								local r = S(E, t.style, m, _, x, true)
								local S, L = b(E, r), P and t.material or nil
								local b, n = p(h, L), t.style == z.SILHOUETTE or t.style == z.GLOW
								if r then
									A(
										r,
										S,
										Z,
										if t.style == z.SILHOUETTE
											then v <= 0 and t.outline or (v >= 1 and Z or t.outline:Lerp(Z, v))
											else Z,
										n and b or U(1, b, v)
									)
								end
								if _ then
									T(E, Z, t.style == z.GLOW and h or U(1, h, v), j)
								end
								if x then
									ZH(E, t.style, t.shape, Z, U(1, b, 1 - v), j)
								end
								if L then
									if g then
										s.enter("chams/parts")
									end
									x, m = F(E, j), Q.skinFor(L, t.pattern)
									if S.list == x and S.material == L and S.tint == Z and S.skin == m then
										for p, p in i(x) do
											d[p] = true
										end
									else
										S.list = x
										S.material = L
										S.tint = Z
										S.skin = m
										for p, p in i(x) do
											if p.Parent then
												d[p] = true
												yH(p, L, Z, m, nil, P and t.seenFade or t.hiddenFade)
											end
										end
									end
									if g then
										s.leave("chams/parts")
									end
								else
									S.list = nil
								end
							end
						end
					end
					local p, F, Z = f[z.LOCAL], f[z.WORLDWEAPON], f[z.GLOVES]
					if p or F or Z then
						f = Y.localCharacter()
						if (p or Z) and f then
							N = iH(f, j)
							if p then
								AH(f)
								G(f, p, B, j, nil, N.rest, true)
							end
							if Z then
								for P, P in i(N.gloves) do
									l(P, Z, B, j)
								end
							end
						end
						local P = O(j)
						if P then
							if F then
								for O, O in i(I(P, j)) do
									l(O, F, B, j)
								end
							end
							if p or Z then
								local O = e(P, j)
								if p then
									for P, P in i(O.groups) do
										G(P.host, p, B, j, P.parts, P.parts, true)
									end
								end
								if Z then
									for P, P in i(O.gloves) do
										l(P, Z, B, j)
									end
								end
							end
						end
						if F and f then
							for O, P in i(a) do
								O = f:FindFirstChild(P)
								if O then
									for P, P in i(TH(O, j)) do
										l(P, F, B, j)
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
					F = J
					for O, P in y(F) do
						f = d[O]
						if f then
							if P.retryAt ~= nil then
								P.retryAt = nil
								P.failedAt = nil
							end
						else
							p = P.retryAt == nil or j >= P.retryAt
							if p then
								Z = P.failedAt ~= nil and j - P.failedAt >= z.RESTORE_GRAVE
								local p, F = q(O, P, Z)
								if p then
									J[O] = nil
								else
									N = Z and not F
									if N then
										J[O] = nil
									else
										P.failedAt = P.failedAt or j
										P.retryAt = j + z.RESTORE_RETRY
										if Z then
											P.failedAt = j
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
					for p in y(V) do
						if not B[p] then
							uH(p)
						end
					end
					for p in y(fH) do
						if not B[p] then
							R(p)
						end
					end
					for p in y(JH) do
						if not B[p] then
							bH(p)
						end
					end
					Z = D and not K
					if Z then
						rH()
					end
					D = K
					if K then
						u = nil
					else
						W(j)
					end
				end
				local p = {}
				local J, O = -1, {}
				z.styleOf = function(u)
					local F, f = u or z.ENEMY, w.generation()
					u = J ~= f
					if u then
						o.clear(p)
						J = f
					end
					f = p[F]
					if f ~= nil then
						return f ~= O and f or nil
					end
					if not w.bool(F .. "_enabled") then
						p[F] = O
						return nil
					end
					f = {
						seen = w.color(F .. "_color", c.fromRGB(255, 154, 241)),
						hidden = w.color(F .. "_hidden", c.fromRGB(124, 68, 116)),
						outline = w.color(F .. "_outline", c.fromRGB(20, 20, 24)),
						material = z.material(w.str(F .. "_material", z.DEFAULT)),
						pattern = w.str(F .. "_ffpattern", Q.DEFAULT),
						seenFade = w.transparency(F .. "_color"),
						hiddenFade = w.transparency(F .. "_hidden"),
					}
					p[F] = f
					return f
				end
				z.dress = function(p, J)
					local O = z.styleOf(J)
					if not p or not O or not O.material then
						return false
					end
					for J, u in i(p:GetDescendants()) do
						if u:IsA("BasePart") and u.Transparency < 1 then
							J = u:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
							if J then
								J:Destroy()
							end
							if u:IsA("MeshPart") then
								u.TextureID = Q.skinFor(O.material, O.pattern)
							end
							u.Material = O.material
							u.Color = O.seen
						end
					end
					return true
				end
				z.refresh = function()
					local p = false
					for J, J in i(z.SIDES) do
						if w.bool(J .. "_enabled") then
							p = true
							break
						end
					end
					z.enabled = p
					if
						w.bool(z.WORLDWEAPON .. "_enabled")
						or w.bool(z.LOCAL .. "_enabled")
						or w.bool(z.GLOVES .. "_enabled")
					then
						H.start()
					end
					if p then
						local p = not pH
						if p then
							pH = k.Heartbeat:Connect(s.safe(C, "chams"))
						end
					else
						local p = pH
						if p then
							pH:Disconnect()
							pH = nil
						end
						IH()
						rH()
					end
					return z
				end
				z.reset = function()
					local p = pH
					if p then
						pH:Disconnect()
						pH = nil
					end
					IH()
					SH()
					rH()
					z.enabled = false
				end
				return z
			end
end)()


_registry["features/crosshair"] = (function()
return function(r23)
	local r15 = r23("core/flags")
	local r17 = r23("game/guard")
	local r19 = r23("game/modules")
	local r21 = r23("core/service").get("Players")

	local r23_1 = {
		enabled = false,
		STYLES = { "Classic", "Classic Static" },
		DEFAULT_STYLE = "Classic",
		DEFAULT_COLOR = Color3.new(0,1,0),
	}

	local r2 = {}
	r2[1] = "Crosshair Style"
	r2[2] = "Center Dot"
	r2[3] = "Length"
	r2[4] = "Thickness"
	r2[5] = "Gap"
	r2[6] = "T Style"
	r2[7] = "Follow Recoil"
	r2[8] = "Red"
	r2[9] = "Green"
	r2[10] = "Blue"
	r2[11] = "Outline"
	r2[12] = "Alpha"
	local r3 = nil
	local r4 = nil
	local r5 = nil
	local r6 = false

	local r7 = function()
		local s5, s6 = r17.call(function()
			local t2 = r19.get("Controllers", "DataController")
			if typeof(t2) ~= "table" then
				return nil
			end

			if typeof(t2.Get) ~= "function" then
				return nil
			end

			if typeof(t2.CreateListener) ~= "function" then
				return nil
			end
			return t2
		end)

		return s5 and s6 or nil
	end

	local r8 = function(s3)
		if r4 then
			return
		end
		r4 = {}

		for _, s7 in ipairs(r2) do
			local s9 = s3[s7]

			if typeof(s9) == "table" then
				r4[s7] = { Enabled = s9.Enabled, Value = s9.Value }
			else
				r4[s7] = s9
			end
		end
	end

	local r9 = function(s8, s9, s10, s11)
		local s2 = s8[s9]
		if typeof(s2) ~= "table" then
			s8[s9] = { Enabled = s10, Value = s11 }
			return
		end
		s2.Enabled = s10
		s2.Value = s11
	end

	local r10 = function()
		local s800001 = 3566121523
		local s800002 = 3661396522
		if not r3 then
			return
		end
		local s5 = r15.color("xhair_color", r23_1.DEFAULT_COLOR)
		local s13 = r15.opacity("xhair_color")
		r3["Crosshair Style"] = r15.str("xhair_style", r23_1.DEFAULT_STYLE)
		local s6 = r3
		local s800002_1 = bit32.bor(s800002, s800001)
		s6["Center Dot"] = r15.bool("xhair_dot")
		r3["T Style"] = r15.bool("xhair_tstyle")
		r3["Follow Recoil"] = r15.bool("xhair_recoil")
		local s9 = r3
		local t152_77_1 = table.pack(bit32.band(s800001, 4294967295))
		local t152_77_2 = table.pack(bit32.band(s800002_1, 4294967295))
		local t152_77_3 = table.pack(bit32.band(t152_77_1[1], 65535))
		local t152_77_4 = table.pack(bit32.rshift(t152_77_1[1], 16))
		local t152_77_5 = table.pack(bit32.band(t152_77_2[1], 65535))
		local s800001_1 = bit32.band(t152_77_3[1] * t152_77_5[1] + bit32.lshift(bit32.band(t152_77_3[1] * bit32.rshift(t152_77_2[1], 16) + t152_77_4[1] * t152_77_5[1], 65535), 16), 4294967295)
		s9.Length = r15.num("xhair_length", 5)
		r3.Thickness = r15.num("xhair_thickness", 1)
		r3.Gap = r15.num("xhair_gap", 0)
		r3.Red = math.floor(s5.R * 255 + 0.5)
		r3.Green = math.floor(s5.G * 255 + 0.5)
		r3.Blue = math.floor(s5.B * 255 + 0.5)
		local s9_1 = r15.num
		r9(r3, "Outline", r15.bool("xhair_outline"), s9_1("xhair_outline_size", 1))
		r9(r3, "Alpha", s13 < 1, math.floor(s13 * 255 + 0.5))
	end

	local r11 = function()
		if not r3 then
			return
		end
		r3.Thickness = 0
		r3["Center Dot"] = false
		r9(r3, "Outline", false, 0)
	end

	local r12 = function()
		if not (r3 and r4) then
			return
		end

		for _, s4 in ipairs(r2) do
			local s12 = r4[s4]

			if typeof(s12) == "table" then
				r9(r3, s4, s12.Enabled, s12.Value)
			else
				r3[s4] = s12
			end
		end
	end

	local r13 = function(s2)
		if typeof(s2) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		r3 = s2
		r8(s2)
		r23_1.paint()
	end

	r23_1.paint = function()
		if not r3 then
			return
		end

		if r6 then
			r11()
		elseif r23_1.enabled then
			r10()
		else
			r12()
		end
	end

	r23_1.mute = function(arg1)
		local s1 = arg1 == true
		if r6 == s1 then
			return
		end
		r6 = s1
		r23_1.paint()
	end

	r23_1.refresh = function()
		r23_1.enabled = r15.bool("xhair_enabled")

		if not r5 then
			local s7 = r7()

			if s7 then
				local s4, s5 = r17.call(function()
					return s7.CreateListener(r21.LocalPlayer, "Settings.Game.Crosshair", r13)
				end)

				if s4 then
					r5 = s5
				end
			end
		end

		r23_1.paint()
		return r23_1
	end

	r23_1.reset = function()
		r12()

		if r5 then
			local s2 = r7()

			if s2 and typeof(s2.RemoveListener) == "function" then
				r17.call(function()
					s2.RemoveListener(r21.LocalPlayer, "Settings.Game.Crosshair", r5)
				end)
			end
		end

		r3 = nil
		r4 = nil
		r5 = nil
		r6 = false
		r23_1.enabled = false
	end

	return r23_1
end
end)()


_registry["features/customsky"] = (function()
return function(r37)
	local r14 = r37("ui/create")
	local r15 = r37("core/flags")
	local r16 = r37("game/guard")
	local r18 = r37("core/log")
	local r2 = r37("core/service")
	local r19 = r37("services/skyboxes")
	local r20 = r2.get("Lighting")
	local r22 = {}
	local r23 = "Menu"

	local r7 = {
		"SunTextureId",
		"MoonTextureId",
		"SunAngularSize",
		"MoonAngularSize",
		"StarCount",
		"CelestialBodiesShown",
	}

	local r9 = {}

	for _, r4 in ipairs(r19.FACES) do
		table.insert(r9, r4.prop)
	end

	for _, r8 in ipairs(r7) do
		table.insert(r9, r8)
	end

	local r2_1 = { "Atmosphere" }
	local r3_1 = 12
	local r4_1 = nil
	local r6 = nil
	local r7_2 = nil
	local r8_1 = nil
	local r10 = {}
	local r11 = nil
	local r12 = nil
	local r13 = false
	local r24 = {}

	local r25 = function(s21)
		if r6 == s21 then
			return
		end

		if r6 then
			pcall(function()
				r6:Destroy()
			end)
		end

		r6 = s21

		pcall(function()
			s21.Parent = nil
		end)
	end

	local r27 = function(s2)
		local s4 = s2.ClassName
		local s6 = r10[s4]

		if s6 then
			if s6 ~= s2 then
				pcall(function()
					s6:Destroy()
				end)
			end
		end

		r10[s4] = s2

		pcall(function()
			s2.Parent = nil
		end)
	end

	local r28 = function()
		if r13 then
			return
		end

		if not r15.bool("sky_pin_clock", true) then
			return
		end

		if math.abs(r20.ClockTime - r3_1) < 0.001 then
			return
		end
		r13 = true

		pcall(function()
			r20.ClockTime = r3_1
		end)

		r13 = false
	end

	local r29 = function(s2)
		if s2.Name == "CaseFog" then
			return false
		end

		for _, s6 in ipairs(r2_1) do
			if s2:IsA(s6) then
				return true
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	local r30 = function(s16)
		if r6 then
			local s2, s3 = pcall(function()
				return r6[s16]
			end)

			if s2 then
				return s3
			end
		end

		return r24[s16]
	end

	local r31 = false

	local r32 = function()
		if not r4_1 then
			return
		end

		for _, s4 in ipairs(r9) do
			local s8 = r30(s4)

			if s8 ~= nil then
				pcall(function()
					r4_1[s4] = s8
				end)
			end
		end

		local s3_1 = nil

		if r8_1 then
			s3_1 = r19.faces(r8_1)
		end

		if s3_1 then
			for _, s10 in ipairs(r19.FACES) do
				local s2 = s3_1[s10.key]

				if s2 then
					pcall(function()
						r4_1[s10.prop] = s2
					end)
				end
			end
		end

		if not r15.bool("sky_hide_celestial", true) then
			return
		end

		if not pcall(function()
			r4_1.CelestialBodiesShown = false
			r4_1.StarCount = 0
		end) then
			if not r31 then
				r31 = true
				r18.warn("customsky", "could not hide the celestial bodies on this engine version")
			end
		end
	end

	local r33 = function(s35)
		r4_1 = r14.new("Sky", { Name = r23 })
		if not r4_1 then
			return false
		end
		table.clear(r24)
		local s1, s2, s3 = ipairs(r9)

		for _, s3_1 in s1, s2, s3 do
			local s4_1, s5 = pcall(function()
				return r4_1[s3_1]
			end)

			if s4_1 then
				r24[s3_1] = s5
			end
		end

		local s4_2, s5_1, s6 = ipairs(r20:GetChildren())

		for _, s6_1 in s4_2, s5_1, s6 do
			if s6_1:IsA("Sky") then
				r25(s6_1)
			elseif r29(s6_1) then
				r27(s6_1)
			end
		end

		r8_1 = s35
		r32()
		r4_1.Parent = r20
		return true
	end

	local r34 = function()
		if not r12 then
			r11 = r20.ClockTime
			r12 = r20:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ClockTime"):Connect(r16.safe(r28, "customsky/clock"))
			r28()
		end

		if r7_2 then
			return
		end
		local s6_1 = r20.ChildAdded

		local s8 = function(t16)
			if not r4_1 then
				return
			end

			if t16 == r4_1 then
				return
			end

			if r29(t16) then
				r27(t16)
				return
			end

			if not t16:IsA("Sky") then
				return
			end
			r25(t16)
			r32()
		end

		r7_2 = s6_1:Connect(r16.safe(s8, "customsky"))
	end

	local r35 = function()
		if r7_2 then
			r7_2:Disconnect()
			r7_2 = nil
		end

		if r12 then
			r12:Disconnect()
			r12 = nil

			if r11 then
				pcall(function()
					r20.ClockTime = r11
				end)
			end

			r11 = nil
		end

		if r4_1 then
			pcall(function()
				r4_1:Destroy()
			end)

			r4_1 = nil
		end

		if r6 then
			pcall(function()
				r6.Parent = r20
			end)

			r6 = nil
		end

		local s2_1, s3, s4 = pairs(r10)

		for _, s4_1 in s2_1, s3, s4 do
			pcall(function()
				s4_1.Parent = r20
			end)
		end

		table.clear(r10)
		r8_1 = nil
	end

	r22.refresh = function()
		if not r20 then
			return r22
		end
		local s4 = r15.str("sky_set", r19.NONE)
		if not (r15.bool("sky_enabled") and s4 ~= r19.NONE) then
			r35()
			return r22
		end

		if r4_1 and r8_1 == s4 then
			r32()

			if r15.bool("sky_pin_clock", true) then
				r28()
			elseif r11 then
				pcall(function()
					r20.ClockTime = r11
				end)
			end

			return r22
		end

		if r4_1 then
			local s6_1 = function()
				r4_1:Destroy()
			end

			pcall(s6_1)
			r4_1 = nil
		end

		if not r33(s4) then
			r35()
			return r22
		end
		r8_1 = s4
		r34()
		return r22
	end

	local r36 = function()
		r35()
		return r22
	end

	r22.reset = r36
	return r22
end
end)()

_registry["features/deatheffect/init"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("services/shotclaim")
				local O = p("features/deatheffect/catalog")
				local u = p("core/flags")
				local F = p("game/guard")
				local f = p("services/gameevents")
				local o, Z = p("core/service"), p("services/vfx/engine")
				local p = o.get("Players")
				local i = o.get("RunService")
				local o, y, P, b, I = p and p.LocalPlayer, {}, {}
				local function h()
					return { color = u.color("deathfx_color", Color3.fromRGB(255, 154, 241)) }
				end
				local function A()
					return O.byName(u.str("deathfx_effect", O.default())) or O.byName(O.default())
				end
				local function O(T, r)
					local S = A()
					if not S or not T then
						return
					end
					local A, c = pcall(S.build, h())
					if not A or typeof(c) ~= "table" then
						return
					end
					Z.play(c, T, r)
				end
				local function h()
					if #P == 0 then
						return
					end
					for A = #P, 1, -1 do
						local T = P[A]
						table.remove(P, A)
						pcall(O, T.at, T.character)
					end
				end
				local function O(A)
					if not u.bool("deathfx_enabled") then
						return
					end
					local T = A and A.deathPosition
					if typeof(T) ~= "Vector3" then
						return
					end
					local r = tonumber(A.victim)
					A = r and (p:GetPlayerByUserId(r))
					r = A and A.Character or nil
					local p, A, S = r and J.on(r), #P + 1, {}
					S.at, S.character, P[A] = p or T, r, S
				end
				y.preview = function()
					local p = o and o.Character
					local J = p and (p:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
					if not J then
						return y
					end
					P[#P + 1] = { at = J.Position, character = p }
					p = not I
					if p then
						I = i.Heartbeat:Connect(F.safe(h, "deathfx"))
					end
					return y
				end
				y.refresh = function()
					local p = u.bool("deathfx_enabled")
					local J = p and not b
					if J then
						f.start()
						b = f.on("kill", O)
					else
						local O = not p and b
						if O then
							f.off(b)
							b = nil
						end
					end
					J = p and not I
					if J then
						I = i.Heartbeat:Connect(F.safe(h, "deathfx"))
					else
						local J = not p and I and #P == 0
						if J then
							I:Disconnect()
							I = nil
						end
					end
					return y
				end
				y.reset = function()
					local p = b
					if p then
						f.off(b)
						b = nil
					end
					p = I
					if p then
						I:Disconnect()
						I = nil
					end
					table.clear(P)
					Z.reset()
				end
				return y
			end
end)()

					local _q, xq, dq, Lq, nq, Mq, tq, Xq = I(function()
						local I, pj, Jj =
							Uq:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso"),
							Uq:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"),
							Uq:FindFirstChild("Head")
						if not I or not pj or not Jj then
							return nil
						end
						local Uq, Oj, uj =
							I:FindFirstChild("Root"), pj:FindFirstChild("Waist"), Jj:FindFirstChild("Neck")
						if not Uq or not Oj or not uj then
							return nil
						end
						I = Uq.C0.Position.Y - Uq.C1.Position.Y + Oj.C0.Position.Y
						Uq = I - Oj.C1.Position.Y
						Oj = Uq + uj.C0.Position.Y
						local Fj = Oj - uj.C1.Position.Y
						return I, Oj - I, Fj - Oj, Uq - I, Jj.Size.X * 0.5, pj.Size.X * 0.5, pj.Size.Z * 0.5
					end)
					if not _q or xq == nil then
						u.resetRig()
						return false
					end
					return u.setRig(xq, dq, Lq, nq, Mq, tq, Xq)
				end
				local function I()
					local Uq = u.headAt(pH)
					local _q = (if Uq < 0 then -Uq else Uq) / JH
					local JH, Uq = _q * OH, _q * uH
					hH = JH * JH
					AH = Uq * Uq
				end
				I()
				local function JH(OH)
					local uH = Wq(OH)
					I()
					return uH
				end
				local function I(OH, uH, Wq, Uq, _q, xq, dq)
					if Uq <= 0 then
						return
					end
					local Lq = aH >= G and Uq <= DH[G]
					if Lq then
						return
					end
					Lq = aH + 1
					Lq = if Lq > G then G else Lq
					while Lq > 1 and DH[Lq - 1] < Uq do
						EH[Lq], sH[Lq], vH[Lq] = EH[Lq - 1], sH[Lq - 1], vH[Lq - 1]
						mH[Lq], BH[Lq], gH[Lq] = mH[Lq - 1], BH[Lq - 1], gH[Lq - 1]
						DH[Lq] = DH[Lq - 1]
						Lq -= 1
					end
					EH[Lq] = OH
					sH[Lq] = uH
					vH[Lq] = Wq
					mH[Lq] = _q
					BH[Lq] = xq
					gH[Lq] = dq
					DH[Lq] = Uq
					Lq = aH < G
					if Lq then
						aH += 1
					end
				end
				local function G(OH)
					aH = 0
					local uH, Wq = o.get()
					for Uq = 1, Wq, 1 do
						local _q = uH[Uq]
						Uq = _q.character
						if Uq and _q.alive and not _q.ally then
							local xq = Uq:FindFirstChild("Head")
							if xq then
								local dq, Lq, nq =
									xq.Position, i.get(Uq) == false and H or w, O[7].velocity(Uq)
								if nq then
									I(dq.X, dq.Y, dq.Z, Lq, nq.X, nq.Y, nq.Z)
								else
									I(dq.X, dq.Y, dq.Z, Lq, 0, 0, 0)
								end
								nq = Iq[_q.key]
								if not nq then
									nq = { x = 0, y = 0, z = 0, at = 0 }
									Iq[_q.key] = nq
								else
								end
								nq.x, nq.y, nq.z = dq.X, dq.Y, dq.Z
								nq.at = OH
							end
						end
					end
					for i, H in h(Iq) do
						uH = OH - H.at
						if uH > 0.5 and uH <= Q then
							local h, Iq = 1 - uH / Q, O[2].characterOf(i)
							if not Iq or not O[2].isAliveOf(Iq) then
								I(H.x, H.y, H.z, Y + (w - Y) * h, 0, 0, 0)
							end
						end
					end
					uH = iH
					if uH then
						Wq = oq - 1
						for i = 0, Wq, 1 do
							OH = eq
							local h, w = OH + Fq[i] * m, qq
							I(h, wq, w + fq[i] * m, E, 0, 0, 0)
						end
					end
					uH = aH
					for i = 1, uH, 1 do
						local I, h, w = mH[i], BH[i], gH[i]
						OH = P.sqrt(I * I + w * w)
						KH[i] = u.needed(OH)
						CH[i] = OH > q
						if CH[i] then
							kH[i] = EH[i] + I * u.MAX_EXTRAP
							zH[i] = sH[i] + h * u.MAX_EXTRAP
							lH[i] = vH[i] + w * u.MAX_EXTRAP
						else
							kH[i], zH[i], lH[i] = EH[i], sH[i], vH[i]
						end
					end
				end
				local function i(I, h, q, w, H)
					VH = 0
					local Q, Y, E = eq - h, wq - q, qq - w
					local OH = P.sqrt(Q * Q + Y * Y + E * E)
					if OH <= 0 then
						return
					end
					Q /= OH
					Y /= OH
					E /= OH
					local uH = H / OH
					OH = if uH < 0.9 then uH / P.sqrt(1 - uH * uH) * 1.15 else 4
					H, uH = P.sqrt(1 + OH * OH), I - 1
					for mH = 0, uH, 1 do
						local uH, BH, gH, Iq, Iq, Iq, Iq, Iq, Iq, Iq, Iq, Iq, Iq, Wq, Uq = O[8].read(mH)
						local _q, xq, dq = uH - h, BH - q, gH - w
						uH, I, BH, gH =
							_q * Q + xq * Y + dq * E,
							_q * _q + xq * xq + dq * dq,
							Iq * Iq + Wq * Wq + Uq * Uq,
							true
						if I > BH then
							_q = P.sqrt(I - BH)
							gH = if uH * H < _q - OH * P.sqrt(BH) then false else gH
						else
						end
						if gH then
							jH[VH] = mH
							VH += 1
						end
					end
				end
				local function I(h, q, w, H, Q, Y)
					local E, OH, uH = H - h, Q - q, Y - w
					Q = P.sqrt(E * E + OH * OH + uH * uH)
					if Q <= 0 then
						return false, false
					end
					E /= Q
					OH /= Q
					uH /= Q
					local Y, mH, BH = VH, false, true
					for gH = 0, Y - 1, 1 do
						H = jH[gH]
						if O[8].entry(H, h, q, w, E, OH, uH, Q) ~= nil then
							BH = if O[8].get(H, 16) ~= 1 then false else BH
							mH = true
						else
						end
					end
					return mH, mH and BH
				end
				local function h()
					local q = u.headAt(1)
					return (if q < 0 then -q else q) + e * 0.5
				end
				local function q(w, H)
					local Q, Y = w - eq, H - qq
					H = P.sqrt(Q * Q + Y * Y)
					if H <= 0 then
						return 1, 0
					end
					return Q / H, Y / H
				end
				local function w(H)
					local Q, Y, E, OH = EH[H], sH[H], vH[H], DH[H]
					local uH = O[8].gather(r.new(eq, wq, qq), r.new(Q, Y, E), e, Qq)
					local mH = uH == nil
					if mH then
						jq += 1
						return false
					end
					Cq += uH
					aq += 1
					i(uH, Q, Y, E, h())
					local BH, gH = q(Q, E)
					mH = QH - 1
					for jH = 0, mH, 1 do
						local VH = xH[jH]
						if VH == jH then
							dH[jH], LH[jH] = I(Q, Y, E, WH[jH], UH[jH], _H[jH])
						end
						local Q, Iq = dH[VH], Hq
						Iq = if ZH then u.yawOf(jH % YH) else Iq
						local Wq = u.EXP_HEAD * (Q and 0 or 1) + u.EXP_TORSO * u.halfWidth(Iq, BH, gH)
						Wq = if Q and LH[VH] then Wq - V else Wq
						NH[jH] = NH[jH] + OH * Wq
					end
					if CH[H] then
						Y, E, BH = kH[H], zH[H], lH[H]
						i(uH, Y, E, BH, h())
						for H = 0, QH - 1, 1 do
							mH = xH[H]
							if mH == H and dH[H] then
								if not I(Y, E, BH, WH[H], UH[H], _H[H]) then
									dH[H] = false
									NH[H] = NH[H] + OH * u.EXP_HEAD
								end
							elseif mH ~= H and dH[H] ~= dH[mH] then
								NH[H] = NH[H] + OH * u.EXP_HEAD
							end
						end
					end
					return true
				end
				local function H(Q, Y, E, V, OH, uH, mH)
					local BH, gH, kH = V - Q, OH - Y, uH - E
					local zH = P.sqrt(BH * BH + gH * gH + kH * kH)
					if zH <= 0 then
						return -mH
					end
					BH /= zH
					gH /= zH
					kH /= zH
					zH = -kH
					local lH = P.sqrt(zH * zH + BH * BH)
					local CH
					if lH < 1.0E-6 then
						zH, CH, lH = 1, 0, 1
					else
						CH = BH
					end
					zH /= lH
					CH /= lH
					local lH, jH, VH, dH =
						gH * CH, kH * zH - BH * CH, -gH * zH, if I(Q, Y, E, V, OH, uH) then 1 else 0
					dH = if I(Q, Y, E, V + zH * mH, OH, uH + CH * mH) then dH + 1 else dH
					dH = if I(Q, Y, E, V - zH * mH, OH, uH - CH * mH) then dH + 1 else dH
					dH = if I(Q, Y, E, V + lH * mH, OH + jH * mH, uH + VH * mH) then dH + 1 else dH
					return X[if I(Q, Y, E, V - lH * mH, OH - jH * mH, uH - VH * mH) then dH + 1 else dH] * mH
				end
				local function I(Q, Y, E, V, X, OH)
					Bq += 1
					local uH = p.reachesPoint(r.new(Q, Y, E), r.new(V, X, OH), j, Qq)
					return uH ~= true
				end
				S.sweepMin = function(p)
					local Q = u.headAt(1)
					local Y = u.HEAD_HALF / (if Q < 0 then -Q else Q)
					return P.asin(if Y > 1 then 1 else Y) + p * u.OWNER_PERIOD * 0.25
				end
				S.omegaFor = function(p)
					local Q = u.headAt(1)
					local Y = u.HEAD_HALF / (if Q < 0 then -Q else Q)
					Y = if Y > 1 then 1 else Y
					local Q, E, j =
						c * u.spinFloor(),
						3.141592653589793 / u.OWNER_PERIOD,
						4 * (p - P.asin(Y)) / u.OWNER_PERIOD
					j = if j < Q then Q else j
					return if j > E then E else j
				end
				local function p(Q)
					if not Q then
						return nil
					end
					return Q.PrimaryPart or Q:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				end
				local function Q(Y)
					local E = O[2].localCharacter()
					local j = p(E)
					if not j then
						return false
					end
					local V = j.Position
					Qq = E
					local X, OH, uH = V.X, V.Y, V.Z
					eq, Gq, qq = X, OH, uH
					E, uH = u.headAt(0)
					wq = V.Y + uH
					uH = j.CFrame.LookVector
					Hq = P.atan2(uH.Z, uH.X)
					G(Y)
					Y = QH - 1
					for G = 0, Y, 1 do
						V = G % YH
						OH = (G - V) / YH
						j, X = u.headAt(u.pitchOf(OH))
						uH = Hq
						uH = if ZH then u.yawOf(V) else uH
						local Y = eq
						WH[G] = Y + j * P.cos(uH)
						UH[G] = Gq + X
						Y = qq
						_H[G] = Y + j * P.sin(uH)
						NH[G] = 0
						Y = V > 0 and (j == 0 or not ZH)
						if Y then
							xH[G] = OH * YH
						else
							xH[G] = G
						end
					end
					Bq, kq, A, Rq = 0, 0, rq, 0
					return true
				end
				local function G()
					local Y = TH
					if not Y then
						return
					end
					Y = QH - 1
					for E = 0, Y, 1 do
						local Y = E % YH
						local j, V = (E - Y) / YH, Hq
						V = if ZH then u.yawOf(Y) else V
						Y = u.shortest(SH, V)
						Y = if Y < 0 then -Y else Y
						local V = P.abs(u.pitchOf(j) - rH) < 1.0E-6 and Y < 1.0E-6
						if not V then
							NH[E] = NH[E] + N + W * Y / 3.141592653589793
						end
					end
				end
				local function Y()
					local E, j = 1 / 0, 0
					for V = 0, QH - 1, 1 do
						if NH[V] < E then
							E, j = NH[V], V
						else
						end
					end
					vq = (j - j % YH) / YH
				end
				local function E()
					for j = 0, YH - 1, 1 do
						local V, X = nH[j], j
						while X > 0 and nH[tH[X - 1]] > V do
							tH[X] = tH[X - 1]
							X -= 1
						end
						tH[X] = j
					end
				end
				local function j()
					local V, X = vq * YH, ZH and YH or 1
					for OH = 0, YH - 1, 1 do
						nH[OH] = 1 / 0
						MH[OH] = false
					end
					for OH = 0, X - 1, 1 do
						nH[OH] = 0
						MH[OH] = true
					end
					kq = 0
					local OH = aH
					for uH = 1, OH, 1 do
						local QH = DH[uH]
						local mH = QH > 0
						if mH then
							local mH, BH, gH, kH = EH[uH], sH[uH], vH[uH], KH[uH]
							local uH = O[8].gather(r.new(eq, wq, qq), r.new(mH, BH, gH), e, Qq)
							local zH = uH ~= nil
							if zH then
								kq += 1
								i(uH, mH, BH, gH, h())
								local uH, zH = q(mH, gH)
								local q = X - 1
								for lH = 0, q, 1 do
									local q = V + lH
									local CH, jH = H(mH, BH, gH, WH[q], UH[q], _H[q], kH), Hq
									jH = if ZH then u.yawOf(lH) else jH
									nH[lH] = nH[lH]
										+ QH
											* (u.EXP_HEAD * u.exposure(CH, kH) + u.EXP_TORSO * u.halfWidth(
												jH,
												uH,
												zH
											))
									if CH < kH then
										MH[lH] = false
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
					OH = TH
					if OH then
						local q, OH = u.pitchOf(vq), X - 1
						for X = 0, OH, 1 do
							V = Hq
							V = if ZH then u.yawOf(X) else V
							local OH = u.shortest(SH, V)
							OH = if OH < 0 then -OH else OH
							local V = P.abs(q - rH) < 1.0E-6 and OH < 1.0E-6
							if not V then
								nH[X] = nH[X] + N + W * OH / 3.141592653589793
							end
						end
					end
					E()
				end
				local function q(E)
					local V = not ZH
					if V then
						local N = Hq
						return N, 0
					end
					V = kq == 0
					if V then
						local N = SH
						return N, 0
					end
					V = 0
					for N = 0, YH - 1, 1 do
						V = if MH[N] then V + 1 else V
					end
					if V == 0 or V == YH or E < 0 or not MH[E] then
						return u.yawOf(E < 0 and 0 or E), 0
					end
					V = E
					while MH[(V - 1) % YH] and E - V + 1 < YH do
						V -= 1
					end
					local N = E
					while MH[(N + 1) % YH] and N - V + 1 < YH do
						N += 1
					end
					E = N - V + 1
					return (u.yawOf(V) + (E - 1) * 0.5 * u.YAW_STEP) % c, (E - 1) * 0.5 * u.YAW_STEP
				end
				local function E()
					local V = ZH and YH or 1
					local N, W = if K > V then V else K, vq * YH
					local K, X = N - 1, -1
					for N = 0, K, 1 do
						V = Bq
						if V >= a then
							break
						end
						local OH = tH[N]
						N = nH[OH] < 1 / 0
						if N then
							local N, uH, QH = W + OH, aH, true
							for YH = 1, uH, 1 do
								local uH = DH[YH] >= C
								if uH then
									local C = Bq
									if C >= a then
										QH = false
										break
									end
									if not I(EH[YH], sH[YH], vH[YH], WH[N], UH[N], _H[N]) then
										QH = false
										break
									end
								end
							end
							if QH then
								Dq += 1
								X = OH
								break
							end
							Kq += 1
						end
					end
					W, V = q(X)
					mq = X
					zq = kq == 0
					K = X < 0
					if K then
						RH, eH = W, 3.141592653589793
						rH = u.SIGN * yH
					else
						rH, RH, eH = u.pitchOf(vq), Hq, V
						local q = ZH
						if q then
							RH = W
						end
					end
					TH = true
					lq += 1
					W = lq % 64 == 1
					if W then
						O[6].info(
							"dfa",
							"decisao %d T=%d anel=%d A=%.1f tubo=%.1f raios=%d rej=%d nil=%d sonda=%d",
							lq,
							aH,
							vq,
							P.deg(eH),
							aq > 0 and Cq / aq or 0,
							Bq,
							Kq,
							jq,
							Vq
						)
					end
					A = Tq
				end
				local function q(K)
					local C = aH
					for a = 1, C, 1 do
						if a ~= K and DH[a] >= DH[K] then
							return false
						end
					end
					return true
				end
				local function K()
					Vq += 1
					zq = false
					local C, a, V = aH, 0, 0
					for N = 1, C, 1 do
						if DH[N] > a then
							a, V = DH[N], N
						else
						end
					end
					if V == 0 then
						return false
					end
					local a, N, W = EH[V], sH[V], vH[V]
					C = P.atan2(W - qq, a - eq)
					for V = 1, 5, 1 do
						local X, OH = 1, 0
						if V == 2 then
							OH = 3.141592653589793
						else
							if V == 3 then
								X, OH = -1, 1.5707963267948966
							else
								if V == 4 then
									X, OH = -1, -1.5707963267948966
								else
									X = if V == 5 then 0 else X
								end
							end
						end
						local uH, QH, YH = C + OH, u.headAt(X)
						V = eq
						local C, OH, mH = V + QH * P.cos(uH), Gq + YH, qq
						YH = I(a, N, W, C, OH, mH + QH * P.sin(uH))
						if YH then
							rH = X
							RH, eH, TH = uH % c, 0, true
							return true
						end
					end
					rH, eH, TH = u.SIGN * yH, 3.141592653589793, true
					return true
				end
				local function I()
					uq = 0
					local C = -1
					for a = 0, s - 1, 1 do
						if not (XH[a] and pq[a]) then
							C = a
							break
						end
					end
					local a = C < 0
					if a then
						oq = 0
						return
					end
					local V, N, W = s - 1, -1, 0
					for X = 0, V, 1 do
						a = (C + X) % s
						X = XH[a] and pq[a]
						if X then
							if N < 0 then
								N, W = a, 0
							else
							end
							W = W + 1
						else
							local C = N >= 0 and W > 0
							if C then
								Jq[uq] = N
								Oq[uq] = W
								uq += 1
							end
							N, W = -1, 0
						end
					end
					a = N >= 0 and W > 0
					if a then
						Jq[uq] = N
						Oq[uq] = W
						uq += 1
					end
					oq = 0
					while true do
						V = oq
						if not (V < z) then
							break
						end
						local z, C, V = uq, 0, -1
						for N = 0, z - 1, 1 do
							if Oq[N] > C then
								C, V = Oq[N], N
							else
							end
						end
						if V < 0 then
							break
						end
						z, a = (Jq[V] + (Oq[V] - 1) * 0.5) * (c / s), oq
						Fq[a] = P.cos(z)
						local C = oq
						fq[C] = P.sin(z)
						oq += 1
						Oq[V] = 0
					end
				end
				local function z(C)
					Aq[1] = C
					for a = 1, k, 1 do
						C = Zq
						a = C * (c / s)
						local k, V, N, W, X = P.cos(a), P.sin(a), r.new(yq, Pq, bq), r.new, yq
						local OH, uH = X + k * v, bq
						a = W(OH, Pq, uH + V * v)
						OH = F.cast(N, a, Aq, F.BULLET)
						XH[C] = OH == nil or (OH.Position - N).Magnitude >= m
						W = XH[C]
						if W then
							OH, N, X = r.new(yq, Gq + D, bq), r.new, yq
							local W, QH, YH = X + k * v, Gq + D, bq
							a = N(W, QH, YH + V * v)
							uH = F.cast(OH, a, Aq, F.BULLET)
							pq[C] = uH == nil or (uH.Position - OH).Magnitude >= m
						else
							pq[C] = false
						end
						Zq += 1
						N = Zq >= s
						if N then
							Zq = 0
							I()
							return
						end
					end
				end
				local function F()
					local I = O[4].ours()
					I = if type(I) ~= "number" then 65 else I
					return u.OWNER_PERIOD + I / 1000 + O[7].renderDelay()
				end
				local function I(v)
					local m = sq
					if m then
						return true
					end
					m = Yq
					if m < 0 then
						return true
					end
					local k, D = v - Yq, F()
					if k < (if D < U then U else D) then
						return false
					end

						return true

							return true
						end
					end

						gq = k
						return true

								if u.exposure(r, h) > d then

								end
							end
						end
					end
					return false
				end
				local F = -1
				S.regime = function(o, i)
					local h = S.sweepMin(S.omegaFor(o))
					if i then
						return o >= h * M
					end
					return o >= h * n
				end
				S.movementYaw = function(o, i, h, r, e)
					local H, v = i * i + h * h, r and AH or hH
					if H >= v then
						r = P.atan2(h, i) + 3.141592653589793
						return r, true, u.shortest(o, r) >= 0 and 1 or -1
					end
					return o + e * R, false, e
				end
				local function o(i)
					wH = S.regime(eH, wH)
					qH = S.omegaFor(wH and eH or 3.141592653589793)
					local P, h, r = qH * i, wH and eH or 0, u.shortest(SH, RH)
					SH = (SH + (if (if r > P then P else r) < -P then -P else if r > P then P else r)) % c
					local r = h - cH
					cH += if (if r > P then P else r) < -P then -P else if r > P then P else r
					h = GH
					GH = (h + qH * i / c) % 1
				end
				local function i()
					local P = b.clock()
					local h = F < 0 and 0 or P - F
					F, h = P, if h > 0.25 then 0.25 else h

							end

								A = cq

								if f == cq then
									E()
								end
							end

				local function f(P, I, h)
					local r, R = 0, 0
					if T(h) == "Vector3" then
						r, R = h.X, h.Z
					else
					end
					local h, e, H = S.movementYaw(I, r, R, bH, IH)

				local function P(I, h, r, c, R, e, H)

					end

						return

				end

					end
					y.unregister(S.BIND)
					I, h, T, PH, bH, IH, FH, fH, oH, TH, wH, zq, kq, cH, eH, A, F, Yq, Eq, gq, sq =

							{
								Name = "BeaconTickGlow",
								AnchorPoint = h.new(0.5, 0.5),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								Visible = false,
								ZIndex = n.zbase,
								Parent = n.parent,
							}
						),
						m.get("tickGlow")
					if X and t then
						X.ImageContent = t
					end
					local r, t, OH, uH =
						q.new(
							"ImageLabel",
							{
								Name = "BeaconTipGlow",
								AnchorPoint = h.new(0.5, 0.5),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								Visible = false,
								ZIndex = n.zbase,
								Parent = n.parent,
							}
						),
						q.new(
							"ImageLabel",
							{
								Name = "BeaconTipEdge",
								AnchorPoint = h.new(0.5, 0.5),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								ImageColor3 = A.new(),
								Visible = false,
								ZIndex = n.zbase + 1,
								Parent = n.parent,
							}
						),
						q.new(
							"ImageLabel",
							{
								Name = "BeaconTip",
								AnchorPoint = h.new(0.5, 0.5),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								Visible = false,
								ZIndex = n.zbase + 2,
								Parent = n.parent,
							}
						),
						p.ARROW_GRADIENT
					local FH, fH, oH, ZH =
						q.new(
							"UIGradient",
							{
								Color = c.new({
									R.new(0, A.new(uH, uH, uH)),
									R.new(0.06, A.new(uH, uH, uH)),
									R.new(0.9, A.new(1, 1, 1)),
									R.new(1, A.new(1, 1, 1)),
								}),
								Parent = OH,
							}
						),
						m.get("outofview"),
						m.get("outofviewEdge"),
						m.get("outofviewGlow")
					if fH then
						OH.ImageContent = fH
					end
					if oH then
						t.ImageContent = oH
					end
					if ZH then
						r.ImageContent = ZH
					end
					n.beacon = {
						disc = M,
						ring = pH,
						tick = JH,
						tickGlow = X,
						tip = OH,
						tipEdge = t,
						tipGlow = r,
						tipShade = FH,
						art = "outofview",
						marks = {},
					}
					ZH = { M, JH, X, OH, t, r }
					for r, r in F(ZH) do
						_(n.beacon, r).Visible = false
					end
					return n.beacon
				end
				local function r(R)
					local _ = C[R]
					if _ then
						return _
					end
					_ = p.buildIcon(W and W.parent or j, W and W.z or p.ZBASE)
					if _ then
						_.live = {}
					end
					C[R] = _
					return _
				end
				local function R(_)
					p.hideIcon(_)
					if o(_.live) ~= nil then
						O.clear(_.live)
					end
				end
				local function _(n)
					if not n.beacon then
						return
					end
					local M = n.beacon
					M.since = nil
					M.leaving = nil
					x(M, M.disc, "Visible", false)
					x(M, M.tick, "Visible", false)
					x(M, M.tickGlow, "Visible", false)
					x(M, M.tip, "Visible", false)
					x(M, M.tipEdge, "Visible", false)
					x(M, M.tipGlow, "Visible", false)
				end
				local function n(M, t)
					local X = C[M]
					if not X then
						return
					end
					R(X)
					p.fadeArrow(X, t)
				end
				local function M(t)
					local X = C[t]
					C[t] = nil
					if not X then
						return
					end
					local function pH(JH)
						if JH then
							Z(function()
								JH:Destroy()
							end)
						end
					end
					pH(X.weapon)
					pH(X.weaponShade)
					pH(X.weaponRamp)
					t = X.beacon
					if t then
						pH(t.disc)
						pH(t.ring)
						pH(t.tick)
						pH(t.tickGlow)
						pH(t.tip)
						pH(t.tipEdge)
						pH(t.tipGlow)
						pH(t.tipShade)
					end
				end
				local t = O.create(8)
				local function X(pH, JH, OH, uH)
					if pH:WorldToViewportPoint(OH.Position).Z <= 0 then
						return nil
					end
					local FH, fH, oH = uH / 2, pH.ViewportSize, -p.MARGIN
					local ZH, iH, yH, PH, bH, IH, hH, AH, TH, rH, SH, cH, RH, eH =
						fH.X + p.MARGIN,
						-p.MARGIN,
						fH.Y + p.MARGIN,
						OH.Position,
						OH.XVector * FH.X,
						OH.YVector * FH.Y,
						OH.ZVector * FH.Z,
						p.NEAR,
						0,
						0,
						1 / 0,
						1 / 0,
						-1 / 0,
						-1 / 0
					for FH = -1, 1, 2 do
						for fH = -1, 1, 2 do
							for GH = -1, 1, 2 do
								uH = pH:WorldToViewportPoint(PH + bH * FH + IH * fH + hH * GH)
								TH += 1
								t[TH] = uH
								if uH.Z > AH then
									rH += 1
									GH, JH = J.clamp(uH.X, oH, ZH), J.clamp(uH.Y, iH, yH)
									SH, cH, RH, eH =
										if GH < SH then GH else SH,
										if JH < cH then JH else cH,
										if GH > RH then GH else RH,
										if JH > eH then JH else eH
								else
								end
							end
						end
					end
					if rH == 0 then
						return nil
					end
					OH, AH = RH - SH, eH - cH
					if AH < p.MIN_HEIGHT then
						return nil
					end
					return SH, cH, OH, AH, t
				end
				local function t(pH, JH, OH, uH)
					if OH then
						pH.leaving = nil
						pH.since = pH.since or JH
						local FH = J.clamp((JH - pH.since) / p.ARROW_FADE_IN, 0, 1)
						return FH * FH * (3 - 2 * FH), 1
					end
					pH.since = nil
					OH = pH.marks
					if not ((OH[pH.tip] or U).Visible or (OH[pH.disc] or U).Visible) then
						return nil
					end
					pH.leaving = pH.leaving or JH
					OH = J.clamp((JH - pH.leaving) / p.ARROW_FADE_OUT, 0, 1)
					if OH >= 1 then
						pH.leaving = nil
						return nil
					end
					return 1 - OH * OH * (3 - 2 * OH), uH and 0 or -1
				end
				p.fadeArrow = function(pH, JH)
					local OH = pH.beacon
					if not OH then
						return
					end
					local uH = t(OH, JH, false, true)
					if not uH then
						_(pH)
						return
					end
					JH, pH = 1 - (1 - (OH.heldFade or 0)) * uH, OH.marks
					if (pH[OH.tip] or U).Visible then
						x(OH, OH.tip, "ImageTransparency", JH)
						x(OH, OH.tipEdge, "ImageTransparency", 1 - (1 - JH) * p.ARROW_EDGE)
						x(OH, OH.tipGlow, "ImageTransparency", 1 - (1 - JH) * p.ARROW_GLOW)
					end
					if (pH[OH.disc] or U).Visible then
						x(OH, OH.ring, "Transparency", JH)
						x(OH, OH.disc, "ImageTransparency", JH)
					end
					if (pH[OH.tick] or U).Visible then
						x(OH, OH.tick, "BackgroundTransparency", JH)
						x(OH, OH.tickGlow, "ImageTransparency", 1 - (1 - JH) * p.TICK_GLOW)
					end
				end
				p.paintArrow = function(pH, JH, OH, uH, FH)
					if not OH and not pH.beacon then
						return
					end
					local fH = L(pH)
					local L, oH = t(fH, FH, OH ~= nil, false)
					if not L then
						_(pH)
						return
					end
					local t, ZH, iH, yH, PH
					if OH then
						t, ZH, iH, yH, PH =
							uH and JH.arrowColor or JH.arrowHidden,
							uH and JH.arrowFade or JH.arrowHiddenFade,
							OH[1],
							OH[2],
							OH[3]
						fH.heldX = iH
						fH.heldY = yH
						fH.heldAngle = PH
						fH.heldTint = t
						fH.heldFade = ZH
					else
						t, ZH, iH, yH, PH =
							fH.heldTint or A.new(1, 1, 1),
							fH.heldFade or 0,
							fH.heldX or 0,
							fH.heldY or 0,
							fH.heldAngle or 0
					end
					FH = oH * p.ARROW_SLIDE * (1 - L)
					if FH ~= 0 then
						uH = J.rad(PH)
						iH, yH = iH + J.cos(uH) * FH, yH + J.sin(uH) * FH
					else
					end
					ZH = 1 - (1 - ZH) * L
					FH, OH, pH =
						JH ~= nil and JH.arrowMode == p.ARROW_AVATAR,
						JH ~= nil and JH.arrowMode == p.ARROW_TICK,
						JH ~= nil and JH.arrowSize or p.ARROW_SIZE
					L = J.floor(pH * p.TICK_LONG + 0.5)
					JH = if OH
						then J.max(p.TICK_TIP_MIN, J.floor(L / p.TICK_REACH + 0.5))
						else J.max(p.ARROW_TIP_MIN, J.floor(pH * p.ARROW_TIP_SCALE + 0.5))
					oH = OH and J.floor(JH * p.TICK_SQUASH + 0.5) or JH
					d(fH, fH.tip, "Size", JH, oH)
					d(fH, fH.tipEdge, "Size", JH, oH)
					local bH, IH =
						J.floor(JH * p.ARROW_GLOW_SCALE + 0.5), J.floor(oH * p.ARROW_GLOW_SCALE + 0.5)
					d(fH, fH.tipGlow, "Size", bH, IH)
					IH = OH and "soundtip" or "outofview"
					if fH.art ~= IH then
						fH.art = IH
						uH, oH = m.get(IH), m.get(IH .. "Glow")
						if uH then
							x(fH, fH.tip, "ImageContent", uH)
						end
						if oH then
							x(fH, fH.tipGlow, "ImageContent", oH)
						end
						if fH.tipShade then
							x(fH, fH.tipShade, "Enabled", not OH)
						end
					end
					x(fH, fH.disc, "Visible", FH)
					x(fH, fH.tick, "Visible", OH)
					x(fH, fH.tickGlow, "Visible", OH and p.TICK_GLOW > 0)
					x(fH, fH.tip, "Visible", true)
					x(fH, fH.tipEdge, "Visible", p.ARROW_EDGE > 0 and not OH)
					x(fH, fH.tipGlow, "Visible", p.ARROW_GLOW > 0)
					oH, IH = nil
					if FH then
						bH, uH = J.floor(iH + 0.5), J.floor(yH + 0.5)
						d(fH, fH.disc, "Size", pH, pH)
						d(fH, fH.disc, "Position", bH, uH)
						x(fH, fH.ring, "Color", t)
						x(fH, fH.ring, "Transparency", ZH)
						if userId and fH.userId ~= userId then
							fH.userId = userId
							x(fH, fH.disc, "Image", z.headshot(userId))
						end
						local z, uH = pH * 0.5 + pH * p.TAIL_OUT - JH * p.ARROW_ART_TIP, J.rad(PH)
						oH, IH = (J.floor(iH + J.cos(uH) * z + 0.5)), J.floor(yH + J.sin(uH) * z + 0.5)
					else
						if OH then
							local z, pH, OH =
								J.max(p.TICK_THICK_MIN, J.floor(L / p.TICK_RATIO + 0.5)),
								J.floor(iH + 0.5),
								J.floor(yH + 0.5)
							d(fH, fH.tick, "Size", z, L)
							d(fH, fH.tick, "Position", pH, OH)
							x(fH, fH.tick, "Rotation", PH)
							x(fH, fH.tick, "BackgroundColor3", t)
							x(fH, fH.tick, "BackgroundTransparency", ZH)
							d(fH, fH.tickGlow, "Size", z + p.TICK_GLOW_PAD * 2, L + p.TICK_GLOW_PAD * 2)
							d(fH, fH.tickGlow, "Position", pH, OH)
							x(fH, fH.tickGlow, "Rotation", PH)
							x(fH, fH.tickGlow, "ImageColor3", t)
							x(fH, fH.tickGlow, "ImageTransparency", 1 - (1 - ZH) * p.TICK_GLOW)
							pH, OH = J.rad(PH), JH * p.TICK_SEAT
							oH, IH = (J.floor(iH + J.cos(pH) * OH + 0.5)), J.floor(yH + J.sin(pH) * OH + 0.5)
						else
							oH, IH = (J.floor(iH + 0.5)), J.floor(yH + 0.5)
						end
					end
					d(fH, fH.tip, "Position", oH, IH)
					d(fH, fH.tipEdge, "Position", oH, IH)
					d(fH, fH.tipGlow, "Position", oH, IH)
					x(fH, fH.tip, "ImageColor3", t)
					x(fH, fH.tip, "ImageTransparency", ZH)
					x(fH, fH.tipEdge, "ImageTransparency", 1 - (1 - ZH) * p.ARROW_EDGE)
					x(fH, fH.tipGlow, "ImageColor3", t)
					x(fH, fH.tipGlow, "ImageTransparency", 1 - (1 - ZH) * p.ARROW_GLOW)
					x(fH, fH.tip, "Rotation", PH)
					x(fH, fH.tipEdge, "Rotation", PH)
					x(fH, fH.tipGlow, "Rotation", PH)
				end
				local z, L, t = {}, {}, { 0, 0, 0 }
				local function pH(JH)
					local OH = L[JH]
					if not OH then
						OH = { 0, 0, 0, 0 }
						L[JH] = OH
					else
					end
					return OH
				end
				local L, JH, OH, uH, FH = {}, {}, {}, {}, 0
				local function fH(oH, ZH, iH)
					local yH = L[ZH]
					if yH then
						return JH[yH], OH[yH], uH[yH]
					end
					local PH, bH, IH, hH = ZH.Position
					if iH then
						local iH, AH, TH = B.at(PH.X, PH.Y, PH.Z)
						bH = iH ~= nil and TH > p.NEAR
						IH, hH = iH, AH
					else
						yH = oH:WorldToViewportPoint(PH)
						IH, hH, bH = yH.X, yH.Y, yH.Z > p.NEAR
					end
					if not bH then
						IH, hH = 0, 0
					else
					end
					FH += 1
					L[ZH] = FH
					ZH, yH = FH, FH
					JH[FH] = IH
					OH[ZH] = hH
					uH[yH] = bH
					return IH, hH, bH
				end
				local function JH(OH, uH, oH, ZH)
					local iH = a(uH)
					O.clear(z)
					O.clear(L)
					FH = 0
					uH = oH and iH.head or nil
					if uH then
						local a, L, FH = fH(OH, uH, ZH)
						if FH then
							local FH, yH, PH, bH, IH = uH.Position, OH.CFrame.UpVector, uH.Size.Y / 2
							if ZH then
								bH, IH = B.at(FH.X + yH.X * PH, FH.Y + yH.Y * PH, FH.Z + yH.Z * PH)
							else
								oH = OH:WorldToViewportPoint(FH + yH * PH)
								bH, IH = oH.X, oH.Y
							end
							if bH then
								yH, FH = bH - a, IH - L
								PH = J.sqrt(yH * yH + FH * FH)
								if PH >= p.HEAD_MIN then
									t[1] = a
									t[2] = L
									t[3] = PH
									z.head = t
								end
							end
						end
					end
					for a, L in F(iH) do
						uH, oH = L[1], L[2]
						if uH and oH then
							local t, FH, iH = fH(OH, uH, ZH)
							local uH, yH, PH = fH(OH, oH, ZH)
							if iH and PH then
								L = pH(a)
								L[1] = t
								L[2] = FH
								L[3] = uH
								L[4] = yH
								z[a] = L
							end
						end
					end
					return z
				end
				local function z(a, L)
					local t, pH = a:WorldToViewportPoint(L), a.ViewportSize
					L = t.Z <= 0
					if not L and t.X >= 0 and t.X <= pH.X and t.Y >= 0 and t.Y <= pH.Y then
						return nil
					end
					local OH, uH = pH.X / 2, pH.Y / 2
					local FH, fH = t.X - OH, t.Y - uH
					if L then
						FH, fH = -FH, -fH
					else
					end
					L = J.sqrt(FH * FH + fH * fH)
					if L < 1 then
						return nil
					end
					a = J.min(pH.X, pH.Y) * p.ARROW_RADIUS
					return OH + FH / L * a, uH + fH / L * a, J.deg(J.atan2(fH, FH))
				end
				p.edgeRamp = function(a, L)
					local t = p.BAR_RAMP
					local pH = O.create(t + 1)
					pH[1] = a
					pH[t + 1] = L
					for OH = 1, t - 1, 1 do
						pH[OH + 1] = a:Lerp(L, OH / t)
					end
					return pH
				end
				local function a(L)
					L = (L or p.ENEMY) .. "_"
					local t, pH, OH, uH =
						H.bool(L .. "weapon"),
						H.set(L .. "weapon_render"),
						H.num(L .. "box_thickness", 1),
						H.bool(L .. "box_outline")
					local FH = {
						box = H.bool(L .. "box"),
						name = H.bool(L .. "name"),
						health = H.bool(L .. "health"),
						bones = H.bool(L .. "bones"),
						arrows = H.bool(L .. "arrows"),
						flags = H.bool(L .. "flags"),
						flagColor = H.color(L .. "flag_color", A.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
						flagFade = H.transparency(L .. "flag_color"),
						flagGradient = H.bool(L .. "flag_color_grad"),
						flagColorB = H.color(L .. "flag_color_grad_b", A.fromRGB(124, 68, 116)),
						flagFadeB = H.transparency(L .. "flag_color_grad_b"),
						flagAngle = H.num(L .. "flag_color_grad_angle", 0),
						arrowMode = H.str(L .. "arrow_mode", p.ARROW_AVATAR),
						arrowSize = H.num(L .. "arrow_size", p.ARROW_SIZE),
						arrowColor = H.color(L .. "arrow_color", A.fromRGB(120, 200, 255)),
						arrowFade = H.transparency(L .. "arrow_color"),
						arrowHidden = H.color(L .. "arrow_hidden", A.fromRGB(70, 110, 150)),
						arrowHiddenFade = H.transparency(L .. "arrow_hidden"),
						boneColor = H.color(L .. "bone_color", A.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
						boneFade = H.transparency(L .. "bone_color"),
						boneHidden = H.color(L .. "bone_hidden", A.fromRGB(120, 100, 118)),
						boneHiddenFade = H.transparency(L .. "bone_hidden"),
						boneWidth = H.num(L .. "bone_width", 1),
						boneHead = H.bool(L .. "bone_head"),
						mode = H.str(L .. "box_mode", p.MODE_2D),
						visibleOnly = H.bool(L .. "visible_only"),
						boxColor = H.color(L .. "box_color", A.fromRGB(255, 154, 241)),
						boxFade = H.transparency(L .. "box_color"),
						hiddenColor = H.color(L .. "box_hidden", A.fromRGB(124, 68, 116)),
						hiddenFade = H.transparency(L .. "box_hidden"),
						boxGradient = H.bool(L .. "box_color_grad"),
						boxColorB = H.color(L .. "box_color_grad_b", A.fromRGB(124, 68, 116)),
						boxFadeB = H.transparency(L .. "box_color_grad_b"),
						boxAngle = H.num(L .. "box_color_grad_angle", 90),
						thickness = OH,
						padX = H.num(L .. "box_padx", 0),
						padY = H.num(L .. "box_pady", 0),
						shadow = uH,
						shadowColor = H.color(L .. "box_outline_color", A.new()),
						shadowFade = H.transparency(L .. "box_outline_color"),
						shadowOffset = H.num(L .. "box_outline_extra", p.BOX_SHADOW),
						outset = OH,
						nameColor = H.color(L .. "name_color", A.new(1, 1, 1)),
						nameFade = H.transparency(L .. "name_color"),
						nameGradient = H.bool(L .. "name_color_grad"),
						nameColorB = H.color(L .. "name_color_grad_b", A.fromRGB(124, 68, 116)),
						nameFadeB = H.transparency(L .. "name_color_grad_b"),
						nameAngle = H.num(L .. "name_color_grad_angle", 0),
						weaponIcon = t and pH.icon == true,
						weaponText = t and pH.text == true,
						weaponColor = H.color(L .. "weapon_color", p.WEAPON_TINT),
						weaponFade = H.transparency(L .. "weapon_color"),
						weaponGradient = H.bool(L .. "weapon_color_grad"),
						weaponColorB = H.color(L .. "weapon_color_grad_b", A.fromRGB(124, 68, 116)),
						weaponFadeB = H.transparency(L .. "weapon_color_grad_b"),
						weaponAngle = H.num(L .. "weapon_color_grad_angle", 0),
						barGap = H.num(L .. "health_gap", p.BAR_GAP),
						barFill = p.BAR_FILL,
						barBorder = p.BAR_BORDER,
						barMode = H.str(L .. "health_mode", p.BAR_HEALTH),
						barTop = H.color(L .. "health_top", p.BAR_TOP),
						barTopFade = H.transparency(L .. "health_top"),
						barBottom = H.color(L .. "health_bottom", p.BAR_BOTTOM),
						barBottomFade = H.transparency(L .. "health_bottom"),
						barLow = H.color(L .. "health_low", p.BAR_LOW),
						barLowFade = H.transparency(L .. "health_low"),
						barMid = H.color(L .. "health_mid", p.BAR_MID),
						barMidFade = H.transparency(L .. "health_mid"),
						barHigh = H.color(L .. "health_full", p.BAR_HIGH),

					local OH, uH = pH or p.ENEMY, H.generation()

						O.clear(L)
						t = uH
					end

						return uH
					end

				local function a(L, t)
					if t < 0.5 then
						local pH = t * 2
						return L.barLow:Lerp(L.barMid, pH),
							1 - (L.barLowFade + (L.barMidFade - L.barLowFade) * pH)
					end
					local pH = (t - 0.5) * 2
					return L.barMid:Lerp(L.barHigh, pH),
						1 - (L.barMidFade + (L.barHighFade - L.barMidFade) * pH)
				end
				local L = { nil, nil }

					local fH = Y.mine(OH)

						Y.hold(OH, fH)
						return fH

						uH = k.clear(pH, oH, L)
					else
					end
					Y.publish(OH, uH)
					return uH
				end

				p.refreshBox = function(I, e, uH, FH, oH, ZH)
					local PH = I[e]

						I[e] = PH
						return PH
					end

					if not oH then
						return ZH
					end
					PH = ZH or {}
					PH.size = bH

					PH.at = FH
					I[e] = PH

				p.TRACE_SLOW = 0.05
				p.TRACE_BEAT = 2
				local i, S, e, fH = 0, 0, 0, 0
				local function oH()
					local ZH, PH = Z(collectgarbage, "count")
					return ZH and y(PH) or 0
				end
				local function y(ZH)
					local PH = u.clock()
					local bH = i > 0 and PH - i or 0
					i = PH
					PH = q.count()
					local i = PH - S
					S = PH
					local S = Q.frames or 0
					local q = fH > 0 and S - fH or 1
					fH = S
					local fH, IH, hH = 0, 0, w.on
					if hH then
						fH = oH()
						IH, e = e > 0 and fH - e or 0, fH
					else
					end
					S = bH > p.TRACE_SLOW
					if S then
						local S, e = Q.breakdown(4)
						w.log(
							"esp",
							"LENTO dt=%.0fms quadros=%d alvos=%d cmds=%d objs=%d novos=%d heap=%dkb %+dkb%s | soma=%.1fms %s",
							bH * 1000,
							q,
							ZH,
							V.n or 0,
							PH,
							i,
							fH,
							IH,
							w.engine(),
							S * 1000,
							e .. (if S * 1000 > bH * 1000 then " (soma>dt: conta contaminada)" else "")
						)
					end
					w.every(
						"esp/frame",
						p.TRACE_BEAT,
						"esp",
						"base dt=%.0fms quadros=%d alvos=%d cmds=%d objs=%d novos=%d heap=%dkb %+dkb",
						bH * 1000,
						q,
						ZH,
						V.n or 0,
						PH,
						i,
						fH,
						IH
					)
				end
				local function i()
					local S = E.inMainMenu()
					if S then
						local e = V
						if e then
							V:begin()
							V:finish()
						end
						e = N
						if e then
							N:begin()
							N:finish()
						end
						e = W
						if e then
							W:begin()
							W:finish()
						end
						return
					end
					S = b.CurrentCamera
					local b = not S or not j
					if b then
						return
					end
					V:begin()
					N:begin()
					x = 0
					b = not OH
					if b then
						OH = true
						B.selfTest(S)
					end
					local e, q = B.beginFrame(S, Q.stamp), S.ViewportSize
					local w, x, fH, oH, ZH = q.X, q.Y, S.CFrame.Position, FH(), u.clock()
					iH, yH = yH > 0 and J.min(ZH - yH, 0.1) or 0.016666666666666666, ZH
					b, q = uH(), s.players(s.ESP)
					O.clear(h)
					T = 0
					O.clear(A)
					local u, uH = g.get()
					local g = E.viewedPlayer()
					d = uH > 0 and d % uH or 0
					O.clear(L)
					local O, FH = uH - 1, 0
					for iH = 0, O, 1 do
						if FH >= p.BOX_REFRESH then
							break
						end
						local yH = u[(d + iH) % uH + 1]
						iH = yH.alive and yH.character or nil
						if iH then
							yH = l[iH]
							if yH == nil or ZH - yH.at >= p.BOX_MAX_AGE then
								L[iH] = true
								FH += 1
							else
							end
						else
						end
					end
					for FH = 1, uH, 1 do
						O = u[FH]
						local uH, iH, yH, PH =
							L[O.character] == true, O.player, O.key, O.ally and p.ALLY or p.ENEMY
						FH = if O.alive and (g == nil or iH ~= g) then (I(iH, PH, q, b, h)) else nil
						local I, h = FH and O.character
						local q, L = false, false
						if I then
							local bH, IH = Z(I.GetPivot, I)
							h = if bH then IH else h
						else
						end
						if h then
							PH = h.Position
							L = e and B.visible(PH.X, PH.Y, PH.Z, 0)
							q = L or not e or B.visible(PH.X, PH.Y, PH.Z, p.MARGIN)
						else
						end
						local Z, bH, IH, hH, AH, TH = I ~= nil and FH.arrows and h ~= nil and not L
						PH = false
						if I and q then
							local q = p.refreshBox(l, I, h, ZH, p.BOX_REFRESH, uH)
							if q then
								local l = q.offset and h * q.offset or h
								PH = t(fH, I, l, q.size)
								if Y(FH.mode) or not e then
									bH, IH, hH, AH, TH = X(S, I, l, q.size)
								else
									P[1], P[2], P[3], P[4], P[5], P[6], P[7], P[8], P[9], P[10], P[11], P[12] =
										l:GetComponents()
									a[1] = q.size.X
									a[2] = q.size.Y
									a[3] = q.size.Z
									local q, Y, l, L, X = B.corners(P, a, U)
									if q > 0 and Y then
										local P, q, B, a =
											J.clamp(Y, -p.MARGIN, w + p.MARGIN),
											J.clamp(l, -p.MARGIN, x + p.MARGIN),
											J.clamp(L, -p.MARGIN, w + p.MARGIN),
											J.clamp(X, -p.MARGIN, x + p.MARGIN)
										if a - q >= p.MIN_HEIGHT then
											bH, IH, hH, AH = P, q, B - P, a - q
										else
										end
									else
									end
								end
							else
							end
						else
							PH = if Z then (t(fH, I, h, nil)) else PH
						end
						uH = I ~= nil and (PH or not FH.visibleOnly) or Z
						if uH then
							local P = r(yH)
							local r, q, w
							if Z then
								r, q, w = z(S, h.Position)
							else
							end
							local Z
							if r then
								c[1] = r
								c[2] = q
								c[3] = w
								Z = c
							else
							end
							p.paintArrow(P, FH, Z, PH, ZH)
							A[yH] = true
							T += 1
							if bH then
								local Z, h, r, c, q = O.health, O.maxHealth
								if FH.flags then
									local w = Z and h and h > 0 and Z / h or nil
									r, c, q = v.of(iH, I, oH, w)
								else
								end
								m.name = iH and G.of(iH) or G.ofName(O.name)
								m.weapon = (FH.weaponIcon or FH.weaponText) and iH and E.equippedOf(iH) or nil
								m.health = Z
								m.maxHealth = h
								m.corners = TH
								m.sight = PH
								m.bones = FH.bones and JH(S, I, FH.boneHead, e) or nil
								m.flags = r
								m.clocks = c
								m.icons = q
								m.hasIcon = FH.weaponIcon and pH(m.weapon) ~= nil or false
								Z = k(FH.mode) and N or V
								p.emit(Z, bH, IH, hH, AH, FH, m)
								p.paintIcon(P, bH, IH, hH, AH, FH, m)
								local I, h = J.floor(bH - FH.padX), J.floor(IH - FH.padY)
								o(
									Z,
									P,
									FH,
									m,
									I + J.ceil(hH + FH.padX * 2) + p.FLAG_GAP + FH.outset,
									h - FH.outset
								)
							else
								R(P)
							end
						end
					end
					e = d
					d = e + p.BOX_REFRESH
					b = C
					for J in f(b) do
						if not A[J] then
							n(J, ZH)
							if J.Parent == nil then
								M(J)
							end
						end
					end
					b = D.main and D.main.Visible
					if b then
						O, x, g = D.main.AbsolutePosition, D.main.AbsoluteSize, V
						g:occlude(O.X, O.Y, x.X, x.Y)
						u = N
						u:occlude(O.X, O.Y, x.X, x.Y)
					else
						V:occlude()
						N:occlude()
					end
					V:finish()
					N:finish()
					y(T)
				end
				p.attach = function(J)
					j = J
					V = K.layer(p.BIND, p.ZBASE, { parent = J })
					N = K.layer(p.BIND .. "/fade", p.ZBASE, { parent = J, tier = "instance" })
					W = K.layer(p.BIND .. "/arrow", p.ZBASE + 1, { tier = "instance", parent = J })
					return p
				end
				p.ENEMY = "esp"
				p.ALLY = "esp_ally"
				p.SIDES = { p.ENEMY, p.ALLY }
				p.PIECES = { "box", "name", "health", "bones", "arrows", "flags" }
				p.refresh = function()
					local J = false
					for O, O in F(p.SIDES) do
						for u, u in F(p.PIECES) do
							if H.bool(O .. "_" .. u) then
								J = true
								break
							end
						end
						if J then
							break
						end
					end
					J = if s.any(s.ESP) then true else J
					p.enabled = J
					if J then
						Q.onDraw(p.BIND, i)
					else
						Q.stop(p.BIND)
						local J = V
						if J then
							V:clear()
						end
						J = N
						if J then
							N:clear()
						end
						J = C
						for O, O in f(J) do
							R(O)
							_(O)
						end
					end
					return p
				end
				p.reset = function()
					Q.stop(p.BIND)
					C, j = {}, nil
					p.enabled = false
					OH = false
				end
				return p
			end
end)()

return function(p)
				local J, O, u, F, f, o, Z, i, y, P, b, I, h, A, T, r, S =

				local N = p("core/service")
				local p = N.get("Players")
				local W = N.get("ReplicatedStorage")
				local U = N.get("RunService")
				local _, x =
					N.get("UserInputService"),
					{
						WIDTH = 420,
						GAP = 8,
						HEADER = 34,
						TARGET_W = 62,
						TARGET_H = 150,
						HEALTH = 68,
						MAX_HEALTH = 100,
						DEPTH_X = 16,

						DEPTH_SHRINK = 6,
						SOURCE_ENEMY = "enemy",
						SOURCE_ALLY = "teammate",
						SOURCE_AVATAR = "yourself",
					}
				x.SOURCES = {
					{
						key = x.SOURCE_ENEMY,
						icon = "crosshair",
						label = "enemy",
						tip = "the rig of the side you are playing against",
					},
					{ key = x.SOURCE_ALLY, icon = "users", label = "teammate", tip = "the rig of your own side" },
					{
						key = x.SOURCE_AVATAR,
						icon = "roblox",
						label = "yourself",
						tip = "your roblox avatar, fetched from your profile",
					},
				}
				local N, d, L =
					{ Terrorists = "Anarchist", ["Counter-Terrorists"] = "IDF" },
					{ Terrorists = "Counter-Terrorists", ["Counter-Terrorists"] = "Terrorists" }
				local function n(M)
					local t = m.teamOf(p.LocalPlayer)
					t = Z(t) == "string" and t or nil
					if not t then
						return nil
					end
					return M == x.SOURCE_ENEMY and (d[t] or t) or t
				end
				local function d(M)
					local t = n(M)
					if not t then
						return M == x.SOURCE_ENEMY and "Anarchist" or "IDF"
					end
					return N[t] or "IDF"
				end
				local function N(M, t, X)
					if t == x.SOURCE_AVATAR then
						return nil
					end
					local pH = n(t)
					if not pH then
						return nil
					end
					local n = c.forPlayer(t == x.SOURCE_ALLY, pH)
					if not n then
						return nil
					end
					if K.request(n.source, n.ref) ~= "ready" then
						return nil
					end
					pH = K.clone(n.source, n.ref)
					if not pH then
						return nil
					end
					n = R.apply(M, pH, X)
					if not n then
						return nil
					end
					L = n
					return n.copy
				end
				local c = {
					[x.SOURCE_ENEMY] = { chams = s.ENEMY, esp = H.ENEMY },
					[x.SOURCE_ALLY] = { chams = s.ALLY, esp = H.ALLY },
					[x.SOURCE_AVATAR] = { chams = s.ALLY, esp = H.ALLY },
				}
				x.FIT = 1.7
				x.EYE = 0.55
				x.SPIN = 0.12
				x.FADE = 0.14
				x.RESUME_HOVER = 6
				x.RESUME_DRAG = 40
				x.DRAG = 0.011
				local K, n, M, t, X
				local pH = {}
				x.SLIDE = 34
				x.SWITCH = S.new(0.2, r.EasingStyle.Quad, r.EasingDirection.Out)
				local JH, OH, uH, FH = true
				local fH, oH, ZH, iH, yH, PH, bH, IH, hH = 26, 0.25, 1.15
				local AH, TH, rH = 0
				local SH, cH = 0
				local RH, eH = 22, 14
				local GH = S.new(0.16, r.EasingStyle.Quad, r.EasingDirection.Out)
				local S
				local qH = {}
				x.SOURCE_FLAG = "preview_source"
				local function wH()
					local HH = g.options and g.options[x.SOURCE_FLAG]
					local QH = HH and (HH:Get())
					return Z(QH) == "string" and QH or x.SOURCE_ENEMY
				end
				local function Z(HH)
					local QH, YH, EH = E.get(), wH(), qH
					for sH, vH in f(EH) do
						local EH = sH == YH
						vH.glyph.ImageColor3 = EH and QH or Y.get("faint")
						vH.glyph.ImageTransparency = EH and 0 or 0.35
						vH.label.TextColor3 = QH
						sH = vH.label.AbsoluteSize.X
						local Y = EH and (if sH <= 0 then #vH.label.Text * 8 else sH) or 0
						if vH.want ~= Y then
							vH.want = Y
							sH = h.fromOffset(Y, RH)
							if HH then
								vH.holder.Size = sH
							else
								l.to(vH.holder, GH, { Size = sH })
							end
						end
						vH.label.TextTransparency = EH and 0 or 1
					end
				end
				local Y = 0
				local GH = P.new(0, 0, -1)
				local HH, QH, YH, EH = P.zero, 10, false
				local sH, vH = false, 0
				local function mH(BH, gH, kH, zH)
					local lH, DH = O.create(8), 0
					for KH = -1, 1, 2 do
						for CH = -1, 1, 2 do
							for aH = -1, 1, 2 do
								local jH = aH > 0
								aH = jH and x.DEPTH_SHRINK or 0
								local VH, NH =
									BH + (KH < 0 and aH or kH - aH), gH + (CH < 0 and aH or zH - aH)
								if jH then
									VH, NH = VH + x.DEPTH_X, NH - x.DEPTH_Y
								else
								end
								DH += 1
								lH[DH] = P.new(VH, NH, 1)
							end
						end
					end
					return lH
				end
				local function BH(gH)
					if not gH then
						return nil
					end
					local kH, zH = o(function()
						return gH:Clone()
					end)
					return kH and zH or nil
				end
				local function gH(kH)
					if not p then
						return nil
					end
					local zH = kH ~= x.SOURCE_ENEMY
					for lH, lH in F(p:GetPlayers()) do
						if lH ~= p.LocalPlayer then
							kH = m.characterOf(lH)
							if kH and m.isAlly(lH) == zH then
								return kH
							end
						end
					end
					return nil
				end
				local kH
				local zH, lH, DH, KH = "idle", 5, 2, 0
				local function CH()
					local aH = zH == "loading" or zH == "ready"
					if aH then
						return
					end
					local aH = p.LocalPlayer
					if not aH then
						return
					end
					zH = "loading"
					y.spawn(function()
						local jH, VH = v.callAsGame(function()
							local NH = aH.UserId
							return p:CreateHumanoidModelFromUserId(NH)
						end)
						local NH = jH and "modelo nil" or i(VH)
						if not (jH and VH) then
							local WH, UH = v.callAsGame(function()
								local _H = aH.UserId
								return p:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(_H)

						if k then
							zH = "failed"
							return
						end
						KH += 1
						zH = "idle"

							local y = zH
							if y == "idle" then
								CH()
							end
						end)
					end)
				end
				local function y(v)
					local k = v == x.SOURCE_AVATAR
					if k then
						local lH = zH == "ready"
						if lH then
							local DH = kH
							return BH(DH)
						end
						lH = zH
						if lH == "idle" then
							CH()
						end
						return nil

				local function v(k)

					end
					W = bH
					if W then

							o(function()
								y:Destroy()
							end)
						end
					end

							y.PlatformStand = true
							y:ChangeState(r.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
						end)

				local function y()

					N.CFrame = W(d + k * QH, HH)
				end
				local function T()
					local k = wH()
					local N, W =
						s.styleOf(c[k] and c[k].chams),
						k == x.SOURCE_AVATAR and (p.LocalPlayer and p.LocalPlayer.Character) or (gH(k))
					local s, d =
						k .. "|" .. zH .. "|" .. i(m.teamOf(p.LocalPlayer)) .. "|" .. i(W) .. "|" .. (N and i(
							N.seen
						) .. i(N.material) .. i(N.seenFade) or "off"),
						IH
