						return
					end
					cH = s
					d = bH and rH == nil
					if d then
						rH = "out"
					end
				end
				local function i(s)
					local k = iH
					if not k then
						return
					end
					k = rH == nil
					if k then
						local N = cH and not bH
						if N then
							IH, cH = cH, nil
							v(wH())
							rH, SH = "in", 1
						end
						return
					end
					k = rH == "out"
					if k then
						local k, N = J.min, SH
						SH = k(N + s / x.FADE, 1)
						iH.ImageTransparency = SH
						N = SH >= 1
						if N then
							IH, cH = cH or IH, nil
							v(wH())
							rH = "in"
						end
						return
					end
					local v, k = J.max, SH
					SH = v(k - s / x.FADE, 0)
					iH.ImageTransparency = SH
					s = SH <= 0
					if s then
						rH = nil
					end
				end
				local function s(v, k, N, W, d)
					local GH = v:PointToObjectSpace(d)
					d = -GH.Z
					if d <= 0.05 then
						return nil
					end
					local v, HH = GH.X / (d * k * N), GH.Y / (d * k)
					return (v * 0.5 + 0.5) * W.X, (0.5 - HH * 0.5) * W.Y
				end
				local function v(k)
					local N = not PH or not bH
					if N then
						return nil
					end
					local N, W = PH.CFrame, J.tan(J.rad(PH.FieldOfView) / 2)
					return N, W, k.X / k.Y
				end
				local k
				local function N()
					local W = not bH
					if W then
						k = nil
						return nil
					end
					W = bH:GetPivot()
					local d = k and k.model == bH and k.pivot == W
					if d then
						local GH = k
						return GH
					end
					local GH, HH, QH = o(function()
						local BH = bH
						return BH:GetBoundingBox()
					end)
					if not GH or not HH or not QH then
						HH, QH = nil, nil
					else
					end
					GH, d = {}, H.BONES
					for BH, gH in F(d) do
						local lH = bH
						local DH, aH = lH:FindFirstChild(gH[1], true), bH
						lH = aH:FindFirstChild(gH[2], true)
						if DH and lH and DH:IsA("BasePart") and lH:IsA("BasePart") then
							GH[BH] = { DH.Position, lH.Position }
						end
					end
					d = bH:FindFirstChild("Head", true)
					k = {
						model = bH,
						pivot = W,
						boxCF = HH,
						extent = QH,
						bones = GH,
						headAt = (if d and not d:IsA("BasePart") then nil else d)
								and (if d and not d:IsA("BasePart") then nil else d).Position
							or nil,
						headHalf = (if d and not d:IsA("BasePart") then nil else d)
								and (if d and not d:IsA("BasePart") then nil else d).Size.Y / 2
							or 0,
					}
					W = k
					return W
				end
				local function W(d, GH)
					local HH, QH, BH = v(d)
					if not HH then
						return nil
					end
					local gH = N()
					if not gH then
						return nil
					end
					local lH = O.create(#H.BONES)
					for O, DH in f(gH.bones) do
						local f, aH = s(HH, QH, BH, d, DH[1])
						local jH, VH = s(HH, QH, BH, d, DH[2])
						if f and jH then
							lH[O] = { f, aH, jH, VH }
						end
					end
					if GH and gH.headAt then
						local O = gH.headAt
						local f, GH = s(HH, QH, BH, d, O)
						local DH, aH = s(HH, QH, BH, d, O + HH.UpVector * gH.headHalf)
						if f and DH then
							local d, HH = DH - f, aH - GH
							O = J.sqrt(d * d + HH * HH)
							if O >= H.HEAD_MIN then
								lH.head = { f, GH, O }
							end
						end
					end
					return lH
				end
				local function O(f)
					local d, GH, HH = v(f)
					if not d then
						return nil
					end
					local v = N()
					if not v then
						return nil
					end
					local N, QH = v.boxCF, v.extent
					local BH = not N
					if BH then
						local gH, lH, DH = o(function()
							local aH = bH
							return aH:GetBoundingBox()
						end)
						if not gH or not lH or not DH then
							return nil
						end
						v.boxCF = lH
						v.extent = DH
						N, QH = lH, DH
					else
					end
					local gH, lH, DH, aH, jH = QH / 2, 1 / 0, -1 / 0, 1 / 0, -1 / 0
					for QH = -1, 1, 2 do
						for VH = -1, 1, 2 do
							for NH = -1, 1, 2 do
								v = N * P.new(gH.X * QH, gH.Y * VH, gH.Z * NH)
								NH, BH = s(d, GH, HH, f, v)
								if NH then
									lH, DH, aH, jH =
										if NH < lH then NH else lH,
										if NH > DH then NH else DH,
										if BH < aH then BH else aH,
										if BH > jH then BH else jH
								else
								end
							end
						end
					end
					if lH > DH then
						return nil
					end
					return lH, aH, DH - lH, jH - aH
				end
				local f
				local function P(s)
					local v = not K or not n or not X or not M
					if v then
						return
					end
					v = not t or not t.Visible
					if v then
						return
					end
					v = K.Visible
					if not v then
						return
					end
					v = n.AbsoluteSize
					if v.X <= 0 or v.Y <= 0 then
						return
					end
					Z(true)
					T()
					i(J.min(s or 0.016666666666666666, 0.1))
					j.step(s)
					local i = hH
					if i then
						local T = wH() == x.SOURCE_AVATAR and zH ~= "ready"
						hH.Visible = T
						if T then
							local T, N = J.min(s or 0.016666666666666666, 0.1), AH
							AH = (N + ZH * 360 * T) % 360
							hH.Rotation = AH
						end
					end
					i = not sH and not YH and u.clock() >= vH
					if i then
						local T, N = J.min(s or 0.016666666666666666, 0.1), Y
						Y = (N + x.SPIN * 3.141592653589793 * 2 * T) % 6.283185307179586
					end
					y()
					local y, T, N, d = O(v)
					if not y then
						y, T, N = (v.X - x.TARGET_W) / 2, (v.Y - x.TARGET_H) / 2, x.TARGET_W
						d = x.TARGET_H
					else
					end
					i = c[wH()] or c[x.SOURCE_ENEMY]
					s = H.style(i.esp)
					local O, ZH, GH
					if s.flags then
						O, ZH, GH = C.sample()
					else
					end
					i = (s.weaponIcon or s.weaponText) and m.equippedOf(p.LocalPlayer) or nil
					pH.name = p.LocalPlayer and e.of(p.LocalPlayer) or "player"
					pH.health = x.HEALTH
					pH.maxHealth = x.MAX_HEALTH
					pH.sight = true
					pH.weapon = i
					pH.hasIcon = s.weaponIcon and H.iconFor(i) ~= nil or false
					pH.bones = s.bones and W(v, s.boneHead) or nil
					pH.flags = O
					pH.clocks = ZH
					pH.icons = GH
					pH.corners = mH(y - s.padX, T - s.padY, N + s.padX * 2, d + s.padY * 2)
					X:begin()
					H.emit(X, y, T, N, d, s, pH)
					H.paintIcon(M, y, T, N, d, s, pH)
					local p, O, i = J.floor(y - s.padX), J.floor(T - s.padY), J.ceil(N + s.padX * 2)
					H.emitFlags(X, M, s, pH, p + i + H.FLAG_GAP + s.outset, O - s.outset)
					X:finish()
				end
				local function p()
					local J = t ~= nil and t.Visible

				end
				local b = { ["HE Grenade"] = true, Molotov = true, ["Incendiary Grenade"] = true }
				p.SAFE_COLOR = A.fromRGB(120, 210, 230)
				p.HARM_COLOR = A.fromRGB(255, 140, 60)
				local v = { fire = "burning", smoke = "smoked" }
				local function K(C)
					if C.kind == "fire" then
						return true
					end
					if C.kind == "smoke" then
						return false
					end
					return b[C.weapon] == true
				end
				local function b(C)
					if K(C) then
						return w.color("esp_util_harm_color", p.HARM_COLOR)
					end
					return w.color("esp_util_safe_color", p.SAFE_COLOR)
				end
				local K, C, a = {}
				local function j(V)
					if V.phase == "end" then
						K[V.id] = nil
						return
					end
					if V.phase == "move" then
						local N = K[V.id]
						if N and V.position then
							N.position = V.position
						end
						return
					end
					if not V.position then
						return
					end
					local N, W = V.duration, F.clock()
					local U, _ = V.id, { kind = V.kind, position = V.position, born = W }
					_.expires, _.total, K[U] = N and N > 0 and W + N or nil, N, _
				end
				local function V(N)
					return N.PrimaryPart or N:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
				end
				local function N(W, U)
					local _ = {}
					for x, d in o(K) do
						if d.expires and d.expires <= W then
							K[x] = nil
						elseif d.position then
							O.insert(
								_,
								{
									kind = d.kind,
									position = d.position,
									born = d.born,
									left = d.expires and d.expires - W or nil,
									total = d.total,
								}
							)
						end
					end
					W = {}
					for x, d in f(z:GetTagged("Grenade")) do
						W[d.Name] = true
						if d:IsDescendantOf(P) then
							x = V(d)
							if x then
								local L, n =
									O.insert,
									{ kind = "grenade", weapon = d:GetAttribute("GrenadeName"), position = x.Position }
								n.landing, n.born = D[d.Name], 0
								L(_, n)
							end
						end
					end
					y(W)
					O.sort(_, function(y, W)
						local x, d = B[y.kind] and B[y.kind].rank or 0, B[W.kind] and B[W.kind].rank or 0
						if x ~= d then
							return x > d
						end
						return (y.position - U).Magnitude < (W.position - U).Magnitude
					end)
					return _
				end
				p.TRAIL_LIFE = 1.5
				p.TRAIL_WIDTH = 0.15
				p.TRAIL_COLOR = A.fromRGB(200, 200, 210)
				local y, W, U = {}
				local function _()
					local x = w.color("esp_util_trail_color", p.TRAIL_COLOR)
					local d = W ~= x or not U
					if d then
						W = x
						U = R.new(x)
					end
					x = U
					return x
				end
				local function R(W)
					local U, x = y[W], _()
					if U then
						if U.Color ~= x then
							U.Color = x
						end
						return
					end
					U = V(W)
					if not U then
						return
					end
					local V, _ =
						q.new("Attachment", { Position = I.new(0, p.TRAIL_WIDTH / 2, 0), Parent = U }),
						q.new("Attachment", { Position = I.new(0, -p.TRAIL_WIDTH / 2, 0), Parent = U })
					y[W] = q.new(
						"Trail",
						{
							Attachment0 = V,
							Attachment1 = _,
							Color = x,
							Transparency = S.new({ c.new(0, 0.05), c.new(0.55, 0.45), c.new(1, 1) }),
							WidthScale = S.new({ c.new(0, 1), c.new(1, 0.05) }),
							Lifetime = p.TRAIL_LIFE,
							LightEmission = 1,
							LightInfluence = 0,
							FaceCamera = true,
							MinLength = 0.05,
							Parent = U,
						}
					)
				end
				local function I()
					for S, c in o(y) do
						if not S:IsDescendantOf(P) then
							Z(function()
								c:Destroy()
							end)
							y[S] = nil
						end
					end
				end
				local S, c, V, W = {}
				local U, _ = false, {}
				local function x(d, L)
					local n = d.marks
					if not n then
						n = {}
						d.marks = n
					else
					end
					d = n[L]
					if not d then
						d = {}
						n[L] = d
					else
					end
					return d
				end
				local function d(L, n, M, t)
					local X = x(L, n)
					if X[M] == t then
						return
					end
					X[M] = t
					n[M] = t
				end
				local function L(n, M, t, X, pH)
					local JH = x(n, M)
					n = JH[t]
					if n then
						if n[1] == X and n[2] == pH then
							return
						end
					else
						n = { 0, 0 }
						JH[t] = n
					end
					n[1] = X
					n[2] = pH
					M[t] = T.fromOffset(X, pH)
				end
				local function x(n, M)
					return ((n.marks or _)[M] or _).Visible == true
				end
				local _ = {}
				local function n(M)
					if not M then
						return nil
					end
					local t = _[M]
					if t ~= nil then
						return t or nil
					end
					local t, X = E.get(M), E.bytes(M)
					_[M] = (t or X) and { content = t, bytes = X } or false
					return _[M] or nil
				end
				local _
				local M, t, X = {}, {}, 0
				p.WIDTH_MEMO = 4096
				local function pH(JH)
					if JH == nil or JH == "" then
						return 0
					end
					local OH = t[JH]
					if OH then
						return OH
					end
					OH = _
					if not OH then
						return nil
					end
					d(M, _, "Text", JH)
					OH = _.TextBounds
					OH = OH and OH.X or 0
					if OH <= 0 then
						return nil
					end
					local M = X
					local uH = M >= p.WIDTH_MEMO
					if uH then
						O.clear(t)
						X = 0
					end
					t[JH] = OH
					X += 1
					return OH
				end
				local function M(JH, OH, uH, FH, fH, oH)
					local ZH, iH, yH, PH =
						{
							Name = JH,
							AnchorPoint = h.new(0.5, FH),
							Size = T.fromOffset(fH, oH),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							ScaleType = r.ScaleType.Slice,
							Visible = false,
							ZIndex = uH,
							Parent = OH,
						},
						E.get("shadow"),
						E.dimensions("shadow")
					if iH and yH and PH then
						OH, JH = E.shadowSlice()
						ZH.ImageContent = iH
						ZH.SliceCenter = e.new(JH, JH, yH - JH, PH - JH)
					end
					return q.new("ImageLabel", ZH)
				end
				local function e()
					local JH = W and W.parent or c
					if not JH then
						return nil
					end
					local OH = W and W.z or p.ZBASE
					local uH, FH, fH, oH, ZH, iH =
						M("UtilityGlow", JH, OH, 0, p.WIDTH, p.GLYPH),
						q.new(
							"ImageLabel",
							{
								Name = "UtilityGlyphShade",
								Size = T.fromOffset(p.GLYPH, p.GLYPH),
								AnchorPoint = h.new(0.5, 0),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								ScaleType = r.ScaleType.Fit,
								ImageColor3 = A.new(),
								Visible = false,
								ZIndex = OH + 1,
								Parent = JH,
							}
						),
						q.new(
							"ImageLabel",
							{
								Name = "UtilityGlyph",
								Size = T.fromOffset(p.GLYPH, p.GLYPH),
								AnchorPoint = h.new(0.5, 0),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								ScaleType = r.ScaleType.Fit,
								Visible = false,
								ZIndex = OH + 2,
								Parent = JH,
							}
						),
						E.get("tooltipArrow"),
						{
							Name = "UtilityArrowShade",
							AnchorPoint = h.new(0.5, 0.5),
							Size = T.fromOffset(p.ARROW_SIZE, p.ARROW_SIZE),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							ScaleType = r.ScaleType.Fit,
							ImageColor3 = A.new(),
							Visible = false,
							ZIndex = OH + 1,
							Parent = JH,
						},
						{
							Name = "UtilityArrow",
							AnchorPoint = h.new(0.5, 0.5),
							Size = T.fromOffset(p.ARROW_SIZE, p.ARROW_SIZE),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							ScaleType = r.ScaleType.Fit,
							Visible = false,
							ZIndex = OH + 2,
							Parent = JH,
						}
					if oH then
						ZH.ImageContent = oH
						iH.ImageContent = oH
					end
					oH = q.new("ImageLabel", ZH)
					return {
						glow = uH,
						glyph = fH,
						glyphShade = FH,
						arrow = q.new("ImageLabel", iH),
						arrowShade = oH,
						beaconGlow = M(
							"UtilityBeaconGlow",
							JH,
							OH,
							0.5,
							p.BEACON + p.GLOW_PAD * 2,
							p.BEACON + p.GLOW_PAD * 2
						),
						beaconGlyph = q.new(
							"ImageLabel",
							{
								Name = "UtilityBeaconGlyph",
								AnchorPoint = h.new(0.5, 0.5),
								Size = T.fromOffset(p.BEACON, p.BEACON),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								ScaleType = r.ScaleType.Fit,
								Visible = false,
								ZIndex = OH + 2,
								Parent = JH,
							}
						),
						landGlow = M(
							"UtilityLandingGlow",
							JH,
							OH,
							0.5,
							p.LANDING + p.GLOW_PAD * 2,
							p.LANDING + p.GLOW_PAD * 2
						),
						landGlyph = q.new(
							"ImageLabel",
							{
								Name = "UtilityLandingGlyph",
								AnchorPoint = h.new(0.5, 0.5),
								Size = T.fromOffset(p.LANDING, p.LANDING),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								ScaleType = r.ScaleType.Fit,
								Visible = false,
								ZIndex = OH + 2,
								Parent = JH,
							}
						),
					}
				end
				local function h(E)
					local M = S[E]
					if M then
						local JH = S
						return JH[E]
					end
					M = S
					M[E] = e()
					M = S
					return M[E]
				end
				local function e(E)
					local M = B[E.kind]
					local B = E.weapon or M and M.weapon
					return i(B) == "string" and B or nil
				end
				local function i(E)
					local B = l[E.kind]
					if B then
						return B:upper()
					end
					B = e(E)
					if not B then
						return ""
					end
					return B:gsub(" Grenade$", ""):upper()
				end
				local function E(B, l, M)
					local JH = B.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(l)
					l, B = JH.X, -JH.Y
					JH = J.sqrt(l * l + B * B)
					if JH < 1.0E-4 then
						return nil
					end
					local OH, uH, FH = M.X / 2, M.Y / 2, J.min(M.X, M.Y) * p.ARROW_RADIUS
					return OH + l / JH * FH, uH + B / JH * FH, J.deg(J.atan2(B, l))
				end
				local B = A.new(1, 1, 1)
				local l = A.new()
				local function A(M, JH, OH, uH, FH)
					if OH then
						local OH, fH = m.at(JH.X, JH.Y, JH.Z)
						if OH == nil then
							return nil
						end
						if OH < 0 or OH > uH or fH < 0 or fH > FH then
							return nil
						end
						return OH, fH
					end
					uH, FH = M:WorldToViewportPoint(JH)
					if not FH or uH.Z <= 0 then
						return nil
					end
					return uH.X, uH.Y
				end
				local function M(JH, OH, uH)
					if x(JH, OH) then
						d(JH, OH, "Visible", false)
					end
					if uH and (x(JH, uH)) then
						d(JH, uH, "Visible", false)
					end
				end
				local function JH(OH, uH, FH, fH, oH)
					if not uH then
						M(OH, OH.glyph, OH.glyphShade)
						return
					end
					local ZH = 1 - oH
					d(OH, OH.glyphShade, "Image", uH)
					d(OH, OH.glyphShade, "ImageTransparency", ZH)
					L(OH, OH.glyphShade, "Position", FH + p.SHADOW, fH + p.SHADOW)
					d(OH, OH.glyphShade, "Visible", true)
					d(OH, OH.glyph, "Image", uH)
					d(OH, OH.glyph, "ImageColor3", B)
					d(OH, OH.glyph, "ImageTransparency", ZH)
					L(OH, OH.glyph, "Position", FH, fH)
					d(OH, OH.glyph, "Visible", true)
				end
				local function OH(uH, FH, fH, oH, ZH)
					if not FH then
						M(uH, uH.beaconGlyph)
						return
					end
					d(uH, uH.beaconGlyph, "Image", FH)
					d(uH, uH.beaconGlyph, "ImageColor3", B)
					d(uH, uH.beaconGlyph, "ImageTransparency", 1 - ZH)
					L(uH, uH.beaconGlyph, "Position", fH, oH)
					d(uH, uH.beaconGlyph, "Visible", true)
				end
				local function uH(FH, fH, oH, ZH, iH)
					if not fH then
						M(FH, FH.landGlyph)
						return
					end
					d(FH, FH.landGlyph, "Image", fH)
					d(FH, FH.landGlyph, "ImageColor3", B)
					d(FH, FH.landGlyph, "ImageTransparency", 1 - iH)
					L(FH, FH.landGlyph, "Position", oH, ZH)
					d(FH, FH.landGlyph, "Visible", true)
				end
				local function FH(fH, oH, ZH, iH, yH, PH, bH, IH, hH)
					if not ZH then
						if x(fH, oH) then
							d(fH, oH, "Visible", false)
						end
						return
					end
					d(fH, oH, "ImageColor3", IH)
					d(fH, oH, "ImageTransparency", 1 - hH * p.GLOW_ALPHA)
					L(fH, oH, "Position", iH, yH)
					L(fH, oH, "Size", PH, bH)
					d(fH, oH, "Visible", true)
				end
				local function fH(oH)
					if x(oH, oH.arrow) then
						d(oH, oH.arrow, "Visible", false)
					end
					if x(oH, oH.arrowShade) then
						d(oH, oH.arrowShade, "Visible", false)
					end
					FH(oH, oH.beaconGlow, false)
					M(oH, oH.beaconGlyph)
				end
				local function oH(ZH)
					FH(ZH, ZH.landGlow, false)
					M(ZH, ZH.landGlyph)
				end
				local function ZH(iH)
					FH(iH, iH.glow, false)
					M(iH, iH.glyph, iH.glyphShade)
				end
				local function iH(yH)
					fH(yH)
					oH(yH)
					ZH(yH)
				end
				local function yH(PH, bH, IH, hH, AH, TH)
					if not TH then
						return false
					end
					PH:textShaded(bH, IH, p.TEXT_SIZE, hH, B, AH, true)
					return true
				end
				local function PH(bH, IH, hH, AH, TH, rH, SH, cH)
					local RH = TH.icon and v[hH.kind] or nil
					local eH, GH = RH and n(RH) or nil, TH.icon and not RH and Q.weaponIcon(e(hH)) or nil
					local qH, wH =
						eH ~= nil or GH ~= nil,
						if hH.left
								and hH.total
								and hH.total > 0
							then J.clamp(hH.left / hH.total, 0, 1)
							else nil
					local HH, QH, YH, EH =
						TH.bar == true and wH ~= nil,
						TH.time == true and hH.left ~= nil,
						TH.text == true,
						TH.distance == true
					local sH, vH, mH, BH, gH, kH =
						YH and i(hH) or "",
						QH and u.format("%.1f S", J.max(hH.left, 0)) or "",
						EH and u.format("%dM", J.floor((hH.position - AH).Magnitude)) or "",
						0,
						p.GLYPH,
						TH.glow == true
					bH:group()
					if qH then
						RH = p.GLYPH // 2
						if eH then
							bH:imageShaded(rH - RH, SH + BH, p.GLYPH, p.GLYPH, eH, B, cH, cH)
							JH(IH, nil, 0, 0, 0)
						else
							JH(IH, GH, rH, SH + BH, cH)
						end
						BH = BH + p.GLYPH + p.GAP
					else
						JH(IH, nil, 0, 0, 0)
					end
					if yH(bH, rH, SH + BH, sH, cH, YH) then
						BH, gH = BH + p.ROW + p.GAP, if kH then J.max(gH, pH(sH) or 0) else gH
					else
					end
					if HH then
						qH, RH = rH - p.BAR_W // 2, SH + BH
						bH:fill(qH, RH, p.BAR_W, p.BAR_H + 2, l, cH)
						bH:fill(qH + 1, RH + 1, J.floor((p.BAR_W - 2) * wH + 0.5), p.BAR_H, B, cH)
						BH, gH = BH + p.BAR_H + 2 + p.GAP, if p.BAR_W > gH then p.BAR_W else gH
					else
					end
					if yH(bH, rH, SH + BH, vH, cH, QH) then
						BH, gH = BH + p.ROW + p.GAP, if kH then J.max(gH, pH(vH) or 0) else gH
					else
					end
					if yH(bH, rH, SH + BH, mH, cH, EH) then
						BH, gH = BH + p.ROW + p.GAP, if kH then J.max(gH, pH(mH) or 0) else gH
					else
					end
					FH(
						IH,
						IH.glow,
						TH.glow == true and BH > 0,
						rH,
						SH - p.GLOW_PAD,
						J.floor(gH) + p.GLOW_PAD * 2,
						J.floor(BH) + p.GLOW_PAD * 2,
						b(hH),
						cH
					)
				end
				local function u(i, l, pH, JH, yH, bH, IH, hH, AH)
					if not (pH ~= nil and yH.landing == true and pH.landing ~= nil) then
						l.landSince = nil
						oH(l)
						return
					end
					local TH, rH = A(JH, pH.landing, IH, hH, AH)
					if not TH then
						oH(l)
						return
					end
					l.landSince = l.landSince or bH
					IH, hH = J.clamp((bH - l.landSince) / p.FADE_IN, 0, 1) * p.LANDING_ALPHA, v[pH.kind]
					AH, bH = hH and n(hH) or nil, not hH and Q.weaponIcon(e(pH)) or nil
					if not AH and not bH then
						oH(l)
						return
					end
					local JH, oH, hH, SH =
						J.round(TH), J.round(rH), p.LANDING // 2, p.LANDING + p.GLOW_PAD * 2
					FH(l, l.landGlow, yH.glow == true, JH, oH, SH, SH, b(pH), IH)
					i:group()
					if AH then
						i:image(JH - hH, oH - hH, p.LANDING, p.LANDING, AH, B, IH)
						M(l, l.landGlyph)
					else
						uH(l, bH, JH, oH, IH)
					end
				end
				local function i(l, pH, JH, uH, oH, yH, bH, IH)
					local hH
					if JH ~= nil and yH.arrow == true and not IH then
						pH.arrowLeaving = nil
						pH.arrowSince = pH.arrowSince or bH
						hH = J.clamp((bH - pH.arrowSince) / p.FADE_IN, 0, 1)
					else
						pH.arrowSince = nil
						if not x(pH, pH.arrow) then
							fH(pH)
							return
						end
						pH.arrowLeaving = pH.arrowLeaving or bH
						hH = 1 - (bH - pH.arrowLeaving) / p.FADE_OUT
						if hH <= 0 then
							pH.arrowLeaving = nil
							fH(pH)
							return
						end
					end
					IH = 1 - hH
					if JH == nil then
						d(pH, pH.arrow, "ImageTransparency", IH)
						d(pH, pH.arrowShade, "ImageTransparency", IH)
						local x, AH = pH.beaconX, pH.beaconY
						if x then
							bH = p.BEACON + p.GLOW_PAD * 2
							FH(
								pH,
								pH.beaconGlow,
								yH.glow == true and (pH.beaconArt or pH.beaconAsset) ~= nil,
								x,
								AH,
								bH,
								bH,
								pH.beaconColor or B,
								hH
							)
							l:group()
							if pH.beaconArt then
								local TH = p.BEACON // 2
								l:image(x - TH, AH - TH, p.BEACON, p.BEACON, pH.beaconArt, B, hH)
							else
								OH(pH, pH.beaconAsset, x, AH, hH)
							end
						end
						return
					end
					local x, AH, TH = E(uH, JH.landing or JH.position, oH)
					if not x then
						fH(pH)
						return
					end
					local E, fH, oH, rH = b(JH), J.round(x), J.round(AH), TH - 180
					d(pH, pH.arrowShade, "Rotation", rH)
					d(pH, pH.arrowShade, "ImageTransparency", IH)
					L(pH, pH.arrowShade, "Position", fH + p.SHADOW, oH + p.SHADOW)
					d(pH, pH.arrowShade, "Visible", true)
					d(pH, pH.arrow, "Rotation", rH)
					d(pH, pH.arrow, "ImageColor3", B)
					d(pH, pH.arrow, "ImageTransparency", IH)
					L(pH, pH.arrow, "Position", fH, oH)
					d(pH, pH.arrow, "Visible", true)
					oH, uH = J.rad(TH), p.ARROW_SIZE * 0.5 + p.BEACON * 0.5 + 2
					TH, fH, IH = J.round(x - J.cos(oH) * uH), J.round(AH - J.sin(oH) * uH), v[JH.kind]
					bH, oH = IH and n(IH) or nil, not IH and Q.weaponIcon(e(JH)) or nil
					pH.beaconX = TH
					pH.beaconY = fH
					pH.beaconArt = bH
					pH.beaconAsset = oH
					pH.beaconColor = E
					AH = p.BEACON + p.GLOW_PAD * 2
					FH(pH, pH.beaconGlow, yH.glow == true and (bH or oH) ~= nil, TH, fH, AH, AH, E, hH)
					l:group()
					if bH then
						JH = p.BEACON // 2
						l:image(TH - JH, fH - JH, p.BEACON, p.BEACON, bH, B, hH)
						M(pH, pH.beaconGlyph)
					else
						OH(pH, oH, TH, fH, hH)
					end
				end
				local function b(e, E, v, B, l, x, d, L, n)
					local M, pH = v.ViewportSize, p.MAX_BADGES
					for JH = 1, pH, 1 do
						local pH = B[JH]
						local B = pH and h(JH) or S[JH]
						if B then
							local h, OH, uH = not pH
							if pH then
								local FH, fH = A(v, pH.position, d, L, n)
								h, OH, uH = if not FH then true else h, FH, fH
							else
							end
							i(e, B, pH, v, M, l, E, pH ~= nil and not h)
							u(e, B, pH, v, l, E, d, L, n)
							if h then
								if B.stacked then
									B.leaving = B.leaving or E
									JH = 1 - (E - B.leaving) / p.FADE_OUT
									if JH <= 0 then
										B.stacked = false
										B.leaving = nil
										B.gone = nil
										ZH(B)
									else
										PH(e, B, B.gone, B.goneOrigin, l, B.goneX, B.goneY, JH)
									end
								end
							else
								B.leaving = nil
								local u, i, h =
									J.clamp((E - (pH.born or 0)) / p.FADE_IN, 0, 1),
									J.round(OH),
									J.round(uH) - p.GLYPH // 2

								B.goneOrigin = x
								B.goneX = i
								B.goneY = h
								B.stacked = true
								PH(e, B, pH, x, l, i, h, u)
							end
						end
					end
				end

					local u = Q.inMainMenu()
					if u then

						if i then
							V:begin()
							V:finish()
						end
						i = W
						if i then

					u = not c or not V

						return
					end

					if not u then

					end
					V:begin()
					local i = not U
					if i then
						U = true
						m.selfTest(u)
					end
					local i, h = m.beginFrame(u, H.stamp), u.ViewportSize

					if w.bool("esp_util_trail") then
						for F, F in f(z:GetTagged("Grenade")) do
							if F:IsDescendantOf(P) then
								R(F)
							end
						end
					end
					I()
					b(V, Q, u, N(Q, E), v, E, i, A, e)
					Q = s.main and s.main.Visible
					if Q then
						u, i, A = s.main.AbsolutePosition, s.main.AbsoluteSize, V
						A:occlude(u.X, u.Y, i.X, i.Y)
					else
						V:occlude()
					end
					V:finish()
				end
				p.attach = function(u)
					c = u
					V = G.layer(p.BIND, p.ZBASE, { parent = u })
					W = G.layer(p.BIND .. "/gear", p.ZBASE, { tier = "instance", parent = u })
					_ = q.new(
						"TextLabel",
						{
							Name = "UtilityRuler",

							Size = T.fromOffset(p.WIDTH * 4, p.ROW),
							TextWrapped = false,
							TextXAlignment = r.TextXAlignment.Left,
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Text = "",

							TextTransparency = 1,
							TextStrokeTransparency = 1,
							Visible = true,
							ZIndex = p.ZBASE,
							Parent = u,
						}
					)
					return p
				end
				local function u()
					local F = S
					for f, f in o(F) do
						if f then
							iH(f)
							f.arrowSince = nil
							f.arrowLeaving = nil
							f.landSince = nil
							f.leaving = nil
							f.stacked = false
							f.gone = nil
						end
					end
					F = V
					if F then
						V:clear()
					end
				end
				p.refresh = function()
					local F = w.bool("esp_util_enabled")
					p.enabled = F
					if F then
						local F = not C
						if F then
							C = Y.on("utility", j)
						end
						F = not a
						if F then
							a = Y.on("grenadeThrown", k)
						end
						H.onDraw(p.BIND, J)
					else
						H.stop(p.BIND)
						local J = C
						if J then
							Y.off(C)
							C = nil
						end
						J = a
						if J then
							Y.off(a)
							a = nil
						end
						u()
					end
					return p
				end
				p.enabled = false
				p.reset = function()
					H.stop(p.BIND)
					local J = C
					if J then
						Y.off(C)
						C = nil
					end
					J = a
					if J then
						Y.off(a)
						a = nil
					end
					O.clear(D)
					for J, F in o(y) do
						Z(function()
							F:Destroy()
						end)
						y[J] = nil
					end
					O.clear(K)
					u()
					S, c, V, W, _ = {}, nil, nil, nil, nil
					O.clear(t)
					X, U = 0, false
					p.enabled = false
				end
				return p
			end
end)()

function Runtime:oh(values) return table.unpack(values, 1, values.n) end
function Runtime:Wh(destination, offset, ...)
    local values = table.pack(...)
    table.move(values, 1, values.n, offset + 1, destination)
end
function Runtime:Lh(destination, offset, values)
    table.move(values, 1, values.n, offset + 1, destination)
    destination.n = offset + values.n
end

				local function P()

						return nil
					end
					return p:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
				end
				local function p()
					local b = P()
					return b and b:FindFirstChild("MainGui") or nil
				end
				local function b(I)
					if I.Name ~= Z then
						return nil
					end
					local Z = I:FindFirstChild(i)
					return Z and Z:FindFirstChild(y) or nil
				end
				local function Z(i)
					local y = i.Adornee
					if not y then
						return nil
					end
					i = y:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
					if not i then
						return nil
					end
					return F:GetPlayerFromCharacter(i)
				end
				local function i(y)
					local I = b(y)
					if not I then
						return
					end
					local h = Z(y)
					if not h then
						return
					end
					y = J.of(h)
					if I.Text ~= y then
						I.Text = y
					end
				end
				local y, I, h = "BS_Name", {}, {}
				local function A(T)
					local r = string.match(T, "%(@([%w_]+)%)")
					if not r then
						return nil
					end
					for T, T in ipairs(F:GetPlayers()) do
						if T.Name == r then
							return T
						end
					end
					return nil
				end
				local function F(T, r)
					local S = I[T]
					if not S then
						local c, R = T:GetAttribute(y), T.Text
						S = { real = c ~= nil and J.isMask(R) and c or R, kept = c }
						I[T] = S
					else
						if T.Text ~= S.shown and T.Text ~= S.real then
							S.real = T.Text
							S.mark = nil
							if string.find(S.real, "%a") then
								h[T] = S
							end
						end
					end
					if S.mark ~= r then
						local c = S.real
						if not string.find(c, "%a") then
							S.want = c
						else
							local R = A(c)
							if R then
								S.want = J.hides(R) and J.text() or c
							else
								S.want = J.mask(c)
							end
						end
						S.mark = r
					end
					r = S.want ~= S.real
					if r then
						h[T] = S
					end
					if r then
						if S.kept ~= S.real then
							T:SetAttribute(y, S.real)
							S.kept = S.real
						end
					elseif S.kept ~= nil then
						T:SetAttribute(y, nil)
						S.kept = nil
					end
					if T.Text ~= S.want then
						T.Text = S.want
					end
					S.shown = T.Text
				end
				local A, T = false
				local r, S, c = 0, 20, 0
				local function R(e)
					local G = P()
					if not G then
						return
					end
					for q, q in ipairs(G:GetChildren()) do
						i(q)
					end
					G = p()
					if not G then
						return
					end
					for q, q in ipairs(G:GetDescendants()) do
						if q:IsA("TextLabel") then
							F(q, e)
						end
					end
				end
				local function e(G)
					c += 1
					local q = c >= S
					if q then
						c = 0
					end
					for S, w in pairs(I) do
						if q and S.Parent == nil then
							I[S] = nil
							h[S] = nil
						elseif w.mark ~= G or S.Text ~= w.shown then
							F(S, G)
						end
					end
				end
				local function S(G)
					for q, w in pairs(h) do
						if w.mark ~= G or q.Text ~= w.shown then
							F(q, G)
						end
					end
				end
				local function G()
					for q, w in pairs(I) do
						if w.kept ~= nil then
							if w.real ~= nil and q.Text == w.shown and q.Text ~= w.real then
								q.Text = w.real
							end
							q:SetAttribute(y, nil)
						end
					end
					table.clear(I)
					table.clear(h)
					c = 0
					local y = P()
					if not y then
						return
					end
					for I, h in ipairs(y:GetChildren()) do
						I = b(h)
						local y = I and (Z(h))
						if I and y then
							I.Text = y.DisplayName or y.Name
						end
					end
				end
				local function Z()
					local y = A
					if y then
						return
					end
					local y, b = P(), p()
					if not y or not b then
						return
					end
					A = true
					O.signal(y.ChildAdded, function(p)
						task.defer(i, p)
					end)
					O.signal(b.DescendantAdded, function(p)
						if not p:IsA("TextLabel") then
							return
						end
						task.defer(function()
							F(p, J.signature())
						end)
					end)
				end
				local function p()
					local O = J.signature()
					local F = O ~= T
					if F then
						T, r = O, 0
						local i = A
						if i then
							R(O)
						end
					elseif not J.active() then
						return
					end
					F = not A
					if F then
						Z()
						local i = A
						if i then
							R(O)
						end
						return
					end
					F = os.clock()
					local i = F >= r
					if i then
						r = F + o
						e(O)
					else
						S(O)
					end
				end
				f.refresh = function()
					Z()
					u.onDraw(f.BIND, p)
					T, r = J.signature(), 0
					R(T)
					return f
				end
				f.reset = function()
					u.stop(f.BIND)
					A, T, r = false, nil, 0
					G()
				end
				return f
			end
end)()


_registry["features/hit"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J, O, u, F, f, o, Z, i, y, P, b, I, h, A, T, r, S, c =
					math,
					table,
					string,
					os,
					ipairs,
					pairs,
					next,
					pcall,
					xpcall,
					typeof,
					tostring,
					tonumber,
					workspace,
					Vector2,
					Color3,
					UDim2,
					Enum,
					NumberSequence
				local R = p("services/alias")
				local e = p("features/bullet")
				local G = p("services/motion")
				local q = p("ui/create")
				local w = p("services/damage")
				local H = p("services/eventfeed")
				local Q = p("services/equipped")
				local Y = p("core/flags")
				local E = p("game/guard")
				local s = p("ui/font")
				local v = p("services/frame")
				local m = p("services/gamedata")
				local B = p("services/gameevents")
				local g = p("services/hitsounds")
				local k = p("ui/library")
				local z = p("ui/line")
				local l = p("core/log")
				local D, K = p("core/service"), p("ui/zindex")
				local p = E.CLOCKED
				local C = D.get("Players")
				local D, a, j = C.LocalPlayer, { BIND = "hit/draw", WORK = "hit/work" }, false
				local function V(N)
					if j then
						print("[hit] " .. N)
					end
				end
				local N, W, U, _, x, d, L, n, M =
					{
						{ "Head", "UpperTorso" },
						{ "UpperTorso", "LowerTorso" },
						{ "UpperTorso", "LeftUpperArm" },
						{ "LeftUpperArm", "LeftLowerArm" },
						{ "LeftLowerArm", "LeftHand" },
						{ "UpperTorso", "RightUpperArm" },
						{ "RightUpperArm", "RightLowerArm" },
						{ "RightLowerArm", "RightHand" },
						{ "LowerTorso", "LeftUpperLeg" },
						{ "LeftUpperLeg", "LeftLowerLeg" },
						{ "LeftLowerLeg", "LeftFoot" },
						{ "LowerTorso", "RightUpperLeg" },
						{ "RightUpperLeg", "RightLowerLeg" },
						{ "RightLowerLeg", "RightFoot" },
					},
					0.4,
					1,
					0.6,
					4,
					8,
					0.16,
					0.3,
					1.1
				local t, X, pH, JH, OH, uH, FH, fH, oH, ZH = L + n + M, 16, 110, 26, 15, 1.55, 8, 6, 4
				local iH, yH = 0
				local PH, bH = {}
				local IH, hH, AH = 0
				local TH, rH, SH = 0, {}
				local cH, RH, eH, GH, qH = 2, 6, 7, {}
				local wH, HH, QH, YH = false, false, {}, false
				local function EH()
					local sH = ZH
					if sH then
						local vH = ZH
						return vH
					end
					local vH = k.base
					if not vH then
						return nil
					end
					local function mH(BH, gH, kH)
						local zH = q.new(
							"Frame",
							{
								Size = BH,
								Position = gH,
								BackgroundColor3 = T.new(1, 1, 1),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								ZIndex = K.HUD,
								Visible = false,
								Parent = vH,
							}
						)
						if not zH then
							return nil
						end
						gH, BH = q.new, { Rotation = kH }
						BH.Transparency, BH.Parent = c.new(0, 1), zH
						gH("UIGradient", BH)
						return zH
					end
					sH = {
						top = mH(r.new(1, 0, 0.3, 0), r.new(0, 0, 0, 0), 90),
						bottom = mH(r.new(1, 0, 0.3, 0), r.new(0, 0, 0.7, 0), 270),
						left = mH(r.new(0.25, 0, 1, 0), r.new(0, 0, 0, 0), 0),
						right = mH(r.new(0.25, 0, 1, 0), r.new(0.75, 0, 0, 0), 180),
					}
					for c, c in o(sH) do
						if not c then
							return nil
						end
					end
					ZH = sH
					mH = ZH
					return mH
				end
				local function c(sH)
					local vH = iH - sH
					sH = vH <= 0
					if sH then
						local mH = ZH
						if mH then
							local mH = ZH
							for BH, BH in o(mH) do
								BH.Visible = false
							end
						end
						return
					end
					sH = EH()
					if not sH then
						return
					end
					local EH, mH, BH =
						Y.num("hit_overlay_time", 350) / 1000,
						Y.color("hit_overlay_color", T.fromRGB(255, 40, 40)),
						1 - J.clamp(Y.num("hit_overlay_strength", 35) / 100, 0, 1)
					local gH = J.clamp(vH / J.max(EH, 0.01), 0, 1)
					for EH, EH in o(sH) do
						EH.Visible = true
						EH.BackgroundColor3 = mH
						EH.BackgroundTransparency = BH + (1 - BH) * (1 - gH)
					end
				end
				local function EH()
					local sH = yH
					if sH then
						local vH = yH
						return vH
					end
					sH = k.base
					if not sH then
						return nil
					end
					local vH = {}
					for mH = 1, FH, 1 do
						local BH = q.new(
							"TextLabel",
							{
								AnchorPoint = A.new(0.5, 0.5),
								Size = r.fromOffset(120, 40),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								FontFace = s.face(true),
								TextSize = OH,
								TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4,
								TextXAlignment = S.TextXAlignment.Center,
								Text = "",
								Visible = false,
								ZIndex = K.HUD,
								Parent = sH,
							}
						)
						if not BH then
							return nil
						end
						vH[mH] = BH
					end
					yH = vH
					sH = yH
					return sH
				end
				local function S(q)
					for s, sH in f(q) do
						s = false
						for q, q in f(PH) do
							if q.label == sH then
								s = true
								break
							end
						end
						if not s then
							return sH
						end
					end
					return nil
				end
				local q = 1
				local function s(sH, vH)
					if #PH >= FH then
						O.remove(PH, 1)
					end
					q = -q
					local FH =
						{ text = sH, at = vH, side = q, born = F.clock(), expires = F.clock() + t, label = nil }
					O.insert(PH, FH)
					return FH
				end
				local function q(FH)
					local sH = J.max(0, (FH - L - n) / M)
					if FH < L then
						local n = FH / L
						return if n < 0.5 then 0.5 + (uH - 0.5) * n * 2 else uH + (1 - uH) * (n - 0.5) * 2,
							X * n,
							0,
							0
					end
					return 1, X - pH * sH * sH, J.clamp((sH - 0.45) / 0.55, 0, 1), sH
				end
				local function L(n, M, X)
					if #PH == 0 then
						return
					end
					local pH = EH()
					if not pH then
						return
					end
					local uH, FH = Y.color("hit_info_color", T.fromRGB(255, 220, 90)), X / 2
					for EH = #PH, 1, -1 do
						X = PH[EH]
						local sH = n - X.born
						if sH >= t then
							if X.label then
								X.label.Visible = false
							end
							O.remove(PH, EH)
						else
							if not X.label then
								X.label = S(pH)
							end
							local S = X.label
							if S then
								local n, t = true
								if X.at then
									local pH, EH = M:WorldToViewportPoint(X.at)
									t, n = A.new(pH.X, pH.Y), EH
								else
									t = FH
								end
								local M, pH, FH, EH = q(sH)
								S.Text = X.text
								S.Visible = n and X.text ~= ""
								if S.Visible then
									S.Position = r.fromOffset(t.X + X.side * JH * EH, t.Y - pH)
									S.TextSize = J.max(1, J.floor(OH * M + 0.5))
									S.TextColor3 = uH
									S.TextTransparency = FH
									S.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4 + 0.6 * FH
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
				local r, S = { A.new(-1, -1), A.new(1, 1), A.new(-1, 1), A.new(1, -1) }, 1
				local function q(n)
					if n and n[1] and n[1].Parent then
						return n
					end
					n = k.base
					if not n then
						return nil
					end
					local M = {}
					for t = 1, #r, 1 do
						local X = z.new(n, K.HUD + 3)
						if not X then
							return nil
						end
						M[t] = X
					end
					return M
				end
				local function n(M)
					if not M then
						return
					end
					for t, t in f(M) do
						t.Visible = false
					end
				end
				local function M(t, X, pH, JH)
					for OH, uH in f(t) do
						local t = r[OH]
						z.place(uH, X + t * x, X + t * (x + d), S)
						uH.BackgroundColor3 = JH
						uH.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - pH
						uH.Visible = true
					end
				end
				local function r(x, d, t)
					local X = IH - x
					local pH = X <= 0
					if pH then
						n(bH)
					else
						bH = q(bH) or bH
						local JH = bH and bH[1] and bH[1].Parent
						if JH then
							local JH, OH = t / 2, hH
							if OH then
								local OH, uH = d:WorldToViewportPoint(hH)
								JH = if uH then A.new(OH.X, OH.Y) else JH
							else
							end
							M(
								bH,
								JH,
								J.clamp(X / _, 0, 1),
								Y.color("hit_marker_color", T.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
							)
						end
					end
					pH = TH - x
					x = pH <= 0
					if x then
						n(AH)
						return
					end
					AH = q(AH) or AH
					X = not AH or not AH[1] or not AH[1].Parent
					if X then
						return
					end
					M(
						AH,
						t / 2,
						J.clamp(pH / _, 0, 1),
						Y.color("hit_marker_2d_color", T.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
					)
				end
				local function q()
					local x = SH and SH[1] and SH[1][1] and SH[1][1].Parent
					if x then
						local d = SH
						return d
					end
					x = k.base
					if not x then
						return nil
					end
					local d = {}
					for M = 1, oH, 1 do
						local t = {}
						for X = 1, #N, 1 do
							local pH = z.new(x, K.HUD + 2)
							if not pH then
								return nil
							end
							t[X] = pH
						end
						d[M] = t
					end
					SH = d
					x = SH
					return x
				end
				local function x(d)
					if not d then
						return
					end
					local M = {}
					for t, t in f(N) do
						for X, pH in f(t) do
							if not M[pH] then
								X = d:FindFirstChild(pH)
								if X and (X:IsA("BasePart")) then
									M[pH] = X.Position
								end
							end
						end
					end
					if Z(M) == nil then
						return
					end
					if #rH >= oH then
						O.remove(rH, 1)
					end
					local d, t = O.insert, { points = M }
					t.expires = F.clock() + fH
					d(rH, t)
				end
				local function d(M, t)
					for X = #rH, 1, -1 do
						if rH[X].expires <= M then
							O.remove(rH, X)
						end
					end
					local X = #rH == 0
					if X then
						local pH = HH or not SH
						if pH then
							return
						end
						HH = true
						pH = SH
						for JH, JH in f(pH) do
							for pH, pH in f(JH) do
								pH.Visible = false
							end
						end
						return
					end
					HH = false
					X = q()
					if not X then
						return
					end

					for pH = 1, oH, 1 do
						local JH, OH = rH[pH], X[pH]
						if not JH then
							for X, X in f(OH) do
								X.Visible = false
							end
						else
							pH = J.clamp((JH.expires - M) / fH, 0, 1)
							for M, X in f(N) do
								local uH, FH, fH = OH[M], JH.points[X[1]], JH.points[X[2]]
								if FH and fH then
									M, X = t:WorldToViewportPoint(FH)
									local JH, OH = t:WorldToViewportPoint(fH)
									if X and OH then
										z.place(uH, A.new(M.X, M.Y), A.new(JH.X, JH.Y), S)
										uH.BackgroundColor3 = q
										uH.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - pH
										uH.Visible = true
									else
										uH.Visible = false
									end
								else
									uH.Visible = false
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
				local function q()
					local M = qH and qH[1] and qH[1].cross[1] and qH[1].cross[1].Parent
					if M then
						local t = qH
						return t
					end
					M = k.base
					if not M then
						return nil
					end
					local k = {}
					for t = 1, cH, 1 do
						local X = { real = {}, lead = {}, cross = {} }
						for pH = 1, #N, 1 do
							local JH, OH = z.new(M, K.HUD + 2), z.new(M, K.HUD + 2)
							if not JH or not OH then
								return nil
							end
							X.real[pH] = JH
							X.lead[pH] = OH
						end
						for pH = 1, 2, 1 do
							local JH = z.new(M, K.HUD + 3)
							if not JH then
								return nil
							end
							X.cross[pH] = JH
						end
						k[t] = X
					end
					qH = k
					k = qH
					return k
				end
				local function k(K, M)
					if not K then
						return
					end
					local t, X, pH = G.offset(K, nil, true), {}, {}
					for G, JH in f(N) do
						for OH, uH in f(JH) do
							if not X[uH] then
								G = K:FindFirstChild(uH)
								if G and (G:IsA("BasePart")) then
									OH = G.Position
									X[uH] = OH
									pH[uH] = OH + t
								end
							end
						end
					end
					if Z(X) == nil then
						return
					end
					if #GH >= cH then
						O.remove(GH, 1)
					end
					K, t = O.insert, { real = X, lead = pH, impact = M }
					t.expires = F.clock() + RH
					K(GH, t)
				end
				local function Z(G, K, M, t, X)
					for pH, JH in f(N) do
						local N, OH, uH = G[pH], K[JH[1]], K[JH[2]]
						if OH and uH then
							JH, pH = M:WorldToViewportPoint(OH)
							local G, K = M:WorldToViewportPoint(uH)
							if pH and K then
								z.place(N, A.new(JH.X, JH.Y), A.new(G.X, G.Y), S)
								N.BackgroundColor3 = t
								N.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - X
								N.Visible = true
							else
								N.Visible = false
							end
						else
							N.Visible = false
						end
					end
				end
				local function G(K, N)
					for M = #GH, 1, -1 do
						if GH[M].expires <= K then
							O.remove(GH, M)
						end
					end
					local M = #GH == 0
					if M then
						local t = wH or not qH
						if t then
							return
						end
						wH = true
						t = qH
						for X, X in f(t) do
							for t, t in f(X.real) do
								t.Visible = false
							end
							for t, t in f(X.lead) do
								t.Visible = false
							end
							for t, t in f(X.cross) do
								t.Visible = false
							end
						end
						return
					end
					wH = false
					M = q()
					if not M then
						return
					end
					local q, t, X =
						Y.color("hit_extrapolation_real_color", T.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)),
						Y.color("hit_extrapolation_color", T.fromRGB(120, 220, 255)),
						Y.color("hit_extrapolation_impact_color", T.fromRGB(255, 80, 80))
					for T = 1, cH, 1 do
						local pH, JH = GH[T], M[T]
						if not pH then
							for M, M in f(JH.real) do
								M.Visible = false
							end
							for M, M in f(JH.lead) do
								M.Visible = false
							end
							for M, M in f(JH.cross) do
								M.Visible = false
							end
						else
							T = J.clamp((pH.expires - K) / RH, 0, 1)
							Z(JH.real, pH.real, N, q, T)
							Z(JH.lead, pH.lead, N, t, T)
							local Z
							local q = false
							if pH.impact then
								Z, q = N:WorldToViewportPoint(pH.impact)
							else
							end
							if q then
								local q = A.new(Z.X, Z.Y)
								z.place(JH.cross[1], q - A.new(eH, 0), q + A.new(eH, 0), S)
								z.place(JH.cross[2], q - A.new(0, eH), q + A.new(0, eH), S)
								for Z, Z in f(JH.cross) do
									Z.BackgroundColor3 = X
									Z.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - T
									Z.Visible = true
								end
							else
								for Z, Z in f(JH.cross) do
									Z.Visible = false
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
				local Z, A, T = {}, {}
				local function S()
					local q = m.equippedInfoOf(D)
					local z = q and q.Name
					q = P(z) ~= "string" or z == T
					if q then
						return
					end
					T = z
					w.stats(z)
				end
				local function q()
					local z, K = m.everyone()
					for N = 1, K, 1 do
						local K = z[N]
						N = m.healthOf(K)
						if N then
							local z = Z
							z[K.UserId] = N
							z = N > 0
							if z then
								local z = A
								z[K.UserId] = N
							end
						end
					end
				end
				local function z(K)
					local N = C:GetPlayerByUserId(K)
					return N and m.healthOf(N) or nil
				end
				local K = {}
				a.watch = function(N)
					if P(N) == "function" then
						K[#K + 1] = N
					end
				end
				local P = 0
				a.demand = function(N)
					P = J.max(0, P + (N and 1 or -1))
					return a.refresh()
				end
				local N = {}
				local function M(t)
					O.insert(N, t)
				end
				local t = {}
				local function X(pH)
					O.insert(t, pH)
				end
				local function pH()
					local JH = #t
					if JH == 0 then
						return
					end
					JH = t
					t = {}
					for OH, OH in f(JH) do
						g.fire(OH)
					end
				end
				local function g()
					local JH = #N
					if JH == 0 then
						return
					end
					JH = N
					N = {}
					for OH, uH in f(JH) do
						for JH, FH in f(K) do
							OH, JH = i(FH, uH)
							if not OH then
								l.warn(u.format("hit: listener failed: %s", b(JH)))
							end
						end
					end
				end
				local i, l = {}, 16
				e.watch(function(K)
					if #i >= l then
						O.remove(i, 1)
					end
					O.insert(i, K)
					V(u.format("shot kept=%d hits=%d", #i, #(K.hits or {})))
				end)
				local function l(K)
					if not K then
						return nil
					end
					local JH = F.clock()
					local OH
					for uH = #i, 1, -1 do
						local FH = i[uH]
						if JH - FH.at > W then
							break
						end
						for W, JH in f(FH.hits or {}) do
							uH = JH.Instance
							if uH and (uH:IsDescendantOf(K)) then
								local K, fH =
									{ position = JH.Position, instance = uH, traversals = W - 1, origin = FH.origin },
									m.hitboxLabelOf(uH.Name)
								if fH then
									K.label = fH
									return K
								end
								if not OH then
									K.label = uH.Name
									OH = K
								else
								end
							else
							end
						end
					end
					return OH
				end
				local function K(W, JH)
					if not W or not W.instance then
						return nil
					end
					local OH = m.equippedInfoOf(D)
					if not OH then
						return nil
					end
					local uH = w.partOf(W.instance)
					if not uH then
						return nil
					end
					local FH, fH, oH =
						if W.origin and W.position then (W.position - W.origin).Magnitude else 0,
						w.armorOf(JH)
					JH = w.predict({
						weapon = OH.Name,
						part = uH,
						distance = FH,
						traversals = W.traversals or 0,
						armor = fH,
						armorKind = oH,
					})
					if not JH or JH.capped then
						return nil
					end
					return J.max(0, J.floor(JH.health + 0.5))
				end
				local w = {}
				local function W(JH, OH, OH, OH)
					if not JH then
						return ""
					end
					if OH == "taken" then
						return u.format("-%ddmg", JH)
					end
					return u.format("%ddmg", JH)
				end
				local function JH(OH, uH, FH)
					if OH.entry then
						OH.entry.text = W(uH, OH.part, OH.name, OH.kind)
					end
					M({ kind = OH.kind, damage = uH, predicted = OH.predicted, name = OH.name, part = OH.part, remaining = FH })
				end
				local function OH(uH)
					for FH = #w, 1, -1 do
						local fH = w[FH]
						local oH, cH = z(fH.victimId), false
						if oH then
							local z = fH.before - oH
							if z >= 1 then
								JH(fH, J.floor(z + 0.5), J.max(0, J.floor(oH + 0.5)))
								cH = true
							else
							end
						else
						end
						if not cH and (not oH or oH <= 0) and fH.before > 0 then
							JH(fH, J.floor(fH.before + 0.5), 0)
							cH = true
						else
						end
						if cH then
							O.remove(w, FH)
						elseif uH > fH.expires then
							if fH.predicted then
								M({
									kind = fH.kind,
									damage = fH.predicted,
									predicted = fH.predicted,
									name = fH.name,
									part = fH.part,
								})
							end
							O.remove(w, FH)
						end
					end
				end
				local function z(JH)
					local uH, FH = JH.victimId, JH.headshot
					V(
						u.format(
							"show part=%s pos=%s char=%s pred=%s dmg=%s",
							b(JH.partName),
							b(JH.position ~= nil),
							b(JH.character ~= nil),
							b(JH.predicted),
							b(JH.damage)
						)
					)
					X(FH and "head" or "body")
					local fH = H.wants("dealt", H.FLASH)
					if fH then
						iH = F.clock() + Y.num("hit_overlay_time", 350) / 1000
					end
					fH = H.wants("dealt", H.INFO)
					local oH = fH or P > 0
					if oH then
						local oH, cH = u.upper, JH.partName or (FH and "Head" or "Body")
						local RH, eH, GH = oH(cH), JH.victim and R.of(JH.victim) or "id " .. b(uH), JH.damage
						if GH then
							if fH then
								s(W(JH.damage, RH, eH), JH.position)
							end
							M({ kind = "dealt", damage = JH.damage, name = eH, part = RH, remaining = 0 })
						else
							cH = JH.predicted
							local R, oH = fH and s(W(cH, RH, eH), JH.position) or nil, Z[uH]
							if oH then
								local GH, qH =
									O.insert,
									{ kind = "dealt", victimId = uH, before = oH, entry = R, part = RH, name = eH, predicted = cH }
								qH.expires = F.clock() + U
								GH(w, qH)
							elseif cH then
								M({ kind = "dealt", damage = cH, predicted = cH, name = eH, part = RH })
							end
						end
					end
					FH = H.wants("dealt", H.MARKER2D)
					if FH then
						TH = F.clock() + _
					end
					fH = H.wants("dealt", H.MARKER) and JH.position
					if fH then
						hH = JH.position
						IH = F.clock() + _
					end
					if H.wants("dealt", H.SKELETON) and JH.character then
						x(JH.character)
					end
					if H.wants("dealt", H.EXTRAPOLATION) and JH.character then
						k(JH.character, JH.position)
					end
					V("show done")
				end
				local function R(k)
					if not j then
						return z(k)
					end
					local _, x = y(z, debug.traceback, k)
					if not _ then
						V("SHOW FAILED " .. b(x))
					end
				end
				local function y(k)
					X("kill")
					local z = H.wants("kill", H.FLASH)
					if z then
						iH = F.clock() + Y.num("hit_overlay_time", 350) / 1000
					end
					z = I(k.victim)
					if not z then
						return
					end
					local I = C:GetPlayerByUserId(z)
					local _ = I and m.characterOf(I)
					local x = l(_)
					R({
						victimId = z,
						victim = I,
						character = _,
						position = x and x.position or nil,
						partName = x and x.label or nil,
						headshot = k.headshot,
						damage = A[z],
					})
				end
				local I, k = 0.45, 14
				local function z(_, x)
					if not _.melee then
						return nil
					end
					if not x then
						return nil
					end
					_ = Q.actedAt("melee")
					if not _ or F.clock() - _ > I then
						return nil
					end
					_ = m.characterOf(D)
					local I, Q =
						_ and (_:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")), x:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if not I or not Q then
						return nil
					end
					if (Q.Position - I.Position).Magnitude > k then
						return nil
					end
					return { position = Q.Position }
				end
				local function I(Q)
					local k = Q.victim
					local _ = k == D.UserId
					if _ then
						X("taken")
						local D, x = Z[k], H.wants("taken", H.INFO)
						local M = (x or P > 0) and D
						if M then
							O.insert(
								w,
								{
									kind = "taken",
									victimId = k,
									before = D,
									entry = x and s(W(nil, nil, nil, "taken")) or nil,
									expires = F.clock() + U,
								}
							)
						end
						return
					end
					if not m.localAlive() then
						return
					end
					_ = C:GetPlayerByUserId(k)
					local s = _ and m.characterOf(_)
					local D = l(s) or z(Q, s)
					if j then
						local z = i[#i]
						V(
							u.format(
								"damaged victim=%s char=%s found=%s kept=%d age=%.3f",
								_ and _.Name or b(k),
								b(s ~= nil),
								b(D ~= nil),
								#i,
								z and F.clock() - z.at or -1
							)
						)
					end
					if not D then
						return
					end
					R({
						victimId = k,
						victim = _,
						character = s,
						position = D.position,
						partName = D.label,
						headshot = Q.headshot,
						predicted = K(D, _),
					})
				end
				local b, R = 0, true
				local function Q()
					local s, k = F.clock(), m.localAlive()
					local z = R and not k
					if z then
						O.clear(i)
						O.clear(w)
						iH, IH, hH, TH = 0, 0, nil, 0
					end
					R = k
					k = j and s - b >= 1
					if k then
						b = s
						V(
							u.format(
								"tick awaiting=%d lines=%d marker=%.2f skel=%d out=%d",
								#w,
								#PH,
								J.max(0, IH - s),
								#rH,
								#N
							)
						)
					end
					if p then
						E.enter("hit/resolve")
					end
					OH(s)
					if p then
						E.leave("hit/resolve")
					end
					if p then
						E.enter("hit/sample")
					end
					q()
					if p then
						E.leave("hit/sample")
					end
					S()
					pH()
					if p then
						E.enter("hit/publish")
					end
					g()
					if p then
						E.leave("hit/publish")
					end
				end
				local p
				local function J()
					if m.inMainMenu() then
						p()
						return
					end
					local u, b = F.clock(), h.CurrentCamera
					if not b then
						return
					end
					local F = b.ViewportSize
					c(u)
					L(u, b, F)
					r(u, b, F)
					d(u, b)
					G(u, b)
				end
				local function u()
					return H.anyWants(H.FLASH)
						or H.anyWants(H.INFO)
						or H.anyWants(H.MARKER2D)
						or H.anyWants(H.MARKER)
						or H.anyWants(H.SKELETON)
						or H.anyWants(H.EXTRAPOLATION)
				end
				local function F()
					local b = u() or P > 0 or Y.bool("hs_enabled")
					return b
				end
				local function b(h, r)
					local S = B.on(h, r)
					if S then
						O.insert(QH, S)
					end
				end
				p = function()
					local h = ZH
					if h then
						local r = ZH
						for S, S in o(r) do
							S.Visible = false
						end
					end
					for o, o in f(PH) do
						if o.label then
							o.label.Visible = false
						end
					end
					O.clear(PH)
					O.clear(rH)
					n(bH)
					n(AH)
					h = SH
					if h then
						local o = SH
						for h, h in f(o) do
							for o, o in f(h) do
								o.Visible = false
							end
						end
					end
					iH, IH, hH, TH = 0, 0, nil, 0
				end
				a.refresh = function()
					local o = F()
					local F = o ~= YH
					if F then
						YH = o
						e.demand(o)
						if o then
							B.start()
							b("damage", I)
							b("kill", y)
							b("death", function()
								X("death")
							end)
						else
							for F, F in f(QH) do
								B.off(F)
							end
							O.clear(QH)
							O.clear(w)
						end
					end
					if o then
						v.onDraw(a.WORK, Q)
						v.onDraw(a.BIND, J)
					else
						v.stop(a.WORK)
						v.stop(a.BIND)
						p()
					end
					if not u() then
						p()
					end
					return a
				end
				a.reset = function()
					v.stop(a.WORK)
					v.stop(a.BIND)
					for J, J in f(QH) do
						B.off(J)
					end
					O.clear(QH)
					O.clear(w)
					O.clear(i)
					O.clear(N)
					O.clear(t)
					YH, P, T = false, 0, nil
					p()
					ZH, yH, bH, AH, SH, HH, Z, A = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, false, {}, {}
				end
				return a
			end
end)()


_registry["features/impacts"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("features/bullet")
				local O = p("core/flags")
				local u = p("services/frame")
				local F = p("services/gameevents")
				local f, o, Z =
					p("core/service").get("Players"),
					{ BIND = "world/impacts", enabled = false, SIZE = 0.35, THICK = 0.16, CORE = 0.42, CORE_DARK = 0.28 },
					0.01
				o.LIFE = 8
				o.MAX = 64
				local p, i, y, P, b, I, h = 0.02, 128, {}, {}, {}, false
				local A = false
				local function T(r, S, c)
					if typeof(r) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(S) ~= "Vector3" then
						return
					end
					if S.Magnitude < 1.0E-4 then
						return
					end
					local R = #y
					if R >= i then
						return
					end
					table.insert(y, { position = r, normal = S, side = c })
				end
				local function i(r)
					if not O.bool("impact_enabled") then
						return
					end
					local S = r.hits
					if typeof(S) ~= "table" then
						return
					end
					if not O.bool("impact_client") then
						return
					end
					for r, r in ipairs(S) do
						if typeof(r) == "table" then
							T(r.Position, r.Normal, "client")
						end
					end
				end
				local function r(S)
					if not O.bool("impact_enabled") then
						return
					end
					local c = f
						and f.LocalPlayer
						and S.attacker ~= nil
						and S.attacker == tostring(f.LocalPlayer.UserId)
					if not c and not O.bool("impact_enemy") then
						return
					end
					T(S.position, S.normal, c and "server" or "other")
				end
				local function f()
					return workspace and workspace.Terrain or nil
				end
				local function T(S, c)
					local R = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
					R.Name = c
					R.Adornee = S
					R.AlwaysOnTop = false
					R.ZIndex = 0
					R.Transparency = 1
					R.Visible = false
					R.Parent = S
					return R
				end
				local function S(c)
					local R = b[c]
					if R and R.node.Parent and R.core.Parent then
						return R
					end
					local e = f()
					if not e then
						return nil
					end
					R = { node = T(e, "Impact"), core = T(e, "ImpactCore"), tint = nil, shown = false }
					b[c] = R
					return R
				end
				local function T()
					local c = #y
					if c == 0 then
						return
					end
					c = y
					y = {}
					for R, R in ipairs(c) do
						if #P >= o.MAX then
							table.remove(P, 1)
						end
						local c, e = table.insert, { position = R.position, normal = R.normal, side = R.side }
						e.born = os.clock()
						c(P, e)
					end
				end
				local function c(R, e)
					if R.shown == e then
						return
					end
					R.shown = e
					R.node.Visible = e
					R.core.Visible = e
				end
				local function R()
					for e, e in ipairs(b) do
						c(e, false)
					end
				end
				local e
				local G = {}
				local function q()
					local w, H = O.generation(), e
					if H == w then
						return
					end
					e = w
					G.client = O.color("impact_client_color", Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255))
					G.server = O.color("impact_server_color", Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120))
					G.other = O.color("impact_enemy_color", Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 120))
				end
				local e, w, H, Q
				local function Y()
					local E = e
					local s, v = E == o.SIZE
					if s then
						E = w
						v = E == o.THICK
					else
						v = s
					end
					if v then
						return
					end
					E, v = o.SIZE, o.THICK
					e, w = E, v
					H = Vector3.new(o.SIZE, o.SIZE, o.THICK)
					Q = Vector3.new(o.SIZE * o.CORE, o.SIZE * o.CORE, o.THICK + Z * 2)
				end
				local function e(w)
					for E = #P, 1, -1 do
						if w - P[E].born >= o.LIFE then
							table.remove(P, E)
						end
					end
					local E = f()
					if not E then
						return
					end
					q()
					Y()
					local f, q = E.CFrame, o.MAX
					for Y = 1, q, 1 do
						E = P[Y]
						local q = not E
						if q then
							if b[Y] then
								c(b[Y], false)
							end
						else
							local q = S(Y)
							if q then
								local S = E.position + E.normal.Unit * p
								local p = f:ToObjectSpace((CFrame.lookAt(S, S + E.normal.Unit)))
								q.node.CFrame = p
								q.core.CFrame = p * CFrame.new(0, 0, -Z)
								S = q.size ~= H
								if S then
									q.size = H
									q.node.Size = H
									q.core.Size = Q
								end
								p = G[E.side]
								if q.tint ~= p then
									q.tint = p
									q.node.Color3 = p
									q.core.Color3 =
										Color3.new(p.R * o.CORE_DARK, p.G * o.CORE_DARK, p.B * o.CORE_DARK)
								end
								S = math.clamp((w - E.born) / o.LIFE, 0, 1)
								q.node.Transparency = S
								q.core.Transparency = S
								c(q, true)
							end
						end
					end
				end
				local function p()
					T()
					e(os.clock())
				end
				o.refresh = function()
					local f = O.bool("impact_enabled")
					local O = f ~= A
					if O then
						A = f
						J.demand(f)
						if f then
							F.start()
							h = F.on("impact", r)
						else
							local Z = h
							if Z then
								F.off(h)
								h = nil
							end
						end
					end
					O = not I
					if O then
						I = true
						J.watch(i)
					end
					o.enabled = f
					if f then
						u.onDraw(o.BIND, p)
					else
						u.stop(o.BIND)
						table.clear(y)
						table.clear(P)
						R()
					end
					return o
				end
				o.reset = function()
					u.stop(o.BIND)
					local p = h
					if p then
						F.off(h)
						h = nil
					end
					for p, p in ipairs(b) do
						pcall(function()
							p.node:Destroy()
						end)
						pcall(function()
							p.core:Destroy()
						end)
					end
					table.clear(b)
					table.clear(y)
					table.clear(P)
					A = false
					o.enabled = false
				end
				return o
			end
end)()


_registry["features/instant"] = (function()
return function(r34)
	local r6 = r34("core/flags")
	local r7 = r34("game/guard")
	local r8 = r34("game/modules")
	local r9 = r34("services/equipped")
	local r10 = r34("game/patcher")

return function(p)
