				local O = p("services/backtrack")
				local u = p("services/motion")
				local F = p("services/selftrack")
				local f = p("features/chams")
				local o = p("services/ffskin")
				local Z = p("core/flags")
				local i = p("services/gamedata")
				local y = p("game/guard")
				local P, b, I = p("core/service").get("RunService"), {}, 0.1
				local p, h = f.SHADED, 0.25
				local function A()
					return setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
				end
				local T, r = { lead = A(), back = A(), self_lead = A(), self_back = A() }
				b.enabled = false
				local function S(c, R)
					local e = T[c][R]
					if not e then
						return
					end
					T[c][R] = nil
					if e.taps then
						for c, c in ipairs(e.taps) do
							pcall(function()
								c:Disconnect()
							end)
						end
					end
					if e.wires then
						for c, c in ipairs(e.wires) do
							pcall(function()
								c.node:Destroy()
							end)
						end
					end
					pcall(function()
						e.model:Destroy()
					end)
				end
				local function c()
					for R, e in pairs(T) do
						for G in pairs(e) do
							S(R, G)
						end
						T[R] = A()
					end
				end
				local function A(R, e, G)
					local q, w, H = e.color, e.fade, e.material
					R.color = q
					R.fade = w
					R.material = H
					R.skin = G
					for Q, Q in ipairs(R.pairs) do
						Q.fake.Color = q
						Q.fake.Transparency = w
						Q.fake.Material = H or Q.born
						if Q.mesh then
							Q.fake.TextureID = G
						end
					end
					if R.wires then
						for G, G in ipairs(R.wires) do
							G.node.Color3 = q
							G.node.Transparency = w
						end
					end
					if R.glow then
						e = f.veil(w, H ~= nil)
						R.glow.FillColor = q
						R.glow.OutlineColor = q
						R.glow.FillTransparency = e
						R.glow.OutlineTransparency = w
					end
				end
				local function R(e, G, q)
					if not e:IsA("BasePart") or e.Transparency >= 1 then
						return
					end
					local w, H = pcall(function()
						return e:Clone()
					end)
					if not w or not H then
						return
					end
					for w, w in ipairs(H:GetChildren()) do
						pcall(function()
							w:Destroy()
						end)
					end
					if H:IsA("MeshPart") and H.TextureID ~= "" then
						H.TextureID = ""
					end
					H.Anchored = true
					H.CanCollide = false
					H.CanQuery = false
					H.CanTouch = false
					H.Massless = true
					H.CastShadow = false
					H.Transparency = h
					H.Parent = G
					q[#q + 1] = { real = e, fake = H, born = H.Material, mesh = H:IsA("MeshPart") }
				end
				local e = {}
				local function G(q, w)
					local H = 0
					for Q, Y in ipairs(f.WORLD_WEAPON_BINS) do
						Q = q:FindFirstChild(Y)
						if Q then
							H += 1
							w[H] = Q
						else
						end
					end
					for q = H + 1, #w, 1 do
						w[q] = nil
					end
					return w, H
				end
				local function q(w)
					local H = {}
					for Q, Y in ipairs(f.WORLD_WEAPON_BINS) do
						Q = w:FindFirstChild(Y)
						if Q then
							for w, w in ipairs(Q:GetDescendants()) do
								H[w] = true
							end
						end
					end
					return H
				end
				local function w(H, Q, Y)
					local E = Instance.new("Model")
					E.Name = "Camera"
					local s, v = {}, not Y.armed and q(Q) or nil
					for q, q in ipairs(Q:GetDescendants()) do
						if v == nil or not v[q] then
							R(q, E, s)
						end
					end
					v = nil
					if Y.armed then
						v = {}
						G(Q, v)
					else
					end
					if #s == 0 then
						E:Destroy()
						return nil
					end
					local R
					if Y.style == f.SILHOUETTE then
						R = f.newGlow()
						R.Adornee = E
						R.Parent = E
					else
					end
					y.own(E)
					E.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
					local q
					if Y.style ~= f.PAINT and Y.style ~= f.SILHOUETTE then
						local m = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
						if m then
							local B = f.classOf(Y.style, Y.shape)
							q = {}
							for g, k in ipairs(s) do
								g = Instance.new(B)
								g.Name = "EffectShell"
								g.Adornee = k.real
								g.AlwaysOnTop = false
								g.ZIndex = 0
								g.Visible = false
								g.Parent = m
								f.shadeAdorn(g, Y.style)
								f.shapeAdorn(g, Y.style, Y.shape, k.real.Size)
								q[#q + 1] = { real = k.real, node = g, pose = g.CFrame }
							end
						else
						end
					else
					end
					local m = {
						model = E,
						pairs = s,
						wires = q,
						glow = R,
						style = Y.style,
						shape = Y.shape,
						bins = v,
						stale = false,
						shown = false,
						color = nil,
						fade = nil,
						material = nil,
						taps = {},
					}
					for R, R in ipairs(s) do
						Y = R.real.AncestryChanged:Connect(y.safe(function(R, R)
							if R == nil then
								m.stale = true
							end
						end, "leadghost"))
						m.taps[#m.taps + 1] = Y
					end
					if v then
						for R, R in ipairs(v) do
							E = R.ChildAdded:Connect(y.safe(function()
								m.stale = true
							end, "leadghost"))
							m.taps[#m.taps + 1] = E
						end
					end
					T[H][Q] = m
					return m
				end
				local function R(q, H)
					local Q, Y, E = q.bins, G(H, e)
					if #Q ~= E then
						return true
					end
					for e = 1, E, 1 do
						if Q[e] ~= Y[e] then
							return true
						end
					end
					return false
				end
				local function e(G, q, H)
					local Q = T[G][q]
					if
						Q
						and not Q.stale
						and Q.model.Parent
						and Q.style == H.style
						and Q.shape == H.shape
						and not (Q.bins ~= nil and R(Q, q))
					then
						return Q
					end
					if Q then
						S(G, q)
					end
					return w(G, q, H)
				end
				local R, G = { alive = true }, {}
				local function q(w)
					local H = F.eye()
					if H == nil then
						return nil
					end
					local Q = if w then F.forward(H) else F.backAt(1)
					if Q == nil then
						return nil
					end
					return Q - H
				end
				local F, w =
					{ {
						kind = "lead",
						flag = "lead_ghost_enabled",
						base = "lead_ghost",
						tint = "lead_ghost_color",
						fallback = Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255),
						offsetOf = function(H)
							return u.offset(H, nil, true)
						end,
					}, {
						kind = "back",
						flag = "backtrack_chams",
						base = "backtrack_chams",
						tint = "backtrack_chams_color",
						fallback = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120),
						offsetOf = function(u)
							if not O.enabled() then
								return nil
							end
							return O.offsetAt(u, J.rungFor(u) or 1)
						end,
					}, {
						kind = "self_lead",
						flag = "self_forwardtrack_chams",
						base = "self_forwardtrack_chams",
						tint = "self_forwardtrack_chams_color",
						fallback = Color3.fromRGB(170, 255, 150),
						mine = true,
						offsetOf = function()
							return q(true)
						end,
					}, {
						kind = "self_back",
						flag = "self_backtrack_chams",
						base = "self_backtrack_chams",
						tint = "self_backtrack_chams_color",
						fallback = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 110),
						mine = true,
						offsetOf = function()
							return q(false)
						end,
					} }, {}
				local J = -1
				local function O(u)
					local q = Z.generation()
					local H = J ~= q
					if H then
						table.clear(w)
						J = q
					end
					H = w[u.kind]
					if H then
						return H
					end
					H = {
						color = Z.color(u.tint, u.fallback),
						fade = math.max(Z.transparency(u.tint), h),
						style = Z.str(u.base .. "_style", p),
						shape = Z.str(u.base .. "_shape", f.SHAPE_DEFAULT),
						material = f.material(Z.str(u.base .. "_material", f.DEFAULT)),
						pattern = Z.str(u.base .. "_ffpattern", o.DEFAULT),
						armed = u.mine == true,
					}
					w[u.kind] = H
					return H
				end
				local p = {}
				local function J(u)
					local f = 0
					if u.mine then
						local u = i.localCharacter()
						if u then
							p[1] = u
							f = 1
						else
						end
					else
						for u, h in ipairs(i.players(R, G)) do
							u = not i.isAlly(h) and i.characterOf(h) or nil
							if u then
								f += 1
								p[f] = u
							else
							end
						end
					end
					for u = f + 1, #p, 1 do
						p[u] = nil
					end
					return p
				end
				local function p(u)
					local f = O(u)
					local O, i = o.skinFor(f.material, f.pattern), {}
					for o, h in ipairs(J(u)) do
						o = u.offsetOf(h)
						if o ~= nil and o.Magnitude >= I then
							local J = e(u.kind, h, f)
							if J then
								i[h] = true
								if
									J.color ~= f.color
									or J.fade ~= f.fade
									or J.material ~= f.material
									or J.skin ~= O
								then
									A(J, f, O)
								end
								for O, O in ipairs(J.pairs) do
									O.fake.CFrame = O.real.CFrame + o
								end
								if J.wires then
									for O, f in ipairs(J.wires) do
										O = f.real.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(o)
										f.node.CFrame = f.pose + O
									end
									if not J.shown then
										J.shown = true
										for O, O in ipairs(J.wires) do
											O.node.Visible = true
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
					for J in pairs(T[u.kind]) do
						if not i[J] then
							S(u.kind, J)
						end
					end
				end
				local function J()
					for O, O in ipairs(F) do
						if Z.bool(O.flag) then
							p(O)
						else
							for p in pairs(T[O.kind]) do
								S(O.kind, p)
							end
						end
					end
				end
				b.refresh = function()
					local p = Z.bool("lead_ghost_enabled")
						or Z.bool("backtrack_chams")
						or Z.bool("self_forwardtrack_chams")
						or Z.bool("self_backtrack_chams")
					b.enabled = p
					if p then
						local O = not r
						if O then
							r = P.Heartbeat:Connect(y.safe(J, "leadghost"))
						end
						return b
					end
					p = r
					if p then
						r:Disconnect()
						r = nil
					end
					c()
					return b
				end
				b.reset = function()
					local p = r
					if p then
						r:Disconnect()
						r = nil
					end
					c()
					b.enabled = false
				end
				return b
			end
end)()


_registry["features/localplayer"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/create")
				local O = p("services/equipped")
				local u = p("core/flags")
				local F = p("services/frame")
				local f = p("game/guard")
				local o = p("ui/library")
				local Z, i = p("core/service"), p("ui/zindex")
				local y = p("services/gamedata")
				p = Z.get("Players")
				local Z, P, b, I, h, A, T, r, S, c, R =
					p and p.LocalPlayer,
					{ BIND = "hud/localplayer" },
					1,
					{ "Gameplay", "Middle", "Crosshair" },
					{ "Gameplay", "Middle", "SniperScope" },
					2,
					0.3,
					{ crosshair = {}, scope = {} },
					{},
					0
				P.enabled = false
				local function p(e)
					return e ~= nil and e.Parent ~= nil
				end
				local function e(G)
					for q, q in ipairs(G) do
						if p(q) then
							return true
						end
					end
					return false
				end
				local function G(q, w)
					local H = q
					for q, q in ipairs(w) do
						H = H and (H:FindFirstChild(q))
						if not H then
							return nil
						end
					end
					return H
				end
				local function q(w, H)
					local Q = {}
					for Y, E in ipairs(w:GetChildren()) do
						if E:IsA("ScreenGui") then
							Y = G(E, H)
							if Y and (Y:IsA("GuiObject")) then
								table.insert(Q, Y)
							end
						end
					end
					return Q
				end
				local function G()
					if not u.bool("lp_force_crosshair") then
						return nil
					end
					if not O.isScoped() then
						return true
					end
					if not u.bool("lp_remove_scope") then
						return false
					end
					if u.bool("lp_scope_line") then
						return false
					end
					return true
				end
				local function w()
					if not u.bool("lp_remove_scope") then
						return nil
					end
					return false
				end
				local function H(Q, Y)
					return function()
						local E = Y()
						if E == nil then
							return
						end
						if Q.Visible ~= E then
							Q.Visible = E
						end
					end
				end
				local function Q(Y, E, s)
					if S[Y] then
						pcall(function()
							S[Y]:Disconnect()
						end)
						S[Y] = nil
					end
					S[Y] = E:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(f.safe(H(E, s), "localplayer/guard"))
				end
				local function f()
					local H = Z and (Z:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui"))
					if not H then
						return
					end
					local Z = not e(r.crosshair)
					if Z then
						local Y = r
						Y.crosshair = q(H, I)
						Y = r
						for I, E in ipairs(Y.crosshair) do
							Q("crosshair" .. I, E, G)
						end
					end
					Z = not e(r.scope)
					if Z then
						local Z = r
						Z.scope = q(H, h)
						Z = r
						for I, h in ipairs(Z.scope) do
							Q("scope" .. I, h, w)
						end
					end
				end
				local function Z(I, h, q, H)
					local Q = J.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Size = h,
							Position = q,
							BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							ZIndex = i.HUD,
							Visible = false,
							Parent = I,
						}
					)
					if not Q then
						return nil
					end
					h, q, I = math.min(T, 0.98) * 0.5, J.new, { Rotation = H }
					I.Transparency, I.Parent =
						NumberSequence.new({
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5 - h, 1),
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5 - h * 0.45, 0.55),
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0),
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5 + h * 0.45, 0.55),
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5 + h, 1),
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
						}),
						Q
					q("UIGradient", I)
					return Q
				end
				local function J()
					local i = R and R.horizontal and R.horizontal.Parent
					if i then
						local I = R
						return I
					end
					i = o.base
					if not i then
						return nil
					end
					local o = A * 0.5
					local I, h =
						Z(i, UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, A), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -o), 0),
						Z(i, UDim2.new(0, A, 1, 0), UDim2.new(0.5, -o, 0, 0), 90)
					if not (I and h) then
						return nil
					end
					R = { horizontal = I, vertical = h }
					i = R
					return i
				end
				local o = {}
				local function Z(i, I, h)
					local A = o[i]
					if not A then
						A = {}
						o[i] = A
					else
					end
					if A[I] == h then
						return
					end
					A[I] = h
					i[I] = h
				end
				local function o()
					local i = R
					if i then
						Z(R.horizontal, "Visible", false)
						Z(R.vertical, "Visible", false)
					end
				end
				local function i()
					if not u.bool("lp_scope_line") then
						o()
						return
					end
					local I = J()
					if not I then
						return
					end
					local J, h, A =
						O.isScoped(),
						u.color("lp_scope_line_color", Color3.new(0, 0, 0)),
						u.transparency("lp_scope_line_color")
					for O, O in pairs(I) do
						Z(O, "Visible", J)
						if J then
							Z(O, "BackgroundColor3", h)
							Z(O, "BackgroundTransparency", A)
						end
					end
				end
				local function J(O, Z)
					if Z == nil then
						return
					end
					for I, I in ipairs(O) do
						if p(I) and I.Visible ~= Z then
							I.Visible = Z
						end
					end
				end
				local function O()
					if y.inMainMenu() then
						o()
						return
					end
					local Z, y = os.clock(), not e(r.crosshair) or not e(r.scope)
					local I = y and Z - c >= b
					if I then
						c = Z
						f()
					end
					J(r.crosshair, G())
					J(r.scope, w())
					i()
				end
				local function J()
					for f, Z in pairs(S) do
						pcall(function()
							Z:Disconnect()
						end)
						S[f] = nil
					end
					local f = r
					for Z, Z in ipairs(f.scope) do
						if p(Z) then
							pcall(function()
								Z.Visible = true
							end)
						end
					end
					r, c = { crosshair = {}, scope = {} }, 0
					o()
				end
				P.refresh = function()
					local p = u.bool("lp_force_crosshair")
						or u.bool("lp_remove_scope")
						or u.bool("lp_scope_line")
					P.enabled = p
					if p then
						F.onDraw(P.BIND, O)
					else
						F.stop(P.BIND)
						J()
					end
					return P
				end
				P.reset = function()
					F.stop(P.BIND)
					J()
					R = nil
					P.enabled = false
				end
				return P
			end
end)()


_registry["features/localtrail"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/create")
				local O = p("core/flags")
				local u = p("game/guard")
				local F = p("services/vfx/node")
				local f, o = p("core/service"), u.CLOCKED
				local p, Z = f.get("Players"), f.get("RunService")
				local f = p and p.LocalPlayer
				local p, i, y, P, b, I, h =
					{ DEFAULT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(240, 154, 255) },
					0.15,
					1.5,
					500,
					{
						{ key = "left", names = { "LeftFoot", "Left Leg" } },
						{ key = "right", names = { "RightFoot", "Right Leg" } },
					}
				local A, T = {}
				local function r()
					local S = workspace.CurrentCamera
					if not S then
						return nil
					end
					local c = I and I.Parent == S
					if c then
						local R = I
						return R
					end
					c = I
					if c then
						pcall(function()
							I:Destroy()
						end)
					end
					I = nil
					table.clear(A)
					I = Instance.new("Folder")
					I.Name = "Camera"
					u.own(I)
					I.Parent = S
					c = I
					return c
				end
				local function S(c, R)
					for e, G in ipairs(R.names) do
						e = c:FindFirstChild(G)
						if e and (e:IsA("BasePart")) then
							return e
						end
					end
					return nil
				end
				local function c(R)
					local e = r()
					if not e then
						return nil
					end
					local r = A[R]
					if r then
						return r
					end
					r = Instance.new("Part")
					r.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
					r.Transparency = 1
					F.hygiene(r)
					r.Parent = e
					local F, G =
						J.new("Attachment", { Position = Vector3.new(0, i / 2, 0), Parent = r }),
						J.new("Attachment", { Position = Vector3.new(0, -i / 2, 0), Parent = r })
					e = J.new(
						"Trail",
						{
							Attachment0 = F,
							Attachment1 = G,
							Color = ColorSequence.new(O.color("trail_color", p.DEFAULT_COLOR)),
							Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
								NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.05),
								NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, 0.45),
								NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
							}),
							WidthScale = NumberSequence.new({
								NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
								NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.05),
							}),
							Lifetime = y,
							LightEmission = 1,
							LightInfluence = 0,
							FaceCamera = true,
							MinLength = 0.05,
							Parent = r,
						}
					)
					T = nil
					F = { anchor = r, trail = e, last = nil }
					A[R] = F
					return F
				end
				local function J(F)
					local i, y = f and f.Character, O.color("trail_color", p.DEFAULT_COLOR)
					local f, r = y ~= T, typeof(F) == "number" and F > 0
					for R, e in ipairs(b) do
						if o then
							u.enter("trail/foot")
						end
						R = i and (S(i, e))
						if o then
							u.leave("trail/foot")
						end
						if not R then
							local o = A[e.key]
							if o and o.last then
								o.last = nil
								o.trail:Clear()
							end
						else
							local o = c(e.key)
							if o then
								local i = (R.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -R.Size.Y / 2, 0)).Position
								if o.last and r and (i - o.last).Magnitude / F > P then
									o.trail:Clear()
								end
								if f then
									o.trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(y)
								end
								o.anchor.CFrame = CFrame.new(i)
								o.last = i
							end
						end
					end
					if f then
						T = y
					end
				end
				local function F()
					local f = h
					if f then
						h:Disconnect()
						h = nil
					end
					f = I
					if f then
						pcall(function()
							I:Destroy()
						end)
					end
					I, T = nil, nil
					table.clear(A)
				end
				p.refresh = function()
					local f = O.bool("trail_enabled")
					if f then
						local O = not h
						if O then
							h = Z.Heartbeat:Connect(u.safe(J, "localtrail"))
						end
						return p
					end
					F()
					return p
				end
				p.reset = function()
					F()
					return p
				end
				return p
			end
end)()


_registry["features/los"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J, O, u, F, f, o, Z, i, y, P, b =
					math,

					b.new().ExcludeInstances = {}
				end)
				local p = e and function(G, q)
					G.ExcludeInstances = q
				end or function(G, q)
					G.FilterDescendantsInstances = q
				end
				local G = R.get("Players")

					G.LocalPlayer, { BIND = "los/draw", WIDTH = 0.1, GLOW = 5 }, 5000, 0.12, 0.2, 24
				local E, s = Z.fromRGB(255, 64, 64), {}

					s[v] = y.new(1 - v / Y)
				end
				local y = {}
				local function v(m)
					y[m.player] = { yaw = m.yaw, vertical = m.vertical }
				end
				local function m(B)
					local g = J.sqrt(J.max(0, 1 - B.vertical * B.vertical))
					return o.new(-J.sin(B.yaw) * g, B.vertical, -J.cos(B.yaw) * g)
				end
				local o = {}
				local function B()
					return f:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
				end
				local function g(k)
					local z = o[k]
					if z and z.beam.Parent then
						return z
					end
					z = B()
					if not z then
						return nil
					end
					local B, l =
						I.new("Attachment", { Name = "L0", Parent = z }),
						I.new("Attachment", { Name = "L1", Parent = z })
					if not B or not l then
						return nil
					end
					local D = I.new(
						"Beam",
						{
							Name = "Sight",
							Attachment0 = B,
							Attachment1 = l,

							CurveSize1 = 0,
							Segments = 10,
							FaceCamera = true,
							LightEmission = 1,
							LightInfluence = 0,
							Enabled = false,
							Parent = z,
						}
					)
					if not D then
						return nil
					end
					o[k] = { a0 = B, a1 = l, beam = D, fade = 0, tint = nil, hidden = true, on = false }
					return o[k]
				end
				local function I(B)
					local k = o[B]
					if not k then
						return
					end
					F(function()
						k.beam:Destroy()
					end)
					F(function()
						k.a0:Destroy()
					end)
					F(function()
						k.a1:Destroy()
					end)
					o[B] = nil
				end
				local F
				local B = { nil, nil }
				local function k(z, l)
					local D = not F
					if D then
						F = b.new()
						local b = not e
						if b then
							local b = F
							b.FilterType = i.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
						end
						F.IgnoreWater = true
					end
					B[1] = z
					B[2] = l
					p(F, B)
					z = F
					return z
				end
				local function p(i, b, e)
					local z = b > i.fade and H or Q
					i.fade = i.fade + (b - i.fade) * J.min(1, e / z)
					return i.fade
				end
				local function i(b, e)
					if b.on == e then
						return
					end
					b.on = e
					b.beam.Enabled = e
				end
				local function b(e, H, Q)
					if H and e.tint ~= H then
						e.tint = H
						e.beam.Color = P.new(H)
					end
					if e.width ~= q.WIDTH then
						e.width = q.WIDTH
						e.beam.Width0 = q.WIDTH
						e.beam.Width1 = q.WIDTH
					end
					if e.glow ~= q.GLOW then
						e.glow = q.GLOW
						e.beam.Brightness = q.GLOW
					end
					H = J.floor(J.clamp(Q, 0, 1) * Y + 0.5)
					if e.step ~= H then
						e.step = H
						e.beam.Transparency = s[H]
					end
					i(e, true)
				end
				local P
				local e, H, Q, Y = false, false
				local function s()
					local z, l = h.generation(), P
					if l == z then
						return
					end
					P = z
					e = h.bool("los_ally")
					H = h.bool("los_enemy")
					Q = h.color("los_enemy_color", Z.fromRGB(255, 190, 80))
					Y = h.color("los_ally_color", Z.fromRGB(120, 200, 255))
				end
				local Z, P, z = {}, 0.03333333333333333
				local function l(D)
					if T.inMainMenu() then
						z()
						return
					end
					local K = J.min(D or 0.016666666666666666, 0.1)
					s()
					local J, s, C = T.characterOf(R), T.viewedCharacter(), f:FindFirstChild("Debris")
					O.clear(Z)
					local T, R = r.get()
					for r = 1, R, 1 do
						D = T[r]
						r = D.player
						local T, R = r and D.alive and y[r] or nil, D.ally
						local a = T and (R and e or not R and H)
						if a then
							local e = D.character
							local H = e and e ~= s and e:FindFirstChild("Head")
							if H then
								Z[r] = true
								local D = g(r)
								if D then
									local r, g, a, j = H.Position, os.clock(), D.target, D.atMe
									if not a or not D.castAt or g - D.castAt > P then
										local P = m(T)
										local T = f:Raycast(r, P * w, k(e, C))
										a, j =
											T and T.Position or r + P * w,
											T and T.Instance and J and T.Instance:IsDescendantOf(J)
										D.castAt = g
										D.target = a
										D.atMe = j
									else
									end
									g = j and E or (R and Y or Q)
									D.hidden = false
									D.a0.WorldPosition = r
									D.a1.WorldPosition = a
									b(D, g, p(D, 1, K))
								end
							end
						end
					end
					for J, f in u(o) do
						if not Z[J] and not f.hidden then
							s = p(f, 0, K)
							if s < 0.01 then
								f.fade = 0
								f.hidden = true
								i(f, false)
							else
								b(f, nil, s)
							end
						end
					end
				end
				local p, J
				z = function()
					for f, f in u(o) do
						f.fade = 0
						f.hidden = true
						i(f, false)
					end
				end
				q.refresh = function()
					local f = h.bool("los_enabled")
					local Z = f and not p
					if Z then
						S.start()
						p = S.on("lookAngle", v)
					else
						local i = not f and p
						if i then
							S.off(p)
							p = nil
						end
					end
					Z = f and not J
					if Z then
						J = G.PlayerRemoving:Connect(c.safe(function(Z)
							y[Z] = nil
							I(Z)
						end, "los/leave"))
					end
					if f then
						A.onDraw(q.BIND, l)
					else
						A.stop(q.BIND)
						z()
					end
					return q
				end
				q.reset = function()
					A.stop(q.BIND)
					local f = p
					if f then
						S.off(p)
						p = nil
					end
					f = J
					if f then
						J:Disconnect()
						J = nil
					end
					for p in u(o) do
						I(p)
					end
					O.clear(o)
					O.clear(y)
					O.clear(B)
					F = nil
				end
				return q
			end
end)()


_registry["features/menuguard"] = (function()

local J = getthreadidentity
local O = getloadedmodules

return function(p)
				local u = p("ui/inputguard")
				local F = p("game/modules")
				local f, o, Z = p("core/log"), {}
				local function p()
					if typeof(debug) ~= "table" or typeof(debug.getupvalues) ~= "function" then
						return nil
					end
					local i = F.controller("InputController")
					if not i or typeof(i.Start) ~= "function" then
						return nil
					end
					local y, P = pcall(debug.getupvalues, i.Start)
					if not y or typeof(P) ~= "table" then
						return nil
					end
					for i, i in pairs(P) do
						if
							typeof(i) == "table"
							and (rawget(i, "ScrollWheelUp") ~= nil or rawget(i, "ScrollWheelDown") ~= nil)
						then
							return i
						end
					end
					return nil
				end
				o.DIAGNOSTICS = false
				local i = false
				local function y()
					local P = i
					if P then
						return
					end
					i = true
					local i = {}
					local function b(I, h)
						table.insert(i, string.format("%s=%s", I, tostring(h)))
					end
					b("getupvalues", typeof(debug) == "table" and typeof(debug.getupvalues) or "no debug")
					local I
					b("threadid", typeof(J))
					local J
					b("loadedmodules", typeof(O))
					table.insert(i, "| " .. tostring(F.trace("Controllers", "InputController")))
					P = F.controller("InputController")
					b("| controller", typeof(P))
					if typeof(P) == "table" then
						b("Start", typeof(P.Start))
						if typeof(P.Start) == "function" then
							local J, O = pcall(debug.getupvalues, P.Start)
							b("upvalues", J and (typeof(O) == "table" and #O or typeof(O)) or "error")
							if J and typeof(O) == "table" then
								local J, F = {}, 0
								for P, P in pairs(O) do
									if typeof(P) == "table" then
										F += 1
										for O in pairs(P) do
											if typeof(O) == "string" then
												table.insert(J, O)
											end
										end
									else
									end
								end
								b("tables", F)
								b("keys", table.concat(J, ","):sub(1, 200))
							end
						end
					end
					f.info("guard", table.concat(i, " "))
				end
				local function J()
					local O = Z
					if O then
						return
					end
					O = p()
					if not O then
						if o.DIAGNOSTICS then
							pcall(y)
						end
						return
					end
					Z = { map = O, up = O.ScrollWheelUp, down = O.ScrollWheelDown }
					O.ScrollWheelUp = nil
					O.ScrollWheelDown = nil
				end
				local function p()
					local O = Z
					if not O then
						return
					end
					O = Z
					local F = O
					Z = nil
					if F.map.ScrollWheelUp == nil then
						F.map.ScrollWheelUp = F.up
					end
					if F.map.ScrollWheelDown == nil then
						F.map.ScrollWheelDown = F.down
					end
				end
				o.start = function()
					u.add({ block = J, release = p })
				end
				o.stop = function()
					p()
				end
				return o
			end
end)()


_registry["features/modulation"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/create")
				local O = p("game/guard")
				local u = p("core/log")
				local F = p("services/modstyle")
				local f, o = p("core/service").get("RunService"), {}
				local p, Z = string.char(0), 0.1
				local function i(y, P)
					if P.solid then
						y.Material = P.material
						y.Color = P.color
						y.Transparency = P.transparency
					else
						y.Transparency = 1
					end
					for b, b in ipairs(y:GetDescendants()) do
						if b:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
							b.Color = P.sequence
							b.LightEmission = P.glow
							b.LightInfluence = 1 - P.glow
						end
					end
				end
				local function y(P, b)
					local I = P:FindFirstChildOfClass("Highlight")
					if not b.xray or not b.solid then
						if I then
							I:Destroy()
						end
						return
					end
					if not I then
						I = J.new(
							"Highlight",
							{ DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop, OutlineTransparency = 1, Parent = P }
						)
						if not I then
							return
						end
					else
					end
					I.Adornee = P
					I.FillColor = b.color
					I.FillTransparency = b.transparency
				end
				local function P(b, I, h)
					local A = b:FindFirstChild(p)
					if not h.light then
						if A then
							A:Destroy()
						end
						return
					end
					if not A then
						A = J.new(
							"Part",
							{
								Name = p,
								Anchored = true,
								CanCollide = false,
								CanQuery = false,
								CanTouch = false,
								CastShadow = false,
								Transparency = 1,
								Size = Vector3.new(1.0, 1.0, 1.0),
								Parent = b,
							}
						)
						if not A then
							return
						end
						J.new("PointLight", { Shadows = false, Parent = A })
					else
					end
					A.CFrame = CFrame.new(I)
					I = A:FindFirstChildOfClass("PointLight")
					if I then
						I.Color = h.color
						I.Brightness = h.brightness
						I.Range = h.range
					end
				end
				local J = {}
				local function b(I)
					local h, A, T, r, S = I.node:GetChildren(), (Vector3.new(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)), 0, 1 / 0, -1 / 0
					for c, R in ipairs(h) do
						if R:IsA("BasePart") and R.Name ~= p then
							A += R.Position
							T += 1
							c = R.Size.Y / 2
							r, S =
								if R.Position.Y - c < r then R.Position.Y - c else r,
								if R.Position.Y + c > S then R.Position.Y + c else S
						else
						end
					end
					if T == 0 then
						I.centre = nil
						return
					end
					local c, R = A / T, 0
					for A, T in ipairs(h) do
						if T:IsA("BasePart") and T.Name ~= p then
							A = Vector2.new(T.Position.X - c.X, T.Position.Z - c.Z).Magnitude + T.Size.X / 2
							R = if A > R then A else R
						else
						end
					end
					I.centre = c
					I.radius = R
					I.bottom = r
					I.top = S
				end
				local function I(h, A)
					local T = h.node
					for r, r in ipairs(T:GetChildren()) do
						if r:IsA("BasePart") and r.Name ~= p then
							i(r, A)
						end
					end
					b(h)
					y(T, A)
					if h.centre then
						P(T, h.centre, A)
					end
				end
				local h = {}
				local function A(T, r)
					local S = { node = T, kind = r, signature = "" }
					table.insert(J, S)
					local c = T.ChildAdded:Connect(O.safe(function(R)
						if not R:IsA("BasePart") or R.Name == p then
							return
						end
						local e = F.of(r)
						if not e then
							return
						end
						i(R, e)
						b(S)
						y(T, e)
						if S.centre then
							P(T, S.centre, e)
						end
					end, "modulation/voxel"))
					table.insert(h, c)
					task.defer(function()
						if not T.Parent then
							return
						end
						local i = F.of(r)
						if not i then
							return
						end
						I(S, i)
						S.signature = F.signature(i)
					end)
				end
				local function i(y)
					if not y then
						return
					end
					if not y:IsA("Folder") then
						return
					end
					local P = y.Name
					if P:sub(1, 11) == "VoxelSmoke_" then
						A(y, "smoke")
					elseif P:sub(1, 10) == "VoxelFire_" then
						A(y, "fire")
					end
				end
				local y, P = 0, {}
				local function b()
					local A, T = os.clock(), y
					if A < T then
						return
					end
					y = A + Z
					table.clear(P)
					for Z in pairs(F.KINDS) do
						P[Z] = F.of(Z)
					end
					for Z = #J, 1, -1 do
						A = J[Z]
						if not A.node.Parent then
							table.remove(J, Z)
						else
							T = P[A.kind]
							if T then
								local Z = F.signature(T)
								if Z ~= A.signature then
									A.signature = Z
									I(A, T)
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
				local Z, y = false
				local function P()
					for I in pairs(F.KINDS) do
						if F.of(I) then
							return true
						end
					end
					return false
				end
				o.refresh = function()
					local I = not P()
					if I then
						local P = y
						if P then
							y:Disconnect()
							y = nil
						end
						return o
					end
					I = not Z
					if I then
						local P = workspace:FindFirstChild("Debris")
						local A = not P
						if A then
							u.warn("modulation", "workspace.Debris is missing, nothing will be styled")
						else
							Z = true
							table.insert(h, P.ChildAdded:Connect(O.safe(i, "modulation/debris")))
							for u, u in ipairs(P:GetChildren()) do
								task.spawn(i, u)
							end
						end
					end
					I = not y
					if I then
						y = f.Heartbeat:Connect(O.safe(b, "modulation"))
					end
					return o
				end
				o.reset = function()
					local O = y
					if O then
						y:Disconnect()
						y = nil
					end
					for u, u in ipairs(h) do
						pcall(function()
							u:Disconnect()
						end)
					end
					table.clear(h)
					for u, u in ipairs(J) do
						O = u.node
						if O and O.Parent then
							local u = O:FindFirstChild(p)
							if u then
								pcall(function()
									u:Destroy()
								end)
							end
							local p = O:FindFirstChildOfClass("Highlight")
							if p then
								pcall(function()
									p:Destroy()
								end)
							end
						end
					end
					table.clear(J)
					F.reset()
					Z = false
				end
				return o
			end
end)()

						end

						end

						i.clear("pen_shot")

return function(r21)

		FLAG = "net_ping_nan",
		NAN_REPORT = "nan",
	}

	local r10 = 0.03
	local r11 = false
	local r13 = false

	local r14 = function()
		local s9 = math.floor(r8.DEFAULT_MS)

		if s9 < r8.MIN_MS then
			s9 = r8.MIN_MS
		end

		if r8.MAX_MS < s9 then
			s9 = r8.MAX_MS
		end

		local s4 = math.floor(s9 * r10)

		if not (s4 > 0) then
			if s9 < r8.MIN_MS then
				s9 = r8.MIN_MS
			end

			if s9 > r8.MAX_MS then
				s9 = r8.MAX_MS
			end

			return s9
		end

		local s3 = -s4
		math.random(s3, s4)

		if not s3 then
		end

		error("devirt: bit32.bxor failed: int() argument must be a string, a bytes-like object or a real number, not 'NoneType' (at 34:34)")
	end

	local r16 = function()
		if r1.bool(r8.FLAG) then
			return r8.NAN_REPORT, (0/0)
		end
		local s7 = r14()
		return string.format("%d", s7), s7
	end

	local r17 = function()
		local s6 = r5.get("Database", "Security", "Remotes")
		local s6_1 = typeof(s6) == "table" and s6.Player or nil
		local s7_1

			s7_1 = s6_1.ReportPlayerConnect
			s7_1 = s7_1 or nil
			local s6_2 = typeof(s7_1) == "table"

			if s6_2 then
				s6_2 = typeof(s7_1.Send) == "function"
				if s6_2 then
					return s7_1
				end
			elseif s6_2 then
				return s7_1
			end
		else
			s7_1 = nil

			if typeof(s7_1) == "table" then
				if typeof(s7_1.Send) == "function" then
					return s7_1
				end
			end
		end

		return nil
	end

	local r18 = function()
		local s4 = r17()

		if not s4 then
			if not r13 then
				r13 = true
				r4.warn("pingspoof", "Remotes.Player.ReportPlayerConnect.Send did not resolve; the swap waits for the next refresh")
			end

			return
		end

		local s11 = s4.Send

		r11 = r7.set(r8.GROUP, s4, "Send", function(t27, ...)
			local t1 = tonumber(t27)

			if t1 ~= nil then
				r3.observe(t1)
			end

			local t1_1, t2, t3 = pcall(r16)
			if not t1_1 then
				return s11(t27, ...)
			end
			r3.declare(t3)
			return s11(t2, ...)
		end) == true
	end

	local r19 = function()
		return r8.ENABLED or r1.bool(r8.FLAG)
	end

	local r20 = function()
		return r11 and r19() and r7.applied(r8.GROUP)
	end

	r8.armed = r20

	r8.refresh = function()

		r7.sync(r8.GROUP, s8, r18)

				local F = p("features/autokill")
				local f = p("core/flags")
				local o = p("services/frame")
				local Z = p("services/gamedata")
				local i = p("services/lethality")
				local y = p("services/trace")
				local P = p("ui/library")
				local b = p("services/motion")
				local I = p("services/seed")
				local h, A, T, r, S =
					p("services/targeting"),
					{ BIND = "aim/rage" },
					0.08333333333333333,
					{ at = 0, part = nil, player = nil, shot = nil }
				A.target = function()
					local p = S
					return p
				end
				A.reachable = function()
					local p = S ~= nil and r.shot ~= nil
					return p
				end
				A.solution = function()
					local p = S ~= nil and r.shot or nil
					return p
				end
				local function p(c)
					return b.offset(c)
				end
				local b =
					{ offsetOf = p, hitbox = Z.NEAREST, aliveCheck = true, visibleCheck = false, allowImmune = true }
				local function c()
					local R = F.set()
					b.only = R
					b.teamCheck = R == nil
					b.fovDegrees = f.num("rage_fov", 360)
					return b
				end
				local function b(R)
					local e, G, q, w = os.clock(), h.candidates(R, c()), I.aim(R), f.set("rage_hitbox")
					u.beginFrame(q)
					R = {}
					y.every("fila", 0.5, "rage", "%d candidatos na varredura", #G)
					for I, c in ipairs(G) do
						I = Z.characterOf(c.player)
						local H, Q
						if I then
							local Y = u.closeness(q, I)
							H, Q = i.bound(c.player, q, w, p(I), Y)
							for p = 1, u.backRungs(), 1 do
								local E = u.backFor(I, p)
								if E then
									local p, I = i.bound(c.player, q, w, E, Y)
									if p and (H == nil or p > H) then
										H, Q = p, I
									else
									end
								else
								end
							end
						else
						end
						if H then
							R[#R + 1] = { player = c.player, bound = H, health = Q, immune = c.immune }
						end
					end
					table.sort(R, function(p, I)
						if p.immune ~= I.immune then
							return not p.immune
						end
						return p.bound > I.bound
					end)
					local p = r.part
					local I = not not (p and p.Parent)
					if I then
						local I, c, H = r.shot and r.shot.health or nil, true, false
						for Q, Q in ipairs(R) do
							local Y, E = Q.player, r.player
							if Y == E then
								c = false
							else
								H = if I and Q.bound > I then true else H
							end
						end
						I = not c and not H and e - r.at < T
						if I then
							return p
						end
					end
					r.at = e
					local I, T, c, e
					for H, H in ipairs(R) do
						if I and I.kills then
							break
						end
						if H.immune and I and not T then
							break
						end
						if not (I ~= nil and H.bound <= I.health and H.bound < H.health) then
							p = u.solve(H.player, q, w)
							if i.better(p, I) then
								c, e = p.part, H.player
								I, T = p, H.immune
							else
							end
						else
						end
					end
					if not c then
						q = nil
						for p, p in ipairs(G) do
							if not p.immune then
								q = p
								break
							end
						end
						q = q or G[1]
						c, e = q and q.part or nil, q and q.player or nil
					else
					end
					r.part = c
					r.player = e
					r.shot = I
					return c
				end
				local function p()
					S = nil
					if not (f.bool("rage_enabled") or F.set()) then
						y.every("cadeia", 0.5, "rage", "parado: `rage` desligado e sem auto kill")
						return O.idle(workspace.CurrentCamera)
					end
					if P.open or Z.isTyping() or Z.viewedCharacter() then
						y.every(
							"cadeia",
							0.5,
							"rage",
							"parado: menu=%s digitando=%s espectando=%s",
							tostring(P.open),
							tostring(Z.isTyping()),
							tostring(Z.viewedCharacter() ~= nil)
						)
						return
					end
					local Z = workspace.CurrentCamera
					if not Z then
						return
					end
					S = b(Z)
					local i = S
					if not i then
						y.every("cadeia", 0.5, "rage", "sem alvo: nenhum candidato produziu tiro que chega")
						return O.idle(Z)
					end
					y.every("cadeia", 0.5, "rage", "alvo escolhido: %s", tostring(S.Name))
					if f.bool("rage_silent") or F.set() then
						return O.idle(Z)
					end
					local y
					local y, y, P = J, typeof(J) == "function"
					if y then
						i = J
						P = not i()
					else
						P = y
					end
					if P then
						return O.idle(Z)
					end
					y, P = h.angleTo(Z, S.Position)
					if not y then
						return O.idle(Z)
					end
					O.turn(Z, y, P, 1)
				end
				A.refresh = function()
					local J = not (f.bool("rage_enabled") or F.set())
					if J then
						o.stop(A.BIND)
						S = nil
						local J, O = r, r
						r.part = nil
						J.player = nil
						O.shot = nil
						u.reset()
						return A
					end
					o.onDraw(A.BIND, p)
					return A
				end
				A.reset = function()
					o.stop(A.BIND)
					S, r = nil, { at = 0, part = nil, player = nil, shot = nil }
					u.reset()
				end
				return A
			end
end)()


_registry["features/ragestrafe"] = (function()
return function(r18)
	local r2 = r18("core/flags")
	local r4 = r18("services/mover")
	local r5 = r18("services/usercmd")
	local r6 = { BIND = "strafe/rage", enabled = false, DEFAULT_SPEED = 25, MAX_SPEED = 100 }
	local r7 = 1.5
	local r9 = 0.866
	local r11 = 2.25

	local r12 = function(arg1, s30, s31, arg4, arg5, s34, s35)
		if not r6.enabled then
			return
		end

		if typeof(s35) ~= "Vector3" then
			return
		end

		if typeof(s30) ~= "Vector2" then
			return
		end

		if s34 ~= false then
			return
		end
		local s1 = s35.X
		local s2 = s35.Z
		local s3 = math.sqrt(s1 * s1 + s2 * s2)
		if s3 < r7 then
			return
		end
		local s6 = math.cos(s31)
		local s8 = math.sin(s31)
		local s4 = -s30.Y
		local s5 = s6 * s30.X - s8 * s4
		local s4_1 = -s8 * s30.X - s6 * s4
		local s10 = math.sqrt(s5 * s5 + s4_1 * s4_1)
		if s10 < 0.05 then
			return
		end
		local s5_1 = s5 / s10
		local s4_2 = s4_1 / s10
		local s35_1 = r6.MAX_SPEED
		local s32 = math.clamp(r2.num("rage_strafe_speed", r6.DEFAULT_SPEED), 1.5, s35_1)
		local s10_1 = s1 / s3
		local s11 = s2 / s3
		local s1_1 = s10_1 * s4_2 - s11 * s5_1
		local s13

		if s1_1 > 0 then
			s13 = 1
		elseif s1_1 < 0 then
			s13 = -1
		else
			s13 = 1
		end

		local s800001 = 3901291376
		local s4_3

		if s10_1 * s5_1 + s11 * s4_2 < r9 then
			s4_3 = 0
		else
			if s32 <= s3 then
				return Vector2.new(s30.X, s30.Y)
			end
			s4_3 = math.min(1, r11 / (2 * s3))
		end

		local s1_2 = math.sqrt(math.max(0, 1 - s4_3 * s4_3)) * s13
		local s2_1 = s10_1 * s4_3 - s11 * s1_2
		local s1_3 = s10_1 * s1_2 + s11 * s4_3
		return Vector2.new(s6 * s2_1 - s8 * s1_3, -(-s8 * s2_1 - s6 * s1_3))
	end

	r6.refresh = function()
		local s6 = r2.bool("rage_strafe")
		r6.enabled = s6

		if s6 then
			r11 = r4.number("AirSpeedCap", 2.25)
			r5.register(r6.BIND, 30, r12)
		else
			r5.unregister(r6.BIND)
		end

		return r6
	end

	r6.reset = function()
		r5.unregister(r6.BIND)
		r6.enabled = false
	end

	return r6
end
end)()


_registry["features/scopefade"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("features/camera")
				local O = p("services/equipped")
				local u = p("core/flags")
				local F, f, o, Z, i, y, P, b, I, h, A =
					p("services/frame"),
					{ BIND = "view/scopefade", enabled = false },
					0.12,
					0.2,
					0,
					false,
					{},
					0,
					0,
					setmetatable,
					{ __mode = "k" }
				local p = h({}, A)
				f.amount = function(h)
					local A = u.num("lp_scope_fade", 0) / 100
					if A <= 0 then
						return 0
					end
					local T = O.isScoped()
					local r = T ~= y
					if r then
						y = T
						local S = math.clamp((h - i) / o, 0, 1)
						i = h - (1 - S) * o
					end
					r = math.clamp((h - i) / o, 0, 1)
					h = r * r * (3 - 2 * r)
					return (T and h or 1 - h) * A
				end
				local function o(h)
					local A = h - b
					if A < Z then
						return
					end
					b = h
					table.clear(P)
					h = workspace.CurrentCamera
					if not h then
						return
					end
					for Z, Z in ipairs(h:GetDescendants()) do
						if Z:IsA("BasePart") then
							table.insert(P, Z)
						end
					end
				end
				local function Z(h)
					for A, A in ipairs(P) do
						if A.Parent and A.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= h then
							A.LocalTransparencyModifier = h
						end
						p[A] = true
					end
				end
				local function h()
					for A in pairs(p) do
						pcall(function()
							A.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
						end)
					end
					table.clear(p)
				end
				local function A(T)
					local r = workspace.CurrentCamera
					if not r then
						return
					end
					for S, S in ipairs(r:GetDescendants()) do
						if S:IsA("BasePart") and S.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= T then
							S.LocalTransparencyModifier = T
						end
					end
				end
				f.release = function()
					local T = I ~= 0 or next(p) ~= nil
					if T then
						I = 0
						h()
						A(0)
					end
					table.clear(P)
					b = 0
				end
				local function P()
					local b = u.bool("cam_third")
					if
						if not b and typeof(J.viewmodelBlocked) == "function" then J.viewmodelBlocked() else b
					then
						f.release()
						return
					end
					local J = os.clock()
					local b = f.amount(J)
					local A = b == 0
					if A then
						local A = I ~= 0 or next(p) ~= nil
						if A then
							I = 0
							h()
						end
						return
					end
					I = b
					o(J)
					Z(b)
				end
				f.refresh = function()
					local p = u.num("lp_scope_fade", 0) > 0
					f.enabled = p
					if p then
						O.start()
						F.onDraw(f.BIND, P)
					else
						F.stop(f.BIND)
						f.release()
					end
					return f
				end
				f.reset = function()
					F.stop(f.BIND)
					f.release()
					i, y = 0, false
					f.enabled = false
				end
				return f
			end
end)()

return function(r6)

	}

	local r3 = false
	local r4 = {}
	local r5 = nil

		s11 = s11 and s11.LocalPlayer

		return s11 and s11:FindFirstChild("MainGui") or nil

		end

		return s19
	end

		return r1 and r1[arg1] or nil
	end

		local s14 = {}
		local s2 = r7.avatar()
		local s3 = r11.get("Players")
		s3 = s3 and s3.LocalPlayer

		if s2 and s3 then
			s14[s3.UserId] = s2
		end

		local s2_1, s3_1 = pcall(r10.list)

		if s2_1 and typeof(s3_1) == "table" then
			for _, s4_1 in ipairs(s3_1) do
				local s8 = tonumber(s4_1.userId)

				if s8 and s4_1.avatar then
					local s9_1 = r9.ready(s4_1.avatar)

					if s9_1 then
						s14[s8] = s9_1
					else
						r9.want(s4_1.avatar, s4_1.initial, function()
							if not r3 then
								return
							end
							r19()
							r12.apply()
						end)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		r1 = s14
	end

	local r20 = function(s37)
		if not s37:IsA("ImageLabel") and not s37:IsA("ImageButton") then
			return false
		end
		local s1_1 = s37.Image
		if typeof(s1_1) ~= "string" then
			return false
		end
		local s38 = s1_1:match(r12.PATTERN)
		if s38 == nil then
			return false
		end
		local s2 = r17(tonumber(s38))
		if s2 == nil then
			return false
		end

		if s1_1 == s2 then
			return false
		end
		r2[s37] = s1_1
		s37.Image = s2
		return true
	end

	r12.apply = function()
		if not r3 then
			return r12
		end
		local s9 = r14()
		if s9 == nil then
			return r12
		end

		if #r4 == 0 then
			r5(s9)
		end

		local s2, s3, s4 = ipairs(r12.ROOTS)
		local s15 = 0

		for _, s4_1 in s2, s3, s4 do
			local s8 = r15(s9, s4_1)

			if s8 ~= nil then
				local s6, s7, s8_1 = ipairs(s8:GetDescendants())

				for _, s8_2 in s6, s7, s8_1 do
					if r20(s8_2) then
						s15 += 1
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return r12
	end

	local r22 = function()
		for s3, s4 in pairs(r2) do
			pcall(function()
				if s3.Parent ~= nil then
					s3.Image = s4
				end
			end)
		end

		r2 = {}
	end

	r5 = function(s8)
		local s3, s4, s5 = ipairs(r12.ROOTS)

		for _, s5_1 in s3, s4, s5 do
			local s7 = r15(s8, s5_1)

			if s7 ~= nil then

	r12.setShown = function(arg1)

		if s2 == r3 then
			return r12
		end
		r3 = s2

		if not s2 then
			for _, s4 in ipairs(r4) do
				pcall(function()
					s4:Disconnect()
				end)
			end

			r22()
			return r12
		end

		r19()
		local s2_1 = r14()

		if s2_1 ~= nil then
			r5(s2_1)
		end

		if not r6_1 then
			r6_1 = true

			local s3_1 = function()
				if not r3 then
					return
				end
				r19()
				r12.apply()
			end

			r10.onChange(r8.safe(s3_1, "scoreswap"))
		end

		r12.apply()
		return r12
	end

	r12.reset = function()
		r12.setShown(false)
		r1 = nil
		r2 = {}
	end

	return r12
end
end)()

				local c = x + iH + bH + iH * 2

				local function QH(YH)
					local EH = YH:IsA("Sound") and YH.SoundId == rH
					if EH then
						cH = true
						RH = not RH
					end
				end

function Runtime:oh(values) return table.unpack(values, 1, values.n) end
function Runtime:Wh(destination, offset, ...)

    table.move(values, 1, values.n, offset + 1, destination)
end
function Runtime:Lh(destination, offset, values)
    table.move(values, 1, values.n, offset + 1, destination)

end

							TextStrokeColor3 = A.new(),
							Visible = false,
							ZIndex = m.HUD + 2,
							Parent = X,
						}
					)
					X = not K
					if X then
						D = nil
						return false
					end
					return true
				end
				local function A()
					local S = D
					if S then
						local S = D
						for w, w in o(S) do
							w.Visible = false
						end
					end
				end
				local S = {}
				local function w(v, m, l)
					local x = O.abs(l.Y) > 0.99 and I.new(1, 0, 0) or I.new(0, 1, 0)
					local I = l:Cross(x)
					if I.Magnitude <= 0 then
						return nil
					end
					I = I.Unit * g
					x = I.Unit:Cross(l)
					if x.Magnitude <= 0 then
						return nil
					end
					x = x.Unit * g
					local g = m + l * 0.01
					for l = 1, 4, 1 do
						m = v:WorldToViewportPoint(
							if l == 1
								then g + I + x
								else if l == 2
									then g - I + x
									else if l == 3 then g - I - x else g + I - x
						)
						if m.Z <= 0 then
							return nil
						end
						S[l] = h.new(m.X, m.Y)
					end
					return S
				end
				local function I(h, S, v, m)
					local g = D[h]
					if not g then
						return
					end
					h = v - S
					v = h.Magnitude
					if v < 0.5 then
						g.Visible = false
						return
					end
					local l = S + h * 0.5
					g.Size = T.fromOffset(O.round(v), k)
					g.Position = T.fromOffset(O.round(l.X), O.round(l.Y))
					g.Rotation = O.deg(O.atan2(h.Y, h.X))
					g.BackgroundColor3 = m
					g.Visible = true
				end
				local function h()
					local S = s and (s:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui"))
					if not S then
						return {}
					end
					local v, m = {}, { S:FindFirstChild("MainGui"), S:FindFirstChild("NEWMainGui") }
					for g, k in o(m) do
						S = k and (k:FindFirstChild("Gameplay"))
						k = S and (S:FindFirstChild("Middle"))
						g = k and (k:FindFirstChild("Crosshair"))
						if g then
							for S, S in o(g:GetDescendants()) do
								if S:IsA("ImageLabel") then
									u.insert(v, { object = S, prop = "ImageColor3" })
								elseif S:IsA("Frame") then
									u.insert(v, { object = S, prop = "BackgroundColor3" })
								end
							end
						end
					end
					return v
				end
				local function S()
					local v = L or n
					if v then
						return
					end
					v = f.clock()
					local f = v - M
					if f < 1 then
						return
					end
					M, n = v, true
					b.defer(q.safe(function()
						local f = H.get("Interface", "Screens", "Gameplay", "Middle", "Crosshair")
						local b = i(f) == "table" and i(f.UpdateCrosshair) == "function"
						if b then
							L = f
						end
						n = false
					end, "shotinfo/resolve"))
				end
				local function f()
					local b = L
					if not b then
						return
					end
					local b = L.UpdateCrosshair
					Q.set(B.GROUP, L, "UpdateCrosshair", function(...)
						local H, v = u.pack(q.call(b, ...)), d
						if v then
							local b = p[14](h())
							for h, h in o(p:oh(b)) do
								Z(function()
									h.object[h.prop] = d
								end)
							end
						end
						if not H[1] then
							return
						end
						return u.unpack(H, 2, H.n)
					end)
				end
				local function p()
					d = nil
				end
				local function u(Z)
					local b = not K or C == Z
					if b then
						return
					end
					C = Z
					K.Visible = Z
				end
				local function Z()
					A()
					u(false)
					p()
					Y.preview(nil)
				end
				local function b(h)
					for q, H in o(h) do
						local o = c.partOf(H.instance)
						if o then
							local h = H.instance.Parent
							local H = h and J and J:GetPlayerFromCharacter(h)
							if H and H ~= s then
								return H, o, q
							end
						end
					end
					return nil
				end
				local function J(o, h, q)
					local H = R.str("shotinfo_mode", B.MARKER) == B.DOT
					if H then
						d = q
						A()
						return
					end
					p()
					H = h[1]
					h = w(o, H.position, H.normal)
					if not h then
						A()
						return
					end
					for p = 1, 4, 1 do
						I(p, h[p], h[p % 4 + 1], q)
					end
				end
				local function p()
					if G.inMainMenu() then
						Z()
						return
					end
					local o = R.bool("shotinfo_enabled") and R.str("shotinfo_mode", B.MARKER) == B.DOT
					if o then
						S()
					end
					Q.sync(B.GROUP, o and L ~= nil, f)
					if not R.bool("shotinfo_enabled") then
						Z()
						return
					end
					o = P.CurrentCamera
					if not o then
						Z()
						return
					end
					if not t() then
						return
					end
					local f = s and G.equippedInfoOf(s)
					local P = f and f.Name
					f = P and G.weapon(P)
					if not f or i(f.DamagePerPart) ~= "table" then
						Z()
						return
					end
					local i, I, h, A =
						o.CFrame.Position,
						o.CFrame.LookVector,
						(y(f.Penetration) or 0) + r.bonus(),
						y(f.Range) or 500
					local r = E.trace(i, I, h, A)
					if not r or #r == 0 then
						Z()
						return
					end
					Y.preview(r)
					A, h, I = b(r)
					if not A then
						J(o, r, #r == 1 and B.BLOCKED or B.OPEN)
						u(false)
						return
					end
					J(o, r, B.TARGET)
					local J, b = c.armorOf(A)
					local S = c.predict({
						weapon = P,
						part = h,
						distance = (r[I].position - i).Magnitude,
						traversals = I - 1,
						armor = J,
						armorKind = b,
					})
					if not S then
						u(false)
						return
					end
					i, r, P, h =
						c.lethal(S, G.healthOf(A) or 100),
						y(f.BulletsPerShot) or 1,
						S.capped and true or false,
						a
					b = h ~= S.health or j ~= r or V ~= i or N ~= P
					if b then
						a, j, V, N = S.health, r, i, P
						I = F.format("-%d", S.health)
						I = if r > 1 then I .. F.format("  x%d", r) else I
						K.Text = if P
							then "~" .. (if i then I .. "  KILL" else I)
							else if i then I .. "  KILL" else I
					end
					r = i and B.BLOCKED or B.TARGET
					A = W ~= r
					if A then
						W = r
						K.TextColor3 = r
					end
					i = o.ViewportSize
					J, I = O.round(i.X / 2), O.round(i.Y / 2 + z)
					b = U ~= J or _ ~= I
					if b then
						U, _ = J, I
						S = K
						S.Position = T.fromOffset(J, I)
					end
					u(true)
				end
				B.refresh = function()
					local J = R.bool("shotinfo_enabled")
					B.enabled = J
					if J then
						e.onDraw(B.BIND, p)
					else
						e.stop(B.BIND)
						Z()
						Q.clear(B.GROUP)
					end
					return B
				end
				B.reset = function()
					e.stop(B.BIND)
					Z()
					Q.clear(B.GROUP)
					D, K, L, n = nil, nil, nil, false
					B.enabled = false
				end
				return B
			end
end)()

				local ZH, iH = {}, 64
