								local v = (p.Position - bH).Magnitude
								if v < IH then
									IH, hH = v, AH
								else
								end
							else
							end
						else
						end
					end
					return hH
				end
				local function p(v, iH)
					local bH, IH, hH = FH(v)
					if not bH then
						return
					end
					local FH, AH, TH, rH = t[bH], oH(v)
					if not AH then
						return
					end
					if not rH and y[bH] then
						local y = PH(v.position)
						if y then
							TH = y.UserId
							AH, rH = "p" .. y.UserId, y
						else
						end
					else
					end
					if rH then
						local y = Q.isEnemy(rH) and "sesp_enemy" or "sesp_ally"
						if not q.bool(y) then
							return
						end
					end
					for y, y in f(B) do
						if
							y.group == AH
							and y.category == bH
							and y.expires > iH
							and (y.position - v.position).Magnitude <= FH.merge
						then
							y.position = v.position
							y.expires = iH + FH.life
							y.asset = hH
							y.glyph = IH
							y.player = rH
							return
						end
					end
					if #B >= D then
						return
					end
					pH += 1
					O.insert(
						B,
						{
							id = pH,
							group = AH,
							userId = TH,
							player = rH,
							position = v.position,
							category = bH,
							glyph = IH,
							asset = hH,
							born = iH,
							expires = iH + FH.life,
							life = FH.life,
							rank = FH.rank,
						}
					)
				end
				local y, v = 0.68, 0.15
				local D, t, FH, oH, iH, PH, bH, IH, hH, AH, TH, rH, SH, cH, RH, eH, GH, qH, wH, HH, QH =
					P({}, { __mode = "k" }),
					3.2,
					2.7,
					0.12,
					3,
					{},
					0.06,
					70,
					3,
					4,
					0.78,
					13,
					26,
					0.5,
					1.35,
					0.5,
					1.7,
					0.12,
					0.35,
					{},
					{}
				local function YH(EH)
					local sH = PH[EH]
					if sH and sH.node.Parent then
						return sH
					end
					local vH = b and b.Terrain
					if not vH then
						return nil
					end
					local mH = R.new("CylinderHandleAdornment")
					mH.Name = "SoundRing"
					mH.Adornee = vH
					mH.AlwaysOnTop = true
					mH.ZIndex = 0
					mH.Radius = t
					mH.InnerRadius = FH
					mH.Height = oH
					mH.Transparency = 1
					mH.Visible = false
					mH.Parent = vH
					sH = { node = mH }
					PH[EH] = sH
					return sH
				end
				local function t(FH, oH, EH, sH, vH, mH, BH)
					return (
						e.new(
							FH,
							{
								Name = oH,
								AnchorPoint = h.new(0.5, 0.5),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								Position = T.fromOffset(vH, 0),
								Size = T.fromOffset(EH, sH),
								ZIndex = mH,
								Parent = BH,
							}
						)
					)
				end
				local function FH(oH, EH)
					local sH = QH[oH]
					if sH and sH.node.Parent then
						return sH
					end
					local vH = e.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "SoundMark",
							AnchorPoint = h.new(0.5, 0.5),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Size = T.fromOffset(0, 0),
							Visible = false,
							ZIndex = k.HUD,
							Parent = EH,
						}
					)
					if not vH then
						return nil
					end
					local mH, BH, gH =
						t("ImageLabel", "TickGlow", hH + AH * 2, IH + AH * 2, 0, k.HUD, vH),
						t("Frame", "Tick", hH, IH, 0, k.HUD + 1, vH),
						rH * cH
					local IH, hH =
						t(
							"ImageLabel",
							"TipGlow",
							J.floor(rH * RH + 0.5),
							J.floor(SH * RH + 0.5),
							gH,
							k.HUD,
							vH
						),
						t("ImageLabel", "Tip", rH, SH, gH, k.HUD + 2, vH)
					if not (mH and BH and IH and hH) then
						vH:Destroy()
						return nil
					end
					gH, EH = e.new, {}
					EH.CornerRadius, EH.Parent = r.new(1, 0), BH
					gH("UICorner", EH)
					BH.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					local t, AH, rH = Y.get("soundtip"), Y.get("soundtipGlow"), Y.get("tickGlow")
					if t then
						hH.ImageContent = t
					end
					if AH then
						IH.ImageContent = AH
					end
					if rH then
						mH.ImageContent = rH
					end
					sH = { node = vH, halo = mH, tick = BH, glow = IH, tip = hH }
					QH[oH] = sH
					return sH
				end
				local t = {}
				local function oH(IH)
					local hH = t[IH]
					if not hH then
						hH = {}
						t[IH] = hH
					else
					end
					return hH
				end
				local function t(IH, hH, AH)
					local rH = oH(IH)
					if rH[hH] == AH then
						return
					end
					rH[hH] = AH
					IH[hH] = AH
				end
				local function IH(hH, AH, rH)
					local SH = oH(hH)
					if SH.px == AH and SH.py == rH then
						return
					end
					SH.px = AH
					SH.py = rH
					hH.Position = T.fromOffset(AH, rH)
				end
				local function hH(AH, rH, SH)
					local cH = oH(AH)
					if cH.sw == rH and cH.sh == SH then
						return
					end
					cH.sw = rH
					cH.sh = SH
					AH.Size = T.fromOffset(rH, SH)
				end
				local oH, AH, rH = A.new(1, 1, 1), {}, {}
				local function SH(cH)
					if not cH then
						return nil
					end
					local RH = AH[cH]
					if RH == nil then
						RH = Q.characterOf(cH) or false
						AH[cH] = RH
					else
					end
					return RH or nil
				end
				local cH, RH, EH, sH, vH, mH, BH, gH = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
				local function kH(zH, lH, DH)
					local KH, CH, aH = zH:WorldToViewportPoint(DH), lH.X / 2, lH.Y / 2
					zH, DH = KH.X - CH, KH.Y - aH
					if KH.Z <= 0 then
						zH, DH = -zH, -DH
					else
					end
					KH = J.sqrt(zH * zH + DH * DH)
					if KH < 1 then
						return nil
					end
					local jH = J.min(lH.X, lH.Y) * (G.ARROW_RADIUS + bH)
					return h.new(CH + zH / KH * jH, aH + DH / KH * jH), J.deg(J.atan2(DH, zH))
				end
				local function G(bH, zH, lH, DH, KH)
					local CH, aH, jH = KH.chams == true, KH.radius == true, KH.screen == true
					O.clear(EH)
					local VH, NH, WH, UH =
						0,
						q.color("sesp_screen_color", z.SCREEN_COLOR),
						q.transparency("sesp_screen_color"),
						0
					for _H, xH in o(DH) do
						KH, _H =
							J.clamp((bH - xH.born) / n, 0, 1) * J.clamp((xH.expires - bH) / M, 0, 1),
							X(xH.category)
						if CH and xH.player then
							local dH = SH(xH.player)
							if dH then
								local LH = EH[dH]
								if not LH or KH > LH.alpha then
									EH[dH] = { alpha = KH, color = _H }
								end
							end
						end
						if aH and UH < l then
							UH += 1
							local dH = YH(UH)
							if dH then
								local YH = xH.position
								if xH.player then
									local LH = SH(xH.player)
									local nH = LH and LH.PrimaryPart
									YH = if nH then nH.Position - I.new(0, iH, 0) else YH
								else
								end
								if dH.at ~= YH then
									dH.node.CFrame = S.new(YH) * S.Angles(1.5707963267948966, 0, 0)
									dH.at = YH
								end
								if dH.color ~= _H then
									dH.node.Color3 = _H
									dH.color = _H
								end
								local S = 1 - KH * 0.8
								if dH.fade ~= S then
									dH.node.Transparency = S
									dH.fade = S
								end
								if not dH.shown then
									dH.shown = true
									dH.node.Visible = true
								end
							end
						else
						end
						if jH then
							local S, iH = xH.expires - xH.life, HH[xH.group]
							if not iH then
								iH = { born = bH, heard = S, player = xH.player, position = xH.position }
								HH[xH.group] = iH
							elseif S >= iH.heard then
								iH.heard = S
								iH.player = xH.player
								iH.position = xH.position
							end
						end
					end
					if jH then
						for S, iH in o(HH) do
							DH = bH - iH.heard
							if DH > GH + wH then
								HH[S] = nil
							else
								if VH < l then
									CH = iH.position
									if iH.player then
										aH = SH(iH.player)
										KH = aH and aH.PrimaryPart
										CH = if KH then KH.Position else CH
									else
									end
									local S, YH =
										J.clamp((bH - iH.born) / qH, 0, 1), 1 - J.clamp((DH - GH) / wH, 0, 1)
									local iH = S * S * (3 - 2 * S) * (YH * YH * (3 - 2 * YH))
									VH += 1
									local S, GH, qH = FH(VH, E.base), kH(zH, lH, CH)
									if S and GH then
										S.node.Position = T.fromOffset(GH.X, GH.Y)
										S.node.Rotation = qH
										if not S.shown then
											S.shown = true
											S.node.Visible = true
										end
										S.halo.ImageColor3 = NH
										S.halo.ImageTransparency = 1 - (1 - WH) * (1 - TH) * iH
										S.tick.BackgroundColor3 = NH
										S.tick.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - (1 - WH) * iH
										S.glow.ImageColor3 = NH
										S.glow.ImageTransparency = 1 - (1 - WH) * (1 - eH) * iH
										S.tip.ImageColor3 = NH
										S.tip.ImageTransparency = 1 - (1 - WH) * iH
									elseif S and S.shown then
										S.shown = false
										S.node.Visible = false
									end
								else
								end
							end
						end
					else
						if Z(HH) then
							O.clear(HH)
						end
					end
					for Z = UH + 1, l, 1 do
						NH = PH[Z]
						if NH and NH.shown then
							NH.shown = false
							NH.node.Visible = false
						end
					end
					for Z = VH + 1, l, 1 do
						jH = QH[Z]
						if jH and jH.shown then
							jH.shown = false
							jH.node.Visible = false
						end
					end
					for Z, S in o(D) do
						DH = EH[Z]
						if not DH then
							S.node:Destroy()
							D[Z] = nil
						else
							if S.color ~= DH.color or S.alpha ~= DH.alpha then
								WH = S.node
								WH.FillColor = DH.color
								WH.OutlineColor = DH.color
								WH.FillTransparency = 1 - (1 - y) * DH.alpha
								WH.OutlineTransparency = 1 - (1 - v) * DH.alpha
								S.color = DH.color
								S.alpha = DH.alpha
							end
							EH[Z] = nil
						end
					end
					for Z, S in o(EH) do
						bH = b and b.Terrain
						if bH then
							KH = R.new("Highlight")
							KH.Name = "SoundGlow"
							KH.Adornee = Z
							KH.DepthMode = c.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
							KH.FillColor = S.color
							KH.OutlineColor = S.color
							KH.FillTransparency = 1 - (1 - y) * S.alpha
							KH.OutlineTransparency = 1 - (1 - v) * S.alpha
							KH.Parent = bH
							D[Z] = { node = KH, color = S.color, alpha = S.alpha }
						end
					end
				end
				local Z = {}
				local function y()
					local S = E.base
					if not S then
						return nil
					end
					local R = e.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "Badge",
							Size = T.fromOffset(K, K),
							AnchorPoint = h.new(0.5, 0.5),
							BackgroundColor3 = A.new(0, 0, 0),
							BackgroundTransparency = 0.45,
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							Visible = false,
							ZIndex = k.HUD,
							Parent = S,
						}
					)
					if not R then
						return nil
					end
					local v, FH = e.new, {}
					FH.CornerRadius, FH.Parent = r.new(1, 0), R
					v("UICorner", FH)
					local iH, bH, TH, eH =
						e.new(
							"Frame",
							{
								Name = "Spur",
								Size = T.fromOffset(W, W),
								AnchorPoint = h.new(0.5, 0.5),
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								Rotation = 45,
								Visible = false,
								ZIndex = k.HUD + 1,
								Parent = R,
							}
						),
						e.new(
							"ImageLabel",
							{
								Name = "Face",
								Size = T.fromOffset(C, C),
								AnchorPoint = h.new(0.5, 0.5),
								Position = T.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								ScaleType = c.ScaleType.Crop,
								Visible = false,
								ZIndex = k.HUD + 1,
								Parent = R,
							}
						),
						e.new,
						{}
					eH.CornerRadius, eH.Parent = r.new(1, 0), bH
					TH("UICorner", eH)
					S = {}
					for C, W in f(L) do
						v, eH = W[1], W[2]
						W, FH, TH =
							e.new(
								"Frame",
								{
									Name = "Ring",
									Size = T.fromOffset(K + v, K + v),
									AnchorPoint = h.new(0.5, 0.5),
									Position = T.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
									BackgroundTransparency = 1,
									BorderSizePixel = 0,
									ZIndex = k.HUD + 2 + (#L - C),
									Parent = R,
								}
							),
							e.new,
							{}
						TH.CornerRadius, TH.Parent = r.new(1, 0), W
						FH("UICorner", TH)
						S[C] = e.new("UIStroke", { Thickness = eH, Parent = W })
					end
					FH, TH, v =
						e.new(
							"Frame",
							{
								Name = "Pip",
								Size = T.fromOffset(j, j),
								AnchorPoint = h.new(0.5, 0.5),
								Position = T.new(0.5, N, 0.5, N),
								BackgroundColor3 = A.fromRGB(12, 12, 12),
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								Visible = false,
								ZIndex = k.HUD + 5,
								Parent = R,
							}
						),
						e.new,
						{}
					v.CornerRadius, v.Parent = r.new(1, 0), FH
					TH("UICorner", v)
					return {
						root = R,
						rings = S,
						glyph = e.new(
							"ImageLabel",
							{
								Name = "Glyph",
								Size = T.fromOffset(a, a),
								AnchorPoint = h.new(0.5, 0.5),
								Position = T.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								ScaleType = c.ScaleType.Fit,
								ZIndex = k.HUD + 6,
								Parent = R,
							}
						),
						label = e.new(
							"TextLabel",
							{
								Name = "Range",
								Size = T.fromOffset(K + 20, 12),
								AnchorPoint = h.new(0.5, 0),
								Position = T.new(0.5, 0, 1, 2),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								FontFace = w.face(false),
								TextSize = 11,
								TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4,
								ZIndex = k.HUD + 6,
								Parent = R,
							}
						),
						spur = iH,
						face = bH,
						pip = FH,
						parented = true,
					}
				end
				local function A(r)
					if Z[r] then
						return Z[r]
					end
					Z[r] = y()
					return Z[r]
				end
				local function y(r, S)
					t(r.root, "Visible", S)
					if r.parented ~= S then
						r.parented = S
						r.root.Parent = S and E.base or nil
					end
				end
				local r, S = { nil, nil }, 0.03333333333333333
				local c = P({}, { __mode = "k" })
				local function P(R, e, w, E, v)
					local k = c[R]
					if k and v - k.cast <= S then
						return k.clear
					end
					r[1] = Q.localCharacter()
					r[2] = e
					e = s.clear(w, E, r)
					if k then
						k.cast = v
						k.clear = e
					else
						c[R] = { cast = v, clear = e }
					end
					return e
				end
				local function r(S, c, R, e)
					local w = SH(c)
					local E = w and w.PrimaryPart
					if not E then
						return nil
					end
					local s = E.Position
					local E, v = S:WorldToViewportPoint(s)
					if not (v and E.Z > 0) then
						return nil
					end
					if not P(c, w, R, s, e) then
						return nil
					end
					E = S:WorldToViewportPoint(s + I.new(0, d, 0))
					return h.new(E.X, E.Y)
				end
				local function P(S, c, R, e)
					if not c then
						return nil
					end
					local w = rH[c]
					if w ~= nil then
						return w or nil
					end
					w = r(S, c, R, e)
					rH[c] = w or false
					return w
				end
				local function r(S, c, R)
					local e = R + I.new(0, d, 0)
					local I, w = S:WorldToViewportPoint(e)
					if w and I.Z > 0 then
						return h.new(I.X, I.Y), nil
					end
					e = S.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(R)
					S = J.atan2(e.X, -e.Z)
					w = h.new(J.sin(S), -J.cos(S))
					w = (if w.Magnitude < 1.0E-4 then h.new(0, 1) else w).Unit
					I, R = h.new(c.X / 2 - U, c.Y / 2 - U), h.new(c.X / 2, c.Y / 2)
					c, e = w.X ~= 0 and J.abs(I.X / w.X) or 1 / 0, w.Y ~= 0 and J.abs(I.Y / w.Y) or 1 / 0
					return R + w * J.min(c, e), J.deg(J.atan2(w.Y, w.X)) + 45
				end
				local function I(S)
					local c = #ZH
					if c == 0 then
						return
					end
					c = ZH
					ZH = {}
					for R, R in f(c) do
						p(R, S)
					end
				end
				local function p(S, c, R)
					O.clear(AH)
					O.clear(rH)
					for e = #B, 1, -1 do
						local w = B[e]
						if w.expires <= S then
							fH(w.id)
							O.remove(B, e)
						end
					end
					O.clear(cH)
					O.move(B, 1, #B, 1, cH)
					O.sort(cH, function(e, w)
						if e.rank ~= w.rank then
							return e.rank > w.rank
						end
						return e.expires > w.expires
					end)
					O.clear(RH)
					for e = 1, J.min(#cH, l), 1 do
						RH[cH[e].id] = cH[e]
					end
					for e in o(JH) do
						if not RH[e] then
							fH(e)
						end
					end
					for e in o(RH) do
						if not JH[e] then
							for w = 1, l, 1 do
								if not uH[w] then
									JH[e] = w
									uH[w] = e
									break
								end
							end
						end
					end
					local e, w = c.CFrame.Position, q.set("sesp_render")
					G(S, c, R, RH, w)
					if not w.icons then
						for G, G in o(Z) do
							if G then
								y(G, false)
							end
						end
						return
					end
					O.clear(sH)
					O.clear(vH)
					O.clear(mH)
					O.clear(BH)
					for G, E in o(RH) do
						w = P(c, E.player, e, S)
						if w then
							sH[G] = w
							mH[E.player] = (mH[E.player] or 0) + 1
							O.insert(BH, G)
						end
					end
					O.sort(BH)
					O.clear(gH)
					for P, G in f(BH) do
						P = RH[G].player
						gH[P] = (gH[P] or 0) + 1
						vH[G] = gH[P]
					end
					for P = 1, l, 1 do
						w = uH[P]
						local G = w and RH[w] or nil
						local E = G and A(P) or Z[P]
						if E then
							if not G then
								y(E, false)
							else
								local A, s, v = sH[w]
								if A then
									local k, l = mH[G.player] or 1, vH[w] or 1
									s, v = (h.new(A.X + (l - (k + 1) / 2) * x, A.Y)), nil
								else
									s, v = r(c, R, G.position)
								end
								local h, r =
									X(G.category),
									J.clamp((S - G.born) / n, 0, 1) * J.clamp((G.expires - S) / M, 0, 1)
								IH(E.root, s.X, s.Y)
								y(E, true)
								t(E.root, "BackgroundTransparency", A and 1 or 1 - r * 0.55)
								for S, c in f(E.rings) do
									t(c, "Color", h)
									t(c, "Transparency", A and 1 or 1 - (1 - L[S][3]) * r)
								end
								if G.userId ~= E.faceId then
									E.faceId = G.userId
									P = G.userId and g.headshot(G.userId) or ""
									t(E.face, "Image", P)
								end
								local f = G.userId ~= nil and not A
								t(E.face, "Visible", f)
								t(E.pip, "Visible", f)
								if f then
									hH(E.glyph, V, V)
									if E.glyphForm ~= "corner" then
										E.glyphForm = "corner"
										E.glyph.Position = T.new(0.5, N, 0.5, N)
									end
								else
									local P = A and _ or a
									hH(E.glyph, P, P)
									if E.glyphForm ~= "centre" then
										E.glyphForm = "centre"
										E.glyph.Position = T.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
									end
								end
								f = G.asset or G.glyph
								if f ~= E.shown then
									E.shown = f
									if G.asset then
										E.glyph.Image = G.asset
									elseif G.glyph then
										local P = Y.get(G.glyph)
										if P then
											E.glyph.Image = ""
											i(function()
												E.glyph.ImageContent = P
											end)
										end
									end
								end
								t(E.glyph, "ImageColor3", G.asset and oH or h)
								t(E.face, "ImageTransparency", 1 - r)
								t(E.pip, "BackgroundTransparency", 1 - r * 0.85)
								t(E.glyph, "ImageTransparency", 1 - r)
								f = not A
								t(E.label, "Visible", f)
								if f then
									A = G.position - e
									local i = J.floor(A.Magnitude)
									if E.labelAt ~= i then
										E.labelAt = i
										E.label.Text = u.format("%d", i)
									end
									t(E.label, "TextColor3", h)
									t(E.label, "TextTransparency", 1 - r)
									t(E.label, "TextStrokeTransparency", 1 - r * 0.6)
								end
								t(E.spur, "Visible", v ~= nil)
								if v then
									t(E.spur, "BackgroundColor3", h)
									t(E.spur, "BackgroundTransparency", 1 - r)
									if E.spurSpin ~= v then
										E.spurSpin = v
										E.spur.Rotation = v
										f, A = J.rad(v - 45), K / 2
										E.spur.Position = T.new(0.5, J.cos(f) * A, 0.5, J.sin(f) * A)
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
				local J
				local function u()
					if Q.inMainMenu() then
						J()
						return
					end
					local f = F.clock()
					I(f)
					local F = b.CurrentCamera
					if not F then
						return
					end
					p(f, F, F.ViewportSize)
				end
				local p
				J = function()
					O.clear(B)
					O.clear(JH)
					O.clear(uH)
					O.clear(ZH)
					for F, F in o(Z) do
						if F then
							y(F, false)
						end
					end
					for F, F in o(PH) do
						if F and F.shown then
							F.shown = false
							F.node.Visible = false
						end
					end
					for F, F in o(QH) do
						if F and F.shown then
							F.shown = false
							F.node.Visible = false
						end
					end
					O.clear(HH)
					for F, F in o(D) do
						F.node:Destroy()
					end
					O.clear(D)
				end
				z.refresh = function()
					local F, f = q.bool("sesp_enabled"), not p
					if f then
						p = m.observe(yH)
					end
					m.want(z.GROUP, F)
					if F then
						H.onDraw(z.BIND, u)
					else
						H.stop(z.BIND)
						J()
					end
					return z
				end
				z.reset = function()
					H.stop(z.BIND)
					m.want(z.GROUP, false)
					m.drop(p)
					p = nil
					J()
					for p, p in o(PH) do
						if p then
							p.node:Destroy()
						end
					end
					for p, p in o(QH) do
						if p then
							p.node:Destroy()
						end
					end
					for p, p in o(D) do
						p.node:Destroy()
					end
					O.clear(Z)
					O.clear(OH)
					O.clear(PH)
					O.clear(QH)
					O.clear(D)
					pH = 0
				end
				return z
			end
end)()

return function(p)

					34

				local function z(l)
					if not f.teamOf(l) then
						return 3
					end
					return f.isAlly(l) and 2 or 1
				end
				local function l()
					table.clear(k)
					local D, K = os.clock(), {}
					for C, C in ipairs(p:GetPlayers()) do
						if C ~= Z and f.isSpectating(C) then
							K[C] = true
							if g[C] == nil then
								g[C] = D
							end
							table.insert(k, C)
						end
					end
					for p in pairs(g) do
						if not K[p] then
							g[p] = nil
						end
					end
					table.sort(k, function(p, Z)
						local D, K = z(p), z(Z)
						if D ~= K then
							return D < K
						end
						return p.Name < Z.Name
					end)
					return k
				end
				local function p(Z)
					local z = {}
					for D, D in ipairs(Z) do
						table.insert(z, D.Name .. ":" .. tostring(f.teamOf(D)))
					end
					table.insert(z, J.signature())
					return table.concat(z, "|")
				end
				local Z = {

					Terrorists = "terrorists",
					Spectators = "spectators",
				}

					if not K then
						return "unassigned"
					end
					return Z[K] or string.lower(K)
				end
				local function Z(D)
					local K = math.max(0, math.floor(D))
					return string.format("%d:%02d", K // 60, K % 60)
				end
				local D
				local K, C = {}

							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, H),

					for O, O in ipairs(K) do
						if O.root then
							O.root:Destroy()
						end
					end
					table.clear(K)
					local O = D
					if not O then
						return
					end
					O = D

						return
					end
					P = nil

						I = z(h)
						if I ~= P then
							b += 1
							o(I, b)
							P = I
						else
						end
						b += 1
						I = i(h, b)
						if I then
							table.insert(K, I)
						end
					end
					D.Visible = true

					local i = os.clock()
					for y, P in ipairs(K) do

						if y then
							local b = Z(i - y)
							if P.time.Text ~= b then

							end
						end
					end

					if f.inMainMenu() then
						J()
						return
					end
					local f, i = os.clock(), a
					if f < i then
						return
					end
					a = f + T
					if not j() then
						return
					end
					f = l()
					i = p(f)

					if p then
						C = i
						O(f)
					end
					o()
				end

						A.reset()

					if not u.bool("spectators_enabled") then
						A.reset()
						return A
					end
					C, a = nil, 0

					return A
				end

					J()
					local p = D
					if p then
						D:Destroy()
						D = nil
					end
					table.clear(g)
					table.clear(k)
					C, a = nil, 0
				end
				return A
			end
end)()

					return nil
				end
				local function Q()
					local Y = QH
					if Y then
						QH:Destroy()
						QH = nil
					end
					YH, EH = nil, nil
				end
				local function Y(v)
					local m = v and v.Character
					v = YH ~= m
					if v then
						Q()
						YH = m
					end
					if not m then
						return
					end
					v = not QH
					if v then
						local B = g and g.Terrain
						if not B then
							return
						end
						QH = r.new(
							"Highlight",
							{
								Name = "SpinTargetGlow",
								Adornee = m,
								DepthMode = I.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop,
								FillTransparency = PH,
								OutlineTransparency = bH,
								Parent = B,
							}
						)
					end
					m = QH
					if m then
						v = R.color("xhair_spin_color", s.DEFAULT_COLOR)
						local I = EH ~= v
						if I then
							QH.FillColor = v
							QH.OutlineColor = v
							EH = v
						end
					end
				end
				local function I(r, v, m, B)
					local N, oH, PH, bH, YH =
						IH,
						R.color("xhair_spin_color", s.DEFAULT_COLOR),
						R.color("xhair_spin_tip", s.DEFAULT_TIP),
						1 - R.opacity("xhair_spin_color") * B,
						R.bool("xhair_spin_shift")
					local EH, CH
					if YH then
						B = 0.5 - 0.5 * J.cos(eH * 3.141592653589793 * 2)
						local aH = J.clamp((B - 0.5) / (2 * KH) + 0.5, 0, 1)
						EH, CH = (oH:Lerp(PH, aH)), (PH:Lerp(oH, aH))
					else
						EH, CH = oH, PH
					end
					YH = EH ~= vH or CH ~= mH
					if YH then
						vH, mH = EH, CH
						PH = h.new(EH, CH)
						for h, h in o(N.arms) do
							if h.ramp then
								h.ramp.Color = PH
							end
							if h.haloRamp then
								h.haloRamp.Color = PH
							end
						end
					end
					B, YH = R.bool("xhair_spin_bloom"), 0
					if B then
						PH = lH * (0.5 + 0.5 * J.sin(GH * 3.141592653589793 * 2))
						YH = (1 - kH + PH) * (1 - bH)
					else
					end
					N.root.Position = b.fromOffset(J.floor(r.X + 0.5), J.floor(r.Y + 0.5))
					N.root.Rotation = hH
					N.root.Visible = true
					r = v + m / 2
					for o, h in f(BH) do
						v, oH, o = N[h], h == "Up" or h == "Down", (h == "Up" or h == "Left") and -1 or 1
						v.Size = oH and b.fromOffset(V, m) or b.fromOffset(m, V)
						PH = oH and b.fromOffset(0, r * o) or b.fromOffset(r * o, 0)
						v.Position = PH
						v.BackgroundTransparency = bH
						o = N.arms[h]
						if o and o.edge then
							o.edge.Transparency = bH
						end
						if o and o.halo then
							o.halo.Visible = B
							if B then
								o.halo.Size = b.fromOffset(V + gH * 2, m + gH * 2)
								o.halo.Position = PH
								o.halo.Rotation = oH and 0 or 90
								o.halo.ImageTransparency = 1 - J.clamp(YH, 0, 1)
							end
						end
					end
				end
				local function f(o, h, r, v, m, B)
					local V = FH + v * fH
					h.Text = r
					h.TextColor3 = B
					h.TextTransparency = m
					h.Position = b.fromOffset(0, V)
					h.Visible = true
					o.Text = r
					o.TextTransparency = m
					o.Position = b.fromOffset(ZH, V + ZH)
					o.Visible = true
				end
				local function o(h, r)
					r.Visible = false
					h.Visible = false
				end
				local function h(r, v, m, B)
					local V = IH
					V.text.Position = b.fromOffset(J.floor(r.X + 0.5), J.floor(r.Y + 0.5))
					local b, N, FH =
						0, R.color("xhair_spin_color", s.DEFAULT_COLOR), 1 - R.opacity("xhair_spin_color") * B
					if R.bool("xhair_spin_name") and m then
						B = H(m)
						if B then
							f(V.nameShade, V.name, T.of(B), b, FH, N)
							b = 1
						else
							o(V.nameShade, V.name)
						end
					else
						o(V.nameShade, V.name)
					end
					B, m = false, R.bool("xhair_spin_damage") and wH
					if m then
						r = v - HH
						local T = r < iH
						if T then
							local T = 1 - J.clamp((r - (iH - yH)) / yH, 0, 1)
							f(V.hitShade, V.hit, u.format("%d", wH), b, 1 - (1 - FH) * T, N)
							b, B = b + 1, true
						else
							wH = nil
						end
					else
					end
					if not B then
						o(V.hitShade, V.hit)
					end
					V.text.Visible = b > 0
				end
				local function u()
					if R.str("xhair_spin_when", s.DEFAULT_TRIGGER) == s.DEFAULT_TRIGGER then
						return true
					end
					return w() ~= nil
				end
				local function f()
					local o = g.CurrentCamera
					if not o then
						return
					end
					local b = F.clock()
					local T = J.min(b - AH, uH)
					AH = b
					local r = o.ViewportSize
					local w = y.new(r.X / 2, r.Y / 2)
					if p then
						e.enter("spin/pick")
					end
					local y, v = A(o)
					if p then
						e.leave("spin/pick")
					end
					o, r = k + z + l, rH
					rH = (r + T / o) % 1
					r = eH
					eH = (r + T / DH) % 1
					r = GH
					GH = (r + T / zH) % 1
					local A, m = rH * o, k * D
					r = k - m
					local B, g =
						if A < m
							then A / m
							else if A < m + z
								then 1
								else if A < m + z + r then 1 - (A - m - z) / r else 0,
						y and 1 or 0
					o = cH < g
					if o then
						r, m = J.min, cH
						cH = r(g, m + T / d)
					else
						A = cH > g
						if A then
							local k, z = J.max, cH
							cH = k(g, z - T / d)
						end
					end
					B = B * (1 - cH) + x * cH
					o, g, A =
						K + B * (C - K),
						J.max(a + B * (j - a), 1),
						R.bool("trigger_enabled") and E.armed() and 1 or 0
					r = RH < A
					if r then
						local E, k = J.min, RH
						RH = E(A, k + T / M)
					else
						m = RH > A
						if m then
							local E, k = J.max, RH
							RH = E(A, k - T / M)
						end
					end
					o *= 1 - RH * L
					g += RH * n
					r = c.cook(c.get())
					if r then
						qH = r
					else
						A, m = J.max, qH
						qH = A(0, m - T / X)
					end
					r = qH > 0
					if r then
						A = t * (C - K)
						o, g = o * (1 - qH) + A * qH, g * (1 - qH) + (a + A) * qH
					else
					end
					A = hH
					hH = (A + (U + (W - U) * B ^ _) * T) % 360
					A = u() and 1 or 0
					m = TH < A
					if m then
						local u, E = J.min, TH
						TH = u(A, E + T / OH)
					else
						r = TH > A
						if r then
							local u, E = J.max, TH
							TH = u(A, E - T / OH)
						end
					end
					r = J.clamp(T * pH, 0, 1)
					if y then
						T = SH or w
						SH = T:Lerp(y, r)
					else
						SH = if SH and (SH - w).Magnitude > JH then SH:Lerp(w, r) else nil
					end
					T = TH > 0 and O()
					if T then
						A = SH or w
						if p then
							e.enter("spin/arms")
						end
						I(A, o, g, TH)
						if p then
							e.leave("spin/arms")
						end
						if p then
							e.enter("spin/text")
						end
						h(A, b, v, TH)
						if p then
							e.leave("spin/text")
						end
					else
						P()
					end
					w = R.bool("xhair_spin_glow") and v
					if w then
						if p then
							e.enter("spin/glow")
						end
						Y(H(v))
						if p then
							e.leave("spin/glow")
						end
					else
						y = QH
						if y then
							Q()
						end
					end
					S.mute(TH > 0)
				end
				q.watch(function(p)
					if Z(p) ~= "table" then
						return
					end
					if p.kind ~= "dealt" then
						return
					end
					local J = i(p.damage)
					if not J then
						return
					end
					wH = J
					HH = F.clock()
				end)
				s.refresh = function()
					s.enabled = R.bool("xhair_spin")
					local p = s.enabled and R.bool("xhair_spin_damage")
					local J = p ~= sH
					if J then
						sH = p
						q.demand(p)
					end
					J = s.enabled
					if J then
						AH = F.clock()
						c.start()
						G.onDraw(s.BIND, f)
					else
						G.stop(s.BIND)
						TH, SH, cH, RH, qH, wH = 0, nil, 0, 0, 0, nil
						Q()
						P()
						S.mute(false)
					end
					return s
				end
				s.reset = function()
					G.stop(s.BIND)
					local p = sH
					if p then
						sH = false
						q.demand(false)
					end
					Q()
					IH, SH, cH, RH, qH, TH, hH, rH, wH = nil, nil, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, nil
					s.enabled = false
				end
				return s
			end
end)()


_registry["features/strafe"] = (function()
return function(r28)
	local r1 = r28("core/flags")
	local r2 = r28("services/mover")
	local r3 = r28("services/usercmd")
	local r4 = { BIND = "strafe/legit", enabled = false }
	local r6 = 1.5
	local r8 = 2.25

	local r10 = function(arg1, s24, s25, arg4, arg5, s28, s29)
		if not r4.enabled then
			return
		end

		if s28 ~= false then
			return
		end

		if typeof(s29) ~= "Vector3" then
			return
		end

		if typeof(s24) ~= "Vector2" then
			return
		end
		local s1 = s29.X
		local s2 = s29.Z
		local s3 = math.sqrt(s1 * s1 + s2 * s2)
		if s3 < r6 then
			return
		end
		local s5 = s1 / s3
		local s7 = s2 / s3
		local s8 = math.cos(s25)
		local s10 = math.sin(s25)
		local s1_1 = s24.X
		local s11

		if s1_1 > 0.05 then
			s11 = 1
		elseif s1_1 < -0.05 then
			s11 = -1
		else
			local s1_4 = s5 * -s8 - s7 * -s10

			if s1_4 > 0 then
				s11 = 1
			else
				if not (s1_4 < 0) then
					return
				end
				s11 = -1
			end
		end

		local s1_2 = math.min(1, r8 / (2 * s3))
		local s2_1 = math.sqrt(math.max(0, 1 - s1_2 * s1_2)) * s11
		local s3_1 = s5 * s1_2 - s7 * s2_1
		local s1_3 = s5 * s2_1 + s7 * s1_2
		return Vector2.new(s8 * s3_1 - s10 * s1_3, -(-s10 * s3_1 - s8 * s1_3))
	end

	r4.refresh = function()
		local s6 = r1.bool("strafe_legit") and not r1.bool("rage_strafe")
		r4.enabled = s6

		if s6 then
			r8 = r2.number("AirSpeedCap", 2.25)
			r3.register(r4.BIND, 20, r10)
		else
			r3.unregister(r4.BIND)
		end

		return r4
	end

	r4.reset = function()
		error("devirt: mode 102 selects no dispatch loop (at 102:1)")
	end

	return r4
end
end)()

_registry["features/touchglow"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("core/flags")
				local O = p("services/gamedata")
				local u = p("game/guard")
				local F, f = p("core/service"), p("services/tint")
				p = pcall(function()
					OverlapParams.new().ExcludeInstances = {}
				end)
				local o = p and function(Z, i)
					Z.ExcludeInstances = i
				end or function(Z, i)
					Z.FilterDescendantsInstances = i
				end
				local Z = F.get("Players")
				local i, y, P = F.get("RunService"), {}, 0.05
				local F = Vector3.new(3.4, 6, 3.4) + Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2) * 2
				y.DEFAULT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 60)
				y.PRIORITY = 20
				local b = OverlapParams.new()
				if not p then
					b.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
				end
				b.MaxParts = 24
				local p, I = 0
				y.enabled = false
				local function h()
					local A = {}
					if not Z then
						return A
					end
					for T, r in ipairs(Z:GetPlayers()) do
						T = O.characterOf(r)
						if T then
							table.insert(A, T)
						end
					end
					return A
				end
				local Z, A = { alive = true, enemy = true }, {}
				local function T()
					local r = J.color("touch_glow_color", y.DEFAULT_COLOR)
					o(b, h())
					local o
					for h, S in ipairs(O.players(Z, A)) do
						h = O.characterOf(S)
						S = h and h.PrimaryPart
						if S then
							local O, Z = pcall(workspace.GetPartBoundsInBox, workspace, S.CFrame, F, b)
							if O and typeof(Z) == "table" then
								for O, O in ipairs(Z) do
									if O.CanCollide and f.paintable(O) then
										o = o or {}
										o[O] = r
									else
									end
								end
							else
							end
						else
						end
					end
					f.apply("touch", y.PRIORITY, o)
				end
				local function O()
					local F, o = os.clock(), p
					if F < o then
						return
					end
					p = F + P
					T()
				end
				y.refresh = function()
					local F = J.bool("touch_glow_enabled")
					y.enabled = F
					if F then
						local J = not I
						if J then
							I = i.Heartbeat:Connect(u.safe(O, "touchglow"))
						end
					else
						local J = I
						if J then
							I:Disconnect()
							I = nil
						end
						f.clear("touch")
						p = 0
					end
					return y
				end
				y.reset = function()
					local J = I
					if J then
						I:Disconnect()
						I = nil
					end
					f.clear("touch")
					p = 0
					y.enabled = false
				end
				return y
			end

local Runtime = { [14] = table.pack }
function Runtime:oh(values) return table.unpack(values, 1, values.n) end
function Runtime:Wh(destination, offset, ...)
    local values = table.pack(...)
    table.move(values, 1, values.n, offset + 1, destination)
end
function Runtime:Lh(destination, offset, values)
    table.move(values, 1, values.n, offset + 1, destination)
    destination.n = offset + values.n
end

local p = Runtime

						return k

						return nil
					end

					i[w] = k

								end
								H = O.floor(f * Y + 0.5)
								if D.step ~= H then
									D.step = H
									D.beam.Transparency = v[H]
								end
								w(D, true)
							end
						end
					end
				end
				local O
				local function f()
					if R.inMainMenu() then
						O()
						return
					end
					local y = F.clock()
					p(G.LocalPlayer, true)
					B()
					Q(y)
					b(y)
				end
				local p, F = false
				local y = false
				O = function()
					u.clear(J)
					u.clear(h)
					for J, J in o(I) do
						w(J, false)
					end
				end
				q.refresh = function()
					local J = S.bool("tracer_enabled")
					local o = J ~= y
					if o then
						y = J
						T.demand(J)
						if J then
							e.start()
							F = e.on("tracer", i)
						else
							local i = F
							if i then
								e.off(F)
								F = nil
							end
						end
					end
					o = not p
					if o then
						p = true
						T.watch(Z)
					end
					if J then
						c.onDraw(q.BIND, f)
					else
						c.stop(q.BIND)
						O()
					end
					return q
				end
				q.reset = function()
					c.stop(q.BIND)
					local p = F
					if p then
						e.off(F)
						F = nil
					end
					p = y
					if p then
						T.demand(false)
					end
					y = false
					O()
					u.clear(I)
					u.clear(r)
					u.clear(s)
					m, k, z = nil, 0, false
				end
				return q
			end
end)()


_registry["features/triggerbot"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("services/accuracy")
				local O = p("services/aimpoint")
				local u = p("services/damage")
				local F = p("features/bullet")
				local f = p("services/equipped")
				local o = p("services/lethality")
				local Z = p("services/penetration")
				local i = p("core/flags")
				local y = p("services/frame")
				local P = p("services/gamedata")
				local b = p("game/guard")
				local I = p("ui/library")
				local h = p("services/mover")
				local A = p("services/usercmd")
				local T = p("services/trace")
				local r = p("services/raycast")
				local S = p("services/seed")
				local c, R = p("core/service"), p("services/vision")
				local p = c.get("Players")
				local c, e, G, q, w, H, Q, Y, E =
					p.LocalPlayer, { BIND = "aim/trigger" }, 1200, 0.05, 0.35, 101, false, {}, 0
				local function s(v)
					if not Q and not T.on then
						return
					end
					local m = Y
					m[v] = (m[v] or 0) + 1
				end
				local function v(m)
					local B = not Q and not T.on or m - E < 2
					if B then
						return
					end
					E = m
					B, m = {}, Y
					for E, g in pairs(m) do
						B[#B + 1] = E .. " " .. g
					end
					table.sort(B)
					if #B > 0 then
						if Q then
							print("[tb] " .. table.concat(B, " | "))
						end
						T.log("trigger", "recusas nos ultimos 2 s: %s", table.concat(B, " | "))
					end
					Y = {}
				end
				local Q
				local Y, E, m, B, g, k, z, l = 0, 0, false, 0, false, false, false, false
				local D = S.aim
				local function K(C)
					for a, j in ipairs(p:GetPlayers()) do
						if j ~= c then
							a = P.characterOf(j)
							if a and (C:IsDescendantOf(a)) then
								return j
							end
						end
					end
					return nil
				end
				local function p(C)
					if typeof(C) ~= "Instance" or not C:IsA("BasePart") then
						return 0
					end
					local a = C.Size
					return math.min(a.X, a.Y, a.Z) * 0.5
				end
				local function C(a, j)
					local V = F.redirectedTo()
					local N = V == nil and F.claimable()
					g = N
					local W = O.touchAlong(a, j, G, V, N)
					if not W then
						return nil
					end
					return {
						player = W.player,
						character = W.character,
						part = W.part,
						impact = W.impact,
						distance = W.distance,
						offset = W.offset,
						radius = p(W.part),
						key = u.partOf(W.part),
						silent = W.ours,
						claim = N,
					}
				end
				local function G(a, j)
					local V = C(a, j)
					if not V then
						return nil
					end
					local N, W = P.localCharacter(), workspace.CurrentCamera
					j = N and { N, W, V.character } or { W, V.character }
					if r.cast(a, V.impact, j, r.BULLET) then
						return nil
					end
					return {
						player = V.player,
						distance = V.distance,
						radius = V.radius,
						part = V.key,
						instance = V.part,
						offset = V.offset,
						silent = V.silent,
						claim = V.claim,
					}
				end
				local function r(a, j)
					local V = C(a, j)
					if not V then
						return nil
					end
					j = P.equippedInfoOf(c)
					local C = j and P.weapon(j.Name)
					if not C then
						return nil
					end
					j = tonumber(C.Penetration) or 0
					local C, N = Z.reachesPoint(a, V.impact, j, V.character)
					if not C then
						return nil
					end
					return {
						player = V.player,
						distance = V.distance,
						radius = V.radius,
						part = V.key,
						traversals = N,
						instance = V.part,
						offset = V.offset,
						silent = V.silent,
						claim = V.claim,
					}
				end
				local function Z(C, a)
					local j = G(C, a)
					j = if not j and i.bool("trigger_wallbang") then r(C, a) else j
					if not j then
						return nil
					end
					if i.bool("filter_smoke") and R.smoked(C, C + a * j.distance) then
						return nil
					end
					return j
				end
				local function r(G)
					local C = i.num("trigger_mindamage", 0)
					if C <= 0 then
						return true
					end
					if not G.part then
						return false
					end
					local a = P.equippedInfoOf(c)
					if not a then
						return false
					end
					local j, V = u.armorOf(G.player)
					local N = u.predict({
						weapon = a.Name,
						part = G.part,
						distance = G.distance,
						traversals = G.traversals or 0,
						armor = j,
						armorKind = V,
					})
					if not N then
						return false
					end
					V = P.healthOf(G.player)
					return o.meets(N.health, C, V or 100)
				end
				local function o(G)
					local C = G and G.Properties
					if typeof(C) ~= "table" then
						return false
					end
					if C.AimingOptions ~= "SniperScope" then
						return false
					end
					G = P.equippedInfoOf(c)
					return not J.scoped(G and G.Name)
				end
				local function G()
					return h.onGround(P.localCharacter()) == false
				end
				local function h()
					z = false
					local C = k
					if not C then
						return
					end
					local C = P.characterObject()
					if C then
						pcall(function()
							C.CrouchInputDown = false
						end)
					end
					k = false
				end
				local C = 2
				local function a(j, j, j, V, N, W, U)
					W = z
					if not W then
						return
					end
					if typeof(U) ~= "Vector3" then
						return Vector2.zero
					end
					W, N = U.X, U.Z
					U = math.sqrt(W * W + N * N)
					if U < C then
						return Vector2.zero
					end
					local C, _, x, d = -W / U, -N / U, math.cos(j), math.sin(j)
					N, V = x * C - d * _, -d * C - x * _
					return Vector2.new(N, -V)
				end
				local function C()
					local j, V = i.bool("trigger_auto_stop"), l
					if j == V then
						return
					end
					l = j
					if j then
						A.register("trigger_stop", 40, a)
					else
						A.unregister("trigger_stop")
					end
				end
				local function a(j, V)
					C()
					local C = j and f.canFire(f.FIRE_LEAD)
					m = C
					z = C and i.bool("trigger_auto_stop")
					local z = C and i.bool("trigger_auto_crouch")
					C = z or k
					if C then
						local C = P.characterObject()
						if C then
							if z then
								local N = not k and not C.IsCrouching
								if N then
									k = pcall(function()
										C.CrouchInputDown = true
									end)
								end
							else
								local N = k
								if N then
									pcall(function()
										C.CrouchInputDown = false
									end)
									k = false
								end
							end
						end
					end
					if not (j and i.bool("trigger_auto_scope")) then
						return
					end
					if not V or typeof(V.scope) ~= "function" then
						return
					end
					j = V.Properties
					if typeof(j) ~= "table" or j.AimingOptions ~= "SniperScope" then
						return
					end
					if f.isScoped() then
						return
					end
					j = os.clock()
					z = j - B
					if z < w then
						return
					end
					B = j
					b.callAsGame(V.scope, V, true)
				end
				local function b(w)
					local B = F.aimingAt()
					if not B or not B.Parent then
						return nil
					end
					local k = K(B)
					if not k then
						return nil
					end
					if not P.isAlive(k) then
						return nil
					end
					if P.isImmune(k) then
						return nil
					end
					return {
						player = k,
						distance = (B.Position + O.aimOffset(B.Parent) - O.aimOrigin(B.Parent, w)).Magnitude,
						radius = p(B),
						part = u.partOf(B),
						instance = B,
						claim = false,
						offset = nil,
						silent = true,
					}
				end
				local function p(O, u, w)
					if w and w.claim and w.instance then
						F.claim(w.instance, w.offset)
					end
					return f.shoot(O, u, "triggerbot")
				end
				local function O()
					local u = i.list("trigger_delay")
					local F, w = tonumber(u[1]), tonumber(u[2])
					if not F then
						return i.num("trigger_delay", 60) / 1000
					end
					if not w or w <= F then
						return F / 1000
					end
					return (F + math.random() * (w - F)) / 1000
				end
				local function u(F, w)
					if w.IsChargeFiring then
						return false
					end
					local B = b((S.aim(F)))
					if B then
						if not r(B) then
							s("mindamage")
							return false
						end
						s("SILENT")
						return p(w, nil, B)
					end
					B = S.pick()
					if not B then
						return false
					end
					local k, z = S.aim(F)
					F = S.direction(B, z, J.current() or 0)
					local K = F and (Z(k, F))
					if K and not r(K) then
						s("mindamage")
						return false
					end
					if K then
						s("SEED")
						S.fire(B, function()
							p(w, "Secondary", K)
						end)
						return true
					end
					B = P.equippedInfoOf(c)
					F = B and J.charged(B.Name)
					if not F then
						return false
					end
					B = Z(k, z)
					if not B then
						return false
					end
					if J.chance(F, B.radius, B.distance) < 1 then
						return false
					end
					if not r(B) then
						s("mindamage")
						return false
					end
					s("SEED_M1")
					return p(w, nil, B)
				end
				local function F(S, w, B)
					local k = not S
					if k then
						Q = nil
						s("notarget")
						return false
					end
					k = Q == nil
					if k then
						Q = B
						Y = O()
					end
					local O, z = B - Q, Y
					if O < z then
						s("delay")
						return false
					end
					B = P.equippedInfoOf(c)
					if i.bool("trigger_auto_scope") and i.bool("trigger_scope_wait") then
						k = w.Properties
						if
							typeof(k) == "table"
							and k.AimingOptions == "SniperScope"
							and B
							and not J.settled(B.Name)
						then
							s("scopewait")
							return false
						end
					end
					O = i.num("trigger_hitchance", 0)
					if O > 0 then
						k = B and J.charged(B.Name) or J.current() or 0
						if not S.silent and J.chance(k, S.radius, S.distance) * 100 < O then
							s("chance")
							return false
						end
					end
					if not r(S) then
						s("mindamage")
						return false
					end
					s("SHOOT")
					return p(w, nil, S)
				end
				local function p()
					v(os.clock())
					local function J(O)
						s(O)
						Q = nil
						h()
					end
					if not i.bool("trigger_enabled") then
						J("off")
						return
					end
					m = false
					if I.open then
						J("menu")
						return
					end
					if P.isTyping() then
						J("typing")
						return
					end
					if P.viewedCharacter() then
						J("spectating")
						return
					end
					J = workspace.CurrentCamera
					if not J then
						return s("nocam")
					end
					local O, P, I = f.of("weapon"), D(J)
					local r = Z(P, I)
					I = r ~= nil
					r = if not r then (b(P)) else r
					T.every(
						"trigalvo",
						0.25,
						"trigger",
						"pela mira=%s  pelo resgate=%s  alvo=%s  aberto=%s",
						tostring(I),
						tostring(not I and r ~= nil),
						tostring(r and r.player and r.player.Name),
						tostring(g)
					)
					a(r ~= nil, O)
					I = os.clock()
					P = I - E
					if P < q then
						return s("cooldown")
					end
					if not f.canSend(I) then
						return s("budget")
					end
					if not O then
						return s("noweapon")
					end
					P = i.bool("trigger_need_scope") and o(O)
					if P then
						Q = nil
						return s("needscope")
					end
					P = i.bool("trigger_ignore_air") and G()
					if P then
						Q = nil
						return s("air")
					end
					P = i.bool("filter_flash") and R.blinded()
					if P then
						Q = nil
						return s("flash")
					end
					local o, Z = i.num("trigger_hitchance", 0) >= H
					if o then
						Q = nil
						Z = (u(J, O))
					else
						Z = (F(r, O, I))
					end
					if Z then
						E = I
						s("FIRED")
						T.log(
							"TIRO",
							"alvo=%s  peca=%s  dist=%.1f  silencioso=%s  reivindicado=%s",
							tostring(r and r.player and r.player.Name),
							tostring(r and r.part),
							r and r.distance or -1,
							tostring(r and r.silent),
							tostring(r and r.claim)
						)
					end
				end
				e.armed = function()
					local J = m
					return J
				end
				e.refresh = function()
					local J = not i.bool("trigger_enabled")
					if J then
						y.stop(e.BIND)
						h()
						A.unregister("trigger_stop")
						l = false
						return e
					end
					f.start()
					R.start()
					y.onDraw(e.BIND, p)
					return e
				end
				e.reset = function()
					y.stop(e.BIND)
					h()
					A.unregister("trigger_stop")
					l, Q = false, nil
				end
				return e
			end
end)()


_registry["features/weapon"] = (function()
return function(r4)
	local r2 = r4("features/autokill")
	local r3 = r4("features/camera")
	local r5 = r4("services/equipped")
	local r6 = r4("core/flags")
	local r7 = r4("game/guard")
	local r8 = r4("game/modules")
	local r10 = r4("game/patcher")
	local r4_1 = r4("core/service")
	local r11 = r4_1.get("Players")
	local r4_2 = r4_1.get("RunService")
	local r13 = {}

	local r14 = function(arg1, arg2, arg3)
		arg1[arg2] = arg3
	end

	local r15 = function()
		if r6.bool("autofire_enabled") or r2.set() ~= nil then
			return true
		end
		return r6.bool("weapon_no_recoil")
	end

	local r16 = function()
		if r6.bool("autofire_enabled") or r2.set() ~= nil then
			return true
		end
		return r6.bool("weapon_no_spread")
	end

	local r17 = function()
		if not r6.bool("rcs_enabled") then
			return 1, 1
		end
		local s7 = math.clamp
		return 1 - math.clamp(r6.num("rcs_pitch", 0), 0, 100) / 100, 1 - s7(r6.num("rcs_yaw", 0), 0, 100) / 100
	end

	local r18 = function(s20, s21, s22)
		if typeof(s20) ~= "table" or typeof(s20.Value) ~= "Vector3" then
			return s20
		end

		return {
			Value = Vector3.new(s20.Value.X * s21, s20.Value.Y * s22, s20.Value.Z),
			Damper = s20.Damper,
			Speed = s20.Speed,
		}
	end

	local r19 = function(s31, s32)
		if typeof(s31) ~= "table" or typeof(s31.Value) ~= "Vector3" then
			return s31
		end

		if s32 >= 1 then
			return s31
		end
		return { Value = s31.Value * s32, Damper = s31.Damper, Speed = s31.Speed }
	end

	local r20 = function()
		local s4 = r8.controller("CameraController")
		if typeof(s4) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		local s10 = s4.setWeaponRecoil
		local s12 = s4.weaponKick
		if typeof(s10) ~= "function" or typeof(s12) ~= "function" then
			return
		end

		r10.set("weapon_recoil", s4, "setWeaponRecoil", function(t15, t16)
			if r15() then
				return
			end
			local t4, t5 = r17()
			return s10(r18(t15, t4, t5), t16)
		end)

		r10.set("weapon_recoil", s4, "weaponKick", function(t10, t11)
			if r15() then
				return
			end
			local t14, t15 = r17()
			local t13 = math.min
			local t11_1 = s12(r18(t10, t14, t15), r19(t11, t13(t14, t15)))
			r3.reassert()
			return t11_1
		end)
	end

	local r21 = function()
		local s8 = r8.get("Components", "Weapon", "Classes", "Bullet")
		if typeof(s8) ~= "table" then
			return
		end

		r10.set("weapon_spread", s8, "getTrueSpread", function()
			return 0
		end)
	end

	local r22 = function(s33)
		s33 = s33 and s33.Identifier
		if typeof(s33) ~= "string" or s33 == "" then
			return true
		end
		local s4_1 = r11.LocalPlayer
		local s2_1

		if s4_1 then
			s4_1 = s4_1:GetAttribute("CurrentEquipped")
			s2_1 = typeof(s4_1) ~= "string"
		else
			s2_1 = typeof(s4_1) ~= "string"
		end

		if s2_1 or s4_1 == "" then
			return true
		end
		return s4_1:find(s33, 1, true) ~= nil
	end

	local r23 = function()
		local s8 = r5.get()
		if not s8 then
			return
		end

		if r6.bool("weapon_no_equip_delay") and r22(s8) then
			pcall(r14, s8, "WeaponEquippedTick", 0)
		end

		if r6.bool("weapon_no_quickscope") then
			pcall(r14, s8, "ScopeStartTick", 0)
		end
	end

	local r25 = function()
		r10.sync("weapon_recoil", r15() or r6.bool("rcs_enabled"), r20)
		r10.sync("weapon_spread", r16(), r21)
		r23()
	end

	local r26 = nil

	local r27 = function()
		local s4 = r2.set() ~= nil or r6.bool("weapon_no_recoil") or r6.bool("weapon_no_spread")

		if not s4 then
			local s6 = r6.bool("weapon_no_equip_delay")
			s4 = s6 or r6.bool("autofire_enabled") or r6.bool("rcs_enabled") or r6.bool("weapon_no_quickscope") or r3.needsReassert()
		end

		return s4
	end

	r13.refresh = function()
		if not r27() then
			if r26 then
				r26:Disconnect()
				r26 = nil
			end

			r13.reset()
			return r13
		end

		r5.start()

		if not r26 then
			r26 = r4_2.Heartbeat:Connect(r7.safe(r25, "weapon"))
		end

		return r13
	end

	r13.reset = function()
		if r26 then
			r26:Disconnect()
			r26 = nil
		end

		r10.clear("weapon_recoil")
		r10.clear("weapon_spread")
	end

	r13.noRecoilOn = function()
		return r15()
	end

	r13.noSpreadOn = function()
		return r16()
	end

_registry["features/weather/init"] = (function()

local Runtime = { [14] = table.pack }
function Runtime:oh(values) return table.unpack(values, 1, values.n) end
function Runtime:Wh(destination, offset, ...)
    local values = table.pack(...)
    table.move(values, 1, values.n, offset + 1, destination)
end
function Runtime:Lh(destination, offset, values)
    table.move(values, 1, values.n, offset + 1, destination)
    destination.n = offset + values.n
end

local p = Runtime

return function(J)
				local O = J("features/weather/catalog")
				local u = J("ui/create")

				local b, I, h = {}, {}, {}
				local function A()
					local T = o and o.Parent == workspace
					if T then
						local r = o
						return r
					end
					T = o
					if T then
						pcall(function()
							o:Destroy()
						end)
					end
					table.clear(b)
					o = u.new("Folder", { Name = y, Parent = workspace })
					T = o
					return T
				end
				local function u(y)
					if not Z then
						return nil
					end
					if typeof(Content) ~= "table" or typeof(Content.fromObject) ~= "function" then
						return nil
					end
					local T, r = pcall(function()
						local S = Z:CreateEditableMesh()
						if not S then
							return nil
						end
						local c = {}
						for R = 0, y.points * 2 - 1, 1 do
							local e, G =
								R % 2 == 0 and 1 or y.ratio,
								-1.5707963267948966 + R * 3.141592653589793 / y.points
							table.insert(c, S:AddVertex(Vector3.new(math.cos(G) * e, math.sin(G) * e, 0)))
						end
						local R, e =
							S:AddVertex(Vector3.new(0, 0, y.depth)), S:AddVertex(Vector3.new(0, 0, -y.depth))
						for G = 1, #c, 1 do
							local q, w = c[G], c[G % #c + 1]
							S:AddTriangle(R, q, w)
							S:AddTriangle(e, w, q)
						end
						e = p[14](Content.fromObject(S))
						return Z:CreateMeshPartAsync(p:oh(e))
					end)
					if not T or not r then
						return nil
					end
					r.Anchored = true
					r.CanCollide = false
					r.CanQuery = false
					r.CanTouch = false
					r.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
					r.Size = Vector3.new(y.size, y.size, y.size * y.depth)
					pcall(function()
						r.CastShadow = false
					end)
					return r
				end
				local function p(Z)
					local y = I[Z.name]
					if y then
						return y
					end
					if h[Z.name] then
						return nil
					end
					h[Z.name] = true

						local y = u(Z)
						h[Z.name] = nil
						if y then
							I[Z.name] = y
							i.refresh()
						end
					end, "weather/mesh"))
					return nil
				end
				local u = 6.283185307179586
				local function Z(y, h, T, r)
					local S = T.box / 2
					T = h
						+ Vector3.new(
							r:NextNumber(-S.X, S.X),
							r:NextNumber(-S.Y, S.Y),
							r:NextNumber(-S.Z, S.Z)
						)
					y.CFrame = CFrame.new(T)
						* CFrame.Angles(r:NextNumber(0, u), r:NextNumber(0, u), r:NextNumber(0, u))
					return T
				end
				local function u(y)
					local h = workspace.CurrentCamera
					if not h then
						return nil
					end

				end
				local function y(h, T, r)
					if h < r then
						return 1 - h / r
					end
					local S = T - h
					if S < r then
						return 1 - S / r
					end
					return 0
				end
				local function h(T, r)
					if T.op == r then
						return
					end
					T.op = r
					T.part.Transparency = r
				end
				local function T(r, S, c)
					local R = r.stars
					while #R > S do
						local e = table.remove(R)
						pcall(function()
							e.part:Destroy()
						end)
					end
					if #R >= S then
						return
					end
					local e = r.entry
					local G = u(e)
					local q = not G or not o
					if q then
						return
					end
					while #R < S do
						q = r.template:Clone()
						local S, w = Z(q, G, e, r.rng), r.rng:NextNumber(e.life[1], e.life[2])
						local G = r.rng:NextNumber(0, w)
						local r = { part = q, born = c - G, life = w, pos = S }
						h(r, y(G, w, e.fade))

					end
				end
				local function r(S)
					for c, R in pairs(b) do
						c = R.entry
						local e, G, q = c.fade, c.box / 2, u(c)
						for u, w in ipairs(R.stars) do
							local H, Q = w.part, S - w.born
							if Q >= w.life then
								if q then
									w.pos = Z(H, q, c, R.rng)
									w.life = R.rng:NextNumber(c.life[1], c.life[2])
									w.born = S
									Q = 0
								else
								end
							else
								if q then
									u = w.pos - q
									if math.abs(u.X) > G.X or math.abs(u.Y) > G.Y or math.abs(u.Z) > G.Z then
										local u = Q + e
										if u < w.life then
											w.life = u
										end
									end
								end
							end
							h(w, y(Q, w.life, e))
						end
					end
				end
				local function u()
					local Z = o and o.Parent ~= workspace
					if Z then
						i.refresh()
						return
					end
					r(os.clock())
				end
				local function Z()
					local y = P
					if y then
						P:Disconnect()
						P = nil
					end
					y = o
					if y then
						pcall(function()
							o:Destroy()
						end)
					end
					o = nil
					table.clear(b)
				end
				local function o()
					local y, h = F.set("weather_effects"), {}

						end
					end

				end
				local function y(h, r)
					local S = F.num("weather_intensity", i.DEFAULT_INTENSITY)
					local c = O.throttle(h, S)
					for R, e in ipairs(h) do
						R = b[e.name]
						if R then
							local h = F.color(O.colorFlag(e.name), e.color)
							for G, G in ipairs(R.stars) do
								G.part.Color = h
							end
							T(R, math.floor(O.countFor(e, S) * c), r)
						end
					end
				end
				i.refresh = function()
					if not F.bool("weather_enabled") then
						Z()
						return i
					end
					if not A() then
						return i
					end
					local O, F, h = os.clock(), o(), {}
					for o, o in ipairs(F) do
						h[o.name] = true
					end
					for o, A in pairs(b) do
						if not h[o] then
							for T, T in ipairs(A.stars) do
								pcall(function()
									T.part:Destroy()
								end)
							end
							b[o] = nil
						end
					end
					for o, o in ipairs(F) do
						if not b[o.name] then
							h = p(o)
							if h then
								local p, A = o.name, { entry = o, template = h, stars = {} }
								A.rng, b[p] = Random.new(), A
							end
						end
					end
					y(F, O)
					h = next(b) ~= nil and not P
					if h then
						P = J.Heartbeat:Connect(f.safe(u, "weather"))
					else
						F = next(b) == nil and P
						if F then
							P:Disconnect()
							P = nil
						end
					end
					return i
				end
				i.reset = function()
					Z()
					for p, J in pairs(I) do
						pcall(function()
							J:Destroy()
						end)
						I[p] = nil
					end
					return i
				end
				return i
			end
end)()

					else

					_G.__phprof = I.phases
				else
				end
				local T = {}
				I.enter = function(r)

				end
				I.leave = function(r)

					end

					end

					return ...
				end
				local function b(h, r)
					local S = I.clocked[r]
					if not S then

						I.clocked[r] = S
					else
					end

						if i then
							i(r)

_registry["game/patcher"] = (function()
return function(requireModule)
	local guard = requireModule("game/guard")
	local groups = {}
	local patcher = {}

	function patcher.applied(group)
		return groups[group] ~= nil
	end

	function patcher.set(group, container, key, patchFn)
		if not container or typeof(patchFn) ~= "function" then
			return false
		end
		local ok, original = pcall(function()
			return container[key]
		end)
		if not ok or typeof(original) ~= "function" then
			return false
		end
		local safePatch = guard.safe(patchFn, "patch/" .. tostring(group))
		local okSet = pcall(function()
			container[key] = safePatch
		end)
		if not okSet then
			return false
		end
		if not groups[group] then
			groups[group] = {}
		end
		table.insert(groups[group], {
			container = container,
			key = key,
			original = original,
		})
		return true
	end

	function patcher.observe(group, container, key, observerFn)
		if not container or typeof(observerFn) ~= "function" then
			return false
		end
		local ok, original = pcall(function()
			return container[key]
		end)
		if not ok or typeof(original) ~= "function" then
			return false
		end
		local wrapped = guard.shield(function(...)
			pcall(observerFn, ...)
			return original(...)
		end)
		local okSet = pcall(function()
			container[key] = wrapped
		end)
		if not okSet then
			return false
		end
		if not groups[group] then
			groups[group] = {}
		end
		table.insert(groups[group], {
			container = container,
			key = key,
			original = original,
		})
		return true
	end

	function patcher.observeResult(group, container, key, observerFn)
		if not container or typeof(observerFn) ~= "function" then
			return false
		end
		local ok, original = pcall(function()
			return container[key]
		end)
		if not ok or typeof(original) ~= "function" then
			return false
		end
		local wrapped = guard.shield(function(...)
			local results = table.pack(original(...))
			pcall(observerFn, results[1], ...)
			return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
		end)
		local okSet = pcall(function()
			container[key] = wrapped
		end)
		if not okSet then
			return false
		end
		if not groups[group] then
			groups[group] = {}
		end
		table.insert(groups[group], {
			container = container,
			key = key,
			original = original,
		})
		return true
	end

	function patcher.clear(group)
		local list = groups[group]
		if not list then
			return
		end
		for i = #list, 1, -1 do
			local entry = list[i]
			pcall(function()
				entry.container[entry.key] = entry.original
			end)
		end
		groups[group] = nil
	end

	function patcher.clearAll()
		for g in pairs(groups) do
			patcher.clear(g)
		end
		groups = {}
	end

	function patcher.sync(group, enabled, setupFn)
		local isApplied = patcher.applied(group)
		if enabled and not isApplied then
			if typeof(setupFn) == "function" then
				setupFn()
			end
		elseif not enabled and isApplied then
			patcher.clear(group)
		end
	end

	return patcher
end
end)()

_registry["local/account"] = (function()

return function(requireModule)
	local services = requireModule("core/service")
	local subscribers = {}
	local account = { mode = "local" }
	local currentName, currentAvatar = "local", nil
	local function player()
		local players = services.get("Players")
		return players and players.LocalPlayer
	end
	function account.refresh()
		local current = player()
		currentName = current and tostring(current.Name) or "local"
		currentAvatar = current and ("rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. tostring(current.UserId) .. "&w=150&h=150") or nil
		for _, callback in ipairs(subscribers) do pcall(callback) end
		return current ~= nil
	end
	function account.username() return currentName end
	function account.avatar() return currentAvatar end
	function account.photoUrl() return currentAvatar end
	function account.live() return player() ~= nil end
	
	
	function account.remaining() return math.huge end
	function account.subscribe(callback)
		if typeof(callback) == "function" then table.insert(subscribers, callback) end
	end
	account.refresh()
	return account
end
end)()

_registry["services/accuracy"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("services/equipped")
				local O = p("services/gamedata")
				local u = p("services/mover")
				local F, f, o =
					p("core/service").get("Players").LocalPlayer, { DEAD_ZONE = 6.4, CONE_CAP = 140 }, 0.2
				local function p()
					local Z = J.of("weapon")
					local i = typeof(Z) == "table" and Z.Bullet or nil
					return typeof(i) == "table" and i or nil
				end
				local function Z(i, y)
					if not i then
						return false
					end
					local P = O.weapon(y)
					return P == nil or i.Properties == P
				end
				local function i(y)
					local P = J.of("weapon")
					if typeof(P) ~= "table" then
						return nil
					end
					local b = O.weapon(y)
					if b ~= nil and P.Properties ~= b then
						return nil
					end
					return P
				end
				f.base = function(y)
					local P = i(y)
					if not P or typeof(P.getBaseSpread) ~= "function" then
						return nil
					end
					local i, y = pcall(P.getBaseSpread, P)
					return i and typeof(y) == "number" and y or nil
				end
				f.live = function()
					local i = J.of("weapon")
					if typeof(i) ~= "table" or typeof(i.getSpread) ~= "function" then
						return nil
					end
					local y, P = pcall(i.getSpread, i)
					return y and typeof(P) == "number" and P or nil
				end
				f.config = function(i)
					local y = p()
					if Z(y, i) and typeof(y.ActiveSpreadConfig) == "table" then
						return y.ActiveSpreadConfig
					end
					y = O.weapon(i)
					i = y and y.Spread
					return typeof(i) == "table" and i or nil
				end
				f.movement = function(Z, i)
					if not i then
						return 0
					end
					Z = tonumber(Z) or 0
					return (Z < f.DEAD_ZONE and 0 or Z) * (tonumber(i.MovementMultiplier) or 1)
				end
				f.predict = function(Z)
					local i = Z.config or f.config(Z.weapon)
					if not i then
						return nil
					end
					local y = tonumber(i.Range and i.Range.Min) or 0
					local P, b = tonumber(i.Range and i.Range.Max) or y, tonumber(Z.base) or y
					for I = 1, math.max(0, tonumber(Z.shots) or 0), 1 do
						b = math.clamp(b + (tonumber(i.PerShot) or 0), y, P)
					end
					local I = tonumber(Z.speed) or 0
					I = if Z.airborne then I + (tonumber(i.JumpShotMinimum) or 100) else I
					return math.clamp(b, y, P) + f.movement(I, i)
				end
				local function Z()
					local i = O.localCharacter()
					local y = u.velocity(i)
					return y and y.Magnitude or 0, u.onGround(i) == false
				end
				f.chargeConfig = function(u)
					local i = O.weapon(u)
					u = i and i.FireModes
					i = typeof(u) == "table" and u.Primary or nil
					u = typeof(i) == "table" and i.Spread or nil
					return typeof(u) == "table" and u or nil
				end
				f.charged = function(u)
					local i = f.chargeConfig(u)
					if not i then
						return nil
					end
					local y, P = Z()
					return f.predict({
						weapon = u,
						config = i,
						base = tonumber(i.Range and i.Range.Min) or 0,
						speed = y,
						airborne = P,
					})
				end
				f.floor = function(u, i)
					local y = O.weapon(u)
					u = y and y.Spread
					if typeof(u) ~= "table" then
						return 0
					end
					local P = tonumber(u.Range and u.Range.Min) or 0
					if not y or y.AimingOptions ~= "SniperScope" or i then
						return P
					end
					i = tonumber(u.MovementMultiplier) or 1
					return i == 2 and 6 or (i == 3 and 12 or 15)
				end
				f.scoped = function(u)
					if not J.isScoped() then
						return false
					end
					local i = O.weapon(u)
					if not i or i.AimingOptions ~= "SniperScope" or u ~= "AWP" then
						return true
					end
					u = J.of("weapon")
					i = u and tonumber(u.ScopeStartTick) or 0
					return tick() - i >= o
				end
				f.settled = function(u)
					local o = p()
					local p = o and o.Spread
					if typeof(p) ~= "table" then
						return false
					end
					local o, i, y, P = pcall(function()
						return p:getPosition(), p:getGoal(), p:getVelocity()
					end)
					if not o or typeof(i) ~= "number" or typeof(y) ~= "number" or typeof(P) ~= "number" then
						return false
					end
					if math.abs(i - y) > 0.001 or math.abs(P) > 0.001 then
						return false
					end
					y = O.weapon(u)
					if y and y.AimingOptions == "SniperScope" and J.isScoped() then
						return f.scoped(u)
					end
					return true
				end
				f.current = function()
					local p = O.equippedInfoOf(F)
					if not p then
						return nil
					end
					local J, O, u = f.base(p.Name), f.live(), f.floor(p.Name, f.scoped(p.Name)) or 0
					if J and O then
						return math.max(J, u) + math.max(0, O - J)
					end
					O = f.config(p.Name)
					if not O then
						return nil
					end
					local F, o = Z()
					F = if o then F + (tonumber(O.JumpShotMinimum) or 100) else F
					p = J or tonumber(O.Range and O.Range.Min) or 0
					return math.max(p, u) + f.movement(F, O)
				end
				f.radiusOf = function(p)
					if typeof(p) ~= "Instance" or not p:IsA("BasePart") then
						return 0
					end
					local J = p.Size
					return math.min(J.X, J.Y, J.Z) * 0.5
				end
				f.chance = function(p, J, O)
					p, J, O = math.min(tonumber(p) or 0, f.CONE_CAP), tonumber(J) or 0, tonumber(O) or 0
					if J <= 0 or O <= 0 then
						return 0
					end
					if p <= 0 then
						return 1
					end
					local u, F = math.rad(p) * 0.5, math.atan(J / O)
					return math.clamp(F / u, 0, 1)
				end
				return f
			end
end)()

						end)
					end
					for o, o in ipairs(J.covered or {}) do
						pcall(function()
							o.node.Transparency = o.was
							if o.material ~= nil then
								o.node.Material = o.material
							end
						end)
					end
					J.joint = nil
					J.copy = nil
					J.covered = nil
					J.joints = nil
					J.skin = nil
					J.probe = nil
				end
				f.INSIDE = 2.5
				f.inside = function(J, o)
					local Z = J and J.head
					if not Z or not Z.Parent or not o then
						return false
					end
					J = Z.Position - o
					return J:Dot(J) < f.INSIDE * f.INSIDE
				end
				f.kindOf = function(J)
					if typeof(J) ~= "Instance" then
						return f.PROP, 0
					end
					local o, Z = u(J), 0
					for u, u in ipairs(f.DRIVEN_LIMBS) do
						Z = if o[u] then Z + 1 else Z
					end
					if Z >= f.RIG_FLOOR then
						return f.RIGGED, Z
					end
					if J:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and i(J) then
						return f.RIGGED, #f.DRIVEN_LIMBS
					end
					return f.PROP, Z
				end
				f.TEAM_RIG = { ["Counter-Terrorists"] = "IDF", Terrorists = "Anarchist" }
				f.templateFor = function(J)
					local u = F.get("ReplicatedStorage")
					if not u then
						return nil
					end
					local F = u:FindFirstChild("Assets")
					u = F and (F:FindFirstChild("Characters"))
					if not u then
						return nil
					end
					local o = u:FindFirstChild(f.TEAM_RIG[J] or "IDF")
					if not o then
						return nil
					end
					J, F = pcall(function()
						return o:Clone()
					end)
					if not J or not F then
						return nil
					end
					return F
				end
				f.localTeam = function()
					local J = O.teamOf(p and p.LocalPlayer)
					if f.TEAM_RIG[J] then
						return J
					end
					return "Counter-Terrorists"
				end
				return f
			end
end)()


_registry["services/aim"] = (function()
return function(r10)
	local r1 = r10("core/log")
	r10("core/service")
	local r3 = 2
	local r4 = 0.005
	local r5 = 2
	local r7 = 0.1
	local r8 = 3
	local r9 = nil
	local r10_1 = 0
	local r12 = nil
	local r2 = { available = typeof(mousemoverel) == "function" }

	if not r2.available then
		r1.warn("aim", "this executor does not expose mousemoverel; aim assist is off")
	end

	local r1_1 = function(s31)
		while s31 > 180 do
			s31 -= 360
		end

		while s31 < -180 do
			s31 += 360
		end

		return s31
	end

	local r13 = function(arg1)
		local s3 = arg1.CFrame.LookVector
		local s1 = Vector3.new(s3.X, 0, s3.Z)
		if s1.Magnitude < 0.0001 then
			return nil
		end
		local s3_1 = s1.Unit
		return math.deg(math.atan2(s3_1.X, s3_1.Z))
	end

	local r15 = function(s23)
		return math.deg(math.atan(1 / (s23.ViewportSize.Y * 0.5 / math.tan(math.rad(s23.FieldOfView) * 0.5))))
	end

	local r17 = function(s35)
		local s2 = r13(s35)

		if s2 and r12 and r9 and math.abs(r10_1) >= r8 then
			local s3_1 = r1_1(s2 - r12) / r10_1

			if s3_1 > r4 and s3_1 < r5 then
				r9 += (s3_1 - r9) * r7
			end
		end

		r12 = s2
	end

	r2.turn = function(s37, s38, s39, s40)
		if not r2.available or not s37 then
			return false
		end
		r9 = r9 or r15(s37) * r3
		r17(s37)
		r10_1 = 0
		local s1_1 = not s38
		if s1_1 or not s39 then
			return false
		end
		local s1_3 = math.max(1, tonumber(s40) or 1)
		local s2_2 = s38 / r9 / s1_3
		local s1_4 = -s39 / r9 / s1_3
		r10_1 = s2_2
		mousemoverel(s2_2, s1_4)
		return true
	end

	r2.idle = function(s10)
		if not s10 then
			return
		end
		r9 = r9 or r15(s10) * r3
		r17(s10)
		r10_1 = 0
	end

	r2.gain = function()
		return r9
	end

	return r2
end
end)()

							y.HIT_TOLERANCE,

				end
				local function D(K, C, a)
					if K == "now" then
						return p
					end
					if K == "lead" then
						return l(K, C, f.offset(C, nil, true))
					end
					if K == "back" then
						if not J.enabled() then
							return nil
						end
						local f = l(K, C, J.offsetAt(C, a))
						if f and f.Magnitude >= e.FLOOR then
							return f
						end

					end
