				end
				local f, l, K, C, a, j, V = 640, 0.12, 0.97, 0.25, 24, 2, 14
				local N = h.create(a * V, 0)
				local W = h.create(a * V, 0)
				local U = h.create(24, 0)
				local _, x = h.create(8, 0), 0.05
				local d = h.create(a, 0)
				local L = h.create(a, 0)
				local n = h.create(f, 0)
				local M = h.create(f, 0)
				local t = h.create(a, 0)
				local X = h.create(a, 0)
				local pH, JH = h.create(Z.CAP, 0), 0
				local OH = h.create(Z.CAP, 0)
				local uH = h.create(Z.CAP, 0)
				local FH = h.create(Z.CAP, 0)
				local fH = h.create(Z.CAP, 0)
				local oH = h.create(Z.CAP, 0)
				local ZH, iH = a * V, 7
				local yH = h.create(ZH * iH, 0)
				local PH = h.create(ZH, 0)
				local bH = h.create(a, 0)
				local IH = h.create(a, 0)
				local hH = h.create(a, 0)
				local AH = h.create(a, 0)
				local TH = h.create(a, 0)
				local rH = h.create(a, 0)
				local SH, cH = h.create(a, 0), 1024
				local RH = h.create(cH, 0)
				local eH = h.create(cH, 0)
				local GH = h.create(cH, 0)
				local qH, wH, HH = h.create(cH, 0), 1.05, 1.02
				local function QH(YH)
					local EH = y.serverAnchor()
					if r(EH) == "Vector3" then
						return EH, true
					end
					EH = v(u.localCharacter())
					if EH ~= nil then
						return EH.Position, false
					end
					return YH, false
				end
				local function YH(EH, sH, vH)
					local mH = -vH
					local BH = I.sqrt(mH * mH + EH * EH)
					local gH, kH, zH
					if BH > 1.0E-6 then
						gH, kH, zH = mH / BH, 0, EH / BH
					else
						gH, kH, zH = 1, 0, 0
					end
					return gH, kH, zH, sH * zH - vH * kH, vH * gH - EH * zH, EH * kH - sH * gH
				end
				local function EH(sH, vH, mH, BH, gH, kH, zH)
					local lH, DH = sH * BH + vH * gH + mH * kH, sH * sH + vH * vH + mH * mH - zH * zH
					sH = lH * lH - DH
					if sH <= 0 then
						return nil
					end
					kH = I.sqrt(sH)
					return -lH - kH, -lH + kH
				end
				local function sH(vH, mH, BH, gH, kH)
					for zH = 0, mH - 2, 1 do
						for lH = zH + 1, mH - 1, 1 do
							local DH, KH, CH, aH = N[vH + zH], W[vH + zH], N[vH + lH], W[vH + lH]
							local jH, VH = CH - DH, aH - KH
							local NH = I.sqrt(jH * jH + VH * VH)
							if NH > 1.0E-9 and gH < ZH then
								if I.abs(DH * VH - KH * jH) / NH <= kH * wH then
									local ZH, kH = 0, true
									for WH = 0, mH - 1, 1 do
										if WH ~= zH and WH ~= lH then
											local mH = jH * (W[vH + WH] - KH) - VH * (N[vH + WH] - DH)
											if mH > 1.0E-9 then
												ZH, kH = 1, if ZH < 0 then false else kH
											else
												if mH < -1.0E-9 then
													ZH, kH = -1, if ZH > 0 then false else kH
												else
												end
											end
										else
										end
									end
									if kH then
										local vH = gH * iH
										yH[vH + 1], yH[vH + 2] = DH, KH
										yH[vH + 3], yH[vH + 4] = CH, aH
										yH[vH + 5] = BH
										yH[vH + 6] = ZH
										yH[vH + 7] = NH
										gH += 1
									else
									end
								else
								end
							else
							end
						end
					end
					return gH
				end
				local function ZH(vH, mH, BH)
					if mH < 3 then
						return false
					end
					local gH, kH = BH * BH, false
					for zH = 0, mH - 2, 1 do
						for lH = zH + 1, mH - 1, 1 do
							local DH, KH = N[vH + lH] - N[vH + zH], W[vH + lH] - W[vH + zH]
							lH = DH * DH + KH * KH
							if lH > 1.0E-18 then
								local zH, CH = 1 / 0, -1 / 0
								for aH = 0, mH - 1, 1 do
									BH = N[vH + aH] * KH - W[vH + aH] * DH
									zH, CH = if BH < zH then BH else zH, if BH > CH then BH else CH
								end
								local vH = gH * lH
								if CH <= 0 or CH * CH < vH then
									return false
								end
								if zH >= 0 or zH * zH < vH then
									return false
								end
								kH = true
							else
							end
						end
					end
					return kH
				end
				local function vH(mH, BH, gH, kH, zH, lH, DH, KH, CH, aH, jH, VH, NH, WH)
					local UH, _H, xH, dH, LH, nH, MH, tH, XH, pq, Jq, Oq, uq, Fq, fq = Z.read(mH)
					local oq, Zq = -1 / 0, 1 / 0
					for iq = 0, 7, 1 do
						local yq, Pq, bq =
							iq % 2 == 0 and -1 or 1,
							I.floor(iq / 2) % 2 == 0 and -1 or 1,
							I.floor(iq / 4) % 2 == 0 and -1 or 1
						local Iq, hq, Aq = uq * yq, Fq * Pq, fq * bq
						bq, Pq, mH, yq =
							UH + dH * Iq + MH * hq + pq * Aq - BH,
							_H + LH * Iq + tH * hq + Jq * Aq - gH,

							iq * 3

						U[yq + 1], U[yq + 2], U[yq + 3] = bq, Pq, mH
						_[iq + 1] = hq

					end

							N[WH + Jq] = (BH * KH + zH * CH + nH * aH) / dH
							W[WH + Jq] = (BH * jH + zH * VH + nH * NH) / dH

						else
						end
					end

										U[lH + 3] + (U[tH + 3] - U[lH + 3]) * nH

									W[WH + Jq] = (dH * jH + BH * VH + kH * NH) / x
									Jq += 1
								else
								end
							else
							end
							zH = uq + 2
							zH = if I.floor(uq / 2) % 2 == 1 then -1 else zH
							if zH >= 0 then
								LH = _[zH + 1]
								if mH > x ~= (LH > x) and Jq < V then
									pq, gH = (x - mH) / (LH - mH), zH * 3
									DH, Fq, UH =
										U[lH + 1] + (U[gH + 1] - U[lH + 1]) * pq,
										U[lH + 2] + (U[gH + 2] - U[lH + 2]) * pq,
										U[lH + 3] + (U[gH + 3] - U[lH + 3]) * pq
									N[WH + Jq] = (DH * KH + Fq * CH + UH * aH) / x
									W[WH + Jq] = (DH * jH + Fq * VH + UH * NH) / x
									Jq += 1
								else
								end
							else
							end
							zH = uq + 4
							zH = if uq >= 4 then -1 else zH
							if zH >= 0 then
								uq = _[zH + 1]
								if mH > x ~= (uq > x) and Jq < V then
									_H, fq = (x - mH) / (uq - mH), zH * 3
									MH, xH, XH =
										U[lH + 1] + (U[fq + 1] - U[lH + 1]) * _H,
										U[lH + 2] + (U[fq + 2] - U[lH + 2]) * _H,
										U[lH + 3] + (U[fq + 3] - U[lH + 3]) * _H
									N[WH + Jq] = (MH * KH + xH * CH + XH * aH) / x
									W[WH + Jq] = (MH * jH + xH * VH + XH * NH) / x
									Jq += 1
								else
								end
							else
							end
						end
					else
					end
					return Jq, oq, Zq
				end
				local function V(U, _, mH, BH, gH, kH, zH, lH, DH, KH, CH, aH, jH, VH)
					local NH = I.sqrt(1 + VH * VH)
					JH = 0
					local WH, UH = U - 1, 0
					for _H = 0, WH, 1 do
						local WH, xH, dH, LH, LH, LH, LH, LH, LH, LH, LH, LH, LH, nH, MH = Z.read(_H)
						local tH, XH, pq = WH - _, xH - mH, dH - BH
						local _, mH, BH, Jq, Oq =
							tH * gH + XH * kH + pq * zH,
							tH * tH + XH * XH + pq * pq,
							LH * LH + nH * nH + MH * MH,
							true,
							-1 / 0
						if mH > BH then
							Oq = I.sqrt(mH - BH)
							Jq = if _ * NH < Oq - VH * I.sqrt(BH) then false else Jq
						else
						end
						if Jq then
							pH[JH] = _H
							OH[JH] = tH
							uH[JH] = XH
							FH[JH] = pq
							fH[JH] = Oq
							WH = JH
							oH[WH] = Z.get(_H, 16)
							JH += 1
						end
						if Jq and _ > 0.001 then
							xH, BH, U =
								(tH * lH + XH * DH + pq * KH) / _,
								(tH * CH + XH * aH + pq * jH) / _,
								I.sqrt(LH * LH + nH * nH + MH * MH) / _
							dH = I.sqrt(xH * xH + BH * BH) - U
							if UH < a or dH < X[a - 1] then
								mH = if UH >= a then a - 1 else UH
								while mH > 0 and X[mH - 1] > dH do
									X[mH] = X[mH - 1]
									t[mH] = t[mH - 1]
									mH -= 1
								end
								X[mH] = dH
								t[mH] = _H
								UH = if UH < a then UH + 1 else UH
							else
							end
						else
						end
					end
					return UH
				end
				local a, U = 128, 4096
				local _ = h.create(U, 0)
				local X, mH, BH = h.create(U, 0), 0, 0
				local function gH(kH, zH, lH, DH)
					if kH >= f then
						return kH
					end
					if zH * zH + lH * lH > DH * DH then
						return kH
					end
					local KH, CH = I.floor((zH / DH + 1) * a), I.floor((lH / DH + 1) * a)
					DH = KH * 1024 + CH + 1
					CH = DH % U
					for a = 1, U, 1 do
						KH = X[CH] ~= mH
						if KH then
							X[CH] = mH
							_[CH] = DH
							break
						end
						a = _[CH] == DH
						if a then
							BH += 1
							return kH
						end
						CH = (CH + 1) % U
					end
					n[kH] = zH
					M[kH] = lH
					return kH + 1
				end
				local function a(U, _, X, kH, zH, lH)
					local DH, KH = lH * K, _ * _ + X * X
					if KH <= DH * DH then
						return gH(U, _, X, lH)
					end
					local K = _ * kH + X * zH
					local CH = K * K - (KH - DH * DH)
					if CH < 0 then
						return U
					end
					DH = I.sqrt(CH)
					CH, KH = -K - DH, -K + DH
					K = (CH < 0 and -CH or CH) <= (KH < 0 and -KH or KH) and CH or KH
					return gH(U, _ + kH * K, X + zH * K, lH)
				end
				local function K(U, _, X)
					local kH = X * l
					for zH = 0, _ - 1, 1 do
						PH[zH] = kH * 2
					end
					local zH, lH, DH = kH * 2, X * X * wH * wH, 0
					for wH = 0, U - 1, 1 do
						for KH = wH + 1, U - 1, 1 do
							X, kH, _ = hH[KH] - hH[wH], AH[KH] - AH[wH], TH[wH] + TH[KH] + zH
							if X * X + kH * kH <= _ * _ then
								for U = bH[wH], bH[wH] + IH[wH] - 1, 1 do
									local _ = U * iH
									local X, wH = yH[_ + 1], yH[_ + 2]
									local kH, zH, CH = yH[_ + 3] - X, yH[_ + 4] - wH, yH[_ + 7]
									for aH = bH[KH], bH[KH] + IH[KH] - 1, 1 do
										_ = aH * iH
										local KH, jH = yH[_ + 1], yH[_ + 2]
										local VH, NH, WH = yH[_ + 3] - KH, yH[_ + 4] - jH, yH[_ + 7]
										local _, UH, _H = kH * NH - zH * VH, KH - X, jH - wH
										jH = _ / (CH * WH)
										if (if jH < 0 then -jH else jH) < C then
											KH = (UH * -zH + _H * kH) / CH
											KH = if KH < 0 then -KH else KH
											if KH > 1.0E-9 and KH < PH[U] then
												PH[U] = KH
											end
											local C = (UH * -NH + _H * VH) / WH
											C = if C < 0 then -C else C
											if C > 1.0E-9 and C < PH[aH] then
												PH[aH] = C
											end
										end
										if (_ > 1.0E-9 or _ < -1.0E-9) and DH < cH then
											jH, KH = (UH * NH - _H * VH) / _, (UH * zH - _H * kH) / _
											if jH >= 0 and jH <= 1 and KH >= 0 and KH <= 1 then
												local C, _ = X + kH * jH, wH + zH * jH
												if C * C + _ * _ <= lH then
													RH[DH] = U
													eH[DH] = aH
													GH[DH] = C
													qH[DH] = _
													DH += 1
												else
												end
											else
											end
										else
										end
									end
								end
							else
							end
						end
					end
					return DH
				end
				local function C(U, _, X)
					local cH = X * l
					for wH = 0, _ - 1, 1 do
						if U >= f then
							break
						end
						local _ = wH * iH
						local kH, zH = yH[_ + 1], yH[_ + 2]
						local lH, DH, KH, CH, aH =
							yH[_ + 3] - kH, yH[_ + 4] - zH, yH[_ + 7], yH[_ + 6], PH[wH] * 0.5
						aH = if aH > cH then cH else aH
						local cH, jH, VH =
							lH * lH + DH * DH, 2 * (kH * lH + zH * DH), kH * kH + zH * zH - X * X
						_ = jH * jH - 4 * cH * VH
						if _ > 0 and cH > 1.0E-12 then
							local NH, WH, UH, _H, xH =
								I.sqrt(_), lH / KH, DH / KH, CH * DH / KH, -CH * lH / KH
							wH, VH = (-jH - NH) / (2 * cH), (-jH + NH) / (2 * cH)
							if wH >= 0 and wH <= 1 then
								local _, cH = kH + lH * wH, zH + DH * wH
								U = if CH == 0
									then a(
										a(U, _ + UH * aH, cH - WH * aH, WH, UH, X),
										_ - UH * aH,
										cH + WH * aH,
										WH,
										UH,
										X
									)
									else a(U, _ + _H * aH, cH + xH * aH, WH, UH, X)
							else
							end
							if VH >= 0 and VH <= 1 then
								local _, cH = kH + lH * VH, zH + DH * VH
								U = if CH == 0
									then a(
										a(U, _ + UH * aH, cH - WH * aH, WH, UH, X),
										_ - UH * aH,
										cH + WH * aH,
										WH,
										UH,
										X
									)
									else a(U, _ + _H * aH, cH + xH * aH, WH, UH, X)
							else
							end
						else
						end
					end
					return U
				end
				local function U(_, X, cH)
					local wH = cH * l
					for l = 0, X - 1, 1 do
						if _ >= f then
							break
						end
						local f, X = RH[l], eH[l]
						local RH, eH = f * iH, X * iH
						local iH, kH, zH, lH, DH, KH, CH, aH, jH =
							yH[RH + 3] - yH[RH + 1],
							yH[RH + 4] - yH[RH + 2],
							yH[eH + 3] - yH[eH + 1],
							yH[eH + 4] - yH[eH + 2],
							yH[RH + 7],
							yH[eH + 7],
							yH[RH + 6],
							yH[eH + 6],
							PH[f]
						jH = (if PH[X] < jH then PH[X] else jH) * 0.5
						jH = if jH > wH then wH else jH
						local f, yH, PH, eH, wH, VH, NH, WH =
							GH[l],
							qH[l],
							iH / DH,
							kH / DH,
							CH * kH / DH,
							-CH * iH / DH,
							aH * lH / KH,
							-aH * zH / KH
						X, RH = wH + NH, VH + WH
						_ = if CH == 0
								or aH == 0
								or X * X + RH * RH < 0.25
							then a(
								a(
									a(
										a(_, f + PH * jH, yH + eH * jH, PH, eH, cH),
										f - PH * jH,
										yH - eH * jH,
										PH,
										eH,
										cH
									),
									f + eH * jH,
									yH - PH * jH,
									PH,
									eH,
									cH
								),
								f - eH * jH,
								yH + PH * jH,
								PH,
								eH,
								cH
							)
							else a(_, f + X * jH, yH + RH * jH, PH, eH, cH)
					end
					return _
				end
				local function f(l, a, _, X, iH, yH, PH, cH, RH)
					local eH = RH
					for GH = 0, l - 1, 1 do
						if iH * OH[GH] + yH * uH[GH] + PH * FH[GH] >= fH[GH] then
							local l, qH = Z.span(pH[GH], a, _, X, iH, yH, PH)
							if l ~= nil and l > 0 and l < RH and qH > 0 then
								local a = oH[GH] == 1 and qH or l
								if a <= cH then
									return nil
								end
								eH = if a < eH then a else eH
							else
							end
						else
						end
					end
					if eH <= cH then
						return nil
					end
					return cH, eH
				end
				local function l(a, _, X, iH)
					return i.reachesPoint(a, _, iH, X) == true
				end
				local function a(_, X, iH, yH, PH)
					PH = iH - X
					local cH = PH.Magnitude
					if cH <= 0.001 then
						return nil
					end
					local RH = yH - H
					if RH <= 0 then
						return nil
					end
					local H, eH, GH = PH.X / cH, PH.Y / cH, PH.Z / cH
					local qH, wH, kH, zH, lH, DH = YH(H, eH, GH)
					for KH = 1, #w, 1 do
						PH, yH = w[KH][1], w[KH][2]
						local CH = T.new(
							iH.X + (qH * PH + zH * yH) * RH,
							iH.Y + (wH * PH + lH * yH) * RH,
							iH.Z + (kH * PH + DH * yH) * RH
						)
						if i.clearLine(CH, X, _) and l(CH, X, _, 0) then
							b.every("sonda", 0.5, "scan", "SONDA abriu no ponto %d de %d", KH, #w + 1)
							return T.new(CH.X - iH.X, CH.Y - iH.Y, CH.Z - iH.Z)
						end
					end
					kH = if cH - Q < RH then cH - Q else RH
					if kH > 0 then
						RH = T.new(iH.X - H * kH, iH.Y - eH * kH, iH.Z - GH * kH)
						if i.clearLine(RH, X, _) and l(RH, X, _, 0) then
							b.every("sonda", 0.5, "scan", "SONDA abriu no passo pela linha, a %.1f studs", kH)
							return T.new(RH.X - iH.X, RH.Y - iH.Y, RH.Z - iH.Z)
						end
					end
					b.every("sonda", 0.5, "scan", "SONDA nao abriu em %d pontos", #w + 1)
					return nil
				end
				local function w(
					H,
					_,
					X,
					iH,
					yH,
					PH,
					cH,
					RH,
					eH,
					GH,
					qH,
					wH,
					kH,
					zH,
					lH,
					DH,
					KH,
					CH,
					aH,
					jH,
					VH,
					NH
				)
					local WH, UH, _H = GH + kH * H + DH * _, qH + zH * H + KH * _, wH + lH * H + CH * _
					CH = I.sqrt(WH * WH + UH * UH + _H * _H)
					if CH <= 1.0E-6 then
						return nil
					end
					WH /= CH
					UH /= CH
					_H /= CH
					wH, _ = EH(aH, jH, VH, WH, UH, _H, NH)
					if wH == nil then
						return nil
					end
					wH = if wH < Q then Q else wH
					if wH >= _ then
						return nil
					end
					NH, H = f(X, iH, yH, PH, WH, UH, _H, wH, _)
					if NH == nil then
						return nil
					end
					aH = (NH + H) * 0.5
					kH, wH, GH = iH + WH * aH, yH + UH * aH, PH + _H * aH
					qH, X, yH = kH - cH, wH - RH, GH - eH
					return kH, wH, GH, (H - NH) / aH, I.sqrt(qH * qH + X * X + yH * yH)
				end
				local f = { 0.82, 0.66, 0.52, 0.4, 0.3, 0.22 }
				local function H(_, X, iH, yH, PH)
					_ = yH - iH
					local cH = _.Magnitude
					if cH <= 0.001 then
						return nil
					end
					local RH, eH, GH = _.X / cH, _.Y / cH, _.Z / cH
					if PH == nil then
						b.every("varredura", 0.5, "scan", "geometria indisponivel -- so a sonda respondeu")
						return nil
					end
					local qH, wH, EH, kH, zH, lH = YH(RH, eH, GH)
					_ = X / cH
					local YH = _ >= 1 and 4 or I.tan(I.asin(_))
					local DH, KH, CH, aH, jH =
						V(PH, iH.X, iH.Y, iH.Z, RH, eH, GH, qH, wH, EH, kH, zH, lH, YH),
						I.sqrt(1 + YH * YH),
						I.max(Q, cH - X),
						YH * HH,
						0
					for Q = 0, DH - 1, 1 do
						d[Q] = jH
						local V, HH, VH = vH(t[Q], iH.X, iH.Y, iH.Z, RH, eH, GH, qH, wH, EH, kH, zH, lH, jH)
						L[Q] = V
						if VH > x and HH * KH <= CH and ZH(jH, V, aH) then
							b.every(
								"varredura",
								0.5,
								"scan",
								"COBERTURA UNICA -- a silhueta %d tapa o disco sozinha (%d oclusores, cone %.4f, fundo %.2f contra %.2f)",
								Q,
								PH,
								YH,
								HH * KH,
								CH
							)
							return nil
						end
						jH += V
					end
					CH = 0
					for Q = 0, DH - 1, 1 do
						bH[Q] = CH
						CH = sH(d[Q], L[Q], Q, CH, YH)
						IH[Q] = CH - bH[Q]
						KH, _, aH, cH = L[Q], d[Q], 0, 0
						for V = 0, KH - 1, 1 do
							aH, cH = aH + N[_ + V], cH + W[_ + V]
						end
						if KH > 0 then
							aH, cH = aH / KH, cH / KH
						else
						end
						local V = 0
						for x = 0, KH - 1, 1 do
							local d, L = N[_ + x] - aH, W[_ + x] - cH
							x = d * d + L * L
							V = if x > V then x else V
						end
						hH[Q], AH[Q], TH[Q] = aH, cH, I.sqrt(V)
						local V, x, d, L = 1 / 0, -1 / 0, 1 / 0, -1 / 0
						for ZH = 0, KH - 1, 1 do
							local bH, IH = N[_ + ZH], W[_ + ZH]
							V, x, d, L =
								if bH < V then bH else V,
								if bH > x then bH else x,
								if IH < d then IH else d,
								if IH > L then IH else L
						end
						rH[Q] = KH > 0 and (x - V) * (L - d) or 0
					end
					for Q = 0, DH - 1, 1 do
						SH[Q] = Q
					end
					for Q = 1, DH - 1, 1 do
						cH, _ = SH[Q], Q
						while _ > 0 and rH[SH[_ - 1]] < rH[cH] do
							SH[_] = SH[_ - 1]
							_ -= 1
						end
						SH[_] = cH
					end
					cH, KH = DH - 1, 0
					for Q = 0, cH, 1 do
						aH, _ = t[SH[Q]], JH
						for Q = KH, _ - 1, 1 do
							if pH[Q] == aH then
								if Q ~= KH then
									pH[Q] = pH[KH]
									pH[KH] = aH
									OH[Q], OH[KH] = OH[KH], OH[Q]
									uH[Q], uH[KH] = uH[KH], uH[Q]
									FH[Q], FH[KH] = FH[KH], FH[Q]
									fH[Q], fH[KH] = fH[KH], fH[Q]
									oH[Q], oH[KH] = oH[KH], oH[Q]
								end
								KH += 1
								break
							end
						end
					end
					mH += 1
					BH = 0
					_, aH = gH(0, 0, 0, YH), K(DH, CH, YH)
					_ = U(C(_, CH, YH), aH, YH)
					local Q, K, C, V, N, W, U, x, d, L =
						iH.X - yH.X, iH.Y - yH.Y, iH.Z - yH.Z, _ - 1, -1 / 0, 0, 0
					CH = 1 / 0
					for t = 0, V, 1 do
						local pH, OH, uH, FH, fH = w(
							n[t],
							M[t],
							JH,
							iH.X,
							iH.Y,
							iH.Z,
							yH.X,
							yH.Y,
							yH.Z,
							RH,
							eH,
							GH,
							qH,
							wH,
							EH,
							kH,
							zH,
							lH,
							Q,
							K,
							C,
							X
						)
						if pH ~= nil and FH > N then
							W = n[t]
							N, U, x, d, L, CH = FH, M[t], pH, OH, uH, fH
						else
						end
					end
					V = x ~= nil
					if V then
						cH = #f
						for V = cH, 1, -1 do
							aH = f[V]
							local f, V, n, M, M = w(
								W * aH,
								U * aH,
								JH,
								iH.X,
								iH.Y,
								iH.Z,
								yH.X,
								yH.Y,
								yH.Z,
								RH,
								eH,
								GH,
								qH,
								wH,
								EH,
								kH,
								zH,
								lH,
								Q,
								K,
								C,
								X
							)
							if f ~= nil and M < CH then
								CH, x, d, L = M, f, V, n
								break
							end
						end
					else
					end
					Q = x == nil
					if Q then
						b.every(
							"varredura",
							0.5,
							"scan",
							"NENHUMA direcao abre -- %d oclusores (%d no cone), %d silhuetas, %d candidatos (%d repetidos), cone %.3f",
							PH,
							JH,
							DH,
							_,
							BH,
							YH
						)
						return nil
					end
					b.every(
						"varredura",
						0.5,
						"scan",
						"ARRANJO abriu -- %d oclusores (%d no cone), %d silhuetas, %d candidatos (%d repetidos), folga angular %.3f, origem a %.2f de %.1f",
						PH,
						JH,
						DH,
						_,
						BH,
						N,
						CH,
						X
					)
					return T.new(x - yH.X, d - yH.Y, L - yH.Z)
				end
				local function f(w, Q, K, C, V, N)
					local W
					local U = l(w, C, Q, 0)
					if U then
						b.every("varredura", 0.5, "scan", "o OLHO tem LINHA LIMPA -- nao ha o que varrer")
					else
						W = (a(Q, C, V, K, N))
					end
					local _
					if W == nil then
						local x = Q:FindFirstChild("Head")
						_ = if x ~= nil and x:IsA("BasePart") then x.Position else _
					else
					end
					local x = true
					if W == nil and _ ~= nil then
						x = l(w, _, Q, 0)
						W = if not x then (a(Q, _, V, K, N)) else W
					else
					end
					if W == nil and (not U or not x) then
						w, N = 0
						if U then
							N = _
						else
							if not x then
								N, w = (C + _) * 0.5, (_ - C).Magnitude * 0.5
							else
								N = C
							end
						end
						local a = Z.gather(V, N, K + j + w, Q)
						W = if not U then (H(Q, K, C, V, a)) else W
						W = if W == nil and not x then H(Q, K, _, V, a) else W
					else
					end
					return W
				end
				e.anchor = function(Z)
					return QH(Z)
				end
				e.radius = function()
					if not O.bool("rage_origin_scan") then
						return 0
					end
					if o.armed() then
						return e.SCAN_CAP
					end
					local o = r((y.serverAnchor())) == "Vector3" and G or m
					return y.ORIGIN_TOLERANCE - o
				end
				local o
				local Z, G = 0
				local function w(H)
					local Q = G ~= nil and H == o
					if Q then
						local m, K = Z, G
						return m, K
					end
					Q = QH(H)
					return e.radius(), Q
				end
				e.beginFrame = function(H)
					o, G = nil, nil
					if r(H) ~= "Vector3" then
						return e
					end
					o = H
					Z = e.radius()
					G = QH(H)
					return e
				end
				e.closeness = function(Z, H)
					if r(Z) ~= "Vector3" then
						return 0
					end
					local Q, m = w(Z)
					if Q <= 0 then
						return 0
					end
					local w = v(H)
					if w == nil then
						return 0
					end
					H = w.Position
					w = I.max(0, (H - m).Magnitude - Q - j)
					return I.max(0, (H - Z).Magnitude + j - w)
				end
				local function Z(w, H, Q, m, K)
					local C, a, j = m.X - w, m.Y - H, m.Z - Q
					return C * C + a * a + j * j > K * K
				end
				local function w(H, Q, m, K, C, a, j)
					if Q == nil then
						Q = {}
						g[H] = Q
					else
					end
					Q.extra = m
					Q.pierce = j
					Q.eyeX, Q.eyeY, Q.eyeZ = K.X, K.Y, K.Z
					Q.aimX, Q.aimY, Q.aimZ = C.X, C.Y, C.Z
					Q.anchorX, Q.anchorY, Q.anchorZ = a.X, a.Y, a.Z
				end
				local function H(Q, m)
					if r(Q) ~= "Vector3" then
						return nil
					end
					local K = v(m)
					if K == nil then
						return nil
					end
					local C = K.Position
					K = I.max(E, (C - Q).Magnitude * s)
					local E = c == nil or (Q - c).Magnitude > K
					if E then
						c, k = Q, 0
					end
					local s, a, j = QH(Q), F.pierce(), g[m]
					if
						j ~= nil
						and j.pierce == a
						and not Z(j.eyeX, j.eyeY, j.eyeZ, Q, K)
						and not Z(j.aimX, j.aimY, j.aimZ, C, K)
						and not Z(j.anchorX, j.anchorY, j.anchorZ, s, K)
					then
						return j.extra
					end
					if j ~= nil and j.extra ~= nil and j.pierce == a and l(s + j.extra, C, m, 0) then
						w(m, j, j.extra, Q, C, s, a)
						return j.extra
					end
					E = k
					if E >= Y then
						return nil
					end
					if e.budget(Q) <= 0 then
						w(m, j, nil, Q, C, s, a)
						return nil
					end
					k += 1
					E = f(Q, m, e.radius(), C, s, a)
					w(m, j, E, Q, C, s, a)
					return E
				end
				local f, Z, w, Q = {}, {}, {}, {}
				local function Y(E, s)
					local m = E[s]
					if m == nil then
						m = {}
						E[s] = m
					else
					end
					m.kind = nil
					m.lead = nil
					m.rung = nil
					m.at = nil
					m.extra = nil
					return m
				end
				local function E(s, m)
					for l = #s, m + 1, -1 do
						s[l] = nil
					end
					return s
				end
				local function s(m, l, K)
					for C = 1, l, 1 do
						local l = m[C]
						if l.kind == "back" and (l.lead - K).Magnitude < e.FLOOR then
							return true
						end
					end
					return false
				end
				local function m(l, K, C)
					for a = 1, K, 1 do
						local K = l[a]
						if K.kind == "self_back" and (K.at - C).Magnitude < e.FLOOR then
							return true
						end
					end
					return false
				end
				local function l()
					if F.magicSkipsGeometry() then
						return 1
					end
					return J.rungs()
				end
				local function J(K, C)
					if K.rung == nil or K.rung <= 1 then
						return false
					end
					return C ~= nil and C.kills == true
				end
				local function K(C, a, j)
					if C == "eye" then
						return a
					end
					if C == "scan" then
						if a == nil or j == nil then
							return nil
						end
						return QH(a) + j
					end
					if C == "self_back" then
						if r(j) ~= "Vector3" then
							return nil
						end
						return j
					end
					if C == "self_fwd" then
						return P.forward(a)
					end
					return nil
				end
				e.origins = function(C, a, j, V)
					local N = 1
					local W = Y(Q, N)
					W.kind = "eye"
					W.at = C
					w[N] = W
					if C == nil or a == nil then
						return E(w, N)
					end
					if not F.magicSkipsGeometry() then
						for U = 1, P.rungs(), 1 do
							local _ = P.backAt(U)
							if _ ~= nil and not m(w, N, _) then
								N += 1
								W = Y(Q, N)
								W.kind = "self_back"
								W.at = _
								W.extra = _
								W.rung = U
								w[N] = W
							else
							end
						end
						local m = P.forward(C)
						if m ~= nil then
							N += 1
							W = Y(Q, N)
							W.kind = "self_fwd"
							W.at = m
							w[N] = W
						else
						end
					else
					end
					if not O.bool("rage_origin_scan") then
						return E(w, N)
					end
					local P = N
					if F.magicSkipsGeometry() then
						if j == nil then
							return E(w, P)
						end
						local m = e.budget(C)
						if m <= 0 then
							return E(w, P)
						end
						local U, _ = F.bound(j, C, V, nil, m)
						if not (U and _ and U >= _) then
							return E(w, P)
						end
						_ = v(a)
						if _ == nil then
							return E(w, P)
						end
						U = _.Position - C
						if U.Magnitude <= 0 then
							return E(w, P)
						end
						_ = C + U.Unit * I.min(m, U.Magnitude)
						N = P + 1
						W = Y(Q, N)
						W.kind = "scan"
						W.at = _
						W.extra = _ - QH(C)
						w[N] = W
						return E(w, N)
					end
					V = H(C, a)
					if V then
						N = P + 1
						W = Y(Q, N)
						W.kind = "scan"
						W.at = QH(C) + V
						W.extra = V
						w[N] = W
					else
						N = P
					end
					return E(w, N)
				end
				e.backFor = function(P, I)
					return D("back", P, I)
				end
				e.backRungs = function()
					return l()
				end
				e.candidates = function(P)
					local I = 1
					local w = Y(Z, I)
					w.kind = "now"
					f[I] = w
					local H = D("lead", P)
					if H and H.Magnitude >= e.FLOOR then
						I = 2
						w = Y(Z, I)
						w.kind = "lead"
						w.lead = H
						f[I] = w
					else
					end
					for Q = 1, l(), 1 do
						H = D("back", P, Q)
						if H ~= nil and not s(f, I, H) then
							I += 1
							w = Y(Z, I)
							w.kind = "back"
							w.lead = H
							w.rung = Q
							f[I] = w
						else
						end
					end
					return E(f, I)
				end
				local f, Z, P = {}, 0, {}
				local function I(w, H)
					Z = #H
					local H, Q = #w, Z
					for w = 1, H * Q, 1 do
						f[w] = nil
					end
				end
				local function w(H, Q, Y, E, s, m)
					local l = f[s]
					if l == nil then
						l = F.bound(H, Q, Y, E.lead, m) or false
						f[s] = l
					else
					end
					return l
				end
				local function H(Q, Y, E, s, m, l, C)
					if m == nil then
						return false
					end
					local a = w(Q, Y, E, s, l, C)
					if not a then
						return false
					end
					return a < m.health or a == m.health and m.traversals == 0
				end
				local function Q(Y, E, s, m, l, C)
					if C == nil then
						return false
					end
					if C.traversals ~= 0 then
						return false
					end
					local a, j = #m
					for m = 1, a, 1 do
						local a, V = P[m], (m - 1) * Z
						for N = 1, #l, 1 do
							m = w(Y, E, s, l[N], V + N, a)
							if not m then
								return false
							end
							j = if j == nil or m > j then m else j
						end
					end
					if j == nil then
						return false
					end
					return C.health >= j
				end
				local function w(Y, E, s)
					Y.kind = E.kind
					Y.rung = E.rung
					Y.originKind = s.kind
					Y.originExtra = s.extra
					return Y
				end
				e.solve = function(Y, E, s)
					if not Y then
						return nil
					end
					local m = u.characterOf(Y)
					if not m then
						return nil
					end
					local l, C = s or O.set("rage_hitbox"), e.candidates(m)
					local a, j = e.origins(E, m, Y, l), F.surfacePad(Y, l)
					for V = 1, #a, 1 do
						s = a[V]
						P[V] = (if E ~= nil and s.at ~= nil then (s.at - E).Magnitude else 0) + j
					end
					I(a, C)
					F.beginWalk()
					s = nil
					for I, V in S(a) do
						j = not J(V, s)
						if j then
							local N, W = P[I], (I - 1) * Z
							for I, U in S(C) do
								if not J(U, s) and not H(Y, E, l, U, s, W + I, N) then
									local I = F.best(Y, V.at, l, U.lead)
									s = if F.better(I, s) then w(I, U, V) else s
								else
								end
							end
						else
						end
					end
					j = O.bool("rage_multipoint", false)
						and not F.magicSkipsGeometry()
						and not Q(Y, E, l, a, C, s)
					if j then
						for O, I in S(a) do
							local Q = not J(I, s)
							if Q then
								local Q, j = P[O], (O - 1) * Z
								for O, Z in S(C) do
									local P = j + O
									if not J(Z, s) and not H(Y, E, l, Z, s, P, Q) then
										O = F.rescue(Y, I.at, l, Z.lead, s, f[P] or nil)
										s = if F.better(O, s) then w(O, Z, I) else s
									else
									end
								end
							else
							end
						end
					else
					end
					Y = B[m]
					if Y == nil then
						Y = {}
						B[m] = Y
					else
					end
					Y.at = A.clock()
					Y.solution = s
					if b.on then
						if s then
							b.every(
								"decisao",
								0.5,
								"mira",
								"resolveu: osso=%s ponto=%s degrau=%s origem=%s dano=%s mata=%s",
								R(s.label),
								R(s.kind),
								R(s.rung),
								R(s.originKind),
								R(s.health),
								R(s.kills)
							)
						else
							b.every(
								"decisao",
								0.5,
								"mira",
								"NAO resolveu: nenhum candidato chega -- %d origens x %d pontos",
								#a,
								#C
							)
						end
					end
					return s
				end
				e.solution = function(J)
					if J == nil then
						return nil
					end
					local O = B[J]
					if not O or not O.solution then
						return nil
					end
					if A.clock() - O.at >= q then
						return nil
					end
					return O.solution
				end
				e.offsetFor = function(J)
					local O = e.solution(J)
					if not O then
						return nil
					end
					return D(O.kind, J, O.rung)
				end
				e.spotFor = function(J, O)
					if r(O) ~= "Instance" then
						return p
					end
					local F = e.solution(J)
					if not F then
						return p
					end
					if F.spot == nil then
						return p
					end
					if F.part ~= O then
						return p
					end
					local f = e.offsetFor(J)
					if f == nil then
						return p
					end
					local Z, P = O.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(F.spot), y.HIT_TOLERANCE - z - f.Magnitude
					if P <= 0 then
						return p
					end
					J = Z.Magnitude
					if J <= P then
						return Z
					end
					return Z * (P / J)
				end
				e.originFor = function(J, O)
					local F = e.solution(J)
					if not F then
						return nil
					end
					return K(F.originKind, O, F.originExtra)
				end
				e.aimOrigin = function(J, O)
					local F = e.originFor(J, O)
					if F then
						return F
					end
					return O
				end
				e.aimOffset = function(J)
					local O = e.offsetFor(J)
					if O then
						return O
					end
					if e.kindFor(J) == "back" then
						if b.on then
							b.every(
								"revalida" .. R(J),
								0.5,
								"mira",
								"%s decidiu `back` e a amostra sumiu: cai no `now`, e NAO no `lead` (direcao oposta)",
								R(J and J.Name)
							)
						end
						return p
					end
					O = D("back", J)
					if O then
						return O
					end
					return D("lead", J)
				end
				local J = 12
				local function O(F, f, Z, y, P, b, I, A, S, R)
					local q, w, H = F - y, f - P, Z - b
					Z = q * I + w * A + H * S
					if Z < -R then
						return false
					end
					Z = if Z < 0 then 0 else Z
					f, P, y = q - I * Z, w - A * Z, H - S * Z
					return f * f + P * P + y * y <= R * R
				end
				local F, f = {}, {}
				local function Z(y)
					F[1] = "now"
					f[1] = p
					local P = D("lead", y)
					P = if P and P.Magnitude < e.FLOOR then nil else P
					local b = D("back", y)
					if P and b then
						y = P.Magnitude <= b.Magnitude
						F[2], f[2] = y and "lead" or "back", y and P or b
						F[3], f[3] = y and "back" or "lead", y and b or P
						return 3
					end
					if P then
						F[2] = "lead"
						f[2] = P
						return 2
					end
					if b then
						F[2] = "back"
						f[2] = b
						return 2
					end
					return 1
				end
				local y, P, b = {}, { enemy = true, alive = true }, {}
				e.touchAlong = function(I, A, S, R, q)
					if r(I) ~= "Vector3" or r(A) ~= "Vector3" then
						return nil
					end
					if A.Magnitude <= 0 then
						return nil
					end
					local r = A.Unit
					local w, H, Q, Y, E, s, m, z, l =
						r.X, r.Y, r.Z, I.X, I.Y, I.Z, u.players(P, b), 1 / 0, false
					for P = 1, #m, 1 do
						A = m[P]
						if not u.isImmune(A) then
							P = u.characterOf(A)
							if P then
								local u = P == R or q == true
								F[1] = "now"
								f[1] = p
								local p, b = u and Z(P) or 1, v(P)
								local Z = b and b.Position
								for R = 1, p, 1 do
									b = f[R]
									local p, f, q = Y - b.X, E - b.Y, s - b.Z
									if Z == nil or O(Z.X, Z.Y, Z.Z, p, f, q, w, H, Q, J) then
										local J, O, O = i.partAlong(T.new(p, f, q), r, P, S)
										if J and O then
											local p = O + b
											local O = (p - I).Magnitude
											if O < z then
												y.player = A
												y.character = P
												y.part = J
												y.impact = p
												y.distance = O
												y.offset = b
												y.kind = F[R]
												y.ours = u
												z, l = O, true
											else
											end
											break
										end
									end
								end
							else
							end
						else
						end
					end
					if not l then
						return nil
					end
					return y
				end
				e.kindFor = function(p)
					local J = e.solution(p)
					if not J then
						return nil
					end
					return J.kind
				end
				e.rungFor = function(p)
					local J = e.solution(p)
					if not J then
						return nil
					end
					return J.rung
				end
				e.reset = function()
					h.clear(B)
					h.clear(g)
					c, k, o, G = nil, 0, nil, nil
					return e
				end
				return e
			end
end)()


_registry["services/alias"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J, O = p("core/config"), p("core/flags")
				local u = p("core/service").get("Players")
				local p, F = u and u.LocalPlayer, { CUSTOM = "custom" }
				F.PRESETS = {
					"hidden",
					"unknown",
					"player",
					string.format("gEt_%s", string.upper(J.NAME)),
					J.NAME,
					F.CUSTOM,
				}
				F.DEFAULT_PRESET = "hidden"
				F.text = function()
					local J = O.str("alias_preset", F.DEFAULT_PRESET)
					if J ~= F.CUSTOM then
						return J ~= "" and J or F.DEFAULT_PRESET
					end
					J = O.str("alias_custom", "")
					return J ~= "" and J or F.DEFAULT_PRESET
				end
				F.hides = function(J)
					if not J then
						return false
					end
					if J == p then
						return O.bool("alias_self")
					end
					return O.bool("alias_others")
				end
				F.isMask = function(p)
					if typeof(p) ~= "string" or p == "" then
						return false
					end
					if p == F.text() then
						return true
					end
					for J, J in ipairs(F.PRESETS) do
						if J ~= F.CUSTOM and p == J then
							return true
						end
					end
					local J = O.str("alias_custom", "")
					return J ~= "" and p == J
				end
				F.active = function()
					return O.bool("alias_self") or O.bool("alias_others")
				end
				local p, J
				F.signature = function()
					local f = O.generation()
					local o = p == f
					if o then
						local Z = J
						return Z
					end
					o = string.format(
						"%s|%s|%s",
						tostring(O.bool("alias_self")),
						tostring(O.bool("alias_others")),
						F.text()
					)
					p, J = f, o
					return o
				end
				F.of = function(p)
					if not p then
						return "?"
					end
					if F.hides(p) then
						return F.text()
					end
					return p.DisplayName or p.Name
				end
				F.ofName = function(p)
					if typeof(p) ~= "string" or p == "" then
						return p
					end
					for J, J in ipairs(u and u:GetPlayers() or {}) do
						if J.Name == p or J.DisplayName == p then
							return F.of(J)
						end
					end
					return p
				end
				local function p(J)
					return J == nil or not string.match(J, "[%w_]")
				end
				F.mask = function(J)
					if typeof(J) ~= "string" or J == "" then
						return J
					end
					if not F.active() then
						return J
					end
					local O = J
					for f, o in ipairs(u and u:GetPlayers() or {}) do
						if F.hides(o) then
							local u, Z, i = F.text(), ipairs, { o.Name, o.DisplayName }
							for o, y in Z(i) do
								if typeof(y) == "string" and y ~= "" and y ~= u then
									J = 1
									while true do
										o, f = string.find(O, y, J, true)
										if not o then
											break
										end
										local Z, i =
											o > 1 and string.sub(O, o - 1, o - 1) or nil,
											f < #O and string.sub(O, f + 1, f + 1) or nil
										if p(Z) and p(i) then
											O, J =
												string.sub(O, 1, o - 1) .. u .. string.sub(O, f + 1), o + #u
										else
											J = f + 1
										end
									end
								else
								end
							end
						else
						end
					end
					return O
				end
				return F
			end
end)()


_registry["services/animdb"] = (function()
return function(r23)
	local r2 = r23("game/guard")
	local r3 = r23("core/log")
	local r4 = r23("core/service")
	local r5 = r4.get("Players")
	local r4_1 = r4.get("ReplicatedStorage")
	local r8 = { Reload = "reloadUntil", Use = "plantUntil" }
	local r9 = {}
	local r10 = false

	local r11 = function(s29)
		return typeof(s29) == "string" and s29:match("%d+") or nil
	end

	local r13 = function(...)
		local s19 = table.pack(...)
		local s2 = ipairs
		local s3 = {}
		table.move(s19, 1, s19.n, 1, s3)
		local s2_1, s3_1, s4 = s2(s3)
		local s7 = r4_1

		for _, s4_1 in s2_1, s3_1, s4 do
			s7 = s7 and s7:FindFirstChild(s4_1)
			if not s7 then
				return nil
			end
		end

		return s7
	end

	local r15 = function()
		if r10 then
			return
		end
		r10 = true
		local s7 = r13("Assets", "WeaponAnimations")
		if not s7 then
			return
		end

		for _, s6 in ipairs(s7:GetChildren()) do
			local s8 = s6:FindFirstChild("CharacterAnimations")

			if s8 then
				for _, s9 in ipairs(s8:GetDescendants()) do
					if s9:IsA("Animation") then
						local s13 = r11(s9.AnimationId)

						if s13 then
							if r9[s13] and r9[s13] ~= s9.Name then
								r3.warn("animdb", "id %s is both %s and %s", s13, r9[s13], s9.Name)
							end

							r9[s13] = s9.Name
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local r17 = {}
	local r18 = {}
	local r19 = {}

	local r20 = function(s33)
		if s33 then
			table.insert(r19, s33)
		end
	end

	local r21 = function(s6)
		local s2 = r17[s6]

		if not s2 then
			local s4 = { reloadUntil = 0, plantUntil = 0 }
			r17[s6] = s4
			s2 = s4
		end

		return s2
	end

	local r23_1 = function(s37, s38)
		local s3 = s38:FindFirstChildOfClass("AnimationController") or s38:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		s3 = s3 and s3:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
		if not s3 then
			return
		end
		local s39 = s3.AnimationPlayed

		local s41 = function(t35)
			local t1 = t35.Animation
			t1 = t1 and r11(t1.AnimationId)
			local t3

			if t1 then
				t3 = r8[r9[t1] or ""]
			else
				t3 = t1
			end

			if not t3 then
				return
			end
			local t1_2 = r21(s37)
			local t4 = t35.Length > 0 and t35.Length
			t4 = t4 or 2.5
			local t2_2 = t35.Speed > 0.01 and t35.Speed or 1
			t1_2[t3] = os.clock() + t4 / t2_2

_registry["services/backtrack"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("core/flags")
				local O = p("services/gamedata")
				local u = p("game/guard")
				local F, f = p("core/service"), p("services/trace")
				local o, Z, i, y, P, b, I, h, A =
					F.get("RunService"),
					math,
					os,
					table,
					200,
					0.008333333333333333,
					132,
					{ 1, 0.6666666666666666, 0.3333333333333333 }
				A = {
					RUNGS = #h,
					rungs = function()
						if not J.bool("rage_backtrack_multi", false) then
							return 1
						end
						return A.RUNGS
					end,
				}
				p, F = setmetatable, { __mode = "k" }
				local T = p({}, F)
				local p
				local function F(r)
					if typeof(r) ~= "Instance" then
						return nil
					end
					local S = r.PrimaryPart
					if S then
						return S
					end
					return r:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				end
				local function r(S, c)
					local R = F(S)
					if not R then
						return
					end
					local e = T[S]
					local G = e == nil
					if G then
						e = {
							count = 0,
							head = 0,
							t = y.create(I, 0),
							px = y.create(I, 0),
							py = y.create(I, 0),
							pz = y.create(I, 0),
						}
						T[S] = e
					else
					end
					S = e.head
					if e.count > 0 and c - e.t[S] < b then
						return
					end
					S = S % I + 1
					e.head = S
					e.count = Z.min(e.count + 1, I)
					G = R.Position
					e.t[S] = c
					e.px[S], e.py[S], e.pz[S] = G.X, G.Y, G.Z
				end
				local function b()
					return J.bool("rage_backtrack") or J.bool("backtrack_chams")
				end
				local S = 0.5
				local c, R = -(1 / 0), {}
				local function e()
					local G, q = i.clock(), b()
					if q then
						c = G
					else
						local b = G - c
						if b > S then
							return
						end
					end
					q = O.players(nil, R)
					for b = 1, #q, 1 do
						local S = q[b]
						if not O.isAlly(S) then
							b = O.characterOf(S)
							if b then
								r(b, G)
							end
						end
					end
				end
				A.offsetAt = function(O, b)
					local r = T[O]
					if r == nil or r.count == 0 then
						return nil
					end
					local S = b or 1
					if S < 1 or S > A.RUNGS then
						return nil
					end
					b = Z.max(0, J.num("rage_backtrack_ms", P)) / 1000 * h[S]
					if b <= 0 then
						return nil
					end
					local P, h, G, q = i.clock(), r.count, r.head, r.t
					local i = P - q[(G - h) % I + 1]
					if i < b then
						if f.on then
							f.every(
								"anel" .. tostring(O),
								0.5,
								"backtrack",
								"%s NAO opinou no degrau %d: anel cobre %.0f ms dos %.0f pedidos (%d de %d amostras)",
								tostring(O.Name),
								S,
								i * 1000,
								b * 1000,
								h,
								I
							)
						end
						return nil
					end
					local f, S, w = P - b
					for b = 0, h - 1, 1 do
						i = (G - b - 1) % I + 1
						b = Z.abs(q[i] - f)
						if S ~= nil and b > S then
							break
						end
						S, w = b, i
					end
					if w == nil then
						return nil
					end
					P = F(O)
					if not P then
						return nil
					end
					f = P.Position
					return Vector3.new(r.px[w] - f.X, r.py[w] - f.Y, r.pz[w] - f.Z)
				end
				A.offset = function(O)
					return A.offsetAt(O, 1)
				end
				A.start = function()
					local O = p
					if O then
						return A
					end
					p = o.Heartbeat:Connect(u.safe(e, "backtrack"))
					return A
				end
				A.enabled = function()
					return J.bool("rage_backtrack")
				end
				A.reset = function()
					local J = p
					if J then
						p:Disconnect()
						p = nil
					end
					local p, J = setmetatable, { __mode = "k" }
					T = p({}, J)
					c = -1 / 0
					y.clear(R)
					return A
				end
				return A
			end
end)()

				end

				return r6
			end

			s5 = s3(isfile) ~= "function"

			if s5 then
				if not s5 then
					s1000100[nil] = nil
				end

				return r6
			end

			if not isfile("neurothycal/badgeequip.json") then
				return r6
			end

			s2_1, s3_1 = pcall(function()
				return r3:JSONDecode(readfile("neurothycal/badgeequip.json"))
			end)

			if s2_1 and typeof(s3_1) == "table" then
				if typeof(s3_1.name) ~= "string" then
					if not s2_1 then
						r2.warn("badgeequip", "badgeequip.json is unreadable, starting fresh")
					end

					return r6
				end

				r6 = s3_1.name
			elseif not s2_1 then
				r2.warn("badgeequip", "badgeequip.json is unreadable, starting fresh")
			end

			return r6
		end

		return r6
	end

	local r8 = function()
		r4.version = r4.version + 1
		local s2 = typeof(writefile) ~= "function"
		if s2 or r6 == nil then
			return
		end

		pcall(function()
			writefile("neurothycal/badgeequip.json", r3:JSONEncode({ name = r6 }))
		end)
	end

	r4.get = function()
		local s2 = r7()
		local s6 = typeof(s2) == "string"
		return s6 and s2 ~= "" and s2 or nil
	end

	r4.set = function(s24)
		local s3

		if typeof(s24) == "string" and s24 ~= "" then
			s3 = s24 or ""
		else
			s3 = ""
		end

		if r7() == s3 then
			return false
		end
		r6 = s3
		r8()
		return true
	end

	r4.clear = function()
		r6 = ""
		r8()
	end

	r4.reset = function()
		r6 = nil
		r4.version = r4.version + 1
	end

	return r4
end
end)()

_registry["services/canvas"] = (function()

local J = identifyexecutor

return function(p)
				local O, u, F, f, o, Z, i, y, P, b, I, h, A, T, r, S, c =
					math,
					table,
					string,
					os,
					ipairs,
					pairs,
					pcall,
					typeof,
					setmetatable,
					Vector2,
					Color3,
					UDim2,
					UDim,
					Enum,
					NumberSequence,
					NumberSequenceKeypoint,
					ColorSequence
				local R = I.new(1, 1, 1)
				local e = c.new(R, R)
				local G = p("ui/create")
				local q = p("services/immediate")
				local w, H, Q = p("ui/font"), { TEXT_SIZES = { 9, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15 } }, {}
				Q.__index = Q
				local p
				local function Y(E, s)
					local v = E.n + 1
					E.n = v
					local m = E.cmds[v]
					if not m then
						m = {}
						E.cmds[v] = m
						E.dirty = true
						m.dirty = true
					else
						m.dirty = false
					end
					if m.kind ~= s then
						m.kind = s
						E.dirty = true
						m.dirty = true
					end
					m.groupHead = E.pendingGroup == true
					E.pendingGroup = false
					return m
				end
				local function E(s, v, m, B)
					if v[m] ~= B then
						v[m] = B
						s.dirty = true
						v.dirty = true
					end
				end
				local function s(v, m, B, g, k, z)
					local l = B ~= nil
					E(v, m, "colorB", l and B or nil)
					E(v, m, "alphaB", l and (g or z or 1) or nil)
					E(v, m, "rotation", l and (k or 90) or nil)
				end
				Q.begin = function(v)
					H.sweep()
					p(v)
					v.n = 0
					v.pendingGroup = false
					v.dirty = false
				end
				Q.rect = function(v, m, B, g, k, z, l, D, K, C, a)
					local j = Y(v, "rect")
					E(v, j, "x", m)
					E(v, j, "y", B)
					E(v, j, "w", g)
					E(v, j, "h", k)
					E(v, j, "color", z)
					E(v, j, "alpha", l or 1)
					E(v, j, "thickness", D or 1)
					s(v, j, K, C, a, l)
				end
				Q.fill = function(v, m, B, g, k, z, l)
					local D = Y(v, "fill")
					E(v, D, "x", m)
					E(v, D, "y", B)
					E(v, D, "w", g)
					E(v, D, "h", k)
					E(v, D, "color", z)
					E(v, D, "alpha", l or 1)
				end
				Q.gradient = function(v, m, B, g, k, z, l, D, K, C)
					local a = Y(v, "gradient")
					E(v, a, "x", m)
					E(v, a, "y", B)
					E(v, a, "w", g)
					E(v, a, "h", k)
					E(v, a, "color", z)
					E(v, a, "alphaTop", l or 1)
					E(v, a, "alphaBottom", D or 1)
					E(v, a, "alpha", ((l or 1) + (D or 1)) * 0.5)
					l = K ~= nil and C ~= nil
					E(v, a, "colorTop", l and K or nil)
					E(v, a, "colorBottom", l and C or nil)
				end
				Q.line = function(v, m, B, g, k, z, l, D)
					local K = Y(v, "line")
					E(v, K, "x", m)
					E(v, K, "y", B)
					E(v, K, "x2", g)
					E(v, K, "y2", k)
					E(v, K, "color", z)
					E(v, K, "alpha", l or 1)
					E(v, K, "thickness", D or 1)
				end
				Q.circle = function(v, m, B, g, k, z, l)
					local D = Y(v, "circle")
					E(v, D, "x", m)
					E(v, D, "y", B)
					E(v, D, "r", g)
					E(v, D, "color", k)
					E(v, D, "alpha", z or 1)
					E(v, D, "thickness", l or 1)
				end
				Q.disc = function(v, m, B, g, k, z)
					local l = Y(v, "disc")
					E(v, l, "x", m)
					E(v, l, "y", B)
					E(v, l, "r", g)
					E(v, l, "color", k)
					E(v, l, "alpha", z or 1)
				end
				local v, m = 1, 1
				local B = I.new()
				Q.text = function(I, g, k, z, l, D, K, C, a, j, V)
					local N = Y(I, "text")
					E(I, N, "x", g)
					E(I, N, "y", k)
					E(I, N, "size", z)
					E(I, N, "text", l)
					E(I, N, "color", D)
					E(I, N, "alpha", K or 1)
					E(I, N, "centered", C == true)
					E(I, N, "shade", false)
					E(I, N, "shadeAlpha", 0)
					s(I, N, a, j, V, K)
				end
				Q.textShaded = function(I, g, k, z, l, D, K, C, a, j, V, N)
					local W = Y(I, "text")
					E(I, W, "x", g)
					E(I, W, "y", k)
					E(I, W, "size", z)
					E(I, W, "text", l)
					E(I, W, "color", D)
					E(I, W, "alpha", K or 1)
					E(I, W, "centered", C == true)
					E(I, W, "shade", true)
					E(I, W, "shadeAlpha", a or K or 1)
					s(I, W, j, V, N, K)
				end

						return nil

						return O.new(e)
					end)

							s.Filled = true
						end
					end)
					if I then
						local I, c = i(function()
							return O.new(e)
						end)
						if not I or not c then
							i(function()
								s:Remove()
							end)
							return nil
						end
						i(function()
							c.ZIndex = R
							c.Visible = false
							c.Color = B
						end)

					end
					return s

				local function O(I, c)
					local R = I.node
					if not R then
						return
					end
					local e = c.kind
					if I.color ~= c.color then
						R.Color = c.color
						I.color = c.color
					end
					if I.alpha ~= c.alpha then
						R.Transparency = c.alpha
						I.alpha = c.alpha
					end
					local s = e == "rect" or e == "fill" or e == "gradient"
					if s then

							R.Position = b.new(c.x, c.y)
							I.x, I.y = c.x, c.y
						end
						if I.w ~= c.w or I.h ~= c.h then
							R.Size = b.new(c.w, c.h)
							I.w, I.h = c.w, c.h
						end
						if e == "rect" and I.thickness ~= c.thickness then
							R.Thickness = c.thickness
							I.thickness = c.thickness
						end
					else

						if s then
							if I.x ~= c.x or I.y ~= c.y then
								R.Position = b.new(c.x, c.y)
								I.x, I.y = c.x, c.y
							end
							if I.r ~= c.r then
								R.Radius = c.r
								I.r = c.r
							end
						else
							local s = e == "circle"
							if s then
								if I.x ~= c.x or I.y ~= c.y then
									R.Position = b.new(c.x, c.y)
									I.x, I.y = c.x, c.y
								end
								if I.r ~= c.r then
									R.Radius = c.r
									I.r = c.r
								end
								if I.thickness ~= c.thickness then
									R.Thickness = c.thickness
									I.thickness = c.thickness
								end
							else
								local s = e == "line"
								if s then
									if I.x ~= c.x or I.y ~= c.y then
										R.From = b.new(c.x, c.y)
										I.x, I.y = c.x, c.y
									end
									if I.x2 ~= c.x2 or I.y2 ~= c.y2 then
										R.To = b.new(c.x2, c.y2)
										I.x2, I.y2 = c.x2, c.y2
									end
									if I.thickness ~= c.thickness then
										R.Thickness = c.thickness
										I.thickness = c.thickness
									end
								else
									local s = e == "text"
									if s then
										local s = I.shade
										if I.x ~= c.x or I.y ~= c.y then
											R.Position = b.new(c.x, c.y)
											if s then
												s.Position = b.new(c.x + v, c.y + v)
											end
											I.x, I.y = c.x, c.y
										end
										if I.text ~= c.text then
											R.Text = c.text
											if s then
												s.Text = c.text
											end
											I.text = c.text
										end
										if I.size ~= c.size then
											R.Size = c.size
											if s then
												s.Size = c.size
											end
											I.size = c.size
										end
										if I.centered ~= c.centered then
											R.Center = c.centered
											if s then
												s.Center = c.centered
											end
											I.centered = c.centered
										end
										local m = r and I.font ~= r
										if m then
											R.Font = r
											if s then
												s.Font = r
											end
											I.font = r
										end
										if s then
											m = c.shade == true
											if m and I.shadeAlpha ~= c.shadeAlpha then
												s.Transparency = c.shadeAlpha
												I.shadeAlpha = c.shadeAlpha
											end
											if I.shadeOn ~= m then
												s.Visible = m
												I.shadeOn = m
											end
										end
									elseif e == "image" then
										local e = I.shade
										if I.x ~= c.x or I.y ~= c.y then
											R.Position = b.new(c.x, c.y)
											if e then
												e.Position = b.new(c.x + v, c.y + v)
											end
											I.x, I.y = c.x, c.y
										end
										if I.w ~= c.w or I.h ~= c.h then
											R.Size = b.new(c.w, c.h)
											if e then
												e.Size = b.new(c.w, c.h)
											end
											I.w, I.h = c.w, c.h
										end
										if c.bytes and I.bytes ~= c.bytes then
											R.Data = c.bytes
											if e then
												e.Data = c.bytes
											end
											I.bytes = c.bytes
										end
										if e then
											local s = c.shade == true
											if s and I.shadeAlpha ~= c.shadeAlpha then
												e.Transparency = c.shadeAlpha
												I.shadeAlpha = c.shadeAlpha
											end
											if I.shadeOn ~= s then
												e.Visible = s
												I.shadeOn = s
											end
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
					if not I.shown then
						R.Visible = true
						I.shown = true
					end
				end
				local function I(c, R)
					local e = Y(c, R.kind)
					if not R.dirty and e.mirrored == R then
						return
					end
					for Y, s in Z(R) do
						if Y ~= "skip" and Y ~= "groupHead" and Y ~= "dirty" then
							E(c, e, Y, s)
						end
					end
					e.mirrored = R
				end
				local function c(R)
					if R.colorB ~= nil then
						return false
					end
					local e = R.kind == "text"
					if e then
						if not H.drawingIsVerified() then
							return false
						end
						local e = r
						return e ~= nil
					end
					if R.kind == "image" then
						return R.bytes ~= nil and R.radius == nil
					end
					if R.kind == "gradient" then
						return R.colorTop == nil
					end
					return true
				end
				local R, e = b.new, {}
				local function b(Y)
					if Y.colorB ~= nil then
						return false
					end
					if Y.kind == "image" then
						return false
					end
					if Y.kind == "text" then
						return false
					end
					if Y.kind == "disc" then
						return false
					end
					if Y.kind == "gradient" then
						return Y.colorTop == nil
					end
					return true
				end
				local function Y(E)
					if not E.fresh then
						return
					end
					E.fresh = false
					for s = 1, E.n, 1 do
						local m = E.cmds[s]
						if not (m.hidden or m.skip) and m.color ~= nil then
							s = m.kind
							if s == "rect" then
								q.rect(R(m.x, m.y), R(m.w, m.h), m.color, m.alpha, 0, m.thickness)
							elseif s == "fill" or s == "gradient" then
								q.fillRect(R(m.x, m.y), R(m.w, m.h), m.color, m.alpha, 0)
							elseif s == "circle" then
								q.circle(R(m.x, m.y), m.r, m.color, m.alpha, 0, m.thickness)
							elseif s == "line" then
								q.line(R(m.x, m.y), R(m.x2, m.y2), m.color, m.alpha, m.thickness)
							elseif s == "text" then
								if m.shade then
									q.text(R(m.x + v, m.y + v), m.size, B, m.shadeAlpha, m.text, m.centered)
								end
								q.text(R(m.x, m.y), m.size, m.color, m.alpha, m.text, m.centered)
							end
						end
					end
				end
				H.publishSizes = function()
					u.clear(e)
					for R, R in o(H.TEXT_SIZES) do
						if q.ready(R) then
							e[R] = true
						end
					end
				end
				H.readySizes = function()
					local R = 0
					for E in Z(e) do
						R += 1
					end
					return R
				end
				H.REAP_AFTER = 15
				H.REAP_MAX = 24
				local function R(E, E, s)
					E.node.Visible = false
					E.shown = false
					E.since = s
					if E.shadeOn then
						E.shade.Visible = false
						E.shadeOn = false
					end
				end
				local function E(s, m)
					i(function()
						if m then
							s.node:Remove()
						else
							s.node:Destroy()
						end
					end)
					if s.shade then
						i(function()
							if m then
								s.shade:Remove()
							else
								s.shade:Destroy()
							end
						end)
					end
				end
				local function s(m, B)
					local g = H.REAP_MAX
					for k, z in Z(m.pool) do
						k = #z
						while k > 0 and g > 0 do
							local D = z[k]
							if not D or D.shown or not D.since or B - D.since < H.REAP_AFTER then
								break
							end
							E(D, m.tier == "drawing")
							G.forget()
							if D.shade then
								G.forget()
							end
							z[k] = nil
							k, g = k - 1, g - 1
						end
					end
					if g < H.REAP_MAX then
						m.lastN = -1
					end
				end
				local function m(B)
					if not B.dirty and B.n == B.lastN then
						return
					end
					B.lastN = B.n
					local g = B.used
					u.clear(g)
					for k = 1, B.n, 1 do
						local z = B.cmds[k]
						if not z.hidden and not z.skip and z.color ~= nil then
							k = z.kind
							local D, K = (g[k] or 0) + 1, B.pool[k]
							if not K then
								K = {}
								B.pool[k] = K
							else
							end
							local a = K[D]
							if not a then
								local j, V = B.make(k, B.parent, B.z, B.opts and B.opts.imageRadius or nil)
								if j then
									a = { node = j, shade = V, shadeOn = false }
									K[D] = a
								else
									B.lastN = -1
								end
							else
							end
							if a then
								g[k] = D
								B.apply(a, z)
							end
						end
					end
					local k = f.clock()
					for z, D in Z(B.pool) do
						for K = (g[z] or 0) + 1, #D, 1 do
							local g = D[K]
							if g.shown then
								R(B, g, k)
							end
						end
					end
				end
				local B, g, k
				local z, D, K = {}, 0, 2048
				local function a(j, V, N)
					if N == nil or N == "" or not V then
						return nil
					end
					local W = V .. "|" .. N
					local U = z[W]
					if U then
						return U
					end
					if not j then
						return nil
					end
					U = not B
					if U then
						B = G.new(
							"TextLabel",
							{
								Name = "CanvasRuler",
								Position = h.fromOffset(-4000, -4000),
								Size = h.fromOffset(4000, 200),
								TextWrapped = false,
								TextXAlignment = T.TextXAlignment.Left,
								TextYAlignment = T.TextYAlignment.Top,
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								TextTransparency = 1,
								FontFace = w.face(true),
								Text = "",
								Visible = true,
								Parent = j,
							}
						)
					end
					U = B
					if not U then
						return nil
					end
					U = g ~= V
					if U then
						B.TextSize = V
						g = V
					end
					j = k ~= N
					if j then
						B.Text = N
						k = N
					end
					N = B.TextBounds
					j = N and N.X or 0
					if j <= 0 then
						return nil
					end
					U = D >= K
					if U then
						u.clear(z)
						D = 0
					end
					z[W] = j
					D += 1
					return j
				end
				local function h(T)
					if T.occX == nil then
						for w = 1, T.n, 1 do
							local B = T.cmds[w]
							if B.hidden then
								B.hidden = false
								T.dirty = true
								B.dirty = true
							end
						end
						return
					end
					local w, B = T.occX, T.occY
					local g, k, z = w + T.occW, B + T.occH, 1
					while z <= T.n do
						local D = T.n
						for K = z + 1, T.n, 1 do
							if T.cmds[K].groupHead then
								D = K - 1
								break
							end
						end
						local K, j, V, N = 1 / 0, -1 / 0, 1 / 0, -1 / 0
						for W = z, D, 1 do
							local U = T.cmds[W]
							local _, x, d, L, n = U.kind
							if _ == "line" then
								if U.x <= U.x2 then
									x, d = U.x, U.x2
								else
									x, d = U.x2, U.x
								end
								if U.y <= U.y2 then
									L, n = U.y, U.y2
								else
									L, n = U.y2, U.y
								end
							else
								if _ == "text" then
									W = a(T.parent, U.size, U.text)
									if W then
										local a = (U.size or 0) * 1.5
										if U.centered then
											x, d = U.x - W * 0.5, U.x + W * 0.5
										else
											x, d = U.x, U.x + W
										end
										L, n = U.y, U.y + a
									else
										x, L, d, n = U.x, U.y, U.x, U.y
									end
									if U.shade then
										d, n = d + v, n + v
									else
									end
								else
									if _ == "image" then
										x, L, d, n = U.x, U.y, U.x + (U.w or 0), U.y + (U.h or 0)
										if U.shade then
											d, n = d + v, n + v
										else
										end
									else
										if _ == "circle" or _ == "disc" then
											x, L, d, n = U.x - U.r, U.y - U.r, U.x + U.r, U.y + U.r
										else
											x, L, d, n = U.x, U.y, U.x + (U.w or 0), U.y + (U.h or 0)
										end
									end
								end
							end
							K, j, V, N =
								if x < K then x else K,
								if d > j then d else j,
								if L < V then L else V,
								if n > N then n else N
						end
						local v = not (j < w or K > g or N < B or V > k)
						for w = z, D, 1 do
							local B = T.cmds[w]
							if B.hidden ~= v then
								B.hidden = v
								T.dirty = true
								B.dirty = true
							end
						end
						z = D + 1
					end
				end
				Q.finish = function(T)
					h(T)
					if T.tier ~= "immediate" then
						local h = T.fallback
						if h then
							h:begin()
							for w = 1, T.n, 1 do
								local v = T.cmds[w]
								w = c(v)
								v.skip = not w
								if not v.hidden and not w then
									I(h, v)
								end
							end
							h:finish()
						end
						m(T)
						return
					end
					local h = T.fallback
					if h then
						h:begin()
					end
					for c = 1, T.n, 1 do
						local w = T.cmds[c]
						c = b(w)
						w.skip = not c
						if not w.hidden and not c and h then
							I(h, w)
						end
					end
					if h then
						h:finish()
					end
					T.fresh = true
				end
				Q.clear = function(b)
					local I = f.clock()
					for h, h in Z(b.pool) do
						for T, T in o(h) do
							if T.shown then
								R(b, T, I)
							end
						end
					end
					b.lastN = -1
					b.n = 0
					b.fresh = false
					if b.fallback then
						b.fallback:clear()
					end
				end
				local b = {}
				H.tier = "instance"
				H.why = nil
				local I, h = false, { volt = true }
				local function T()
					local c
					local c = J
					if y(c) ~= "function" then
						return nil
					end
					c = J
					local J, R = i(c)
					if not J or y(R) ~= "string" then
						return nil
					end
					return F.lower(R)
				end
				local J
				H.drawingIsVerified = function(y)
					local c = y == nil and J ~= nil
					if c then
						local c = J
						return c
					end
					local c, R = y and F.lower(y) or T(), false
					if c then
						for T in Z(h) do
							if F.find(c, T, 1, true) then
								R = true
								break
							end
						end
					else
					end
					c = y == nil
					if c then
						J = R
					end
					return R
				end
				H.arm = function(F, y)
					local h = I
					if h then
						return H.tier
					end
					I = true
					if not G.ALLOW_DRAWING then
						H.tier = "instance"
						H.why = "ui/create.ALLOW_DRAWING esta falso"
						return H.tier
					end
					if y == "instance" then
						H.tier = "instance"
						H.why = "o usuario escolheu instance"
						return H.tier
					end
					if y ~= "drawing" and not H.drawingIsVerified() then
						H.tier = "instance"
						H.why = "a api de desenho deste executor nao foi verificada"
						return H.tier
					end
					h = y ~= "drawing" and q.available()
					if h then
						q.arm(F, H.TEXT_SIZES)
						H.publishSizes()
						r = q.anyFont()
						if H.readySizes() > 0 then
							H.tier = "immediate"
							H.why = nil
							return H.tier
						end
						H.why = "DrawingImmediate existe mas nenhum corpo de fonte registrou"
					else
						local h = y == "drawing"
						if h then
							H.why = "o usuario escolheu drawing"
							local h = q.available()
							if h then
								q.arm(F, H.TEXT_SIZES)
								r = q.anyFont()
							end
						end
					end
					if A() then
						H.tier = "drawing"
						H.why = H.why or "DrawingImmediate ausente"
						return H.tier
					end
					H.tier = "instance"
					if y == "drawing" then
						H.why = "o usuario escolheu drawing, mas o executor nao tem Drawing"
					else
						H.why = H.why or "nem DrawingImmediate nem Drawing"
					end
					return H.tier
				end
				p = function(p)
					if p.resolved then
						return
					end
					p.resolved = true
					local F = p.opts
					local y = F.tier or H.tier
					y = if y == "immediate" and not q.available() then A() and "drawing" or "instance" else y
					y = if y == "drawing" and not A() then "instance" else y
					local h = y == "drawing"
					p.tier = y
					p.make = h and S or l
					p.apply = h and O or C
					if y == "immediate" then
						h = q.paint(p.z, function()
							Y(p)
						end)
						if h then
							p.connection = h
							p.fallback = H.layer(
								p.name .. "/fallback",
								p.z,
								{ tier = A() and "drawing" or "instance", parent = F.parent, imageRadius = F.imageRadius }
							)
						else
							local h = A() and "drawing" or "instance"
							p.tier = h
							p.make = h == "drawing" and S or l
							p.apply = h == "drawing" and O or C
							if h == "drawing" then
								p.fallback = H.layer(
									p.name .. "/fallback",
									p.z,
									{ tier = "instance", parent = F.parent, imageRadius = F.imageRadius }
								)
							end
						end
					elseif y == "drawing" then
						p.fallback = H.layer(
							p.name .. "/fallback",
							p.z,
							{ tier = "instance", parent = F.parent, imageRadius = F.imageRadius }
						)
					end
				end
				H.layer = function(p, O, F)
					local y = b[p]
					if y then
						return y
					end
					F = F or {}
					y = P(
						{
							name = p,
							z = O or 0,
							opts = F,
							resolved = false,
							cmds = {},
							n = 0,
							lastN = -1,
							dirty = true,
							fresh = false,
							pool = {},
							used = {},
							parent = F.parent,
						},
						Q
					)
					b[p] = y
					return y
				end
				H.SWEEP_EVERY = 1
				local p = -1
				H.sweep = function()
					local O = f.clock()
					local F = O - p
					if F < H.SWEEP_EVERY then
						return
					end
					p = O
					F = b
					for f, f in Z(F) do
						if f.pool then
							s(f, O)
						end
						if f.fallback and f.fallback.pool then
							s(f.fallback, O)
						end
					end
				end
				H.reset = function()
					J, p = nil, -1
					local p = b
					for J, O in Z(p) do
						if O.connection then
							i(function()
								O.connection:Disconnect()
							end)
							O.connection = nil
						end
						J = O.tier == "drawing"
						for p, p in Z(O.pool) do
							for O, O in o(p) do
								E(O, J)
							end
						end
					end
					b = {}
					u.clear(e)
					r, I = nil, false
					i(q.reset)
				end
				return H
			end
end)()

		return s2_4, s3_2
	end

	r7.armorOf = r3

	r7.covers = function(s25, s26)
		if s25 == "Legs" then
			return false
		end

		if s25 == "Head" then
			return typeof(s26) == "string" and s26:find("Helmet") ~= nil
		end
		return true
	end

	r7.stats = function(s37)
		local s1 = r4.weapon(s37)
		if not s1 or typeof(s1.DamagePerPart) ~= "table" then
			return nil
		end

		return {
			parts = s1.DamagePerPart,
			armorPen = tonumber(s1.ArmorPenetration) or 1,
			rangeMod = tonumber(s1.RangeModifier) or 1,
			wallbang = tonumber(s1.WallbangMultiplier) or 1,
			pellets = tonumber(s1.BulletsPerShot) or 1,
		}
	end

	r7.predict = function(s12)
		local s13 = r7.stats(s12.weapon)
		if not s13 then
			return nil
		end
		local s2 = tonumber(s13.parts[s12.part])
		if not s2 then
			return nil
		end
		local s14 = s2 * s13.rangeMod ^ ((tonumber(s12.distance) or 0) / r7.FALLOFF_DIV) * s13.wallbang ^ (tonumber(s12.traversals) or 0)
		local s10 = tonumber(s12.armor)
		if not (s10 and s10 > 0 and r7.covers(s12.part, s12.armorKind)) then
			return { raw = s14, health = math.ceil(s14), armor = 0, capped = false }
		end
		local s2_2 = s14 * s13.armorPen
		local s3_2 = s2_2 / r8
		return { raw = s14, health = math.ceil(s2_2), armor = math.min(s3_2, s10), capped = s3_2 > s10 }
	end

	r7.lethal = function(s9, s10)
		local s2 = s9 ~= nil

		if s2 then
			s2 = s9.health >= (tonumber(s10) or 100)
		end

		return s2
	end

	return r7
end
end)()


_registry["services/dropskin"] = (function()
return function(r29)

	local r21 = function(s24)

		end

		local s2_4 = 331251496

		s2_4 = 452197978
		r19("dropskin/pendura", s4_1)

	end

	local r24 = function(s14, s15, s16, s17, s18)
		local s1 = false

		pcall(function()
			s1 = s14.Parent ~= nil and s15.Parent ~= nil
		end)

		if not s1 then
			pcall(function()
				s17:Destroy()
			end)

			return false
		end

		if not pcall(function()
			local t800001 = 2458193474
			local t800002 = 3829646809
			s17.Name = s18.model
			s17:PivotTo(s15:GetPivot())
			local t2, t3, t4 = ipairs(s15:GetDescendants())

			local t12 = 175669348

				r22(arg1, s17)
			end

			t12 = 228144939
			local t3_2 = t4_2:Connect(r5.safe(t6, "dropskin/tarde"))
			table.insert(r3, t3_2)

			local t16 = 199175651

			local t7 = function()
				if s14.Parent ~= nil then
					return
				end

					t3_2:Disconnect()

		end

		end)

		if os.clock() - s30 > s6 then

			return
		end

		r19("dropskin/espera", function()
			r14.paint(s28, s29, s30)

		end

		if not pcall(function()
			r2 = r10:GetInstanceAddedSignal(r14.TAG):Connect(r5.safe(r24_1, "dropskin"))
		end) then

		table.clear(r1_1)
