_registry["ui/autobuy"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/assets")
				local O = p("services/buymenu")
				local u = p("ui/connect")
				local F = p("ui/create")
				local f = p("ui/icon")
				local o = p("ui/metrics")
				local Z = p("ui/motion")
				local i = p("ui/popup")
				local y, P = p("core/service"), p("ui/skin")
				local b, I = p("ui/skins/style"), p("ui/theme")
				local h = p("ui/font")
				local A = p("ui/zindex")
				local p = y.get("RunService")
				local T = y.get("UserInputService")
				local y, r, S = b.ANIM, {}, {}
				S.__index = S
				r.VIEW = 360
				r.INSET = 6
				r.ROW = 26

				r.CHIP_H = 20

				r.BAR_GAP = 10
				r.LIST_GAP = 12

					key = "Counter-Terrorists",
				} }

					{ key = "category", text = "category", glyph = "grid" },
					{ key = "price", text = "price", glyph = "money" },

					local e, G = {}, {}

						for q, q in ipairs(R) do
							if O.byName[q] and not G[q] then
								G[q] = true
								table.insert(e, q)
							end
						end
					end

				end

				end

							type = "autobuy",

					e.token = H

						c(e, "move", e.main, y.move, { Position = w })

					e.scale.Scale = y.enterScale

					task.delay(q, function()
						if e.leaving or not e.main then
							return
						end

							return

						if not G.leaving or not G.main then

							if q then

							end

					local q = {}

						return Q.name < Y.name
					end
					if y.sort == "price" then
						table.sort(q, H)
					elseif y.sort == "name" then

						end)
					else

						for Y, E in ipairs(O.CATEGORIES) do
							Q[E] = Y

							local s, v = Q[R(Y)] or 99, Q[R(E)] or 99
							if s ~= v then
								return s < v == (w == 1)

							Z.dragKey = R
							Z.dragY = e.Position.Y
							Z.dragFrom = Z:indexOf(R)
							Z.dragMoved = false
							Z:paintCard(R)
						elseif e.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
							if i.blocks(y.main) then
								return
							end
							if Z.chosen[R] then
								return
							end
							y.main.BackgroundColor3 = P.get("rowGlow")
							c(y, "fade", y.main, r.FAST, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.94 })
						end
					end, "autobuy/down")
					u.signal(y.main.InputEnded, function(i)
						if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
							if Z.chosen[R] then
								return
							end
							c(y, "fade", y.main, r.FAST, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
						end
					end, "autobuy/out")
				end
				S.wire = function(Z)
					u.signal(T.InputChanged, function(i)
						if not Z.dragKey then
							return
						end
						if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
							return
						end
						local y = i.Position.Y - Z.dragY
						if math.abs(y) > r.DRAG_SLOP then
							Z.dragMoved = true
						end
						if not Z.dragFrom then
							return
						end
						i = r.ROW + r.ROW_GAP
						local R = math.floor(y / i + 0.5)
						Z:moveTo(Z.dragKey, math.clamp(Z.dragFrom + R, 1, #Z.order))
					end, "autobuy/drag")
					u.signal(T.InputEnded, function(i)
						if not Z.dragKey then
							return
						end
						if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
							return
						end
						local i, y = Z.dragKey, Z.dragMoved
						Z.dragKey = nil
						Z.dragMoved = false
						Z.dragFrom = nil
						if y then
							Z:paintCard(i)
							Z:commit(false)
						else
							Z:toggle(i)
						end
					end, "autobuy/drop")
				end
				S.chip = function(Z, i, y, T, R)
					local e, G, q, w, H =
						T.glyph and f.get(T.glyph) or nil,

								Parent = i,

						F.new,
						{}
					H.CornerRadius, H.Parent = UDim.new(0, o.corner), q
					w("UICorner", H)
					F.new(
						"UIPadding",
						{ PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, r.CHIP_PAD), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, r.CHIP_PAD), Parent = q }
					)
					i, H =
						F.new,
						{
							FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
							VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
							SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
						}
					H.Padding, H.Parent = UDim.new(0, r.CHIP_ICON_GAP), q
					i("UIListLayout", H)
					local i = {

						stroke = F.new(
							"UIStroke",
							{
								ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
								Thickness = o.stroke,
								Color = P.get("stroke"),
								Parent = q,
							}
						),
					}
					if e or G then
						i.art = F.new(
							"ImageLabel",
							{
								Name = "Art",
								LayoutOrder = 1,
								Size = UDim2.fromOffset(r.CHIP_ICON, r.CHIP_ICON),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
								ZIndex = R + 1,
								Parent = q,
							}
						)
						if e then
							i.art.ImageContent = e
						else
							i.art.Image = G
						end
					end
					if T.text then
						i.label = F.new(
							"TextLabel",
							{
								Name = "Label",
								LayoutOrder = 2,
								AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
								Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, r.CHIP_H),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								Text = T.text,
								TextSize = r.SMALL,
								TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
								TextColor3 = P.get("dim"),
								FontFace = h.face(),
								ZIndex = R + 1,
								Parent = q,
							}
						)
					end
					table.insert(Z.chips, i)
					u.signal(q.MouseEnter, function()
						i.hovered = true
						Z:paintChip(i, true)
					end, "autobuy/chipin")
					u.signal(q.MouseLeave, function()
						i.hovered = false
						Z:paintChip(i, false)
					end, "autobuy/chipout")
					u.signal(q.MouseButton1Click, function()
						if y == "team" then
							Z.team = T.key
						else
							Z.sort = T.key
						end
						Z:paintChips()
						Z:relayout()
					end, "autobuy/chip")
					return i
				end
				S.controls = function(Z, i, y)
					local T, R, e =
						F.new(
							"Frame",
							{
								Name = "Field",
								Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, r.SEARCH_H),
								skin = { BackgroundColor3 = "field" },
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								ZIndex = y,
								Parent = i,
							}
						),
						F.new,
						{}
					e.CornerRadius, e.Parent = UDim.new(0, o.corner), T
					R("UICorner", e)
					F.new(
						"UIStroke",
						{
							ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
							Thickness = o.stroke,
							skin = "stroke",
							Parent = T,
						}
					)
					R, e = f.get("search"), 7
					if R then
						F.new(
							"ImageLabel",
							{
								Name = "Glass",

								}
							),
							F.new,
							{

								VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
								SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
							}
						H.Padding, H.Parent = UDim.new(0, r.CHIP_GAP), q
						w("UIListLayout", H)
						return q
					end
					R, T = h(r.SEARCH_H + r.BAR_GAP), h(r.SEARCH_H + r.BAR_GAP + r.CHIP_H + r.BAR_GAP)
					for i, G in ipairs(r.TEAMS) do
						Z:chip(
							R,
							"team",
							{ key = G.key, glyph = G.glyph, image = J.marketplace.team[G.key], tint = b[G.key], order = i },
							y + 1
						)
					end
					for J, i in ipairs(r.SORTS) do
						Z:chip(T, "sort", { key = i.key, text = i.text, glyph = i.glyph, order = J }, y + 1)
					end
					e, R, h =
						F.new(
							"TextButton",
							{
								Name = "Direction",
								AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
								Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
								Size = UDim2.fromOffset(r.CHIP_H + 4, r.CHIP_H),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								AutoButtonColor = false,
								Text = "",

					R("UICorner", h)
					local J = F.new(

						{
							ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,

							skin = "stroke",
							Parent = e,

					Z.dirArt = F.new(

							skin = { ImageColor3 = "dim" },
							ZIndex = y + 2,

					)
					local o = { tweens = {} }
					u.signal(e.MouseEnter, function()
						local i, y = r.FAST, {}

						c(o, "tint", J, i, y)

					u.signal(e.MouseLeave, function()
						local i, y = r.FAST, {}

						c(o, "tint", J, i, y)
					end, "autobuy/dirout")

					I.onChange(function()

					u.signal(p.Heartbeat, function()

					J:paintChips()
					J:relayout()

				return r

_registry["ui/backdrop"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/backdrop_art")
				local O = p("core/log")
				local u = p("ui/raster")
				local F, f, o, Z = p("core/service").get("AssetService"), {}
				local p = false
				local function i(y, P)
					local b, I = buffer.create(y * P * 4), J.alpha
					local h, A, T, r = #I, 255 // (J.levels - 1), 1, 0
					while T < h do
						P, y = string.byte(I, T), string.byte(I, T + 1)
						T += 2
						if P > 0 then
							local I = 16777215 + P * A * 16777216
							for P = 1, y, 1 do
								buffer.writeu32(b, r * 4, I)
								r += 1
							end
						else
							r += y
						end
					end
					return b
				end
				local function y(P, b, I, h, A, T, r)
					for S = 0, A - 1, 1 do
						local A = r + S
						if A >= 0 and A < b then
							local r, c = S * h, A * b
							for A = 0, h - 1, 1 do
								local h = T + A
								if h >= 0 and h < b then
									local b = buffer.readu8(I, (r + A) * 4 + 3)
									if b > 0 then
										local I = (c + h) * 4
										local h = b + buffer.readu8(P, I + 3) * (255 - b) // 255
										h = if h > 255 then 255 else h
										buffer.writeu8(P, I, 255)
										buffer.writeu8(P, I + 1, 255)
										buffer.writeu8(P, I + 2, 255)
										buffer.writeu8(P, I + 3, h)
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
				local function P(b, I)
					local h, A = pcall(function()
						local T, r = i(b, I), J.tile
						local S, c = buffer.create(r * r * 4), J.blits
						for R = 1, #c, 2 do
							y(S, r, T, b, I, c[R], c[R + 1])
						end
						return u.image(S, r, r, "backdrop")
					end)
					return h and A or nil
				end
				f.content = function()
					local y = p
					if y then
						local b = Z
						return b
					end
					p = true
					local b = J.sprite[1]
					local I = J.sprite[2]
					y = u.supported()
					if y then
						local u, h = pcall(function()
							local A = F:CreateEditableImage({ Size = Vector2.new(b, I) })
							A:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, Vector2.new(b, I), i(b, I))
							o = F:CreateEditableImage({ Size = Vector2.new(J.tile, J.tile) })
							local F = J.blits
							local i = #F
							for T = 1, i, 2 do
								local i = o
								i:DrawImage(Vector2.new(F[T], F[T + 1]), A, Enum.ImageCombineType.AlphaBlend)
							end
							pcall(function()
								A:Destroy()
							end)
							Z = Content.fromObject(o)
						end)
						local F = not u or not Z
						if F then
							O.warn("backdrop", "needs EditableImage: %s", tostring(h))
							o, Z = nil, nil
						end
						h = Z
						return h
					end
					Z = P(b, I)
					y = Z
					return y
				end
				f.tileSize = function()
					return J.tile
				end
				f.reset = function()
					o, Z, p = nil, nil, false
				end
				return f
			end
end)()

_registry["ui/checker"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J, O, u = p("ui/raster"), { CELL = 5, LIGHT = 16777215, DARK = 13027014 }
				O.content = function()
					local p = u ~= nil
					if p then
						local F = u or nil
						return F
					end
					p = O.CELL * 2
					local F = buffer.create(p * p * 4)
					for f = 0, p - 1, 1 do
						for o = 0, p - 1, 1 do
							local Z = o < O.CELL ~= (f < O.CELL) and O.DARK or O.LIGHT
							buffer.writeu32(F, (f * p + o) * 4, Z + 4278190080)
						end
					end
					u = J.image(F, p, p, "checker") or false
					p = u or nil
					return p
				end
				O.paint = function(p)
					local J = O.content()
					if not J then
						return false
					end
					p.Image = ""
					p.ImageContent = J
					p.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Tile
					p.TileSize = UDim2.fromOffset(O.CELL * 2, O.CELL * 2)
					return true
				end
				return O
			end
end)()

function Runtime:Lh(destination, offset, values)

					{}
				f.attach = function(p, Z)
					local i = #o > 0 or not p

						return f
					end

										Name = "Aurora" .. b,
										AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),

										Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, I),
										BackgroundColor3 = u.get(),
										BackgroundTransparency = i,
										BorderSizePixel = 0,
										Visible = false,
										ZIndex = F.WINDOW,
										Parent = p,
									}
								),
								"BackgroundColor3"
							),
							J.new,
							{ Rotation = 90 }
						h.Transparency, h.Parent =
							NumberSequence.new({
								NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
								NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
							}),
							y
						P("UIGradient", h)
						o[b] = { frame = y, base = i }
					end
					return f
				end
				f.setEnabled = function(p)
					f.enabled = p and true or false
					p = o
					for J, J in ipairs(p) do
						J.frame.Visible = f.enabled
					end
					return f
				end
				f.onRender = function()
					local p = not f.enabled or #o == 0
					if p then
						return
					end
					local J, u, F =
						f.DEPTH * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(os.clock() * (6.283 / f.PERIOD))), O.amount(), o
					for O, O in ipairs(F) do
						p = math.clamp(O.base - J, 0, 1)
						O.frame.BackgroundTransparency = p + (1 - p) * u
					end
				end
				f.reset = function()
					o = {}
					f.enabled = false
				end
				return f
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/chrome/beam"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/connect")
				local O = p("ui/create")
				local u, F, f =
					p("ui/theme"),
					{ RISE = { 10, 18, 28 }, SPREAD = { 6, 20, 44 }, BASE = { 0.62, 0.8, 0.9 } }
				local p, o = {}
				local Z = false
				F.attach = function(i)
					local y = f or not i
					if y then
						return F
					end
					f = i
					y, i = ipairs, F.RISE
					for P, b in y(i) do
						local i, y, I =
							u.follow(
								O.new(
									"Frame",
									{
										Name = "Beam" .. P,
										AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
										Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
										Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, b),
										BackgroundColor3 = u.get(),
										BackgroundTransparency = F.BASE[P] or 0.9,
										BorderSizePixel = 0,
										Visible = false,
										ZIndex = f.ZIndex,
										Parent = f,
									}
								),
								"BackgroundColor3"
							),
							O.new,
							{ Rotation = 90 }
						I.Transparency, I.Parent =
							NumberSequence.new({
								NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
								NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
							}),
							i
						y("UIGradient", I)
						p[P] = i
					end
					return F
				end
				F.follow = function(O)
					o = O
					O = o and not Z
					if O then
						Z = true
						J.signal(o:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"), F.sync, "beam/move")
						J.signal(o:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"), F.sync, "beam/size")
					end
					F.sync()
					return F
				end
				F.sync = function()
					local J = f
					if not J then
						return
					end
					J = not o
					if J then
						local O = p
						for u, u in ipairs(O) do
							u.Visible = false
						end
						return
					end
					J = o.Size.X.Offset
					local O = J <= 0
					if O then
						local O = p
						for u, u in ipairs(O) do
							u.Visible = false
						end
						return
					end
					local O, u = o.Position.X.Offset + J / 2, p
					for i, y in ipairs(u) do
						y.Visible = true
						y.Position = UDim2.new(0, O, 1, 0)
						y.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(J + (F.SPREAD[i] or 0), F.RISE[i])
					end
				end
				F.reset = function()
					f, p, o, Z = nil, {}, nil, false
				end
				return F
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/chrome/bubbles"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/create")
				local O = p("ui/chrome/reveal")
				local u = p("ui/theme")
				local F, f, o, Z, i =
					p("ui/zindex"),
					{
						COUNT = 128,
						SIZE_MIN = 3,
						SIZE_MAX = 17,
						RISE_MIN = 70,
						RISE_MAX = 195,
						LIFE_MIN = 1.6,
						LIFE_MAX = 6,
						FADE = 0.55,
						HOLLOW = 0.35,
						WOBBLE = 7,
						SPAWN_DEPTH = 6,
						FADE_IN = 10,
						enabled = false,
					}
				local p = {}
				local function y()
					local P, b = i.AbsolutePosition, o.AbsolutePosition
					return P - b
				end
				local function P(b, I, h, A)
					local T, r, S = math.random(f.SIZE_MIN, f.SIZE_MAX), 0.7 + math.random() * 0.7, u.get()
					b.born = I + math.random() * 1.6
					b.life = f.LIFE_MIN + math.random() * (f.LIFE_MAX - f.LIFE_MIN)
					b.rise = f.RISE_MIN + math.random() * (f.RISE_MAX - f.RISE_MIN)
					b.speed = 1.4 + math.random() * 2.4
					b.phase = math.random() * 6.283
					b.column = math.random()
					b.hollow = math.random() < f.HOLLOW
					h, A = h or (y()), A or i.AbsoluteSize.X
					b.originX = h.X + b.column * A
					b.originY = h.Y + f.SPAWN_DEPTH
					b.frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(T, math.max(2, math.floor(T * r)))
					b.half = T / 2
					b.corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.35 + math.random() * 0.15, 0)
					b.frame.Rotation = math.random(0, 179)
					b.frame.BackgroundColor3 = S
					b.stroke.Color = S
					b.stroke.Enabled = b.hollow
					b.frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					b.frame.Visible = false
					b.lit = false
				end
				local b
				local function I(h)
					local A = b
					if A == h then
						return
					end
					b = h
					o.Visible = h
					o.Parent = h and Z or nil
				end
				f.attach = function(h, A)
					local T = o or not h or not A
					if T then
						local r = o
						return r
					end
					i, Z = A, h
					o, b =
						J.new(
							"Frame",
							{
								Name = "BubbleField",
								Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								Visible = false,
								ZIndex = F.BUBBLE,
							}
						),
						false
					A, T = os.clock(), f.COUNT
					for r = 1, T, 1 do
						r = J.new(
							"Frame",
							{
								Name = "Bubble",
								BackgroundColor3 = u.get(),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								Visible = false,
								ZIndex = F.BUBBLE,
								Parent = o,
							}
						)
						h = {
							frame = r,
							corner = J.new("UICorner", { Parent = r }),
							stroke = J.new("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1, Enabled = false, Parent = r }),
						}
						P(h, A)
						table.insert(p, h)
					end
					T = o
					return T
				end
				f.setEnabled = function(J)
					f.enabled = J and true or false
					J = o and not f.enabled
					if J then
						I(false)
					end
					return f
				end
				f.onRender = function(J)
					local u = not o or not i
					if u then
						return
					end
					if not f.enabled then
						I(false)
						return
					end
					u = b == true
					I(J)
					if not J then
						return
					end
					if not u then
						return
					end
					local F, I, h, A, T = os.clock(), y(), i.AbsoluteSize.X, O.amount(), p
					for O, y in ipairs(T) do
						O = (F - y.born) / y.life
						if O >= 1 then
							P(y, F, I, h)
							O = 0
						else
						end
						if O <= 0 then
							y.originX = I.X + y.column * h
							y.originY = I.Y + f.SPAWN_DEPTH
							if y.lit then
								y.lit = false
								y.frame.Visible = false
							end
						else
							if not y.lit then
								y.lit = true
								y.frame.Visible = true
							end
							u = y.rise * O
							local P, I =
								math.min(u / f.FADE_IN, (1 - O) / 0.45, 1),
								math.sin(F * y.speed + y.phase) * f.WOBBLE
							y.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(y.originX + I - y.half, y.originY - u)
							J = 1 - P * (1 - f.FADE)
							J += (1 - J) * A
							if y.hollow then
								y.stroke.Transparency = J
							else
								y.frame.BackgroundTransparency = J
							end
						end
					end
				end
				f.reset = function()
					o, Z, i, p, b = nil, nil, nil, {}, nil
					f.enabled = false
				end
				return f
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/chrome/cursor"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/chrome/cursor_art")
				local O = p("ui/assets")
				local u = p("ui/create")
				local F = p("ui/icon")
				local f = p("ui/zindex")
				local o = p("core/service")
				local p = o.get("Players")
				local Z = o.get("UserInputService")
				local o, i = { mode = "image", fillColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), outlineColor = Color3.new() }
				local y, P = {}
				local b = false
				local function I()
					local h = p.LocalPlayer
					if not h then
						return nil
					end
					local p, A = pcall(function()
						return h:GetMouse()
					end)
					return p and A or nil
				end
				local function p()
					local h = I()
					if not h then
						return
					end
					local A = P == nil
					if A then
						P = h.Icon
					end
					for A, A in ipairs(O.builtin.cursor) do
						if pcall(function()
							h.Icon = A
						end) and h.Icon == A then
							return
						end
					end
				end
				local function O()
					local h = P
					if h == nil then
						return
					end
					local h = I()
					if h then
						pcall(function()
							h.Icon = P
						end)
					end
					P = nil
				end
				local function P(I, h, A, T, r)
					local S = u.new(
						"ImageLabel",
						{
							Name = h,
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
							ImageColor3 = T,
							ZIndex = f.TOP + r,
							Parent = I,
						}
					)
					local I = F.fromAlpha(A, J.size)
					if I then
						pcall(function()
							S.ImageContent = I
						end)
					end
					return S
				end
				local function F(I)
					local h = i and i.Parent
					if h then
						local h = i
						return h
					end
					i = u.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "Pointer",
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(J.size, J.size),
							Visible = false,
							ZIndex = f.TOP,
							Parent = I,
						}
					)
					y.outline = P(i, "Outline", J.outline, o.outlineColor, 0)
					y.fill = P(i, "Fill", J.fill, o.fillColor, 1)
					I = i
					return I
				end
				local u, f
				local function P(I)
					local h = i
					if not h then
						return
					end
					local A, T = I.X - J.hotspot.X, I.Y - J.hotspot.Y
					I = A == u and T == f
					if I then
						return
					end
					u, f = A, T
					h = i
					h.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(A, T)
				end
				o.needsEngineIcon = function()
					return o.mode ~= "image"
				end
				o.repaint = function()
					if y.fill then
						y.fill.ImageColor3 = o.fillColor
					end
					if y.outline then
						y.outline.ImageColor3 = o.outlineColor
					end
				end
				o.setImage = function(J, u)
					if y.fill and J then
						pcall(function()
							y.fill.ImageContent = J
						end)
					end
					if y.outline and u then
						pcall(function()
							y.outline.ImageContent = u
						end)
					end
				end
				o.attach = function(J)
					local u = b
					if u then
						return
					end
					b = true
					if o.mode ~= "image" then
						return
					end
					F(J)
				end
				o.onRender = function()
					if o.mode ~= "image" then
						return
					end
					local J = not i or not i.Visible
					if J then
						return
					end
					P(Z:GetMouseLocation())
				end
				o.setVisible = function(J)
					local u = o.mode == "system"
					if u then
						if J then
							p()
						else
							O()
						end
					else
						local p = o.mode == "image" and i
						if p then
							i.Visible = J
							if J then
								P(Z:GetMouseLocation())
							end
						end
					end
				end
				o.restore = function()
					O()
					local p = i
					if p then
						i.Visible = false
					end
					b = false
				end
				return o
			end
end)()

_registry["ui/chrome/edge"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/create")
				local O = p("core/service")
				local p = O.get("GuiService")
				local u, F, f, o =
					O.get("UserInputService"), { LIT = 0, DARK = 0.85, DEAD_ZONE = 24, enabled = false }
				local O = 0
				local function Z()
					local i, y = u:GetMouseLocation(), p:GetGuiInset()
					return Vector2.new(i.X - y.X, i.Y - y.Y)
				end
				F.attach = function(p, u)
					local i = o or not p or not u
					if i then
						return F
					end
					f = p
					o = J.new(
						"UIGradient",
						{
							Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
								NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, F.LIT),
								NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, F.DARK),
							}),
							Parent = u,
						}
					)
					return F
				end
				F.setEnabled = function(p)
					F.enabled = p and true or false
					p = o
					if not p then
						return F
					end
					p = not F.enabled
					if p then
						local p = o
						p.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0)
					else
						local p = o
						p.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, F.LIT),
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, F.DARK),
						})
					end
					return F
				end
				F.onRender = function(p)
					local J = not F.enabled or not o or not f
					if J then
						return
					end
					if not p then
						return
					end
					J = f.AbsoluteSize
					if J.X <= 0 then
						return
					end
					p = f.AbsolutePosition + J / 2
					J = Z() - p
					if J.Magnitude < F.DEAD_ZONE then
						return
					end
					O = math.deg(math.atan2(J.Y, J.X)) + 180
					o.Rotation = O
				end
				F.reset = function()
					f, o, O = nil, nil, 0
					F.enabled = false
				end
				return F
			end
end)()

							{

								TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
								ZIndex = i.TOP + 1,
								Parent = w,
							}
						),
						mode = O.new(
							"TextLabel",
							{
								Name = "Mode",
								AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
								Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0),
								Size = UDim2.fromOffset(P.MODE_W, P.ROW_H),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								Text = "",
								TextSize = P.MODE_TEXT,
								FontFace = Z.face(),
								skin = "dim",
								TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
								ZIndex = i.TOP + 1,
								Parent = w,
							}
						),
					}
				end
				local function q()
					local w, H, Q = false
					J.signal(b.InputBegan, function(Y)
						if Y.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
							return
						end
						w = true
						local E, s = Y.Position, b.Position
						H, Q = E, s
					end, "keybinds/down")
					J.signal(b.InputEnded, function(Y)
						if Y.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
							return
						end
						w = false
					end, "keybinds/up")
					J.signal(y.InputChanged, function(J)
						local y = w
						if not y then
							return
						end
						if J.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
							return
						end
						local y, w = J.Position - H, b
						w.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Q.X.Offset + y.X, Q.Y.Offset + y.Y)
					end, "keybinds/move")
				end
				P.attach = function(J)
					local y = b or not J
					if y then
						return P
					end
					r = P.PAD_TOP + P.TITLE_LINE + P.RULE_GAP + P.RULE + P.BODY_GAP
					b = O.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "Keybinds",
							Position = UDim2.fromOffset(P.DEFAULT_X, P.DEFAULT_Y),
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(P.WIDTH, R(1)),
							BackgroundTransparency = P.BACKDROP_FADE,
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							Visible = false,
							skin = "window",
							ZIndex = i.TOP,
							Parent = J,
						}
					)
					y, J = O.new, {}
					J.CornerRadius, J.Parent = UDim.new(0, P.RADIUS), b
					y("UICorner", J)
					O.new(
						"UIStroke",
						{ Color = Color3.new(), Thickness = 1, Transparency = P.STROKE_FADE, Parent = b }
					)
					F.attach(b, i.TOP)
					J = u.get("keyboard")
					y = J and P.TITLE_ICON + P.TITLE_GAP or 0
					if J then
						h = o.follow(
							O.new(
								"ImageLabel",
								{
									Name = "Glyph",
									AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
									Position = UDim2.fromOffset(P.PAD_X, P.PAD_TOP + P.TITLE_LINE // 2),
									Size = UDim2.fromOffset(P.TITLE_ICON, P.TITLE_ICON),
									BackgroundTransparency = 1,
									ImageContent = J,
									ImageColor3 = o.get(),
									ZIndex = i.TOP + 1,
									Parent = b,
								}
							),
							"ImageColor3"
						)
					end
					I = o.follow(
						O.new(
							"TextLabel",
							{
								Name = "Title",
								Position = UDim2.fromOffset(P.PAD_X + y, P.PAD_TOP),
								Size = UDim2.new(1, -(P.PAD_X * 2 + y), 0, P.TITLE_LINE),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								Text = P.HEADING,
								TextSize = P.TITLE,
								TextColor3 = o.get(),
								FontFace = Z.face(),
								TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
								ZIndex = i.TOP + 1,
								Parent = b,
							}
						),
						"TextColor3"
					)
					A = O.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "Rule",
							Position = UDim2.fromOffset(P.PAD_X, P.PAD_TOP + P.TITLE_LINE + P.RULE_GAP),
							Size = UDim2.new(1, -P.PAD_X * 2, 0, P.RULE),
							BackgroundColor3 = c(),
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							ZIndex = i.TOP + 1,
							Parent = b,
						}
					)
					T = O.new(
						"TextLabel",
						{
							Name = "Empty",
							Position = UDim2.fromOffset(P.PAD_X, r),
							Size = UDim2.new(1, -P.PAD_X * 2, 0, P.ROW_H),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Text = P.EMPTY,
							TextSize = P.NAME_TEXT,
							FontFace = Z.face(),
							skin = "dim",
							Visible = false,
							ZIndex = i.TOP + 1,
							Parent = b,
						}
					)
					q()
					o.onChange(function()
						local J = A
						if J then
							local J = A
							J.BackgroundColor3 = c()
						end
					end)
					return P
				end
				P.setEnabled = function(J)
					P.enabled = J and true or false
					J = b
					if J then
						local J = b
						J.Visible = P.enabled
					end
					return P
				end
				P.setRows = function(J)
					local O = b
					if not O then
						return
					end
					local u, F, Z = #J, o.get(), f.get("text")
					for f, o in ipairs(J) do
						O = p[f]
						local i = not O
						if i then
							local y = r
							O = G(y + (f - 1) * (P.ROW_H + P.ROW_GAP))
							p[f] = O
						else
						end
						e(O.key, o.key or "--")
						e(O.name, o.name)
						e(O.mode, P.MODE_SHORT[o.mode] or o.mode)
						i = o.active and F or Z
						if O.key.TextColor3 ~= i then
							O.key.TextColor3 = i
							O.name.TextColor3 = i
						end
						O.frame.Visible = true
					end
					F, Z = u + 1, #p
					for O = F, Z, 1 do
						p[O].frame.Visible = false
					end
					Z = T
					Z.Visible = u == 0
					Z = R(u)
					J = b.Size.Y.Offset ~= Z
					if J then
						u = b
						u.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(P.WIDTH, Z)
					end
				end
				P.onRender = function(J, O)
					local u = not P.enabled or not b
					if u then
						return
					end
					S += J or 0
					u = S
					if u < 1 / P.REFRESH then
						return
					end
					S = 0
					P.setRows(O())
				end
				P.position = function()
					local J = b
					if not J then
						return nil
					end
					J = { x = b.Position.X.Offset, y = b.Position.Y.Offset }
					return J
				end
				P.setPosition = function(J, O)
					local u = b
					if not u then
						return P
					end
					J, O = tonumber(J), tonumber(O)
					u = J and O
					if u then
						local u = b
						u.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(J, O)
					end
					return P
				end
				P.reset = function()
					b, I, h, A, T, p, r, S = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, {}, 0, 0
					P.enabled = false
				end
				return P
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/chrome/linkdot"] = (function()
return function(requireModule)
	local create = requireModule("ui/create")
	local linkdot

	linkdot = {
		RATIO = 0.35,
		RING = 2,
		RING_SMALL_AT = 6,
		TONES = {
			live = Color3.fromRGB(88, 214, 141),
			connecting = Color3.fromRGB(240, 190, 90),
			stopped = Color3.fromRGB(232, 102, 102),
			unsupported = Color3.fromRGB(232, 102, 102),
		},
		mount = function(parent, zIndex, bgRole, size, status, ratio)
			if parent == nil then
				return nil
			end
			local pipSize = math.max(4, math.floor((size or 20) * (ratio or linkdot.RATIO) + 0.5))
			local ringThickness = (pipSize < linkdot.RING_SMALL_AT) and 1 or linkdot.RING
			local ringTotalSize = pipSize + ringThickness * 2

			local ring = create.new("Frame", {
				Name = "LinkRing",
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1),
				Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ringTotalSize, ringTotalSize),
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Visible = false,
				ZIndex = zIndex,
				Parent = parent,
				skin = { BackgroundColor3 = bgRole or "surface" },
			})

			if ring == nil then
				return nil
			end
			create.new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0), Parent = ring })

			local pip = create.new("Frame", {
				Name = "Link",
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
				Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(pipSize, pipSize),
				BackgroundColor3 = linkdot.TONES.connecting,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				ZIndex = zIndex + 1,
				Parent = ring,
			})

			if pip == nil then
				pcall(function() ring:Destroy() end)
				create.forget()
				return nil
			end

			create.new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0), Parent = pip })
			local dot = { ring = ring, pip = pip }
			linkdot.paint(dot, status)
			return dot
		end,
		paint = function(dot, status)
			if dot == nil then
				return linkdot
			end
			local tone = linkdot.TONES[status]
			dot.ring.Visible = tone ~= nil
			if tone ~= nil then
				dot.pip.BackgroundColor3 = tone
			end
			return linkdot
		end,
	}

	return linkdot
end
end)()


_registry["ui/chrome/rainbow"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/create")
				local O = p("ui/chrome/reveal")
				local u, F, f =
					p("ui/theme"),
					{
						STOPS = 12,
						GLOW_HEIGHTS = { 2, 5, 9 },
						GLOW_BASE = { 0.74, 0.86, 0.93 },
						PULSE_SPEED = 2.2,
						PULSE_DEPTH = 0.12,
						SCROLL_SPEED = 0.09,
						enabled = false,
					}
				local p, o = {}, {}
				local function Z(i)
					local y = table.create(F.STOPS + 1)
					for P = 0, F.STOPS, 1 do
						y[P + 1] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(
							P / F.STOPS,
							Color3.fromHSV((P / F.STOPS + i) % 1, 1, 1)
						)
					end
					return ColorSequence.new(y)
				end
				local function i(y)
					local P = O.amount()
					return y + (1 - y) * P
				end
				F.attach = function(O)
					local y = f or not O
					if y then
						return F
					end
					f = O
					u.unfollow(f)
					y = f
					y.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
					f.BackgroundTransparency = 0
					O = Z(0)
					table.insert(p, J.new("UIGradient", { Color = O, Parent = f }))
					local P, b = ipairs, F.GLOW_HEIGHTS
					for I, h in P(b) do
						y = F.GLOW_BASE[I] or 0.9
						local P = J.new(
							"Frame",
							{
								Name = "Glow" .. I,
								AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
								Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
								Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h),
								BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
								BackgroundTransparency = y,
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								ZIndex = f.ZIndex - 1,
								Parent = f,
							}
						)
						table.insert(p, J.new("UIGradient", { Color = O, Parent = P }))
						table.insert(o, { frame = P, base = y })
					end
					return F
				end
				F.setEnabled = function(J)
					F.enabled = J and true or false
					J = f
					if not J then
						return F
					end
					J = o
					for O, O in ipairs(J) do
						O.frame.Visible = F.enabled
					end
					J = F.enabled
					if J then
						u.unfollow(f)
						local J = f
						J.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
					else
						local J = p
						for O, O in ipairs(J) do
							O.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
						end
						u.follow(f, "BackgroundColor3")
					end
					return F
				end
				F.onRender = function()
					local J = not F.enabled or not f
					if J then
						return
					end
					J = os.clock()
					local O, u, y =
						Z(J * F.SCROLL_SPEED % 1),
						F.PULSE_DEPTH * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(J * F.PULSE_SPEED)),
						p
					for J, J in ipairs(y) do
						J.Color = O
					end
					O = o
					for J, J in ipairs(O) do
						J.frame.BackgroundTransparency = i(math.clamp(J.base - u, 0, 1))
					end
				end
				F.reset = function()
					f, p, o = nil, {}, {}
				end
				return F
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/chrome/reveal"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/fade")
				local O, u, F =
					p("core/service").get("TweenService"),
					{ RISE = 16, SINK = 12, OPEN_TIME = 0.2, SHUT_TIME = 0.12 }
				u.onSettle = nil
				local p = {}
				u.include = function(f, o)
					if not f or typeof(o) ~= "string" then
						return
					end
					table.insert(p, { object = f, property = o })
				end
				local function f(o)
					local Z = J.snapshot(o)
					for o, o in ipairs(p) do
						if o.object.Parent then
							J.record(Z, o.object, o.property)
						end
					end
					return Z
				end
				u.faded = 0
				u.amount = function()
					return u.faded
				end
				local function p(o, Z)
					u.faded = Z
					J.apply(o, Z)
				end
				u.stop = function()
					local J = F
					if not J then
						return
					end
					local o = J
					F = nil
					p(o.shot, 0)
					o.window.Position = o.home
					o.window.Visible = o.opening
					if u.onSettle then
						u.onSettle()
					end
				end
				u.play = function(J, o)
					if not J then
						return
					end
					u.stop()
					local Z = J.Position
					local i, y =
						Z + UDim2.fromOffset(0, o and u.RISE or 0), Z + UDim2.fromOffset(0, o and 0 or u.SINK)
					J.Visible = true
					local P, b = f(J), o and 1 or 0
					J.Position = i
					p(P, b)
					F = {
						window = J,
						shot = P,
						home = Z,
						from = i,
						to = y,
						opening = o,
						started = os.clock(),
						duration = o and u.OPEN_TIME or u.SHUT_TIME,
						style = o and Enum.EasingStyle.Quint or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
						direction = o and Enum.EasingDirection.Out or Enum.EasingDirection.In,
					}
				end
				u.onRender = function()
					local J = F
					if not J then
						return
					end
					local f = math.clamp((os.clock() - J.started) / J.duration, 0, 1)
					local o = O:GetValue(f, J.style, J.direction)
					J.window.Position = J.from:Lerp(J.to, o)
					p(J.shot, J.opening and 1 - o or o)
					if f < 1 then
						return
					end
					f = J
					F = nil
					p(f.shot, 0)
					f.window.Position = f.home
					f.window.Visible = f.opening
					if u.onSettle then
						u.onSettle()
					end
				end
				return u
			end
end)()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/connect")

								ZIndex = h + 1,

						)
						p.field = O.new(
							"TextBox",
							{
								Name = "Field",

								Size = UDim2.new(1, -p.TEXT_X - 8, 1, 0),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								Text = "",
								PlaceholderText = p.PLACEHOLDER,
								TextSize = F.textSize - 1,
								skin = { TextColor3 = "body", PlaceholderColor3 = "hint" },
								FontFace = i.face(),
								TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
								ClearTextOnFocus = false,
								ClipsDescendants = true,
								TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
								ZIndex = h + 1,
								Parent = p.frame,
							}
						)
						p.wire()
						return p.frame
					end,
					wire = function()
						J.signal(p.field:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"), function()
							p.paintIcon()
							p.onQuery(p.field.Text)
						end, "search/text")
						J.signal(p.field.Focused, function()
							p.editing = true
							local O, i, y, P = f.to, p.stroke, f.HOVER_IN, {}
							P.Color = Z.get()
							O(i, y, P)
							p.paintIcon()
						end, "search/focus")
						J.signal(p.field.FocusLost, function()
							p.editing = false
							local O, i, y, P = f.to, p.stroke, f.HOVER_OUT, {}
							P.Color = o.get("stroke")
							O(i, y, P)
							p.paintIcon()

							end
							local O, i, y, P = f.to, p.stroke, f.HOVER_IN, {}
							P.Color = o.get("edge")
							O(i, y, P)
						end, "search/enter")

							if p.editing then

						J.signal(p.icon.InputBegan, function(O)
							if O.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

							end

							end

							p.iconPress = f.to(
								p.icon,
								f.PRESS,
								{ Size = UDim2.fromOffset(O * F.pressScale, O * F.pressScale) }
							)
							p.Clear()
						end, "search/clear")
						J.signal(p.icon.InputEnded, function(J)
							if J.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
								return
							end
							f.cancel(p.iconPress)
							J = u.size()
							p.iconPress = f.to(p.icon, f.RELEASE, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(J, J) })
						end, "search/clearend")
					end,
					paintIcon = function()
						local J, O, u, F, i = p.editing or p.field.Text ~= "", f.to, p.icon, f.HOVER_IN, {}
						i.ImageColor3 = J and Z.get() or o.get("hint")
						O(u, F, i)
					end,
					Clear = function()
						if not p.field then
							return
						end
						p.field.Text = ""
					end,
					Get = function()
						return p.field and p.field.Text or ""
					end,
				}
				return p
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/chrome/subtabs"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/connect")

				local i = p("ui/font")
				local y = p("ui/zindex")
				local P = p("core/service").get("RunService")
				local p, b, I =
					{
						ROW_HEIGHT = 20,
						ICON_SIZE = 12,
						ICON_GAP = 5,
						SLOT_GAP = 16,
						TEXT_SIZE = 13,
						IDLE_ROLE = "text",
						HOVER = 0.55,
						SLIDE = TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
					},
					{},
					{}
				I.__index = I
				p.add = function(h, A, T)
					local r = setmetatable(
						{ tab = h, title = tostring(A or "subtab"), icon = T and tostring(T) or nil, sections = {} },
						I
					)
					h.subs = h.subs or {}
					table.insert(h.subs, r)
					if #h.subs == 1 then
						h.currentSub = r
					end
					return r
				end
				I.assign = function(h, A)
					if A then
						table.insert(h.sections, A)
					end
					return A
				end
				I.Select = function(I)
					I.tab.currentSub = I
					p.apply(I.tab)
					return I
				end
				p.paint = function(I)
					local h = Z.get()
					for A, T in ipairs(I.subs or {}) do
						if T.label then
							A = if T == I.currentSub
								then h
								else if T == I.hoveredSub
									then O.get(p.IDLE_ROLE):Lerp(h, p.HOVER)
									else O.get(p.IDLE_ROLE)
							f.to(T.label, f.HOVER_IN, { TextColor3 = A })
							if T.glyph then
								f.to(T.glyph, f.HOVER_IN, { ImageColor3 = A })
							end
						end
					end
				end
				p.apply = function(O, I)
					local h = {}
					for A, T in ipairs(O.subs or {}) do
						A = T == O.currentSub
						for r, r in ipairs(T.sections) do
							if r.main then
								if A and not r.main.Visible then
									table.insert(h, r.main)
								end
								r.main.Visible = A
							end
						end
					end
					p.paint(O)
					p.slide(O)
					if not I then
						o.play(h, false)
					end
					if typeof(O.onSub) == "function" then
						pcall(O.onSub, O.currentSub)
					end
				end
				p.slide = function(O)
					local o = O.currentSub
					local I = o and o.slot
					if not I or not O.slider or not O.bar then
						return
					end
					o = I.AbsoluteSize.X
					if o <= 0 then
						return
					end
					local h = I.AbsolutePosition.X - O.bar.AbsolutePosition.X
					f.to(
						O.slider,
						p.SLIDE,
						{ Position = UDim2.new(0, h, 1, -1), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(o, 1) }
					)
				end
				p.reapply = function()
					local O = b
					for f, f in ipairs(O) do
						p.apply(f, true)
					end
				end
				p.showFor = function(O)
					local f = b
					for o, o in ipairs(f) do
						if o.bar then
							o.bar.Visible = o == O
						end
					end
				end
				p.build = function(O, f)
					if not f or not O.subs or #O.subs == 0 then
						return false
					end
					table.insert(b, O)
					O.bar = u.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "SubTabs",
							Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Visible = false,
							ZIndex = y.WINDOW + 1,
							Parent = f,
						}
					)
					local f, o, I =
						u.new(
							"Frame",
							{
								Name = "Row",
								Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -p.ROW_HEIGHT),
								Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, p.ROW_HEIGHT),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								ZIndex = y.WINDOW + 1,
								Parent = O.bar,
							}
						),
						u.new,
						{ FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }
					I.Padding, I.Parent = UDim.new(0, p.SLOT_GAP), f
					o("UIListLayout", I)
					O.slider = Z.follow(
						u.new(
							"Frame",
							{
								Name = "Slider",
								Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -1),
								Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 1),
								BackgroundColor3 = Z.get(),
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								ZIndex = y.WINDOW + 2,
								Parent = O.bar,
							}
						),
						"BackgroundColor3"
					)
					for o, Z in ipairs(O.subs) do
						p.buildSlot(O, Z, f, o)
					end
					p.apply(O, true)
					task.spawn(function()
						P.RenderStepped:Wait()
						p.slide(O)
					end)
					return true
				end
				p.buildSlot = function(O, f, o, Z)
					f.slot = u.new(
						"TextButton",
						{
							Name = "Slot",
							LayoutOrder = Z,
							AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, p.ROW_HEIGHT),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Text = "",
							AutoButtonColor = false,
							ZIndex = y.WINDOW + 2,
							Parent = o,
						}
					)
					o = f.icon and F.get(f.icon)
					if o then
						f.glyph = u.new(
							"ImageLabel",
							{
								Name = "Glyph",
								AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
								Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0),
								Size = UDim2.fromOffset(p.ICON_SIZE, p.ICON_SIZE),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								skin = p.IDLE_ROLE,
								ImageContent = o,
								ZIndex = y.WINDOW + 3,
								Parent = f.slot,
							}
						)
					end
					f.label = u.new(
						"TextLabel",
						{
							Name = "Label",
							AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
							Position = UDim2.new(0, o and p.ICON_SIZE + p.ICON_GAP or 0, 0.5, 0),
							AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, p.ROW_HEIGHT),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Text = f.title,
							TextSize = p.TEXT_SIZE,
							skin = p.IDLE_ROLE,
							FontFace = i.face(),
							TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
							ZIndex = y.WINDOW + 3,
							Parent = f.slot,
						}
					)
					J.signal(f.slot.MouseEnter, function()
						O.hoveredSub = f
						p.paint(O)
					end, "subtab/enter")
					J.signal(f.slot.MouseLeave, function()
						if O.hoveredSub == f then
							O.hoveredSub = nil
							p.paint(O)
						end
					end, "subtab/leave")
					J.signal(f.slot.MouseButton1Click, function()
						f:Select()
					end, "subtab/click")
				end
				p.reset = function()
					local J = b
					for O, O in ipairs(J) do
						O.bar = nil
						O.slider = nil
						O.hoveredSub = nil
						for J, J in ipairs(O.subs or {}) do
							J.slot = nil
							J.label = nil
							J.glyph = nil
						end
					end
					b = {}
				end
				return p
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/chrome/switch"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/connect")
				local O = p("ui/create")
				local u = p("ui/fade")
				local F = p("ui/motion")
				local p, f, o =
					{
						INFO = TweenInfo.new(0.34, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
						RISE = 14,
						STAGGER = 0.07,
						onSettle = nil,
					},
					setmetatable,
					{ __mode = "k" }
				local Z, i = f({}, o), {}
				local function f(o)
					local y = i[o]
					if y then
						return y
					end
					y = { value = O.new("NumberValue", { Name = "SwitchFade" .. o, Value = 0 }) }
					J.signal(y.value.Changed, function(J)
						if y.shot then
							u.apply(y.shot, J)
						end
					end, "switch/fade" .. o)
					i[o] = y
					return y
				end
				p.play = function(J, O)
					if typeof(J) ~= "table" or #J == 0 then
						return
					end
					local o = i
					for y, y in pairs(o) do
						F.cancel(y.tween)
						if y.shot and y.value.Value > 0 then
							u.apply(y.shot, 0)
						end
						y.shot = nil
					end
					for y, P in ipairs(J) do
						if P and P.Parent then
							local J, b = f(y), (y - 1) * p.STAGGER
							o = TweenInfo.new(
								p.INFO.Time,
								p.INFO.EasingStyle,
								p.INFO.EasingDirection,
								0,
								false,
								b
							)
							J.shot = u.snapshot(P)
							u.apply(J.shot, 1)
							J.value.Value = 1
							J.tween = F.to(J.value, o, { Value = 0 })
							if J.tween then
								local u, f =
									J.tween, function()
										if p.onSettle then
											p.onSettle()
										end
									end
								u.Completed:Once(f)
							end
							if O then
								b = Z[P]
								if not b then
									b = P.Position
									Z[P] = b
								else
								end
								P.Position = b + UDim2.fromOffset(0, p.RISE)
								F.to(P, o, { Position = b })
							end
						end
					end
				end
				p.reset = function()
					local J = i
					for O, O in pairs(J) do
						F.cancel(O.tween)
					end
					i = {}
					table.clear(Z)
				end
				return p
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/chrome/tilt"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local p, J, O = { MAX = 2.2, PER_SPEED = 0.0044, TAU = 0.06, enabled = false }
				local u, F = 0
				local function f(o)
					local Z = F
					if Z == o then
						return
					end
					F = o
					J.Rotation = o
				end
				p.attach = function(o)
					if not o then
						return p
					end
					J = o
					O, u, F = o.Position.X.Offset, 0, nil
					return p
				end
				p.setEnabled = function(o)
					p.enabled = o and true or false
					o = not p.enabled and J
					if o then
						u = 0
						f(0)
					end
					return p
				end
				p.onRender = function(o)
					local Z = not p.enabled or not J or not o or o <= 0
					if Z then
						return
					end
					Z = J.Position.X.Offset
					local i = (Z - (O or Z)) / o
					O = Z
					local Z, y = math.clamp(i * p.PER_SPEED, -p.MAX, p.MAX), u
					u = y + (Z - y) * (1 - math.exp(-o / p.TAU))
					f(u)
				end
				p.reset = function()
					J, O, u, F = nil, nil, 0, nil
					p.enabled = false
				end
				return p
			end
end)()

							y = E[P]
							if y and not F[P] then
								F[P] = true
								o += 1
								y.LayoutOrder = o
								y.Visible = true
							else
							end
						end
					else
					end
					O = E
					for y, P in pairs(O) do
						if not F[y] then
							P.Visible = false
						end
					end
					s = o
					F = A
					F.Visible = h.enabled and s > 0
					return h
				end
				h.setEnabled = function(O)
					h.enabled = O and true or false
					O = A
					if O then
						local O = A
						O.Visible = h.enabled and s > 0
					end
					return h
				end
				h.setLink = function(O)
					e = O
					f.paint(R, O)
					return h
				end
				h.setConfig = function(O)
					m = typeof(O) == "string" and O ~= "" and O or h.UNKNOWN
					O = Y and Y.Text ~= m
					if O then
						Y.Text = m
					end
					return h
				end
				local function O(F)
					local f, o = B, 1
					for y, y in ipairs(f) do
						o = if y > o then y else o
					end
					local y, P, I = F and Z.get("danger") or i.get(), #B, h.BARS
					for i = 1, I, 1 do
						F = b[i]
						if not F then
							break
						end
						f = i - (h.BARS - P)
						local I, e = f >= 1
						if I then
							i = B
							e = i[(g + f - 1) % P + 1]
						else
							e = I
						end
						i, I = e or nil, h.BAR_MIN
						I = if i then math.max(h.BAR_MIN, math.floor(h.BAR_H * (i / o) + 0.5)) else I
						if F.Size.Y.Offset ~= I then
							F.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(h.BAR_W, I)
						end
						if F.BackgroundColor3 ~= y then
							F.BackgroundColor3 = y
						end
					end
				end
				local function F(f, o)
					if f and f.Text ~= o then
						f.Text = o
					end
				end
				h.onRender = function(f)
					local o = not h.enabled or not A
					if o then
						return
					end
					f = f or 0
					k += 1
					z += f
					l += f
					D += f
					o = l
					if o < 1 / h.SAMPLE then
						return
					end
					l = 0
					o = z > 0 and k / z or 0
					k, z = 0, 0
					local f = g
					g = f % h.BARS + 1
					B[g] = o
					f = o < h.ALARM
					F(G, tostring(math.floor(o + 0.5)))
					o = f and Z.get("danger") or Z.get("muted")
					local Z = G.TextColor3 ~= o
					if Z then
						G.TextColor3 = o
					end
					Z = E.graph and E.graph.Visible
					if Z then
						O(f)
					end
					Z = E.speed and E.speed.Visible
					if Z then
						o = J()
						F(q, o and string.format("%d", o + 0.5) or h.UNKNOWN)
					end
					f = D >= 1
					if f then
						D = 0
						F(w, string.format("%d ms", p()))
						F(H, u(os.clock() - K))
						F(Q, os.date("%H:%M"))
					end
				end
				h.reset = function()
					A, T, r, S, c, R, G, q, w, H, Q, Y, b, B, g, E, s =
						nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, {}, {}, 0, {}, 0
					local p
					p, v = h.UNKNOWN, nil
					m, k, z, l, D = p, 0, 0, 0, 0
					K = os.clock()
					h.enabled = false
				end
				return h
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/chrome/wordmark"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/connect")
				local O = p("ui/create")
				local u = p("ui/theme")
				local F, f, o, Z =
					p("core/service").get("TextService"),
					{
						WAVE_HEIGHT = 2.6,
						WAVE_SPEED = 2.4,
						WAVE_SPREAD = 0.45,
						GLOW_CORE = 2,
						GLOW_HALO = 5,
						GLOW_WAVE = 0.6,
						CORE_PEAK = 0.3,
						HALO_PEAK = 0.78,
						SHEEN_PERIOD = 5,
						SHEEN_SWEEP = 1.1,
						SHEEN_WIDTH = 2.2,
						SHEEN_REST = 1,
					},
					{}
				local p = ""
				local i = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				local y
				local P, b, I = 22, false, false
				local function h(A, T)
					J.thread(function()
						local J, r = pcall(Instance.new, "GetTextBoundsParams")
						if not J or not r then
							return
						end
						r.Font = T
						r.Size = P
						r.Width = 1000000
						local J, T = #o, 0
						for S = 1, J, 1 do
							r.Text = A:sub(1, S)
							local J, A = pcall(function()
								return F:GetTextBoundsAsync(r)
							end)
							if not J or typeof(A) ~= "Vector2" then
								return
							end
							o[S].x = T
							T = A.X
						end
						b, I = true, false
					end)
				end
				local function J(F, A, T, r, S)
					local c = O.new(
						"TextLabel",
						{
							AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
							AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Text = A,
							TextSize = P,
							TextColor3 = i,
							TextTransparency = S and 1 or 0,
							TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
							ZIndex = F.ZIndex,
							Parent = F,
						}
					)
					if T then
						pcall(function()
							c.FontFace = T
						end)
					end
					return c, (O.new("UIStroke", { Thickness = r, Transparency = 1, Parent = c }))
				end
				f.attach = function(F)
					local A = not F or #o > 0
					if A then
						return false
					end
					y = F
					A = F.Text
					if typeof(A) ~= "string" or A == "" then
						return false
					end
					p = A
					P = F.TextSize
					i = F.TextColor3:Lerp(Color3.new(), 1 - f.SHEEN_REST)
					F.Visible = false
					Z = O.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "Wordmark",
							AnchorPoint = F.AnchorPoint,
							Position = F.Position,
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							ZIndex = F.ZIndex,
							Parent = F.Parent,
						}
					)
					local O, P = F.FontFace, #A
					for T = 1, P, 1 do
						F = A:sub(T, T)
						local P, r = J(Z, F, O, f.GLOW_HALO, true)
						local S, c = J(Z, F, O, f.GLOW_CORE, false)
						o[T] = { label = S, bloom = P, core = c, halo = r, x = 0 }
					end
					h(A, O)
					return true
				end
				f.recolor = function(J)
					local O = not J
					if O then
						local O = y
						if not O then
							return
						end
						J = y.TextColor3
					else
					end
					i = J:Lerp(Color3.new(), 1 - f.SHEEN_REST)
				end
				f.remeasure = function()
					local J = #o == 0 or not Z
					if J then
						return
					end
					J = o[1].label
					if not J then
						return
					end
					b, I = false, false
					h(p, J.FontFace)
				end
				f.onRender = function()
					local p = #o == 0 or not Z or not Z.Parent
					if p then
						return
					end
					p = not I
					if p then
						local J, O = o, 0
						for F, P in ipairs(J) do
							F = P.label.AbsoluteSize.X
							if F <= 0 then
								return
							end
							local J = b
							if not J then
								P.x = O
							end
							O += F
						end
						I = true
					end
					local J, O = os.clock(), u.get()
					local u, F = J % f.SHEEN_PERIOD, -f.SHEEN_WIDTH
					F = if u < f.SHEEN_SWEEP then F + u / f.SHEEN_SWEEP * (#o + f.SHEEN_WIDTH * 2) else F
					p = o
					for P, h in ipairs(p) do
						u = math.sin(J * f.WAVE_SPEED + P * f.WAVE_SPREAD)
						local p = UDim2.fromOffset(h.x, u * f.WAVE_HEIGHT)
						h.label.Position = p
						h.bloom.Position = p
						p = math.max(0, 1 - math.abs(P - F) / f.SHEEN_WIDTH)
						P = math.max((u + 1) * 0.5 * f.GLOW_WAVE, p)
						h.label.TextColor3 = i:Lerp(O, p)
						h.core.Color = O
						h.halo.Color = O
						h.core.Transparency = 1 - P * (1 - f.CORE_PEAK)
						h.halo.Transparency = 1 - P * (1 - f.HALO_PEAK)
					end
				end
				f.reset = function()
					o, Z, y, b, I = {}, nil, nil, false, false
				end
				return f
			end
end)()

				end

						J.x = F
						J.y = f
						p.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(F, f)
					end
				end
				u.placeRingMarked = function(p, J, O, F, f, o)
					if O.thickness ~= o then
						O.thickness = o
						J.Thickness = o
					end
					u.placeMarked(p, O, F, u.CENTERED and f or f - o * 0.5)
				end
				return u
			end
end)()

_registry["ui/cloud/init"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/cloud/anim")
				local O = p("ui/connect")
				local u = p("ui/cloud/data")
				local F = p("core/log")
				local f = p("ui/cloud/source")
				local o = p("core/service")
				local Z = p("ui/skins/spinner")
				local i = p("ui/cloud/browse")
				local y = p("ui/cloud/detail")
				local P = p("ui/cloud/parts")
				local b = p("ui/cloud/state")
				local p
				p = {
					account = nil,
					browse = nil,
					detail = nil,
					build = function(I, h)
						local A = typeof(h) == "table" and h or {}
						P.account = p.account
						if
							not p.watchingAccount
							and typeof(p.account) == "table"
							and typeof(p.account.subscribe) == "function"
						then
							p.watchingAccount = true
							pcall(p.account.subscribe, function()
								pcall(b.notify)
							end)
						end
						if not I then
							return p
						end
						p.browse = i.new(A)
						I:adopt(p.browse, A)
						p.detail = y.new(A)
						I:adopt(p.detail, A)
						p.section = I
						A = o.get("RunService")
						O.signal(A.RenderStepped, function()
							local O = p.section and p.section.main
							if O and O.Visible then
								pcall(Z.step)
							end
						end, "cloud/spin")
						return p
					end,
					RESTORE_TRIES = 4,
					RESTORE_WAIT = 1.5,
					restoreLast = function(O, o)
						local function i(y, P, I)
							if typeof(o) == "function" then
								pcall(o, y, P, I)
							end
						end
						if O then
							i(nil)
							return
						end
						local O = 0
						local function o()
							O += 1
							f.last(function(y, P)
								if P then
									local I = O
									if I < p.RESTORE_TRIES then
										task.delay(p.RESTORE_WAIT, o)
										return
									end
									F.warn(
										"cloud",
										"restore: desisti depois de %d tentativas: %s",
										O,
										tostring(P)
									)
									return i(nil, P)
								end
								if typeof(y) ~= "table" or not y.id then
									return i(nil, nil, true)
								end
								f.apply(y, function(O, P)
									if not O then
										F.warn(
											"cloud",
											"restore: %q nao abriu: %s",
											tostring(y.name),
											tostring(P)
										)
										return i(nil, P)
									end
									u.rememberLast(y)
									i(tostring(y.name))
								end)
							end)
						end
						o()
					end,
					apply = function(O, F)
						f.apply(O, function(o, i)
							if o then
								u.rememberLast(O)
							end
							if typeof(F) == "function" then
								F(o, i)
							end
						end)
					end,
					duplicate = function(O, F)
						local o = u.freeName(tostring(O.name or "config"))
						f.duplicate(O, o, function(O, o)
							if O then
								u.reload(u.PRIVATE)
							end
							if typeof(F) == "function" then
								F(O, o)
							end
						end)
					end,
					publish = function(O, F)
						f.publish(O, function(O, f, o)
							if O then
								if o and o.created == false then
									if o.deduped ~= nil then
										o.minted = o.deduped ~= true
									else
										local i = u.get(o.id)
										o.minted = i == nil
											or o.version == nil
											or tostring(i.version) ~= tostring(o.version)
									end
									if o.minted then
										u.refreshDetail(o.id)
									end
								else
									u.reload(u.PRIVATE)
								end
							end
							if typeof(F) == "function" then
								F(O, f, o)
							end
						end)
					end,
					reset = function()
						b.reset()
						u.reset()
						J.reset()
						pcall(Z.reset)
						p.browse = nil
						p.detail = nil
						p.section = nil
					end,
				}
				return p
			end
end)()

			return s2
		end,
	}

	return r4
end

_registry["ui/cloud/state"] = (function()
return function(r16)
	local r1 = r16("ui/cloud/data")
	local r3 = r16("core/log")
	local r4 = { scope = r1.PRIVATE, LIBRARY = "library", CONFIG = "config" }
	r4.step = r4.LIBRARY
	r4.selected = nil
	r4.query = ""
	local r6 = {}

	r4.subscribe = function(s32, s33)
		if typeof(s32) == "function" then
			table.insert(r6, { run = s32, name = s33 or "?" })
		end

		return s32
	end

	r4.notify = function()
		for _, s4 in ipairs(r6) do
			local s6, s7 = pcall(s4.run)

			if not s6 then
				r3.warn("cloud", "card %q falhou ao repintar: %s", s4.name, tostring(s7))
			end
		end
	end

	r4.entry = function()
		local s7 = r1.list(r4.scope, r4.query)

		if r4.selected then
			for _, s4 in ipairs(s7) do
				if s4.id == r4.selected then
					return s4
				end
			end
		end

		return s7[1]
	end

	local r8 = function(s29)
		if r4.scope == s29 then
			return
		end
		r4.scope = s29
		r4.selected = nil
		r4.query = ""
		r1.setQuery("")
		r4.notify()
	end

	r4.setScope = r8

	r4.open = function(s37)
		if r4.selected == s37 and r4.step == r4.CONFIG then
			return
		end
		r4.selected = s37
		r4.step = r4.CONFIG
		r4.notify()
	end

	r4.back = function()
		if r4.step == r4.LIBRARY then
			return
		end
		r4.step = r4.LIBRARY
		r4.notify()
	end

	r4.setQuery = function(s24)
		s24 = typeof(s24) == "string" and s24 or ""
		if r4.query == s24 then
			return
		end
		r4.query = s24
		r4.notify()
	end

	r1.onChange(function()
		r4.notify()
	end)

	r4.reset = function()
		r6 = {}
		r4.scope = r1.PRIVATE
		r4.step = r4.LIBRARY
		r4.selected = nil
		r4.query = ""
	end

	return r4
end
end)()

function Runtime:oh(values) return table.unpack(values, 1, values.n) end
function Runtime:Wh(destination, offset, ...)
    local values = table.pack(...)
    table.move(values, 1, values.n, offset + 1, destination)
end
function Runtime:Lh(destination, offset, values)
    table.move(values, 1, values.n, offset + 1, destination)
    destination.n = offset + values.n
end

					local J = T ~= nil and T.popup.open and T.popup.anchor == p

								or J.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
							then
								Z.cancel(f.gearPress)
								f.gearPress = Z.to(A, Z.RELEASE, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(h, h) })
							end
							if J.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and not u.open then
								F(false)
							end
						end, "gear/end")
						f.gear = A
						f.popup = u
						return u
					end,
					reserveLabel = function(J)
						if not J.title then
							return
						end
						local O = J:slotCount() * o.subStep + o.controlX
						if O <= o.controlX then
							return
						end
						if J.hit then
							local u = J.hit.Size
							J.hit.Size = UDim2.new(u.X.Scale, -O, u.Y.Scale, u.Y.Offset)
							return
						end
						local u = J.title.Size
						J.title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(J.title.Position.X.Offset + O), u.Y.Scale, u.Y.Offset)
					end,
				}
				return p
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/components/box"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J, O = p("ui/components/base"), p("ui/skin")
				local u = p("ui/connect")
				local F = p("ui/create")
				local f = p("ui/metrics")
				local o = p("ui/motion")
				local Z = p("ui/popup")
				local i = p("ui/theme")
				local y = p("ui/font")
				local P, b, I, h =
					p("ui/zindex"),
					{ LABEL_H = 18, LABEL_GAP = 4, FIELD_H = 20, ROW = 16, ROW_PAD = 4 },
					setmetatable,
					{ __index = J }
				local p = I({}, h)
				p.__index = p
				b.new = function(J)
					J = typeof(J) == "table" and J or {}
					local I = tostring(J.text or "box")
					return setmetatable(
						{
							type = "box",
							text = I,
							tip = J.tip and tostring(J.tip) or nil,
							flag = tostring(J.flag or I),
							value = tostring(J.value or ""),
							placeholder = tostring(J.placeholder or ""),
							lines = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(J.lines) or 1)),
							callback = typeof(J.callback) == "function" and J.callback or nil,
							subcount = 0,
							hasInit = false,
							adornY = b.LABEL_H // 2,
						},
						p
					)
				end
				b.Box = p
				p.Get = function(J)
					return J.value
				end
				p.Set = function(J, I, h)
					J.value = tostring(I or "")
					if J.hasInit and not J.editing then
						J.field.Text = J.value
					end
					if J.onChanged then
						J.onChanged(J.flag, J.value)
					end
					if not h and J.callback then
						pcall(J.callback, J.value)
					end
					return J
				end
				p.Init = function(J, I)
					if J.hasInit or not I then
						return J
					end
					J.hasInit = true
					local h, A = J.zbase or P.WIDGET, J.lines > 1
					local P = A and J.lines * b.ROW + b.ROW_PAD * 2 or b.FIELD_H - 2
					local T = A and P or b.FIELD_H
					J.main = F.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "Box",
							LayoutOrder = J.position or 0,
							Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, b.LABEL_H + b.LABEL_GAP + T),
							AutomaticSize = A and Enum.AutomaticSize.Y or Enum.AutomaticSize.None,
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							ZIndex = h,
							Parent = I,
						}
					)
					J.title = F.new(
						"TextLabel",
						{
							Name = "Title",
							Position = UDim2.fromOffset(f.controlX, 0),
							Size = UDim2.new(1, -f.controlX, 0, b.LABEL_H),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Text = J.text,
							TextSize = f.textSize,
							skin = "body",
							FontFace = y.face(),
							TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
							ZIndex = h + 1,
							Parent = J.main,
						}
					)
					J.field = F.new(
						"TextBox",
						{
							Name = "Field",
							Position = UDim2.fromOffset(f.controlX, b.LABEL_H + b.LABEL_GAP),
							Size = UDim2.new(1, -f.controlX * 2, 0, P),
							AutomaticSize = A and Enum.AutomaticSize.Y or Enum.AutomaticSize.None,
							skin = { BackgroundColor3 = "field", TextColor3 = "body", PlaceholderColor3 = "hint" },
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							Text = J.value,
							PlaceholderText = J.placeholder,
							TextSize = f.textSize - 2,
							FontFace = y.face(),
							TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
							ClearTextOnFocus = false,
							MultiLine = A,
							TextWrapped = A,
							TextYAlignment = A and Enum.TextYAlignment.Top or Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
							ClipsDescendants = true,
							TextTruncate = A and Enum.TextTruncate.None or Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
							ZIndex = h + 1,
							Parent = J.main,
						}
					)
					F.new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, f.corner - 1), Parent = J.field })
					J.stroke = F.new(
						"UIStroke",
						{
							ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
							Thickness = f.stroke,
							skin = "stroke",
							Parent = J.field,
						}
					)
					F.new(
						"UIPadding",
						{
							PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 7),
							PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 7),
							PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, A and b.ROW_PAD or 0),
							PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, A and b.ROW_PAD or 0),
							Parent = J.field,
						}
					)
					J:wire()
					J:adorn()
					J:reserveLabel()
					return J
				end
				p.wire = function(p)
					u.signal(p.field.InputBegan, function(J)
						if J.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
							Z.hold()
						end
					end, "box/down")
					u.signal(p.field.Focused, function()
						Z.hold()
						p.editing = true
						local J, F, f, Z = o.to, p.stroke, o.HOVER_IN, {}
						Z.Color = i.get()
						J(F, f, Z)
					end, "box/focus")
					u.signal(p.field.FocusLost, function()
						p.editing = false
						local J, F, f, Z = o.to, p.stroke, o.HOVER_OUT, {}
						Z.Color = O.get("stroke")
						J(F, f, Z)
						if p.field.Text ~= p.value then
							p:Set(p.field.Text)
						end
					end, "box/blur")
					u.signal(p.field.MouseEnter, function()
						if p.editing then
							return
						end
						local J, F, f, Z = o.to, p.stroke, o.HOVER_IN, {}
						Z.Color = O.get("edge")
						J(F, f, Z)
					end, "box/enter")
					u.signal(p.field.MouseLeave, function()
						if p.editing then
							return
						end
						local J, u, F, f = o.to, p.stroke, o.HOVER_OUT, {}
						f.Color = O.get("stroke")
						J(u, F, f)
					end, "box/leave")
				end
				return b
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/components/button"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J, O = p("ui/components/base"), p("ui/skin")
				local u = p("ui/connect")
				local F = p("ui/create")
				local f = p("ui/icon")
				local o = p("ui/metrics")
				local Z = p("ui/motion")
				local i = p("ui/popup")
				local y = p("ui/theme")
				local P = p("ui/font")
				local b = p("ui/zindex")
				local p, I, h =
					{
						HEIGHT = 34,
						BAR_H = 26,
						PAD = 4,
						INSET_X = 10,
						PRESS_INSET = 2,
						BG = "control",
						BG_HOVER = "hover",
						GRADIENT_TOP = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180),
						GRADIENT_BOTTOM = Color3.fromRGB(253, 253, 253),
					},
					setmetatable,
					{ __index = J }
				local J = I({}, h)
				J.__index = J
				p.new = function(I)
					I = typeof(I) == "table" and I or {}
					return setmetatable(
						{
							type = "button",
							text = tostring(I.text or "button"),
							tip = I.tip and tostring(I.tip) or nil,
							icon = I.icon and tostring(I.icon) or nil,
							tone = I.tone and tostring(I.tone) or nil,
							callback = typeof(I.callback) == "function" and I.callback or nil,
							subcount = 0,
							hasInit = false,
							adornY = p.HEIGHT - p.PAD - p.BAR_H // 2,
						},
						J
					)
				end
				p.Button = J
				J.Get = function(I)
					return I.text
				end
				J.Set = function(I, h)
					I.text = tostring(h or "")
					if I.hasInit then
						if I.label then
							I.label.Text = I.text
						else
							I.bar.Text = I.text
						end
					end
					return I
				end
				J.Fire = function(I)
					if I.callback then
						pcall(I.callback)
					end
					return I
				end
				J.Init = function(I, h)
					if I.hasInit or not h then

					I.hasInit = true
					local A = I.zbase or b.WIDGET

						"Frame",
