				end
				return b
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/fade"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local p, J, O = {}, setmetatable, { __mode = "k" }
				local u = J({}, O)
				local function J(O, F)
					local f = u[O]
					return f and f[F] or nil
				end
				local function O(F, f, o)
					local Z = u[F]
					if not Z then
						Z = {}
						u[F] = Z
					else
					end
					Z[f] = o
				end
				local function F(f, o)
					local Z = u[f]
					if Z then
						Z[o] = nil
					end
				end
				local u, f =
					{ TextLabel = true, TextButton = true, TextBox = true },
					{ ImageLabel = true, ImageButton = true, ViewportFrame = true }
				p.record = function(o, Z, i)
					local y = J(Z, i)
					if y then
						if y < 1 then
							table.insert(o, { object = Z, property = i, original = y })
						end
						return
					end
					local J, y = pcall(function()
						return Z[i]
					end)
					if J and typeof(y) == "number" and y < 1 then
						table.insert(o, { object = Z, property = i, original = y })
					end
				end
				p.snapshot = function(J)
					local o = {}
					if not J then
						return o
					end
					local Z = J:GetDescendants()
					table.insert(Z, J)
					for i, i in ipairs(Z) do
						if i:IsA("UIStroke") then
							p.record(o, i, "Transparency")
						elseif i:IsA("GuiObject") then
							p.record(o, i, "BackgroundTransparency")
							J = i.ClassName
							if u[J] then
								p.record(o, i, "TextTransparency")
							end
							if f[J] then
								p.record(o, i, "ImageTransparency")
							end
							if J == "ScrollingFrame" then
								p.record(o, i, "ScrollBarImageTransparency")
							end
						end
					end
					return o
				end
				p.apply = function(J, u)
					local f = u <= 0
					for o, o in ipairs(J) do
						o.object[o.property] = o.original + (1 - o.original) * u
						if f then
							F(o.object, o.property)
						else
							O(o.object, o.property, o.original)
						end
					end
				end
				return p
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/font"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/font_art")
				local O = p("ui/customfont")
				local u, F, f, o =
					p("ui/font_tiny5_art"),
					{
						families = {
							Arimo = true,
							SourceSansPro = true,
							Gotham = true,
							Inconsolata = true,
							Merriweather = true,
							Nunito = true,
							Ubuntu = true,
						},
						family = "Arimo",
					}
				F.MONO = "Inconsolata"
				F.PIXEL_STEP = 8
				local p = {}
				F.face = function(Z)
					local i = (f or F.family) .. (Z and "/b" or "/r")
					local y = p[i]
					if y then
						local P = p
						return P[i]
					end
					local P = Z and Enum.FontWeight.Bold or Enum.FontWeight.Regular
					Z, y = pcall(function()
						local b = f
						if b then
							local b, I = Font.new, f
							return b(I, P, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
						end
						return Font.fromName(F.family, P, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
					end)
					if not Z or not y then
						Z, y = pcall(function()
							return Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.SourceSans)
						end)
					else
					end
					if not Z or not y then
						return nil
					end
					p[i] = y
					return y
				end
				F.setFamily = function(Z)
					if not F.families[Z] then
						return false
					end
					F.family = Z
					p = {}
					return true
				end
				local function Z(i)
					local y = {}
					for P, b in pairs(i.faces or {}) do
						y[P] = {}
						for i, I in pairs(b) do
							y[P][i] = { b64 = I }
						end
					end
					return y
				end
				F.loadCustom = function(i)
					local y = Z(J)
					if typeof(i) == "table" then
						for P, b in pairs(i) do
							b = if typeof(b) == "string" then { normal = b } else b
							if typeof(b) == "table" then
								y[P] = y[P] or {}
								for I, h in pairs(b) do
									if not y[P][I] then
										y[P][I] = h
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
					i = J.family or "Menu"
					if not O.load(y, i) then
						return false
					end
					f = O.uris[i]
					i = f
					if not i then
						return false
					end
					p = {}
					return true
				end
				F.loadPixel = function()
					local J = o
					if J then
						return true
					end
					J = u.family or "Pixel"
					if not O.load(Z(u), J) then
						return false
					end
					o = O.uris[J]
					J = o
					return J ~= nil
				end
				F.pixel = function()
					local J = o
					if not J then
						return F.face(true)
					end
					J = o .. "/px"
					local u = p[J]
					if u then
						local u = p
						return u[J]
					end
					local u, f = pcall(function()
						local Z, i = Font.new, o
						return Z(i, Enum.FontWeight.Regular, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
					end)
					if not u or not f then
						return F.face(true)
					end
					p[J] = f
					return f
				end
				F.mono = function()
					local J = F.MONO .. "/mono"
					local u = p[J]
					if u then
						local u = p
						return u[J]
					end
					local u, f = pcall(function()
						return Font.fromName(F.MONO, Enum.FontWeight.Regular, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
					end)
					if not u or not f then
						return F.face()
					end
					p[J] = f
					return f
				end
				F.refresh = function(p)
					if not p then
						return 0
					end
					local J = F.face()
					if not J then
						return 0
					end
					local u = 0
					for f, f in ipairs(p:GetDescendants()) do
						u = if f:IsA("TextLabel")
								or f:IsA("TextButton")
								or f:IsA("TextBox")
							then if pcall(function()
									f.FontFace = J
								end)
								then u + 1
								else u
							else u
					end
					return u
				end
				F.report = function()
					if #O.report == 0 then
						return nil
					end
					return table.concat(O.report, " ")
				end
				return F
			end
end)()

_registry["ui/icon"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/icon_art")
				local O = p("services/png")
				local u, F, f = p("ui/raster"), {}, {}
				local function p(o, Z)
					local i, y, P = buffer.create(Z * 4), 1, 0
					while y < #o and P < Z do
						local b, I = string.byte(o, y), string.byte(o, y + 1)
						y += 2
						for o = 1, I, 1 do
							if P >= Z then
								break
							end
							o = P * 4
							buffer.writeu8(i, o, 255)
							buffer.writeu8(i, o + 1, 255)
							buffer.writeu8(i, o + 2, 255)
							buffer.writeu8(i, o + 3, b)
							P += 1
						end
					end
					return i
				end
				F.fromAlpha = function(o, Z, i)
					if typeof(o) ~= "string" or #o == 0 then
						return nil
					end
					i = i or Z
					return u.image(p(o, Z * i), Z, i, "icon")
				end
				F.get = function(u)
					local o = f[u]
					if o ~= nil then
						return o or nil
					end
					o = J.glyphs and J.glyphs[u]
					if not o then
						f[u] = false
						return nil
					end
					local Z = F.fromAlpha(o.data, o.w, o.h)
					f[u] = Z or false
					return Z
				end
				local u = {}
				F.bytes = function(f)
					local o = u[f]
					if o ~= nil then
						return o or nil
					end
					local o = J.glyphs and J.glyphs[f]
					if not o then
						u[f] = false
						return nil
					end
					local Z, i = pcall(function()
						return O.encode(o.w, o.h, buffer.tostring(p(o.data, o.w * o.h)))
					end)
					u[f] = Z and i or false
					return u[f] or nil
				end
				F.dimensions = function(p)
					local O = J.glyphs and J.glyphs[p]
					if not O then
						return nil
					end
					return O.w, O.h
				end
				F.GLYPH = 16
				F.size = function()
					return F.GLYPH
				end
				F.shadowSlice = function()
					local p = J.shadow or {}
					return p.pad or 12, p.slice or 20
				end
				return F
			end
end)()

_registry["ui/inputguard"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local p, J, O = {}, {}, false
				p.add = function(u)
					if typeof(u) ~= "table" then
						return
					end
					table.insert(J, u)
					local F = O and typeof(u.block) == "function"
					if F then
						pcall(u.block)
					end
				end
				p.arm = function()
					local u = O
					if u then
						return
					end
					O = true
					for u, u in ipairs(J) do
						if typeof(u.block) == "function" then
							pcall(u.block)
						end
					end
				end
				p.disarm = function()
					local u = O
					if not u then
						return
					end
					O = false
					for u, u in ipairs(J) do
						if typeof(u.release) == "function" then
							pcall(u.release)
						end
					end
				end
				p.isArmed = function()
					local J = O
					return J
				end
				return p
			end
end)()

					return h

						return "None"

					if c then

					if not table.find(e, c) then
						return
					end
					S.mode = c
					if c == "always" and S.option and S.option.Set then
						S.option:Set(true, R)
					end
					S:repaint()
				end
				r.setKey = function(S, c)
					S.key = c
					S:repaint()
				end
				r.repaint = function(S)
					if not S.icon then
						return
					end
					local c, R, e, G, q = S.mode == "always" or S.key ~= nil, o.to, S.icon, o.HOVER_IN, {}
					q.ImageColor3 = c and i.get() or O.get(I.IDLE_ROLE)
					R(e, G, q)
				end
				r.fire = function(S, c)
					local R = S.option
					if not R or not R.Set then
						return
					end
					if S.mode == "hold" then
						R:Set(c)
					elseif S.mode == "toggle" and c then
						R:Set(not R:Get())
					end
				end
				local function S(c, R)
					if not c.key then
						return false
					end
					return R.KeyCode == c.key or R.UserInputType == c.key
				end
				local c = b.get("TextChatService")
				I.typing = function()
					local b, R = pcall(function()
						return p:GetFocusedTextBox()
					end)
					if b and R then
						return true
					end
					if not c then
						return false
					end
					R, b = pcall(function()
						local e = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("ChatInputBarConfiguration")
						return e ~= nil and e.IsFocused == true
					end)
					return R and b == true
				end
				local function b()
					local c = T
					if c then
						return
					end
					T = true
					J.signal(p.InputBegan, function(T, c)
						c = A
						if c then
							A:capture(T)
							return
						end
						if I.typing() then
							return
						end
						for c, c in ipairs(h) do
							if S(c, T) then
								c:fire(true)
							end
						end
					end, "keybind/down")
					J.signal(p.InputEnded, function(p)
						local T = A
						if T then
							return
						end
						for T, T in ipairs(h) do
							if S(T, p) then
								T:fire(false)
							end
						end
					end, "keybind/up")
				end
				I.capture = function(p)
					if typeof(p) ~= "function" then
						return
					end
					A = {
						capture = function(T, S)
							local c, R = S.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard
							if c then
								T = S.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape
								if T then
									A = nil
									p(nil)
									return
								end
								R = S.KeyCode
							else
								if
									S.UserInputType.Name:match("^MouseButton")
									and S.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
								then
									R = S.UserInputType
								else
									return
								end
							end
							A = nil
							p(R)
						end,
					}
					b()
					return I
				end
				r.capture = function(p, T)
					local S
					if T.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
						S = if T.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Escape then T.KeyCode else S
					else
						if
							T.UserInputType.Name:match("^MouseButton")
							and T.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
						then
							S = T.UserInputType
						else
							return
						end
					end
					A = nil
					p:setKey(S)
					if p.onCapture then
						p.onCapture()
					end
				end
				local p = 22
				local function T(S, c, R, e)
					local G = u.new(
						"TextButton",
						{
							Name = "Row",
							LayoutOrder = c,
							Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, p),
							BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							AutoButtonColor = false,
							Text = "",
							ZIndex = S.ZIndex,
							Parent = S,
						}
					)
					local p, c = u.new, {}
					c.CornerRadius, c.Parent = UDim.new(0, f.corner), G
					p("UICorner", c)
					local p = u.new(
						"TextLabel",
						{
							Name = "Label",
							Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0),
							Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Text = R,
							TextSize = f.textSize - 1,
							skin = I.IDLE_ROLE,
							FontFace = y.face(),
							TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
							ZIndex = S.ZIndex + 1,
							Parent = G,
						}
					)
					J.signal(G.InputBegan, function(y)
						if y.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
							Z.hold()
							e()
						elseif y.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
							if Z.blocks(G) then
								return
							end
							o.to(G, o.HOVER_IN, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.92 })
						end
					end, "keybind/row")
					J.signal(G.InputEnded, function(y)
						if y.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
							o.to(G, o.HOVER_OUT, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
						end
					end, "keybind/rowout")
					return p,
						function(y)
							local S, c, R = o.to, o.HOVER_IN, {}
							R.TextColor3 = y and i.get() or O.get(I.IDLE_ROLE)
							S(p, c, R)
						end
				end
				local function p(O, o)
					return (
						u.new(
							"Frame",
							{
								Name = "Divider",
								LayoutOrder = o,
								Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
								skin = "border",
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								ZIndex = O.ZIndex,
								Parent = O,
							}
						)
					)
				end
				r.buildPanel = function(O)
					if O.popup then
						return O.popup
					end
					local o = Z.new(O.anchor)
					if not o then
						return nil
					end
					O.popup = o
					local Z = {}
					local function y()
						O.keyRow.Text = string.format("key: %s", I.label(O.key))
						for S, c in pairs(Z) do
							c(S == O.mode)
						end
					end
					O.keyRow = T(o.content, 0, "", function()
						local S = A
						if S then
							A = nil
						end
						A = O
						O.keyRow.Text = "press any key..."
						O.keyRow.TextColor3 = i.get()
					end)
					O.onCapture = y
					p(o.content, 1)
					for p, i in ipairs(O.modes or I.MODES) do
						local S, S = T(o.content, p + 1, i, function()
							O:setMode(i)
							y()
						end)
						Z[i] = S
					end
					o.onClose = function()
						local p = A == O
						if p then
							A = nil
							y()
						end
						if O.onPopupClose then
							O.onPopupClose()
						end
					end
					y()
					return o
				end
				I.attach = function(p, O, o, Z, i)
					i = typeof(i) == "table" and i or {}
					local y, A, T =
						F.size(),
						(p.zbase or P.WIDGET) + 3,
						setmetatable(
							{
								option = p,
								mode = i.mode or "toggle",
								modes = typeof(i.modes) == "table" and i.modes or nil,
								key = i.key,
							},
							r
						)
					local i = u.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "Keybind",
							AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
							Position = UDim2.new(1, -Z - f.controlX, 0, p.adornY or f.row // 2),
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(y, y),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							ZIndex = A,
							Parent = o,
						}
					)
					T.anchor = i
					T.icon = u.new(
						"ImageLabel",
						{
							Name = "Hint",
							Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							skin = I.IDLE_ROLE,
							ImageContent = F.get("mouseRight"),
							ZIndex = A,
							Parent = i,
						}
					)
					J.signal(O.InputBegan, function(p)
						if p.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
							local p = T:buildPanel()
							if p then
								p:Toggle()
							end
						end
					end, "keybind/open")
					table.insert(h, T)
					b()
					T:repaint()
					return T
				end
				return I
			end
end)()

						if T then
							c += R

							if p then
								Y.onRender(c)

									N.onRender()

				d.selectTab = function(p, T)
					if not p then
						return
					end
					d.currentTab = p
					for r, S in ipairs(d.tabs) do
						r = S == p
						S:paint()
						for c, c in ipairs(S.columns) do
							if c.main then
								c.main.Visible = r
							end
						end
					end
					k.showFor(p)
					local r = {}
					for S, S in ipairs(p.columns) do
						if S.main then
							table.insert(r, S.main)
						end
					end
					local S = not T
					if S then
						g.play(r, true)
					end
					d.placeHighlight(p, T)
					d.fitWindow(p, S)
					for T, T in ipairs(d.tabWatchers) do
						pcall(T, p)
					end
				end

				d.sizeTab = function(p, T, r)
					if not p then
						return d
					end
					p.width = T

						d.fitWindow(p, false)
					end

				d.tabSize = function(p)
					local T = d.geometry
					if p and p.width then
						return UDim2.fromOffset(p.width, p.height or T.windowHeight)
					end
					return UDim2.fromOffset(d.windowWidth(), T.windowHeight)
				end
				local function p(T)
					if not d.base or d.base.AbsoluteSize.X <= 0 then
						return nil
					end
					local r, S = d.base.AbsoluteSize, d.main.Position
					local c, R = S.X.Offset, S.Y.Offset
					local S, e =
						math.clamp(c, 0, math.max(0, r.X - T.X.Offset)),
						math.clamp(R, 0, math.max(0, r.Y - T.Y.Offset))
					if S == c and e == R then
						return nil
					end
					return UDim2.fromOffset(S, e)
				end
				d.fitWindow = function(T, r)
					if not d.main then
						return
					end
					local S = d.tabSize(T)
					if d.main.Size == S then
						return
					end
					T = p(S)
					if not r then
						d.main.Size = S
						if T then
							d.main.Position = T
						end
						return
					end
					H.cancel(d.resizeTween)
					H.cancel(d.repositionTween)
					d.resizeTween = H.to(d.main, d.WINDOW_RESIZE, { Size = S })
					if T then
						d.repositionTween = H.to(d.main, d.WINDOW_RESIZE, { Position = T })
					end
				end
				d.TAB_SLIDE = TweenInfo.new(0.26, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
				d.placeHighlight = function(p, T)
					if not d.tabHighlight or not d.beamHost then
						return
					end
					if not p or not p.button then
						return
					end
					local r = p.button.AbsoluteSize.X
					if r <= 0 then
						return
					end
					local S = p.button.AbsolutePosition.X - d.beamHost.AbsolutePosition.X
					local p, c = UDim2.new(0, S, 1, 0), UDim2.fromOffset(r, 1)
					H.cancel(d.highlightTween)
					if T then
						d.tabHighlight.Position = p
						d.tabHighlight.Size = c
						return
					end
					d.highlightTween = H.to(d.tabHighlight, d.TAB_SLIDE, { Position = p, Size = c })
				end
				d.SetBackdrop = function(p)
					d.features.backdrop = p and true or false
					if not d.main then
						return d
					end
					if not d.features.backdrop then
						d.main.ImageTransparency = 1
						return d
					end
					p = I.content()
					if not p then
						return d
					end
					local T = I.tileSize()
					d.main.ImageContent = p
					d.main.TileSize = UDim2.fromOffset(T, T)
					d.main.ImageTransparency = d.geometry.backdropFade
					l.follow(d.main, "ImageColor3")

				end
				local function p(T)
					local r, S = tostring(T.text or ""), T.host
					T = S and typeof(S.title) == "string" and S.title or nil
					if not T or T == "" then
						return r
					end
					if r == "" or r == "enabled" or r == T then
						return T
					end
					return T .. " " .. r
				end
				d.collectBinds = function()
					local T = {}
					for r, S in ipairs(i.bindings()) do
						r = S.option
						if
							r
							and d.options[r.flag] == r
							and r.bind == S
							and (S.key ~= nil or S.mode == "always")
						then
							local c = S.mode == "always"
							if not c and typeof(r.Get) == "function" then
								local R, e = pcall(r.Get, r)
								c = R and e == true
							else
							end
							table.insert(T, { key = i.label(S.key), name = p(r), mode = S.mode, active = c })
						end
					end
					table.sort(T, function(p, i)
						return tostring(p.name) < tostring(i.name)
					end)
					return T
				end

				end
				d.SetAurora = function(p)
					d.features.aurora = p and true or false
					b.setEnabled(d.features.aurora)
					return d
				end
				d.SetBubbles = function(p)
					d.features.bubbles = p and true or false
					h.setEnabled(d.features.bubbles)
					return d
				end
				d.SetRainbow = function(p)
					d.features.rainbow = p and true or false
					Y.setEnabled(d.features.rainbow)
					return d
				end
				local p = { divider = true }
				local function i(T, r)
					return tostring(T or ""):lower():find(r, 1, true) ~= nil
				end
				local function T(r, S)
					for c, R in ipairs(d.tabs) do
						c = r and (S[R] or 0) == 0 and d.SEARCH_DIM or 0
						if R.label then
							H.to(R.label, H.STATE, { TextTransparency = c })
						end
						if R.glyph then
							H.to(R.glyph, H.STATE, { ImageTransparency = c })
						end
					end
				end
				d.SEARCH_DIM = 0.65
				d.filterTab = function(r, S, c)
					local R = 0
					for e, G in ipairs(r.columns) do
						for r, q in ipairs(G.sections) do
							r, e = c and i(q.title, S), 0
							for G, w in ipairs(q.options) do
								G = if c then r or not p[w.type] and i(w.text, S) else true
								if w.main then
									w.main.Visible = G
								end
								e = if G then e + 1 else e
							end
							if q.main then
								q.main.Visible = not c or e > 0
							end
							R = if c then R + e else R
						end
					end
					return R
				end
				d.Search = function(p)
					p = tostring(p or ""):lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
					d.query = p
					local i, r, S = p ~= "", {}
					for c, R in ipairs(d.tabs) do
						c = d.filterTab(R, p, i)
						r[R] = c
						S = if i and c > 0 and not S then R else S
					end
					T(i, r)
					if i and S and (r[d.currentTab] or 0) == 0 then
						d.selectTab(S)
					end
					if not i then
						k.reapply()
					end
					return d
				end
				d.keybinds = { toggle = Enum.KeyCode.Insert, unload = Enum.KeyCode.End }
				local p = d.keybinds.toggle
				d.onToggleKey = nil
				d.SetToggleKey = function(i)
					i = if typeof(i) ~= "EnumItem" then p else i
					d.keybinds.toggle = i
					if d.onToggleKey then
						d.onToggleKey(i)
					end
					return i
				end
				d.onUnloadRequest = function()
					if not j.isOpen() then
						return j.confirm(string.format("unload %s?", tostring(d.title)))
					end
					return false
				end
				d.SetOpen = function(p)
					d.open = p and true or false
					if d.main then
						d.main.Modal = d.open
						if d.open then
							o.arm()
						else
							o.disarm()
						end
						if d.features.reveal then
							E.play(d.main, d.open)
						else
							d.main.Visible = d.open
						end
					end
					u.setVisible(d.open)
					if not d.open then
						pcall(Q.closeAll)
						C.dismiss()
					end
				end
				d.Close = function()
					d.SetOpen(not d.open)
				end
				d.Unload = function()
					E.stop()
					o.disarm()
					u.restore()
					Z()
					O.disconnectAll()
					f.destroyAll()
					b.reset()
					I.reset()
					h.reset()
					y.reset()
					V.reset()
					A.reset()
					D.reset()
					m.reset()
					j.reset()
					N.reset()
					k.reset()
					g.reset()
					P.reset()
					J.reset()
					Y.reset()
					F.reset()
					d.tabs = {}
					d.options = {}
					d.flags = {}
					d.hasInit = false
					d.base = nil
					d.menu = nil
					d.world = nil
					d.main = nil
					d.brand = nil
					d.tabRow = nil
					d.columnHolder = nil
					d.rule = nil
					d.beamHost = nil
					d.tabHighlight = nil
					d.headerShadow = nil
					s.frame = nil
				end
				d.repaintOptions = function()
					for p, p in pairs(d.options) do
						if typeof(p.repaint) == "function" then
							pcall(p.repaint, p)
						end
						if typeof(p.colors) == "table" then
							for J, J in ipairs(p.colors) do
								if typeof(J.repaint) == "function" then
									pcall(J.repaint, J)
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
				d.refreshFont = function()
					if d.features.wordmark then
						N.remeasure()
					end
				end
				d.Cursor = u
				d.Theme = l
				d.Typeface = a
				d.Z = W
				return d
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/line"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/create")
				local O = p("ui/zindex")
				return {
					new = function(p, u)
						return J.new(
							"Frame",
							{
								Name = "Line",
								AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								Visible = false,
								ZIndex = u or O.HUD,
								Parent = p,
							}
						)
					end,
					place = function(p, J, O, u)
						local F = O - J
						local f = F.Magnitude
						p.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(f, 1), math.max(u or 1, 1))
						p.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((J.X + O.X) * 0.5, (J.Y + O.Y) * 0.5)
						p.Rotation = f > 0 and math.deg(math.atan2(F.Y, F.X)) or 0
					end,
					placeMarked = function(p, J, O, u, F)
						local f = u - O
						local o = f.Magnitude
						local Z, i = math.max(o, 1), math.max(F or 1, 1)
						if J.width ~= Z or J.height ~= i then
							J.width = Z
							J.height = i
							p.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Z, i)
						end
						i, Z = (O.X + u.X) * 0.5, (O.Y + u.Y) * 0.5
						if J.x ~= i or J.y ~= Z then
							J.x = i
							J.y = Z
							p.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(i, Z)
						end
						Z = o > 0 and math.deg(math.atan2(f.Y, f.X)) or 0
						if J.rotation ~= Z then
							J.rotation = Z
							p.Rotation = Z
						end
					end,
				}
			end
end)()

_registry["ui/motion"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("core/service").get("TweenService")
				local p = {
					enabled = true,
					HOVER_IN = TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
					HOVER_OUT = TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
					PRESS = TweenInfo.new(0.07, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
					RELEASE = TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
					STATE = TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				}
				local function O(u, F)
					for f, o in pairs(F) do
						pcall(function()
							u[f] = o
						end)
					end
				end
				p.to = function(u, F, f)
					if not u then
						return nil
					end
					if not p.enabled then
						O(u, f)
						return nil
					end
					local o, Z = pcall(function()
						return J:Create(u, F, f)
					end)
					if not o or not Z then
						O(u, f)
						return nil
					end
					if not pcall(function()
						Z:Play()
					end) then
						O(u, f)
						return nil
					end
					return Z
				end
				p.cancel = function(J)
					if J then
						pcall(function()
							J:Cancel()
						end)
					end
				end
				return p
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/mount"] = (function()

local J = nil
local O = nil
local u = gethui

return function(p)
				local F = p("ui/create")
				local f, o, Z, i =
					p("core/service"),
					{},
					{
						"Player",
						"Client",
						"Core",
						"Screen",
						"Menu",
						"Hud",
						"Chat",
						"Notification",
						"Prompt",
						"Session",
						"Interface",
						"Overlay",
					},
					{
						"Gui",
						"Overlay",
						"Layer",
						"Container",
						"Handler",
						"Manager",
						"Controller",
						"Frame",
						"Host",
						"Root",
					}
				local function p()
					local y = Random.new()
					local P, b = Z[y:NextInteger(1, #Z)], i[y:NextInteger(1, #i)]
					return P .. (if P == b then "Layer" else b)
				end
				o.GUI_NAME = p()
				local function Z(i)
					local y = (p())
					for P = 1, 12, 1 do
						P = false
						for b, b in ipairs(i) do
							if b == y then
								P = true
								break
							end
						end
						if not P then
							break
						end
						y = (p())
					end
					return y
				end
				o.MENU_NAME = Z({ o.GUI_NAME })
				o.CHROME_NAME = Z({ o.GUI_NAME, o.MENU_NAME })
				o.WORLD_NAME = Z({ o.GUI_NAME, o.MENU_NAME, o.CHROME_NAME })
				o.host = nil
				o.hostPath = nil
				local function p(Z)
					local i
					local i, i, y = J, typeof(J) == "table"
					if i then
						local P
						P, y = J, typeof(J.protect_gui) == "function"
					else
						y = i
					end
					if y then
						pcall(J.protect_gui, Z)
					else
						i = typeof(protect_gui) == "function"
						if i then
							pcall(protect_gui, Z)
						else
							local J
							local J, J = O, typeof(O) == "function"
							if J then
								local J = O
								pcall(J, Z)
							end
						end
					end
				end
				local function J()
					local O, Z = {}
					local Z, Z = u, typeof(u) == "function"
					if Z then
						local i = u
						local u, y = pcall(i)
						if u and y then
							table.insert(O, { name = "gethui", object = y })
						end
					end
					local u, i = pcall(function()
						return f.get("CoreGui")
					end)
					if u and i then
						table.insert(O, { name = "CoreGui", object = i })
					end
					Z, i = pcall(function()
						local u = f.get("Players").LocalPlayer
						return u and (u:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui"))
					end)
					if Z and i then
						table.insert(O, { name = "PlayerGui", object = i })
					end
					return O
				end
				local function O(u, f)
					local Z = F.new(
						"ScreenGui",
						{
							Name = u,
							IgnoreGuiInset = true,
							ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Global,
							ResetOnSpawn = false,
							DisplayOrder = f,
						}
					)
					if not Z then
						return nil
					end
					p(Z)
					for p, u in ipairs(J()) do
						pcall(function()
							Z.Parent = u.object
						end)
						if Z.Parent then
							o.host = u.name
							f, p = pcall(function()
								return u.object:GetFullName()
							end)
							o.hostPath = f and p or "<opaque>"
							return Z
						end
					end
					o.host = nil
					o.hostPath = nil
					return Z
				end
				o.newBase = function()
					return O(o.GUI_NAME, 0)
				end
				o.newWorld = function()
					return O(o.WORLD_NAME, 1)
				end
				o.newMenu = function()
					return O(o.MENU_NAME, 3)
				end
				o.newChrome = function()
					return O(o.CHROME_NAME, 2)
				end
				o.inPlayerGui = function()
					return o.host == "PlayerGui"
				end
				return o
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/notify"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/create")
				local O = p("services/frame")
				local u = p("services/trace")
				local F = p("ui/library")
				local f = p("ui/font")
				local o = p("ui/chrome/watermark")
				local Z, i, y, P, b = p("ui/zindex"), { BIND = "hud/notify" }, 12, 10, 16
				local p, I, h, A = math.floor(b * 1.049 + 0.5), math.ceil(83 * (b / 2)), 4, 13
				local T = p + 8
				local p, r = T, 5
				local S = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 14)
				local c, R, e, G, q, w, H, Q =
					NumberSequence.new({
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.22, 0.25),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.78, 0.25),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
					}),
					6,
					0.12,
					4,
					0.45,
					18,
					16
				local Y, E, s, v = {}, {}, {}
				local m, B = false
				local function g()
					local k = Q and Q.Parent
					if k then
						local z = Q
						return z
					end
					k = F.base
					if not k then
						return nil
					end
					B = nil
					Q = J.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "Notices",
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, p),
							Position = UDim2.fromOffset(y, o.MARGIN + o.HEIGHT + P),
							ZIndex = Z.HUD,
							Parent = k,
						}
					)
					k = Q
					return k
				end
				local function o()
					local y = table.remove(E)
					if y and y.root and y.root.Parent then
						y.root.Visible = true
						return y
					end
					y = g()
					if not y then
						return nil
					end
					local P = J.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "Notice",
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(I + A * 2, p),
							ZIndex = Z.HUD,
							Parent = y,
						}
					)
					if not P then
						return nil
					end
					y = J.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "Pill",
							BackgroundColor3 = S,
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, T),
							ZIndex = Z.HUD,
							Parent = P,
						}
					)
					if not y then
						P:Destroy()
						return nil
					end
					local S, k = J.new, {}
					k.CornerRadius, k.Parent = UDim.new(0, r), y
					S("UICorner", k)
					J.new("UIGradient", { Transparency = c, Parent = y })
					S = J.new(
						"TextLabel",
						{
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(I, T),
							Position = UDim2.fromOffset(A, 0),
							ZIndex = Z.HUD + 1,
							Parent = P,
						}
					)
					if not S then
						P:Destroy()
						return nil
					end
					S.FontFace = f.mono()
					S.TextSize = b
					S.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
					S.RichText = true
					S.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
					S.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
					return { root = P, pill = y, text = S }
				end
				local function J(f)
					local Z = f.piece
					if not Z then
						return
					end
					f.piece = nil
					Z.root.Visible = false
					table.insert(E, Z)
				end
				local function f(Z, y)
					Z.text.Text = y.text
				end
				local function Z(y)
					if y < e then
						return y / e
					end
					local P = y - e
					if P < G then
						return 1
					end
					y = (P - G) / q
					if y >= 1 then
						return nil
					end
					return 1 - y
				end
				local function y(P)
					local b = B
					if b == P then
						return
					end
					B = P
					Q.Visible = P
				end
				local function P()
					if #s > 0 then
						for b = 1, #s, 1 do
							local r = s[b]
							r.root.Visible = false
							E[#E + 1] = r
							s[b] = nil
						end
					end
					local b = os.clock()
					local r = v and b - v or 0
					v = b
					local S = #Y == 0
					if S then
						local c = Q
						if c then
							y(false)
						end
						return
					end
					if not g() then
						return
					end
					y(true)
					if u.on then
						local c, q = 0, F.base
						if q then
							for F, F in ipairs(q:GetChildren()) do
								c = if F.Name == "Notices" then c + 1 else c
							end
						else
						end
						S = 0
						for F, F in ipairs(Y) do
							S = if F.piece then S + 1 else S
						end
						u.every("censo", 1, "aviso", "vivas=%d desenhadas=%d paineis=%d teto=%d", #Y, S, c, R)
					end
					S = math.clamp(r * H, 0, 1)
					for F = #Y, 1, -1 do
						r = Y[F]
						local c = Z(b - r.born)
						if not c then
							J(r)
							table.remove(Y, F)
						else
							r.alpha = c
						end
					end
					for F, Z in ipairs(Y) do
						r = false
						if not Z.piece then
							Z.piece = o()
							if Z.piece then
								f(Z.piece, Z)
								r = true
							else
							end
						else
						end
						b = Z.piece
						if b then
							local f = (F - 1) * (p + h)
							if Z.y then
								Z.y = Z.y + (f - Z.y) * S
							else
								local o = Y[F - 1]
								if o and o.y then
									Z.y = o.y + p + h
								else
									Z.y = f
								end
							end
							local p, F = w * (1 - Z.alpha), 1 - Z.alpha
							b.root.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-p, Z.y)
							if not Z.width and not r then
								f = b.text.TextBounds.X
								if f > 0 then
									Z.width = math.min(f, I) + A * 2
									b.pill.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Z.width, T)
								end
							end
							b.text.TextTransparency = F
							b.pill.BackgroundTransparency = Z.width and F or 1
						end
					end
				end
				i.push = function(p)
					local F = m
					if not F then
						return
					end
					if typeof(p) ~= "table" then
						return
					end
					F = p.text
					if typeof(F) ~= "string" or F == "" then
						return
					end
					p = os.clock()
					table.insert(Y, { text = F, born = p, alpha = 0 })
					while #Y - R > 2 do
						F = Y[1]
						if F.piece then
							s[#s + 1] = F.piece
							F.piece = nil
						end
						table.remove(Y, 1)
					end
					if u.on and #Y - R > 2 then
						u.every(
							"estouro",
							1,
							"aviso",
							"pilha ACIMA do teto depois do corte: vivas=%d teto=%d cortadas=%d",
							#Y,
							R,
							cut
						)
					end
					F = p - e - G
					for u = 1, #Y - R, 1 do
						p = Y[u]
						p.born = math.min(p.born, F)
					end
				end
				i.enable = function(p)
					p = p and true or false
					local u = m
					if p == u then
						return i
					end
					m = p
					if p then
						v = os.clock()
						O.onDraw(i.BIND, P)
					else
						O.stop(i.BIND)
						for p, p in ipairs(Y) do
							J(p)
						end
						table.clear(Y)
						u = Q
						if u then
							y(false)
						end
					end
					return i
				end
				local p = {}
				i.want = function(J, O)
					if typeof(J) ~= "string" then
						return i
					end
					if O then
						p[J] = true
					else
						p[J] = nil
					end
					return i.enable(next(p) ~= nil)
				end
				i.reset = function()
					table.clear(p)
					i.enable(false)
					table.clear(Y)
					table.clear(E)
					table.clear(s)
					v = nil
					local p = Q
					if p then
						Q:Destroy()
						Q, B = nil, nil
					end
				end
				return i
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/players"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("services/alias")
				local O = p("ui/connect")
				local u = p("ui/create")
				local F = p("game/guard")
				local f = p("services/gamedata")
				local o = p("ui/icon")
				local Z = p("ui/library")
				local i = p("services/marks")
				local y = p("ui/motion")
				local P, b = p("core/service"), p("ui/theme")
				local I = p("ui/tooltip")
				local h = p("ui/font")
				local A = p("ui/thumb")
				local T = p("ui/zindex")
				local p = P.get("Players")
				local r = P.get("RunService")
				local P, S, c, R, e, G, q, w, H =
					p and p.LocalPlayer, { WIDTH = 560, HEIGHT = 420 }, 32, 22, 24, 18, 10, 6, 0.5
				S.IDLE = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 128)
				S.OPEN = TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
				local Q, Y, E, s = {
					{
						kind = i.KILL,
						icon = "skull",
						label = "kill",
						tip = "hunts this player. turns on everything the ragebot needs, with no keybind",
					},
					{
						kind = i.PRIORITY,
						icon = "target",
						label = "priority",
						tip = "the aimbot picks this player before anyone else, for as long as they are reachable",
					},
					{
						kind = i.ESP,
						icon = "eye",
						label = "esp",
						tip = "always draws this player, even with the card for their side switched off",
					},
				}
				local v, m, B, g, k, z = {}, {}, {}, 0, 0
				local l, D = 0
				local function K(C, a)
					local j = v[C]
					if not j then
						return
					end
					local V = b.get()
					for N, W in pairs(j) do
						local j = i.has(C, N)
						W.glyph.ImageColor3 = j and V or S.IDLE
						W.glyph.ImageTransparency = j and 0 or 0.35
						W.label.TextColor3 = V
						if W.width <= 0 then
							W.width = W.label.AbsoluteSize.X
							if W.width <= 0 then
								W.width = #W.label.Text * 7
							end
						end
						N = UDim2.fromOffset(j and W.width or 0, G)
						if a then
							W.holder.Size = N
						else
							y.to(W.holder, S.OPEN, { Size = N })
						end
						W.label.TextTransparency = j and 0 or 1
					end
				end
				local function y()
					for C in pairs(v) do
						K(C, true)
					end
				end
				local function C(a, j)
					g += 1
					local V = m[g]
					local N = not V
					if N then
						V = u.new(
							"TextLabel",
							{
								Name = "Head",
								Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, R),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								TextSize = 12,
								FontFace = h.face(true),
								TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
								skin = { TextColor3 = "dim" },
								ZIndex = T.WINDOW + 1,
								Parent = E,
							}
						)
						m[g] = V
					else
					end
					if not V then
						return
					end
					V.Text = a
					V.LayoutOrder = j
					V.Visible = true
				end
				local function R(a, j, V, N)
					local W = u.new(
						"TextButton",
						{
							Name = "Act",
							Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
							AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
							BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							AutoButtonColor = false,
							Text = "",
							LayoutOrder = N,
							ZIndex = T.WINDOW + 2,
							Parent = a,
						}
					)
					if not W then
						return
					end
					a, N = u.new, {}
					N.CornerRadius, N.Parent = UDim.new(0, 4), W
					a("UICorner", N)
					u.new(
						"UIPadding",
						{ PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, w), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, w), Parent = W }
					)
					u.new(
						"UIListLayout",
						{
							FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
							VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
							SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
							Padding = UDim.new(0, 4),
							Parent = W,
						}
					)
					local U = u.new(
						"ImageLabel",
						{
							Name = "Glyph",
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(G, G),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							LayoutOrder = 1,
							ZIndex = T.WINDOW + 3,
							Parent = W,
						}
					)
					local _ = o.get(j.icon)
					if U and _ then
						U.Image = ""
						pcall(function()
							U.ImageContent = _
						end)
					end
					N = u.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "Tag",
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, G),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							ClipsDescendants = true,
							LayoutOrder = 2,
							ZIndex = T.WINDOW + 3,
							Parent = W,
						}
					)
					if not N then
						return
					end
					a = u.new(
						"TextLabel",
						{
							Name = "Text",
							AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
							Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Text = j.label,
							TextSize = 12,
							FontFace = h.face(),
							TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
							TextTransparency = 1,
							ZIndex = T.WINDOW + 3,
							Parent = N,
						}
					)
					if not (U and a) then
						return
					end
					I.attach(W, j.tip)
					O.signal(W.MouseButton1Click, function()
						local o = V.name
						if not o then
							return
						end
						i.toggle(o, j.kind)
						K(o)
					end)
					O.signal(W.MouseEnter, function()
						W.BackgroundTransparency = 0.88
					end)
					O.signal(W.MouseLeave, function()
						W.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					end)
					return { glyph = U, holder = N, label = a, width = 0 }
				end
				local function o()
					local i, I =
						{ slots = {} },
						u.new(
							"Frame",
							{
								Name = "Row",
								Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, c),
								skin = { BackgroundColor3 = "raised" },
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								ZIndex = T.WINDOW + 1,
								Parent = E,
							}
						)
					if not I then
						return nil
					end
					local G, a = u.new, {}
					a.CornerRadius, a.Parent = UDim.new(0, 4), I
					G("UICorner", a)
					local G, j =
						u.new(
							"ImageLabel",
							{
								Name = "Face",
								AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
								Position = UDim2.new(0, q, 0.5, 0),
								Size = UDim2.fromOffset(e, e),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								ZIndex = T.WINDOW + 2,
								Parent = I,
							}
						),
						u.new(
							"TextLabel",
							{
								Name = "Who",
								AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
								Position = UDim2.new(0, q + e + w, 0.5, 0),
								Size = UDim2.new(0.45, 0, 0, c),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								TextSize = 13,
								FontFace = h.face(),
								TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
								TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
								skin = { TextColor3 = "text" },
								ZIndex = T.WINDOW + 2,
								Parent = I,
							}
						)
					local V = u.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "Acts",
							AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
							Position = UDim2.new(1, -q, 0.5, 0),
							Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, c - 8),
							AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							ZIndex = T.WINDOW + 2,
							Parent = I,
						}
					)
					if not (V and G and j) then
						return nil
					end
					u.new(
						"UIListLayout",
						{
							FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
							HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right,
							VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
							SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
							Padding = UDim.new(0, w),
							Parent = V,
						}
					)
					for N, W in ipairs(Q) do
						a = R(V, W, i, N)
						if a then
							i.slots[W.kind] = a
						end
					end
					local function R()
						if not (j and j.Parent and V and V.Parent) then
							return
						end
						j.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(q * 2 + e + w * 2 + V.AbsoluteSize.X), 0, c)
					end
					O.signal(V:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), R)
					i.frame = I
					i.face = G
					i.who = j
					i.fit = R
					return i
				end
				local function O(i, I)
					k += 1
					local c = B[k]
					local R = not c
					if R then
						c = o()
						B[k] = c
					else
					end
					if not c then
						return
					end
					local o, R, e = i.Name, J.of(i), A.headshot(i.UserId)
					c.name = o
					c.frame.LayoutOrder = I
					c.frame.Visible = true
					if c.who.Text ~= R then
						c.who.Text = R
					end
					if c.face.Image ~= e then
						c.face.Image = e
					end
					v[o] = c.slots
					K(o, true)
					c.fit()
				end
				local function o()
					local i, I = {}, {}
					if not p then
						return i, I
					end
					for A, A in ipairs(p:GetPlayers()) do
						if A ~= P then
							table.insert(f.isAlly(A) and I or i, A)
						end
					end
					local function p(f, P)
						return f.Name < P.Name
					end
					table.sort(i, p)
					table.sort(I, p)
					return i, I
				end
				local function p(f, i)
					local P, I = {}, { f, i }
					for f, f in ipairs(I) do
						for i, i in ipairs(f) do
							table.insert(P, i.Name)
						end
						table.insert(P, "|")
					end
					table.insert(P, J.signature())
					return table.concat(P, ",")
				end
				local function J(f, i)
					local P = E
					if not P then
						return
					end
					table.clear(v)
					g, k = 0, 0
					if not f then
						f, i = o()
					else
					end
					local I = 0
					local function A(c, R)
						if #R == 0 then
							return
						end
						I += 1
						C(c, I)
						for c, c in ipairs(R) do
							I += 1
							O(c, I)
						end
					end
					A("enemies", f)
					A("allies", i)
					A = g + 1
					for O = A, #m, 1 do
						m[O].Visible = false
					end
					P = k + 1
					for O = P, #B, 1 do
						A = B[O]
						A.name = nil
						A.frame.Visible = false
					end
					P = s
					if P then
						A = s
						A.Visible = #f == 0 and #i == 0
					end
				end
				local function O()
					local f = not Y or not Y.Visible
					if f then
						return
					end
					f = os.clock()
					local i = f - l
					if i < H then
						return
					end
					l = f
					i, f = o()
					local o, P = p(i, f), z
					if o == P then
						return
					end
					z = o
					J(i, f)
				end
				S.build = function(p)
					if not p then
						return false
					end
					local f = p.columns and p.columns[1]
					Y = f and f.main
					f = Y
					if not f then
						return false
					end
					Z.sizeTab(p, S.WIDTH, S.HEIGHT)
					f, p = Z.geometry, Y
					p.Size = UDim2.new(1, -2 * f.inset, 1, -(4 + Z.footerHeight()))
					E = u.new(
						"ScrollingFrame",
						{
							Name = "Roster",
							Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							ScrollBarThickness = 3,
							CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
							AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
							ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
							ZIndex = T.WINDOW,
							Parent = Y,
						}
					)
					p = E
					if not p then
						return false
					end
					b.follow(E, "ScrollBarImageColor3")
					u.new(
						"UIListLayout",
						{ SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 3), Parent = E }
					)
					s = u.new(
						"TextLabel",
						{
							Name = "Empty",
							AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
							Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
							Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Text = "no one else in the server",
							TextSize = 12,
							FontFace = h.face(),
							skin = { TextColor3 = "dim" },
							Visible = false,
							ZIndex = T.WINDOW + 1,
							Parent = Y,
						}
					)
					b.onChange(y)
					J()
					p = not D
					if p then
						D = r.Heartbeat:Connect(F.safe(O, "players/roster"))
					end
					return true
				end
				S.reset = function()
					local p = D
					if p then
						D:Disconnect()
						D = nil
					end
					table.clear(v)
					table.clear(m)
					table.clear(B)
					g, k, Y, E, s, z, l = 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, nil, 0
				end
				return S
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/popup"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/connect")
				local O = p("ui/create")
				local u = p("ui/fade")
				local F = p("ui/metrics")
				local f = p("ui/motion")
				local o = p("ui/shadow")
				p("ui/skin")
				local Z = p("ui/zindex")
				local i, y, P =
					p("core/service").get("UserInputService"),
					{
						WIDTH = 194,
						PAD = 6,
						PAD_X = 7,
						SURFACE = "raised",
						RISE = 8,
						DROP = 4,
						MARGIN = 8,
						BAR = 4,
						MIN_H = 120,
						OFFSET = 6,
						current = nil,
					},
					{}
				P.__index = P
				y.class = P
				y.host = nil
				y.onSettle = nil
				y.setHost = function(p)
					y.host = p
				end
				local p = false
				local function b(I, h)
					return I ~= nil and h ~= nil and I.frame ~= nil and h:IsDescendantOf(I.frame)
				end
				y.blocks = function(I)
					local h = y.current
					if h == nil or h.open ~= true or h.frame == nil then
						return false
					end
					if I == nil then
						return true
					end
					return not I:IsDescendantOf(h.frame)
				end
				y.hold = function(I)
					if I then
						local h, A = y.current, false
						while h do
							if h == I then
								A = true
								break
							end
							h = h.owner
						end
						if A then
							local h = y.current
							while h and h ~= I do
								if h.guard then
									break
								end
								local A = h.owner
								h:Close()
								h = A
							end
						end
					end
					local h = I or y.current
					while h do
						h.selfClick = true
						h = h.owner
					end
				end
				y.closeAbove = function(I)
					while y.current and y.current ~= I do
						local I = y.current
						I:Close()
						if y.current == I then
							break
						end
					end
				end
				y.closeAll = function()
					y.closeAbove(nil)
				end
				local function I()
					local h = p
					if h then
						return
					end
					p = true
					J.signal(i.InputEnded, function(p)
						if not y.current then
							return
						end
						if p.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
							return
						end
						local p, i = y.current, false
						while p do
							i = if p.guard or p.selfClick then true else i
							p.guard = false
							p.selfClick = false
							p = p.owner
						end
						if i then
							return
						end
						y.closeAll()
					end, "popup/dismiss")
				end
				y.new = function(p, i)
					local h = y.host
					if not h then
						return nil
					end
					local A = i == true or b(y.current, p)
					local i, T =
						A and Z.POPUP_NESTED or Z.POPUP, A and Z.POPUP_NESTED_CONTENT or Z.POPUP_CONTENT
					local Z = setmetatable(
						{ anchor = p, host = h, open = false, options = {}, placement = "beside", frameWidth = y.WIDTH, zbase = T },
						P
					)
					Z.frame = O.new(
						"TextButton",
						{
							Name = "Popup",
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(y.WIDTH, 0),
							skin = { BackgroundColor3 = y.SURFACE },
							BackgroundTransparency = 0,
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							AutoButtonColor = false,
							Text = "",
							Active = true,
							Visible = false,
							ZIndex = i,
							Parent = h,
						}
					)
					Z.fader = O.new("NumberValue", { Name = "Fade", Value = 1, Parent = Z.frame })
					O.new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, F.corner), Parent = Z.frame })
					O.new("UIStroke", { Thickness = F.stroke, skin = "border", Parent = Z.frame })
					Z.shadow = o.attach(Z.frame, i)
					Z.content = O.new(
						"ScrollingFrame",
						{
							Name = "Content",
							Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
							AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
							ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
							ScrollBarThickness = y.BAR,
							VerticalScrollBarInset = Enum.ScrollBarInset.ScrollBar,
							skin = { ScrollBarImageColor3 = "hard" },
							ZIndex = T,
							Parent = Z.frame,
						}
					)
					Z.layout = O.new(
						"UIListLayout",
						{
							SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
							HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
							Padding = UDim.new(0, F.rowGap),
							Parent = Z.content,
						}
					)
					O.new(
						"UIPadding",
						{
							PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, y.PAD),
							PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, y.PAD),
							PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, y.PAD_X),
							PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, y.PAD_X),
							Parent = Z.content,
						}
					)
					J.signal(Z.layout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"), function()
						Z:resize()
					end, "popup/size")
					J.signal(Z.fader.Changed, function()
						if Z.shot then
							u.apply(Z.shot, Z.fader.Value)
						end
					end, "popup/fade")
					J.signal(Z.frame.InputBegan, function(p)
						if p.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
							y.hold(Z)
						end
					end, "popup/inside")
					I()
					return Z
				end
				local function p(J)
					local O = J and (J:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScreenGui"))
					if O and O.AbsoluteSize.Y > 0 then
						return O.AbsoluteSize
					end
					J = workspace.CurrentCamera
					return J and J.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
				end
				P.contentWidth = function(J)
					local O = J.content
					if not O or O.AbsoluteSize.X <= 0 then
						return nil
					end
					J = O.AbsolutePosition.X
					local F = J + O.AbsoluteSize.X
					local function Z(i)
						local I = i
						while I and I ~= O do
							if I:IsA("GuiObject") and not I.Visible then
								return false
							end
							I = I.Parent
						end
						return true
					end
					local i = 0
					for I, h in ipairs(O:GetDescendants()) do
						if h:IsA("TextLabel") and h.Visible and h.Text ~= "" and Z(h) then
							I = h.TextBounds.X
							if I > 0 and not h.TextWrapped then
								local O = h.Parent
								if
									not (
										O
										and O:IsA("GuiObject")
										and (
											O.AutomaticSize == Enum.AutomaticSize.X
											or O.AutomaticSize == Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
										)
									)
								then
									local Z = if O and O:IsA("GuiObject")
										then math.max(F - (O.AbsolutePosition.X + O.AbsoluteSize.X), 0)
										else 0
									local O = h.AbsolutePosition.X - J + I + Z
									i = if O > i then O else i
								else
								end
							else
							end
						else
						end
					end
					if i <= 0 then
						return nil
					end
					return math.ceil(i)
				end
				P.reflow = function(J)
					if J.placement == "below" then
						return
					end
					local O, F = J.anchor, J.host
					if not O or not F then
						return
					end
					local Z, i, I, h =
						F.AbsolutePosition, O.AbsolutePosition, O.AbsoluteSize, J.frameWidth or y.WIDTH
					O = i.X - Z.X + I.X + y.OFFSET
					O = if O + h > F.AbsoluteSize.X then i.X - Z.X - h - y.OFFSET else O
					J.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(O, J.frame.Position.Y.Offset)
				end
				P.resize = function(J)
					if not J.layout then
						return
					end
					local O = J.layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y
					if O <= 0 then
						return
					end
					local F = p(J.host)
					local Z = math.max(F.Y - y.MARGIN * 2, y.MIN_H)
					Z = if J.maxHeight then math.min(Z, J.maxHeight) else Z
					local i = J.frameWidth or y.WIDTH
					if J.placement ~= "below" and J.width then
						i = math.min(J.width, math.max(F.X - y.MARGIN * 2, y.WIDTH))
					else
						if J.placement ~= "below" then
							local I = J:contentWidth()
							if I then
								local h = math.max(F.X - y.MARGIN * 2, y.WIDTH)
								i = math.clamp(I + y.PAD * 2, y.WIDTH, h)
							else
							end
						else
						end
					end
					F = i ~= J.frameWidth
					J.frameWidth = i
					J.frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(i, math.min(O + y.PAD * 2, Z))
					if F then
						J:reflow()
					end
					J:settle()
				end
				P.settle = function(J)
					if not J.frame or J.wantY == nil then
						return
					end
					local O, F, Z =
						p(J.host).Y, J.host and J.host.AbsolutePosition.Y or 0, J.frame.AbsoluteSize.Y
					if Z <= 0 then
						return
					end
					local p, i = F + J.wantY, O - Z - y.MARGIN
					J.homeY = math.max(y.MARGIN, math.min(p, i)) - F
					if J.open then
						J.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(J.frame.Position.X.Offset, J.homeY)
					end
				end
				P.place = function(p)
					local J, O = p.anchor, p.host
					if not J or not O then
						return
					end
					local F, Z, i, I, h, A =
						O.AbsolutePosition, J.AbsolutePosition, J.AbsoluteSize, p.width or y.WIDTH
					if p.placement == "below" then
						I, h, A = i.X, Z.X - F.X, Z.Y - F.Y + i.Y + y.DROP
					else
						h, A = Z.X - F.X + i.X + y.OFFSET, Z.Y - F.Y
						h = if h + I > O.AbsoluteSize.X then Z.X - F.X - I - y.OFFSET else h
					end
					p.frameWidth = I
					p.wantY = A
					p.homeY = A
					p.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(h, A)
					p:settle()
				end
				P.Open = function(p)
					if p.open then
						return p
					end
					if y.current ~= p then
						local J, O = y.current
						while J do
							if b(J, p.anchor) then
								O = J
								break
							end
							J = J.owner
						end
						y.closeAbove(O)
						p.owner = O
					else
						p.owner = nil
					end
					p.open = true
					y.current = p
					p.guard = true
					p.frame.Visible = true
					p:resize()
					p:place()
					p.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p.frame.Position.X.Offset, p.homeY + y.RISE)
					f.cancel(p.fade)
					f.cancel(p.slide)
					if p.shot and not p.settled then
						u.apply(p.shot, 0)
					end
					p.settled = false
					p.shot = u.snapshot(p.frame)
					p.fader.Value = 1
					u.apply(p.shot, 1)
					p.fade = f.to(p.fader, f.HOVER_IN, { Value = 0 })
					if p.fade then
						local J, O =
							p.fade, function()
								if y.onSettle then
									y.onSettle()
								end
							end
						J.Completed:Once(O)
					end
					p.slide = f.to(
						p.frame,
						f.HOVER_IN,
						{ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p.frame.Position.X.Offset, p.homeY) }
					)
					o.fade(p.shadow, true, f.HOVER_IN)
					if p.onOpen then
						p.onOpen()
					end
					return p
				end
				P.Close = function(p)
					if not p.open then
						return p
					end
					if y.current and y.current ~= p and y.current.owner == p then
						y.current:Close()
					end
					p.open = false
					if y.current == p then
						y.current = p.owner
					end
					p.owner = nil
					f.cancel(p.fade)
					f.cancel(p.slide)
					if p.shot and p.fader.Value > 0 then
						u.apply(p.shot, 0)
						p.fader.Value = 0
					end
					p.shot = u.snapshot(p.frame)
					p.settled = false
					p.fade = f.to(p.fader, f.HOVER_OUT, { Value = 1 })
					o.fade(p.shadow, false, f.HOVER_OUT)
					local function J()
						if p.open then
							return
						end
						p.frame.Visible = false
						if p.shot then
							u.apply(p.shot, 0)
						end
						p.settled = true
						if y.onSettle then
							y.onSettle()
						end
					end
					if p.fade then
						p.fade.Completed:Once(J)
					else
						J()
					end
					if p.onClose then
						p.onClose()
					end
					return p
				end
				P.Toggle = function(p)
					if not p.open then
						return p:Open()
					end
					local J = p.owner
					p:Close()
					if J then
						y.hold(J)
					end
					return p
				end
				return y
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/raster"] = (function()

local J = gethui
local O = writefile
local u = isfile
local F = getcustomasset
local f = isfolder
local o = makefolder
local Z = delfile

return function(p)
				local i = p("core/log")
				local y = p("core/service")
				local P, b, I, h, A = y.get("AssetService"), {}, false, false, false
				local function T()
					local r = h
					if r then
						return
					end
					h = true
					if I then
						return
					end
					local function h()
						local r, S
						local S, S = J, typeof(J) == "function"
						if S then
							local c = J
							local J, R = pcall(c)
							r = if J and R then R else r
						else
						end
						if not r then
							local J, c = pcall(function()
								return y.get("CoreGui")
							end)
							r = if J then c else r
						else
						end
						if not r then
							return
						end
						local J = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
						J.Name = "n"
						J.ResetOnSpawn = false
						J.Parent = r
						S = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
						S.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16)
						S.BackgroundTransparency = 1
						S.ImageTransparency = 0
						S.Parent = J
						local y = Vector2.new(16, 16)
						local r = P:CreateEditableImage({ Size = y })
						local c = buffer.create(1024)
						for R = 0, 255, 1 do
							buffer.writeu32(c, R * 4, 4294967295)
						end
						r:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, y, c)
						S.ImageContent = Content.fromObject(r)
						for y = 1, 12, 1 do
							y = S.IsLoaded
							if y then
								A = true
								break
							end
							task.wait()
						end
						pcall(function()
							r:Destroy()
						end)
						pcall(function()
							J:Destroy()
						end)
					end
					pcall(h)
				end
				local function J()
					if I then
						return false
					end
					local y = A
					return y
				end
				b.supported = J
				b.method = function()
					return J() and "editableimage" or "getcustomasset"
				end
				local y, I, h, A = {}, {}, {}, {}
				for r = 0, 255, 1 do
					p = r
					for S = 1, 8, 1 do
						p = if p % 2 == 1
							then bit32.bxor(3988292384, bit32.rshift(p, 1))
							else bit32.rshift(p, 1)
					end
					y[r] = p
				end
				for r = 0, 255, 1 do
					p = y[r]
					p = bit32.bxor(bit32.rshift(p, 8), y[bit32.band(p, 255)])
					I[r] = p
					p = bit32.bxor(bit32.rshift(p, 8), y[bit32.band(p, 255)])
					h[r] = p
					A[r] = bit32.bxor(bit32.rshift(p, 8), y[bit32.band(p, 255)])
				end
				local function p(r)
					local S, c, R = #r, 1, 4294967295
					while c + 3 <= S do
						local e = string.unpack("<I4", r, c)
						R = bit32.bxor(R, e)
						R = bit32.bxor(
							A[bit32.band(R, 255)],
							h[bit32.band(bit32.rshift(R, 8), 255)],
							I[bit32.band(bit32.rshift(R, 16), 255)],
							y[bit32.rshift(R, 24)]
						)
						c = c + 4
					end
					while c <= S do
						R = bit32.bxor(
							y[bit32.band(bit32.bxor(R, string.byte(r, c)), 255)],
							bit32.rshift(R, 8)
						)
						c = c + 1
					end
					return bit32.bxor(R, 4294967295)
				end
				local function y(I)
					local h, A, r, S = #I, 1, 1, 0
					while A <= h do
						local c = math.min(A + 5551, h)
						while A + 3 <= c do
							local h, R, e, G = string.byte(I, A, A + 3)
							r += h
							S += r
							r += R
							S += r
							r += e
							S += r
							r += G
							S += r
							A = A + 4
						end
						while A <= c do
							r += string.byte(I, A)
							S += r
							A = A + 1
						end
						r, S = r % 65521, S % 65521
					end
					return S * 65536 + r
				end
				local function I(h)
					local A, r = { string.char(120, 1) }, #h
					if r == 0 then
						A[#A + 1] = string.char(1, 0, 0, 255, 255)
					end
					local S = 1
					while S <= r do
						local c = math.min(S + 65534, r)
						local R = string.sub(h, S, c)
						local e, G = #R, c >= r and 1 or 0
						A[#A + 1] = string.char(G)
						A[#A + 1] = string.pack("<I2", e)
						A[#A + 1] = string.pack("<I2", 65535 - e)
						A[#A + 1] = R
						S = c + 1
					end
					A[#A + 1] = string.pack(">I4", y(h))
					return table.concat(A)
				end
				local function y(h, A)
					return string.pack(">I4", #A) .. h .. A .. string.pack(">I4", p(h .. A))
				end
				local function p(h, A, r)
					local S, c = A * 4, {}
					for R = 0, r - 1, 1 do
						c[#c + 1] = string.char(0)
						c[#c + 1] = string.sub(h, R * S + 1, (R + 1) * S)
					end
					h = table.concat(c)
					return string.char(137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10)
						.. y(
							"IHDR",
							string.pack(">I4", A) .. string.pack(">I4", r) .. string.char(8, 6, 0, 0, 0)
						)
						.. y("IDAT", I(h))
						.. y("IEND", "")
				end
				local y = "neurothycal/storage/raster"
				local function I()
					local h
					local h, h, A = O, typeof(O) == "function"
					if h then
						local r
						local r = u
						A = typeof(r) == "function"
					else
						A = h
					end
					h = nil
					if A then
						local r
						local r = F
						h = typeof(r) == "function"
					else
						h = A
					end
					return h and typeof(buffer.tostring) == "function"
				end
				local function h()
					local A
					local A, A, r, S = f, typeof(f) ~= "function"
					if A then
						r = A
					else
						local S = o
						r = typeof(S) ~= "function"
					end
					if r then
						return
					end
					A = nil
					for S in y:gmatch("[^/]+") do
						A = A and A .. "/" .. S or S
						S = f
						r = not S(A)
						if r then
							S = o
							pcall(S, A)
						end
					end
				end
				local f = 0
				local function o(A, r)
					if not I() then
						return nil
					end
					h()
					f += 1
					local I = string.format("%s/%s_%d.png", y, tostring(r or "img"), f)
					local f
					local f, f, y = O, not pcall(O, I, A)
					if f then
						y = f
					else
						local O
						r = u
						y = not r(I)
					end
					if y then
						return nil
					end
					local O
					r = F
					A, y = pcall(r, I)
					if A and typeof(y) == "string" and y ~= "" then
						return y, I
					end
					return nil
				end
				local O = {}
				b.image = function(u, F, f, y)
					if J() then
						local I, h = pcall(function()
							local A = Vector2.new(F, f)
							local r = P:CreateEditableImage({ Size = A })
							r:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, A, u)
							table.insert(O, r)
							return Content.fromObject(r)
						end)
						return I and h or nil
					end
					local I, h = pcall(function()
						local A = o(p(buffer.tostring(u), F, f), y)
						if not A then
							return nil
						end
						return Content.fromUri(A)
					end)
					return I and h or nil
				end
				b.surface = function(u, F, f)
					local y = Vector2.new(u, F)
					if J() then
						local J, I = pcall(function()
							local h = { Size = y }
							return P:CreateEditableImage(h)
						end)
						if not J or not I then
							return nil
						end
						local J, P = pcall(function()
							return Content.fromObject(I)
						end)
						if not J or not P then
							return nil
						end
						table.insert(O, I)
						return {
							write = function(J, J)
								pcall(function()
									I:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, y, J)
								end)
								return P
							end,
						}
					end
					local J
					local O = {
						write = function(y, y)
							local P, I = pcall(function()
								local h, A = o(p(buffer.tostring(y), u, F), f)
								if not h then
									return nil
								end
								local p = J
								if p then
									local p
									local p = Z
									pcall(p, J)
								end
								J = A
								return Content.fromUri(h)
							end)
							return P and I or nil
						end,
					}
					return O
				end
				local p = false
				b.announce = function()
					local J = p
					if J then
						return
					end
					p = true
					T()
					if i.SINK then
						print("render method: " .. b.method())
					end
				end
				return b
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/ring"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J, O, u = p("ui/raster"), { THICK = 3, SAMPLES = 3, STEPS = 64 }, {}
				local function p(F)
					local f = u[F]
					if f then
						return f
					end
					local o, Z = F / 2, F / 2 - 1
					local i, y, P, b = Z - O.THICK, table.create(F * F), 1 / O.SAMPLES, O.SAMPLES * O.SAMPLES
					for I = 0, F - 1, 1 do
						for h = 0, F - 1, 1 do
							f = 0
							for A = 0, O.SAMPLES - 1, 1 do
								for T = 0, O.SAMPLES - 1, 1 do
									local r, S = h + (T + 0.5) * P - o, I + (A + 0.5) * P - o
									T = math.sqrt(r * r + S * S)
									f = if T >= i and T <= Z then f + 1 else f
								end
							end
							local i, P = h + 0.5 - o, I + 0.5 - o
							local o = math.atan2(i, -P)
							y[I * F + h + 1] =
								{ cover = f / b, at = (if o < 0 then o + 6.283185307179586 else o)
									/ 6.283185307179586 }
						end
					end
					y.soft = 1 / (6.283185307179586 * Z)
					y.size = F
					u[F] = y
					return y
				end
				local function u(F, f)
					local o = p(F)
					local p, Z = o.soft, buffer.create(F * F * 4)
					for i = 1, F * F, 1 do
						local F = o[i]
						local o = F.cover
						if o > 0 then
							local y = o * math.clamp((f - F.at) / p, 0, 1)
							if y > 0 then
								buffer.writeu32(Z, (i - 1) * 4, 16777215 + math.floor(y * 255) * 16777216)
							end
						end
					end
					return Z
				end
				O.new = function(p, F)
					local f = math.floor(p) * 2
					p = J.surface(f, f, "ring")
					if not p then
						return nil
					end
					local o = math.clamp(F or 1, 0, 1)
					F = p:write(u(f, o))
					if not F then
						return nil
					end
					return {
						surface = p,
						content = F,
						size = f,
						thick = thick,
						step = math.floor(o * O.STEPS + 0.5),
						mutable = J.supported(),
					}
				end
				O.paint = function(p, J)
					if not p or not p.surface then
						return
					end
					if not p.mutable then
						return
					end
					J = math.clamp(J, 0, 1)
					local F = math.floor(J * O.STEPS + 0.5)
					if F == p.step then
						return
					end
					p.step = F
					p.surface:write(u(p.size, J, p.thick or O.THICK))
				end
				return O
			end
end)()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/connect")
				local O = p("ui/create")

				p = {
					DROP = 3,
					COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
					TRANSPARENCY = 0.3,
					attach = function(f, o)
						if not f or not f.Parent then
							return nil
						end
						local Z = u.get("shadow")
						if not Z then
							return nil
						end
						local i, y = u.shadowSlice()
						local P, b = u.dimensions("shadow")
						local u = f.AnchorPoint

						local A = O.new(
							"ImageLabel",
							{
								Name = "Shadow",
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								AnchorPoint = u,
								ImageContent = Z,
								ImageColor3 = p.COLOR,
								ImageTransparency = p.TRANSPARENCY,
								ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice,
								SliceCenter = Rect.new(y, y, P - y, b - y),
								ZIndex = (o or f.ZIndex) - 1,
								Parent = f.Parent,
							}
						)
						local function O()
							local u = f.Position
							A.Position =
								UDim2.new(u.X.Scale, u.X.Offset + I, u.Y.Scale, u.Y.Offset + h + p.DROP)
							u = f.AbsoluteSize
							A.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(u.X + i * 2, u.Y + i * 2)
						end
						O()
						J.signal(f:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"), O, "shadow/move")
						J.signal(f:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), O, "shadow/size")
						A.Visible = f.Visible
						J.signal(f:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), function()
							A.Visible = f.Visible
						end, "shadow/visible")
						return A
					end,
					fade = function(J, O, u)
						if not J then
							return
						end
						local f, o, Z = F.to, u or F.HOVER_IN, {}
						Z.ImageTransparency = O and p.TRANSPARENCY or 1
						f(J, o, Z)
					end,
				}
				return p
			end
end)()
