								body = Color3.fromRGB(48, 48, 54),
								dim = Color3.fromRGB(126, 126, 134),
								hint = Color3.fromRGB(148, 148, 156),
								disabled = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 178),
								field = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
								control = Color3.fromRGB(214, 214, 220),
								grab = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
								hover = Color3.fromRGB(202, 202, 210),
								danger = Color3.fromRGB(200, 40, 40),
								add = Color3.fromRGB(31, 145, 82),
								remove = Color3.fromRGB(198, 51, 46),
								rowGlow = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
							},
						},
						mode = "dark",
					},
					setmetatable,
					{ __mode = "k" }
				local F, f, o =
					O({}, u),
					{},
					{
						TextLabel = "TextColor3",
						TextBox = "TextColor3",
						TextButton = "TextColor3",
						ImageLabel = "ImageColor3",
						ImageButton = "ImageColor3",
						UIStroke = "Color",
					}
				p.get = function(O)
					return (p.PALETTES[p.mode] or p.PALETTES.dark)[O] or Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255)
				end
				local function O(u, Z, i)
					for y, P in pairs(Z) do
						local Z = p.get(P)
						if i then
							J.to(u, p.INFO, { [y] = Z })
						else
							pcall(function()
								u[y] = Z
							end)
						end
					end
				end
				p.paint = function(J, u)
					if not J or not u then
						return J
					end
					u = if typeof(u) == "string" then { [o[J.ClassName] or "BackgroundColor3"] = u } else u
					F[J] = u
					O(J, u, false)
					return J
				end
				p.unpaint = function(J)
					if J then
						F[J] = nil
					end
				end
				p.onChange = function(J)
					if typeof(J) ~= "function" then
						return function() end
					end
					table.insert(f, J)
					local function u()
						local o = f
						for Z, i in ipairs(o) do
							local o = i == J
							if o then
								table.remove(f, Z)
								return
							end
						end
					end
					return u
				end
				p.set = function(J)
					if not p.PALETTES[J] or J == p.mode then
						return p.mode
					end
					p.mode = J
					local u = F
					for o, Z in pairs(u) do
						O(o, Z, true)
					end
					u = f
					for O, O in ipairs(u) do
						pcall(O, J)
					end
					return p.mode
				end
				p.toggle = function()
					return p.set(p.mode == "dark" and "light" or "dark")
				end
				p.reset = function()
					local J, O = setmetatable, { __mode = "k" }
					F, f = J({}, O), {}
				end
				return p
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/skins/adjust"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/skins/chip")
				local O = p("ui/connect")
				local u = p("ui/create")
				local F = p("ui/skins/layer")
				local f = p("ui/skins/preview")
				local o = p("ui/metrics")
				local Z, i = p("core/service"), p("ui/skins/sheet")
				local y = p("ui/skin")
				local P = p("services/skindb")
				local b = p("ui/theme")
				local I = p("ui/font")
				local p, h, A, T, r, S, c, R = Z.get("UserInputService"), {}, 4, 20, 52, 24
				local Z, e, G, q, w = {}
				local H, Q, Y, E, s, v = false
				h.charmButton = nil
				h.onCharm = nil
				local function m(B)
					local g = G
					if not g then
						return
					end
					g = G
					g.Size = UDim2.fromScale(B, 1)
					g = q
					g.Position = UDim2.new(B, 0, 0.5, 0)
					g = i.current()
					local k = P.schema(g.weapon, g.skin)
					g = k and P.floatFromPercent(k, B * 100) or B
					local B, z = k and P.wearName(k, g) or "?", w
					z.Text = string.format("%s   %.4f", B, g)
				end
				local function B()
					local g = e
					if not g then
						return
					end
					local k, z = e.AbsolutePosition.X, e.AbsoluteSize.X
					if z <= 0 then
						return
					end
					g = p:GetMouseLocation().X
					local l = math.clamp((g - k) / z, 0, 1)
					m(l)
					z = i.current()
					g = P.schema(z.weapon, z.skin)
					if not g then
						return
					end
					i.setFloat(P.floatFromPercent(g, l * 100))
					i.refreshHeader()
				end
				h.syncWear = function()
					local g = i.current()
					local k = P.schema(g.weapon, g.skin)
					if not k then
						m(0)
						return
					end
					local z, l = P.floatRange(k)
					local k, D = tonumber(g.float) or z, l - z
					m(D > 0 and math.clamp((k - z) / D, 0, 1) or 0)
				end
				local function m()
					local g = i.current()
					return P.supportsStatTrak(P.schema(g.weapon, g.skin))
				end
				h.syncExtras = function()
					local g = Q
					if not g then
						return
					end
					local k, z, l = i.current(), m(), Y
					l.Visible = z and k.statTrak
					g = Y
					g.BackgroundColor3 = b.get()
					E.Text = z and "stattrak" or "stattrak  (not on stock)"
					g = E
					g.TextColor3 = z and b.get() or y.get("hint")
					Q.BackgroundTransparency = z and 0.15 or 0.6
					s.Visible = z
					z = s
					z.Text = tostring(k.kills or 0)
					z = s
					z.PlaceholderText = string.format("0 - %d", i.killCap())
					z = v
					z.Text = k.nameTag or ""
				end
				h.syncProxy = function()
					local g = R
					if not g then
						return
					end
					g = i.current().class == "Glove" and f.proxyOptions() or {}
					local k = #g > 0
					R.Visible = k
					local z, l = k and J.STRIP_H + A or 0, c
					l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, z)
					l = c
					l.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -z)
					if not k then
						return
					end
					J.fill(R, Z, g, function(g)
						if not f.setProxy(g) then
							return
						end
						for k, k in ipairs(Z) do
							k.setPicked(k.weapon ~= nil and k.weapon == g)
						end
					end, P.iconOf, f.proxy())
				end
				h.sync = function()
					pcall(h.syncWear)
					pcall(h.syncExtras)
					pcall(h.syncProxy)
					pcall(f.refreshHand)
				end
				local function f(P, g, k, z, l)
					local D = u.new(
						"TextLabel",
						{
							Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -A / 2, 0, 14),
							Position = UDim2.new(l * 0.5, l * (A / 2), 0, g),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							FontFace = I.face(),
							TextSize = 11,
							TextColor3 = b.get(),
							TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
							Text = k,
							ZIndex = F.SHEET_ART,
							Parent = P,
						}
					)
					if z then
						b.follow(D, "TextColor3")
					end
					return D
				end
				local function P(g, k, z, l)
					local D, K, C =
						u.new(
							"TextBox",
							{
								Size = k,
								Position = z,
								skin = { BackgroundColor3 = "field", TextColor3 = "body" },
								BackgroundTransparency = 0.15,
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								FontFace = I.face(),
								TextSize = 11,
								PlaceholderText = l,
								PlaceholderColor3 = y.get("hint"),
								TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
								ClearTextOnFocus = false,
								Text = "",
								ZIndex = F.SHEET_ART,
								Parent = g,
							}
						),
						u.new,
						{}
					C.CornerRadius, C.Parent = UDim.new(0, o.corner), D
					K("UICorner", C)
					k, g = u.new, {}
					g.PaddingLeft, g.Parent = UDim.new(0, 6), D
					k("UIPadding", g)
					return D
				end
				local function g(k)
					f(k, 0, "wear", true, 0)
					w = u.new(
						"TextLabel",
						{
							Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -A / 2, 0, 14),
							Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 14),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							FontFace = I.face(),
							TextSize = 11,
							skin = { TextColor3 = "text" },
							TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
							Text = "",
							ZIndex = F.SHEET_ART,
							Parent = k,
						}
					)
					e = u.new(
						"TextButton",
						{
							Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -A / 2, 0, 6),
							Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 34),
							skin = { BackgroundColor3 = "control" },
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							AutoButtonColor = false,
							Text = "",
							ZIndex = F.SHEET_ART,
							Parent = k,
						}
					)
					local z, l = u.new, {}
					l.CornerRadius, l.Parent = UDim.new(1, 0), e
					z("UICorner", l)
					G = b.follow(
						u.new(
							"Frame",
							{
								Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
								BackgroundColor3 = b.get(),
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								ZIndex = F.SHEET_ART + 1,
								Parent = e,
							}
						),
						"BackgroundColor3"
					)
					z, l = u.new, {}
					l.CornerRadius, l.Parent = UDim.new(1, 0), G
					z("UICorner", l)
					q = u.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10),
							AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
							Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0),
							skin = { BackgroundColor3 = "grab" },
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							ZIndex = F.SHEET_ART + 2,
							Parent = e,
						}
					)
					k, l = u.new, {}
					l.CornerRadius, l.Parent = UDim.new(1, 0), q
					k("UICorner", l)
					O.signal(e.InputBegan, function(k)
						if k.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
							return
						end
						H = true
						B()
					end, "skins/wear/down")
					O.signal(p.InputChanged, function(k)
						local z = H
						if not z then
							return
						end
						if k.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
							return
						end
						B()
					end, "skins/wear/move")
					O.signal(p.InputEnded, function(p)
						local B = p.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
						if B then
							H = false
						end
					end, "skins/wear/up")
				end
				local function p(B)
					E = f(B, 0, "stattrak", false, 1)
					Q = u.new(
						"TextButton",
						{
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(T, T),
							Position = UDim2.new(0.5, A / 2, 0, 16),
							skin = { BackgroundColor3 = "field" },
							BackgroundTransparency = 0.15,
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							AutoButtonColor = false,
							Text = "",
							ZIndex = F.SHEET_ART,
							Parent = B,
						}
					)
					local k, z = u.new, {}
					z.CornerRadius, z.Parent = UDim.new(0, o.corner), Q
					k("UICorner", z)
					Y = u.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(T - 8, T - 8),
							Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
							AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
							BackgroundColor3 = b.get(),
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							Visible = false,
							ZIndex = F.SHEET_ART + 1,
							Parent = Q,
						}
					)
					z, k = u.new, {}
					k.CornerRadius, k.Parent = UDim.new(0, 2), Y
					z("UICorner", k)
					O.signal(Q.MouseButton1Click, function()
						if not m() then
							return
						end
						i.setStatTrak(not i.current().statTrak)
						h.syncExtras()
					end, "skins/trak")
					s = P(
						B,
						UDim2.new(0.5, -(A / 2 + T + 6), 0, T),
						UDim2.new(0.5, A / 2 + T + 6, 0, 16),
						"kills"
					)
					O.signal(s.FocusLost, function()
						i.setKills(s.Text)
						h.syncExtras()
					end, "skins/kills")
				end
				local function b(m)
					f(m, r, "name tag", true, 0)
					v = P(m, UDim2.new(0.5, -A / 2, 0, T), UDim2.fromOffset(0, r + 16), "no name tag")
					O.signal(v:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"), function()
						local P = #v.Text > S
						if P then
							local P = v
							P.Text = P.Text:sub(1, S)
						end
					end, "skins/tag/type")
					O.signal(v.FocusLost, function()
						i.setNameTag(v.Text)
					end, "skins/tag")
				end
				local function P(S)
					f(S, r, "charm", true, 1)
					h.charmButton = u.new(
						"TextButton",
						{
							Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -A / 2, 0, T),
							Position = UDim2.new(0.5, A / 2, 0, r + 16),
							skin = { BackgroundColor3 = "field" },
							BackgroundTransparency = 0.15,
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							AutoButtonColor = false,
							FontFace = I.face(),
							TextSize = 11,
							TextColor3 = y.get("dim"),
							TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
							Text = "  none",
							ZIndex = F.SHEET_ART,
							Parent = S,
						}
					)
					u.new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, o.corner), Parent = h.charmButton })
					O.signal(h.charmButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
						if typeof(h.onCharm) == "function" then
							pcall(h.onCharm)
						end
					end, "skins/charm/open")
				end
				h.build = function()
					local O = i.settingsPane()
					if not O then
						return false
					end
					R = J.strip(O, UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, J.STRIP_H))
					R.Name = "Proxies"
					c = u.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "Adjust",
							Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							ZIndex = F.SHEET_BODY,
							Parent = O,
						}
					)
					g(c)
					p(c)
					b(c)
					P(c)
					return true
				end
				h.pane = function()
					local p = c
					return p
				end
				h.reset = function()
					c, R = nil, nil
					table.clear(Z)
					e, G, q, w, Q, Y, E, s, v, H = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, false
					h.charmButton = nil
					h.onCharm = nil
				end
				return h
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/skins/agent"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("services/agentrig")
				local O = p("ui/connect")
				local u = p("ui/create")
				local F = p("game/guard")
				local f = p("features/inventory")
				local o = p("core/log")
				local Z = p("services/loadout")
				local i = p("game/modules")
				local y, P = p("core/service"), p("services/skindb")
				local p, b, I, h, A, T, r, S, c, R, e =
					y.get("ReplicatedStorage"), {}, 1.5, 0.47, 1.53, { -0.5, 0.5 }, 6
				local y, G = false
				local q, w, H, Q, Y = 0
				local E = {}
				local function s(v, ...)
					if E[v] then
						return
					end
					E[v] = true
					o.warn("skins/agent", v, ...)
				end
				local o = CFrame.new(0, 0.2, -8) * CFrame.Angles(0, -3.141592653589793, 0)
				local v, m = CFrame.new(0, 0.025, 0.4), { CT = "Counter-Terrorists", T = "Terrorists" }
				local function B(...)
					local g, k = { ... }, (p:FindFirstChild("Assets"))
					for z, z in ipairs(g) do
						if not k then
							return nil
						end
						k = (k:FindFirstChild(z))
					end
					return k
				end
				local function g()
					local k = B("CharacterAnimations", "CharacterIdle")
					return k and k:IsA("Animation") and k.AnimationId or nil
				end
				local function k(z)
					local l = i.get("Database", "Custom", "GameStats", "Character", "Viewport")
					local D = typeof(l) == "table" and l.VIEWPORT_CHARACTER_CONFIG or nil
					if typeof(D) == "table" and typeof(D[z]) == "table" then
						return D[z]
					end
					l = J.TEAM_RIG[m[z] or ""]
					if not l then
						return nil
					end
					return { Character = l, CameraOffset = o, CharacterOffset = v, IdleAnimation = g() }
				end
				local function J(o)
					local v = p:FindFirstChild("Assets")
					v = v and (v:FindFirstChild("Characters"))
					if not v then
						return nil
					end
					local p = v:FindFirstChild(tostring(o.Character))
					if not p then
						return nil
					end
					return p:Clone()
				end
				local function p(o)
					local v = o:FindFirstChildOfClass("AnimationController")
						or o:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					v = if not v then u.new("AnimationController", { Parent = o }) else v
					return v:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or u.new("Animator", { Parent = v })
				end
				local function o(v, m)
					if typeof(m.IdleAnimation) ~= "string" then
						return
					end
					local g = p(v)
					if not g then
						return
					end
					v = u.new("Animation", { AnimationId = m.IdleAnimation })
					local m, z = pcall(g.LoadAnimation, g, v)
					if not m or not z then
						s("LoadAnimation failed, the agent stays still")
						return
					end
					z.Looped = true
					pcall(function()
						z:Play()
					end)
					R, e = z, nil
				end
				b.ready = function()
					local v = c ~= nil and c.Parent ~= nil
					return v
				end
				b.model = function()
					local v = c
					return v
				end
				b.attach = function(v)
					S = v
				end
				b.build = function(v)
					local m = S
					if not m then
						return
					end
					m = S
					for g, g in ipairs(m:GetChildren()) do
						g:Destroy()
					end
					R, e, w, H, Q, Y, c, y, G, q = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, false, nil, 0
					S.CurrentCamera = nil
					m = k(v)
					if not m then
						s("no viewport recipe for team key %q", tostring(v))
						return
					end
					v = J(m)
					if not v then
						s("Assets.Characters.%s does not exist", tostring(m.Character))
						return
					end
					local J = u.new("WorldModel", { Name = "CharacterWorldModel", Parent = S })
					v.Name = "ViewportCharacter"
					v.Parent = J
					v:PivotTo(m.CharacterOffset or CFrame.new())
					c = v
					o(v, m)
					J = m.CameraOffset or CFrame.new()
					v = u.new(
						"Camera",
						{
							Name = "ViewportCamera",
							CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable,
							FieldOfView = 50,
							CFrame = J * CFrame.new(0, -A, I),
							Parent = S,
						}
					)
					S.CurrentCamera = v
				end
				local function J()
					return i.get("Database", "Custom", "GameStats", "Character", "Attachments")
				end
				b.unarmed = function(o)
					local I = w and w.Parent or nil
					if I then
						w.Parent = nil
					end
					local A, v, m = pcall(o)
					if I then
						w.Parent = I
					end
					if not A then
						return nil
					end
					return v, m
				end
				b.drop = function()
					local o = w
					if o then
						pcall(function()
							w:Destroy()
						end)
						w = nil
					end
					H = nil
					o = Y
					if o then
						pcall(function()
							Y:Stop()
						end)
						Y = nil
					end
					o = c
					if not o then
						return
					end
					o = J()
					local I = {
						typeof(o) == "table" and o.DEFAULT_JOINT_PART or "RightHand",
						"UpperTorso",
						"LeftHand",
					}
					for o, A in ipairs(I) do
						o = c:FindFirstChild(A)
						if o then
							A = { "WeaponAttachment", "WeaponAttachmentHandleR", "WeaponAttachmentHandleL" }
							for I, I in ipairs(A) do
								local A = o:FindFirstChild(I)
								if A then
									pcall(function()
										A:Destroy()
									end)
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
				local function o(I)
					if I.PrimaryPart then
						return I.PrimaryPart
					end
					local A = I:FindFirstChild("Weapon")
					local v = A and A:FindFirstChild("Insert") or nil
					v = if not (if not v then (I:FindFirstChild("Insert", true)) else v)
						then (I:FindFirstChild("Handle", true))
						else if not v then (I:FindFirstChild("Insert", true)) else v
					if not v then
						for A, A in ipairs(I:GetDescendants()) do
							if A:IsA("BasePart") then
								v = A
								break
							end
						end
					else
					end
					return v
				end
				local function I(A)
					local v = A:FindFirstChild("Properties")
					if not v then
						local m = A:FindFirstChild("Weapon")
						v = if m then (m:FindFirstChild("Properties")) else v
					else
					end
					return if not v then (A:FindFirstChild("Properties", true)) else v
				end
				b.hold = function(A)
					local v = not c or typeof(A) ~= "table"
					if v then
						return
					end
					v = Z.selected()
					local m, g, k = P.equipped(v, A)
					if typeof(m) ~= "string" or m == "" then
						return
					end
					if P.classOf(m) == "Glove" then
						return
					end
					local z, l = m .. string.char(0) .. tostring(g), H
					if l == z then
						return
					end
					b.drop()
					l = i.get("Database", "Components", "Libraries", "Skins")
					if typeof(l) ~= "table" then
						return
					end
					if typeof(l.GetCharacterModel) ~= "function" then
						return
					end
					local D = P.get(v, m)
					local K, C =
						if D.statTrak and P.supportsStatTrak(P.schema(m, g))
							then math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(D.kills) or 0))
							else nil,
						if typeof(D.nameTag) == "string" and D.nameTag ~= "" then D.nameTag else nil
					local a, j = F.callAsGame(l.GetCharacterModel, m, g, k, K, C)
					if not a or typeof(j) ~= "Instance" then
						return
					end
					j.Name = m
					v = J()
					a = if typeof(v) == "table"
						then v.WEAPON_JOINT_PARTS and v.WEAPON_JOINT_PARTS[m] or v.DEFAULT_JOINT_PART
						else nil
					D = c:FindFirstChild(a or "RightHand")
					if not D then
						pcall(function()
							j:Destroy()
						end)
						return
					end
					k = o(j)
					if not k then
						pcall(function()
							j:Destroy()
						end)
						return
					end
					j.PrimaryPart = k
					for J, J in ipairs(j:GetDescendants()) do
						if J:IsA("BasePart") then
							J.CanCollide = false
							J.CanQuery = false
							J.CanTouch = false
							J.Anchored = false
							J.Massless = true
						end
					end
					local J = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					local o = J and J:IsA("BasePart") and J.CFrame or nil
					j.Parent = c
					a, g = I(j), u.new("Motor6D", { Name = "WeaponAttachment", Part0 = D, Part1 = k })
					if a then
						l, v = a:FindFirstChild("C0"), a:FindFirstChild("C1")
						if l then
							g.C0 = l.Value
						end
						if v then
							g.C1 = v.Value
						end
					end
					g.Parent = D
					if J and o then
						pcall(function()
							J.CFrame = o
						end)
					end
					w, H = j, z
					b.pose(m, A)
				end
				b.animationKind = function(J, o)
					if typeof(o) == "table" and o.Type == "Melee" then
						return "Melee"
					end
					if typeof(J) ~= "table" or J.Type == nil then
						return nil
					end
					if J.AimingOptions == "SniperScope" then
						return "Sniper"
					end
					if J.Type == "Heavy" then
						return J.MuzzleType == "MachineGun" and "LMG" or "Heavy"
					end
					if J.Type == "Equipment" and J.Class == "Grenade" then
						return "Grenade"
					end
					return ({ Pistol = "Pistol", Rifle = "Rifle", SMG = "SMG" })[J.Type]
				end
				local function J(o, I)
					local A = i.get("Database", "Custom", "GameStats", "Character", "Viewport")
					local v = typeof(A) == "table" and A.ANIMATION_MAPPING or nil
					if typeof(v) ~= "table" then
						return nil
					end
					A = b.animationKind(P.props(o), I)
					I = A and v[A] or nil
					if typeof(I) ~= "table" then
						return nil
					end
					return I[o] or I.Default
				end
				local function o(I)
					local A = B("WeaponAnimations", I, "CharacterAnimations", "Idle")
					return A and A:IsA("Animation") and A or nil
				end
				b.pose = function(I, A)
					local v = c
					if not v then
						return
					end
					v = o(I) or J(I, A)
					if typeof(v) ~= "Instance" then
						return
					end
					I = p(c)
					if not I then
						return
					end
					A = Y
					if A then
						pcall(function()
							Y:Stop()
						end)
						Y = nil
					end
					local p, J = pcall(I.LoadAnimation, I, v)
					if not p or not J then
						return
					end
					J.Looped = true
					J.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
					pcall(function()
						J:Play()
					end)
					Y = J
				end
				b.GLOVE_NAME = { ["Right Arm"] = "RightGlove", ["Left Arm"] = "LeftGlove" }
				b.GLOVE_JOINT = { ["Right Arm"] = "RightHand", ["Left Arm"] = "LeftHand" }
				b.GLOVE_BASE = CFrame.Angles(-1.5707963267948966, 0, 0)
				b.bare = function(p)
					p = p or c
					if not p then
						return 0
					end
					local J = 0
					for o, o in pairs(b.GLOVE_NAME) do
						local I = p:FindFirstChild(o)
						if I then
							pcall(function()
								I:Destroy()
							end)
							J += 1
						else
						end
					end
					return J
				end
				b.wear = function(p, J)
					J = J or c
					if not J then
						return 0
					end
					b.bare(J)
					local o = 0
					for I, A in ipairs(p) do
						I = A:IsA("BasePart") and b.GLOVE_JOINT[A.Name] or nil
						local p = I and J:FindFirstChild(I) or nil
						if p then
							I = A:Clone()
							I.Name = b.GLOVE_NAME[A.Name]
							I.CastShadow = false
							I.CanCollide = false
							I.CanTouch = false
							I.CanQuery = false
							I.Anchored = false
							local A, v, m =
								I:FindFirstChild("Scales"),
								I:FindFirstChild("Offsets"),
								I:FindFirstChild("Rotations")
							A, v, m =
								A and A:FindFirstChild("Character") or nil,
								v and v:FindFirstChild("Character") or nil,
								m and m:FindFirstChild("Character") or nil
							local B, g, k, z =
								A and A.Value or Vector3.new(1, 1, 1),
								v and v.Value or Vector3.new(0, 0, -0.025),
								m and m.Value or Vector3.new(0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
								u.new(
									"Motor6D",
									{ Name = "GloveAttachment", Part0 = p, Part1 = I, Parent = I }
								)
							I.Parent = J
							I.Size = B
							z.C0 = CFrame.new(g)
							z.C1 = I.PivotOffset
								* (b.GLOVE_BASE * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(k.X), math.rad(k.Y), math.rad(k.Z)))
							o += 1
						else
						end
					end
					return o
				end
				b.dress = function()
					local p = c
					if not p then
						return
					end
					local J = Z.selected()
					p = Z.gloves(J)
					if typeof(p) ~= "table" or typeof(p.Name) ~= "string" then
						local u = P.model(J, "Glove")
						p = typeof(u) == "string" and { Name = u } or nil
					else
					end
					if not p then
						return
					end
					local u, o, I = P.equipped(J, p)
					if typeof(u) ~= "string" or u == "" then
						return
					end
					local p, A = J .. string.char(0) .. u .. string.char(0) .. tostring(o), Q
					if A == p then
						return
					end
					local v = i.get("Database", "Components", "Libraries", "Skins")
					if typeof(v) ~= "table" or typeof(v.GetGloves) ~= "function" then
						return
					end

					local m, B = f.bypass(F.callAsGame, function()
						return v.GetGloves(u, o, I)
					end)
					A = not m or typeof(B) ~= "Instance"
					if A then
						O.thread(function()
							local F = c ~= i or Z.selected() ~= J
							if F then
								return
							end
							b.bare(i)
							Q = p
						end)
						return
					end
					O.thread(function()
						local O = c ~= i or Z.selected() ~= J
						if O then
							B:Destroy()
							return
						end
						O = b.wear(B:GetChildren(), i)
						B:Destroy()
						local J = O > 0
						if J then
							Q = p
							return
						end
						s("no glove piece matched (%s / %s)", u, tostring(o))
					end)
				end
				b.rest = function()
					b.dress()
					local p = Z.selected()
					local J = P.lastEdited(p)
					J = if typeof(J) ~= "string" or J == ""
						then p == "Terrorists" and "Glock-18" or "USP-S"
						else J
					b.hold({ Name = J })
				end
				b.forget = function()
					Q, H = nil, nil
				end
				local function p(J, O, u)
					local F = J.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(O)
					O = -F.Z
					if O <= 0.01 then
						return nil
					end
					local f, o = math.tan(math.rad(J.FieldOfView) * 0.5), u.X / math.max(u.Y, 1)
					local J, Z = F.X / (O * f * o) * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.5 - F.Y / (O * f) * 0.5
					return Vector2.new(J * u.X, Z * u.Y)
				end
				b.bounds = function()
					local J = S
					if not J then
						return nil
					end
					local O, u = S.CurrentCamera, S.AbsoluteSize
					J = not c or not c.Parent or not O or u.X <= 0 or u.Y <= 0
					if J then
						return nil
					end
					local J, F, f = pcall(function()
						local o = b.unarmed
						local function Z()
							local i = c
							return i:GetBoundingBox()
						end
						return o(Z)
					end)
					if not J or typeof(f) ~= "Vector3" then
						return nil
					end
					local J, o, Z, i, P = 0, 1 / 0, 1 / 0, -1 / 0, -1 / 0
					for I, I in ipairs(T) do
						for A, s in ipairs(T) do
							for v, v in ipairs(T) do
								A = p(O, (F * CFrame.new(f.X * I, f.Y * s, f.Z * v)).Position, u)
								if A then
									J += 1
									o, Z, i = math.min(o, A.X), math.min(Z, A.Y), math.max(i, A.X)
									P = math.max(P, A.Y)
								else
								end
							end
						end
					end
					if J == 0 then
						return nil
					end
					return o, Z, i, P
				end
				b.centre = function()
					local p = y or not S
					if p then
						return
					end
					p = S.AbsoluteSize
					if p.X <= 0 or p.Y <= 0 then
						return
					end
					local J = string.format("%dx%d", p.X, p.Y)
					p = J ~= G
					if p then
						G, q = J, 0
						return
					end
					q += 1
					J = q
					if J < r then
						return
					end
					local O = S.CurrentCamera
					p = not O or not c or not c.Parent
					if p then
						return
					end
					J, p = pcall(function()
						local u = b.unarmed
						local function F()
							local f = c
							return f:GetBoundingBox()
						end
						return u(F)
					end)
					if not J or typeof(p) ~= "CFrame" then
						return
					end
					y = true
					local J = O.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(p.Position).X + h
					if math.abs(J) < 0.01 then
						return
					end
					pcall(function()
						local p = c
						p:PivotTo(p:GetPivot() - O.CFrame.RightVector * J)
					end)
				end
				b.recentre = function()
					y, G, q = false, nil, 0
				end
				b.setPlaying = function(p)
					local J = not R or e == p
					if J then
						return
					end
					e = p
					pcall(function()
						R:AdjustSpeed(p and 1 or 0)
					end)
					J = Y
					if J then
						pcall(function()
							Y:AdjustSpeed(p and 1 or 0)
						end)
					end
				end
				b.reset = function()
					S, c, R, w, H, Q, Y, e, y, G, q = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, false, nil, 0
					table.clear(E)
				end
				return b
			end
end)()

				local function T(s, z, K, C)
					if K == "failed" then
						return C or "could not load", true
					end
					if K ~= "ready" then
						return nil, false
					end
					if z.source == A.FILE and not A.present(z.ref) then
						return "file is gone", true
					end
					if s.kind == u.PROP then
						return "prop", false
					end
					return nil, false
				end
				local function s(z, K)
					if typeof(z) ~= "number" or z <= 0 then
						return nil
					end
					local C, j = pcall(os.date, K, z)
					if not C or typeof(j) ~= "string" or j == "" then
						return nil
					end
					return string.lower(j)
				end
				local function z(K)
					local C = s(K.added, "%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S")
					local s, j
					if K.source == A.FILE then
						local N, hH = A.fingerprint(K.ref)
						if N then
							s, j = (string.sub(N, 1, 8)), "md5 " .. N
						else
							if hH == "pending" then
								s, j = "reading", "taking the md5 of " .. K.ref
							else
								s, j = "file", K.ref
							end
						end
					else
						if K.source == A.ASSET then
							s, j = "asset " .. K.ref, "marketplace asset " .. K.ref
						else
							s, j = "roblox user", "roblox user " .. K.ref
						end
					end
					return C and C .. "  \194\183  " .. s or s, C and j .. "  \194\183  added " .. C or j
				end
				local function s(K, C, j)
					K.row = C
					K.caption.Text = C.name
					local N, hH = z(C)
					local z, AH = A.request(C.source, C.ref)
					local SH = tostring(C.source) .. "|" .. tostring(C.ref) .. "|" .. tostring(z)
					if K.shown ~= SH then
						K.shown = SH
						if z == "ready" then
							local cH = A.clone(C.source, C.ref)
							K.kind = cH and u.kindOf(cH) or nil
							rH(K.viewport, cH)
						else
							K.kind = nil
							rH(K.viewport, nil)
						end
					end
					if K.state ~= z then
						K.state = z
						if K.ring and not K.savingNow then
							K.ring.Visible = z == "loading"
						end
					end
					SH = {}
					for rH, rH in ipairs((O.slotsOf(C.id))) do
						SH[rH] = true
					end
					local rH = 0
					for cH, RH in ipairs(O.SLOTS) do
						cH = K.marks and K.marks[RH.key]
						if cH then
							local eH = SH[RH.key] == true
							cH.Visible = eH
							if eH then
								cH.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(5 + rH * k, 4)
								rH += 1
							else
							end
						else
						end
					end
					K.meta.Text = N or ""
					K.saveShown = A.savable(C.source)
					SH, N = T(K, C, z, AH)
					C = rH * k
					K.badge.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(5 + C, 4)
					K.badge.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(10 + C), 0, 12)
					K.badge.Text = SH or ""
					K.badge.Visible = SH ~= nil
					K.badge.TextColor3 = N and S.get("danger") or e.get()
					K.why = N and AH or nil
					K.detail = hH
					K.paint(false)
					local T = TH(j)
					K.leaving = false
					if K.frame.Visible then
						F(K, "move", K.frame, r.move, { Position = T })
					else
						K.frame.Position = T + UDim2.fromOffset(r.enterFrom, 0)
						K.frame.Visible = true
						z = math.min(j, r.staggerMax) * r.stagger
						task.delay(z, function()
							if K.leaving then
								return
							end
							F(K, "move", K.frame, r.enter, { Position = T })
						end)
					end
				end
				yH = function()
					local T = L
					if not T then
						return
					end
					local k, z = O.list(), {}
					for K, C in ipairs(k) do
						z[C.id] = true
						T = M

						local N = not j
						if N then
							j = a(K)

							end
						else
						end

						end
					end

					local r = 0
					for Y, s in ipairs((A.scan())) do

							Y = string.gsub(s, "%.%w+$", "")

					SWEEP = TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				}
				local l = NumberSequence.new({
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, 1),
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.86),
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, 1),
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
				})
				local D = Vector2.new(-1.3, 0)
				local K = Vector2.new(1.3, 0)
				local C, a, j, V, N, W
				local U, _, x, d, L = {}
				local n, M = 0
				local t, X, pH, JH, OH, uH = 0, 0.5
				local FH, fH =
					0, { scale = nil, scrim = nil, host = nil, group = nil, on = false, tweens = {} }
				S.onScrimClick = nil
				S.onStep = nil
				local function oH(ZH, iH, yH, PH, bH)
					P.cancel(ZH.tweens[iH])
					ZH.tweens[iH] = P.to(yH, PH, bH)
				end
				S.gridBackdrop = function(P, ZH)
					ZH = ZH or {}
					local iH = ZH.zIndex or f.PANE
					local yH, PH, bH =
						F.new(
							"Frame",
							{
								Name = "Backdrop",
								Size = ZH.size or UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
								Position = ZH.position or UDim2.new(),
								skin = { BackgroundColor3 = "window" },
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								ClipsDescendants = true,
								ZIndex = iH,
								Parent = P,
							}
						),
						F.new,
						{}
					bH.CornerRadius, bH.Parent = UDim.new(0, e), yH
					PH("UICorner", bH)
					for e = 1, w, 1 do
						P = e * q
						F.new(
							"Frame",
							{
								Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0),
								Position = UDim2.fromOffset(P, 0),
								skin = { BackgroundColor3 = "surface" },
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								ZIndex = iH,
								Parent = yH,
							}
						)
						F.new(
							"Frame",
							{
								Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
								Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, P),
								skin = { BackgroundColor3 = "surface" },
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								ZIndex = iH,
								Parent = yH,
							}
						)
					end
					return yH
				end
				local function P()
					local e = not j or not a
					if e then
						return
					end
					e = a.AbsoluteSize
					if e.X <= 0 or e.Y <= 0 then
						return
					end
					local q = string.format("%s|%dx%d", tostring(M), e.X, e.Y)
					local w = q ~= pH
					if w then
						pH, JH, OH, uH, FH = q, nil, nil, nil, 0
					end
					q = os.clock()
					w = uH and q - uH >= v
					if w then
						return
					end
					w = FH
					if q < w then
						return
					end
					FH = q + s
					local w, w, s, s = J.bounds()
					if not w then
						return
					end
					local v, ZH = e.Y - R - H - Y, math.max(R, w - G)
					w = math.min(v, s + G)
					v = JH and JH <= ZH and OH and OH >= w
					if v then
						uH = uH or q
						return
					end
					uH = nil
					JH = math.min(JH or ZH, ZH)
					OH = math.max(OH or w, w)
					w = j
					w.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(R, math.floor(JH))
					q = j
					q.Size = UDim2.new(1, -R * 2, 0, math.ceil(OH - JH))
					q = V
					if q then
						v = V
						v.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(R, math.ceil(OH) + Y)
					end
				end
				local function e()
					return O.PAD * 2 + O.ICON + O.GAP
				end
				local function G(q)
					local w, Y = pcall(Instance.new, "GetTextBoundsParams")
					if not w or not Y then
						return nil
					end
					Y.Text = q
					Y.Font = T.face()
					Y.Size = O.TEXT_SIZE
					Y.Width = 1000
					q, w = pcall(function()
						return r:GetTextBoundsAsync(Y)
					end)
					if not q or not w then
						return nil
					end
					return e() + math.ceil(w.X)
				end
				local function r(q, w)
					local Y, s = q.picked, q.theme
					local v, ZH, iH, yH =
						Y and q.wide or q.narrow,
						Y and s.color or I.get("raised"),
						Y and O.PICKED or (q.hovered and O.HOVER or O.IDLE),
						(Y or q.hovered) and s.color or I.get("dim")
					if not w then
						q.frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(v, O.HEIGHT)
						q.frame.BackgroundColor3 = ZH
						q.frame.BackgroundTransparency = iH
						q.icon.ImageColor3 = yH
						q.label.TextColor3 = s.color
						q.label.TextTransparency = Y and 0 or 1
						return
					end

					bH.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(v, O.HEIGHT)
					oH(q, "size", w, PH, bH)
					oH(q, "bg", q.frame, O.IN, { BackgroundColor3 = ZH, BackgroundTransparency = iH })
					oH(q, "tint", q.icon, O.IN, { ImageColor3 = yH })
					yH, s, w = q.label, O.OPEN, {}
					w.TextTransparency = Y and 0 or 1
					oH(q, "text", yH, s, w)
				end

					local v = z[Y]
					if not v then
						return nil
					end

						F.new(
							"TextButton",

								LayoutOrder = s,
								ZIndex = f.BADGE,
								Parent = w,
							}
						),
						F.new,
						{}
					iH.CornerRadius, iH.Parent = UDim.new(0, O.CORNER), z
					ZH("UICorner", iH)
					local w = F.new(
						"ImageLabel",
						{
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(O.ICON, O.ICON),
							Position = UDim2.fromOffset(O.PAD + O.ICON / 2, O.HEIGHT / 2),
							AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Image = v.icon,
							ImageColor3 = I.get("dim"),
							ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
							ZIndex = f.BADGE + 1,
							Parent = z,
						}
					)
					local s, ZH =
						F.new(
							"TextLabel",
							{
								Size = UDim2.new(1, -(O.PAD * 2 + O.ICON + O.GAP), 1, 0),
								Position = UDim2.fromOffset(O.PAD + O.ICON + O.GAP, 0),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								FontFace = T.face(),
								TextSize = O.TEXT_SIZE,
								TextColor3 = v.color,
								TextTransparency = 1,
								TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
								Text = v.label,
								ZIndex = f.BADGE + 1,
								Parent = z,
							}
						),
						F.new(
							"Frame",
							{
								Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
								skin = { BackgroundColor3 = "rowGlow" },
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								ZIndex = f.BADGE + 2,
								Parent = z,
							}
						)
					local T =
						F.new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 18, Transparency = l, Offset = D, Parent = ZH })
					local l = {
						team = Y,
						theme = v,
						frame = z,
						icon = w,
						label = s,
						sheen = ZH,
						sheenGradient = T,
						narrow = O.PAD * 2 + O.ICON,
						wide = e() + math.ceil(#v.label * 7),
						picked = false,
						hovered = false,
						tweens = {},
					}
					u.thread(function()
						local e = G(v.label)
						if not e or e == l.wide then
							return
						end
						l.wide = e
						if l.picked then
							r(l, false)
						end
					end)
					local function e(G)
						local s, v, iH =
							G and O.ICON - O.PUNCH or O.ICON, G and O.PUNCH_DOWN or O.PUNCH_UP, {}
						iH.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(s, s)
						oH(l, "punch", w, v, iH)
					end
					local function G()
						T.Offset = D
						ZH.BackgroundTransparency = 0
						oH(l, "sheen", T, O.SWEEP, { Offset = K })
					end

						local T = fH
						if T.on then
							return
						end

						r(l, true)
					end, "skins/badge/enter")
					u.signal(z.MouseLeave, function()
						l.hovered = false
						e(false)
						r(l, true)
					end, "skins/badge/leave")

						local T = fH
						if T.on then
							return
						end
						e(true)
					end, "skins/badge/down")
					u.signal(z.MouseButton1Up, function()
						e(false)
					end, "skins/badge/up")
					u.signal(z.MouseButton1Click, function()
						local T = fH

							return
						end
						if not Z.select(Y) then
							return
						end
						G()
					end, "skins/badge/click")
					U[Y] = l
					return l
				end
				local function T(e)
					for G, w in pairs(U) do
						w.picked = G == Z.selected()
						r(w, e)
					end
				end
				local function e()
					if typeof(S.onStep) == "function" then
						S.onStep()
					end
					local G = os.clock()
					local w = G - n
					if w < E then
						return
					end
					n = G
					w, G = Z.selected(), N
					if G then
						N.team = w
					end
					G = W
					if G then
						W.team = w
					end
					h.paint(N, Z.gloves(w), "no glove")
					h.paint(W, Z.knife(w), "no knife")
				end
				S.showing = function()
					local G = o.main ~= nil
						and o.main.Visible
						and o.currentTab == C
						and (x == nil or x.Visible)
					return G
				end
				S.itemsShowing = function()
					local G = o.main ~= nil
						and o.main.Visible
						and o.currentTab == C
						and d ~= nil
						and d.Visible
					return G
				end
				S.agentsShowing = function()
					local G = o.main ~= nil
						and o.main.Visible
						and o.currentTab == C
						and L ~= nil
						and L.Visible
					return G
				end
				local function G()
					local w = a
					if not w then
						return
					end
					w = fH.on and x ~= nil and not x.Visible
					if w then
						S.pushBack(false)
					end
					w = o.main ~= nil and o.main.Visible and o.currentTab == C
					if w then
						A.step()
						h.step()
					end
					w = S.showing()
					J.setPlaying(w and not fH.on)
					if not w then
						return
					end
					w = k[Z.selected()] or "CT"
					local Y = w ~= M
					if Y then
						local Y = os.clock()
						local E = Y >= t
						if E then
							t = Y + X
							J.build(w)
							local Y = J.ready()
							if Y then
								M = w
								J.forget()
								u.thread(J.rest)
								pH = nil
								J.recentre()
							end
						end
					end
					w = fH.on
					if not w then
						J.centre()
						P()
					end
					e()
				end
				S.rightPane = function()
					local P = _
					return P
				end
				S.loadoutPane = function()
					local P = x
					return P
				end
				S.itemsPane = function()
					local P = d
					return P
				end
				S.agentsPane = function()
					local P = L
					return P
				end
				S.showRest = function()
					J.rest()
				end
				S.overlayHost = function()
					local P = fH
					return P.host
				end
				S.pushedBack = function()
					local P = fH
					return P.on
				end
				I.onChange(function()
					local P = fH
					if P.on then
						S.pushBack(true)
					end
				end)
				S.pushBack = function(P)
					local I = fH.on
					if I == P then
						return
					end
					I = not fH.scale or not fH.scrim or not fH.host
					if I then
						return
					end
					fH.on = P
					if P then
						fH.scrim.Visible = true
						fH.host.Visible = true
						h.each(function(e)
							if not e.aboveOverlay then
								h.setHover(e, false)
							end
						end)
						for e, e in pairs(U) do
							e.hovered = false
							r(e, true)
						end
					end
					I = fH
					local r, e, w = I.scale, b.TIME, {}
					w.Scale = P and b.SCALE or 1
					oH(I, "scale", r, e, w)
					w = fH
					e, I, r = w.scrim, b.TIME, {}
					r.BackgroundTransparency = P and B() or 1
					oH(w, "scrim", e, I, r)
					I = fH.group
					if I then
						oH(
							fH,
							"fade",
							fH.group,
							b.TIME,
							{ GroupTransparency = P and b.FADE or 0, GroupColor3 = P and m()
								or Color3.new(1, 1, 1) }
						)
					end
					if P then
						return
					end
					task.delay(b.TIME.Time, function()
						local P = fH
						if P.on then
							return
						end
						fH.scrim.Visible = false
						fH.host.Visible = false
					end)
				end
				S.build = function(P)
					if not P then
						return false
					end
					local I = P.columns[1]
					local r = I and I.main
					if not r then
						return false
					end
					C = P
					I = o.geometry
					o.sizeTab(P, S.WIDTH, S.HEIGHT)
					r.Size = UDim2.new(1, -2 * I.inset, 1, -(4 + o.footerHeight()))
					local o, e, w =
						F.new(
							"Frame",
							{
								Name = "SkinsCard",
								Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 1, -16),
								LayoutOrder = -1,
								skin = { BackgroundColor3 = "surface" },
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								ZIndex = f.CARD,
								Parent = r,
							}
						),
						F.new,
						{}
					w.CornerRadius, w.Parent = UDim.new(0, y.corner + 2), o
					e("UICorner", w)
					F.new("UIStroke", { Thickness = y.stroke, skin = "border", Parent = o })
					e = F.new(
						g and "CanvasGroup" or "Frame",
						{
							Name = "Content",
							Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
							Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
							AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							ZIndex = f.CARD,
							Parent = o,
						}
					)
					if g then
						fH.group = e
					end
					I = fH
					I.scale = F.new("UIScale", { Scale = 1, Parent = e })
					x = e
					d = F.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "Items",
							Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Visible = false,
							ZIndex = f.PANE,
							Parent = o,
						}
					)
					L = F.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "Agents",
							Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Visible = false,
							ZIndex = f.PANE,
							Parent = o,
						}
					)
					_ = F.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "Right",
							Size = UDim2.new(1 - c, -2, 1, -2),
							Position = UDim2.new(c, 1, 0, 1),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							ZIndex = f.PANE,
							Parent = e,
						}
					)
					P = F.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "Left",
							Size = UDim2.new(c, -2, 1, -2),
							Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							ZIndex = f.PANE,
							Parent = e,
						}
					)
					j = S.gridBackdrop(
						P,
						{ size = UDim2.new(1, -R * 2, 1, -R * 2), position = UDim2.fromOffset(R, R), zIndex = f.PANE }
					)
					V = F.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "Equipped",
							Size = UDim2.new(1, -R * 2, 0, H),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							ZIndex = f.PANE,
							Parent = P,
						}
					)
					w = UDim2.new(0.5, -Q / 2, 1, 0)
					N = h.new(V, w, UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0))
					W = h.new(V, w, UDim2.new(0.5, Q / 2, 0, 0))
					I, w, e =
						F.new(
							"Frame",
							{
								Name = "Teams",
								Size = UDim2.new(1, -(R + 6) * 2, 0, O.HEIGHT),
								Position = UDim2.fromOffset(R + 6, R + 6),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								ZIndex = f.BADGE,
								Parent = P,
							}
						),
						F.new,
						{
							FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
							SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
							VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
						}

					w("UIListLayout", e)

						q(I, y, O)
					end
					T(false)
					Z.onChange(function()
						T(true)
						n = 0
					end)
					a = F.new(
						"ViewportFrame",
						{
							Name = "Agent",
							Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 190),
							LightColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
							LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, -0.6),
							ZIndex = f.AGENT,
							Parent = P,
						}
					)
					J.attach(a)
					h.gate = S.pushedBack
					function h.onHover(O, Z)
						if not S.showing() then
							return
						end
						u.thread(function()
							if Z then
								J.hold(O.item)
							else
								J.rest()
							end
						end)
					end
					I = fH
					I.scrim = F.new(
						"TextButton",
						{
							Name = "Scrim",
							Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
							BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							AutoButtonColor = false,
							Text = "",
							Visible = false,
							ZIndex = f.SCRIM,
							Parent = o,
						}
					)
					u.signal(fH.scrim.MouseButton1Click, function()
						if typeof(S.onScrimClick) == "function" then
							pcall(S.onScrimClick)
						end
					end, "skins/scrim")
					e = fH
					e.host = F.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "Sheet",
							Size = UDim2.new(1, -b.INSET * 2, 1, -b.INSET * 2),
							Position = UDim2.fromOffset(b.INSET, b.INSET),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Visible = false,
							ZIndex = f.SHEET,
							Parent = o,
						}
					)
					local O = false
					u.signal(p.Heartbeat, function()
						local p, u = pcall(G)
						local F = not p and not O
						if F then
							O = true
							i.fail("skins/card", "frame step failed: %s", tostring(u))
						end
					end, "skins/card")
					return true
				end
				S.reset = function()
					a = nil
					J.reset()
					h.reset()
					A.reset()
					C, j, V, N, W, _, x, d, L, M, pH, JH, OH, uH, FH, n, t =
						nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, 0, 0, 0
					table.clear(U)
					fH = { scale = nil, scrim = nil, host = nil, group = nil, on = false, tweens = {} }
					S.onScrimClick = nil
					S.onStep = nil
				end
				return S
			end
end)()

return function(r33)
	local r5 = r33("services/caseodds")

				A.paint = function()
					local q, m = i.current().weapon, f.selected()
					local B, g = P.charmOf(m, q)

_registry["ui/skins/items"] = (function()

local Runtime = { [14] = table.pack }
function Runtime:oh(values) return table.unpack(values, 1, values.n) end
function Runtime:Wh(destination, offset, ...)
    local values = table.pack(...)
    table.move(values, 1, values.n, offset + 1, destination)
end
function Runtime:Lh(destination, offset, values)
    table.move(values, 1, values.n, offset + 1, destination)
    destination.n = offset + values.n
end

local p = Runtime

return function(J)
				local O = J("services/badgeequip")
				local u = J("ui/skins/card")
				local F = J("services/cases")
				local f = J("services/charminv")
				local o = J("services/collection")
				local Z = J("ui/connect")
				local i = J("ui/create")
				local y = J("services/fakeinv")
				local P = J("ui/icon")
				local b = J("features/inventory")
				local I = J("ui/skins/layer")
				local h = J("core/log")
				local A = J("ui/metrics")
				local T = J("ui/motion")
				local r, S = J("core/service"), J("ui/skin")
				local c = J("services/skindb")
				local R = J("ui/skins/slot")
				local e, G = J("ui/skins/style"), J("ui/theme")
				local q = J("ui/font")
				local w = J("services/woncharms")
				local H = J("services/wonskins")
				local J = r.get("RunService")
				local Q = r.get("TextService")
				local Y, E, s, v, m, B, g, k, z = r.get("UserInputService"), {}, 60, 8, 6, 28, 24, 14, 5
				local r, l, D, K, C, a, j = k + z * 2, 4, 6, 12, 6, 60, 80
				local V = r + l + (z * 2 + k + D + j)
				local N, W, U, _ =
					TweenInfo.new(0.24, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), 5, 104, 0.35
				local x, d, L, n, M, t, X, pH, JH, OH, uH, FH =
					e.ANIM,
					{ Stock = 1, Blue = 2, Purple = 3, Pink = 4, Red = 5, Special = 6, Forbidden = 7 },
					{
						{ label = "All", cat = nil },
						{ label = "Weapons", cat = "Weapon" },
						{ label = "Knives", cat = "Melee" },
						{ label = "Gloves", cat = "Glove" },
						{ label = "Charms", cat = "Charm" },
						{ label = "Cases", cat = "Case" },
						{ label = "Packages", cat = "Package" },
						{ label = "Capsules", cat = "Capsule" },
						{ label = "Badges", cat = "Badge" },
					},
					{ Weapon = true, Melee = true, Glove = true }
				local e, fH, oH, ZH, iH, yH, PH = {}, {}, {}, {}, ""
				local bH, IH = "name"
				local hH, AH = 0, false
				E.onAdd = nil
				E.onEdit = nil
				E.onOdds = nil
				local function TH(rH, SH, cH, RH, eH)
					T.cancel(rH.tweens[SH])
					rH.tweens[SH] = T.to(cH, RH, eH)
				end
				local rH = {
					Charm = true,
					Badge = true,
					Package = true,
					Case = true,
					["Charm Capsule"] = true,
					["Sticker Capsule"] = true,
				}
				local function SH(cH)
					local RH = typeof(cH.Type) == "string" and cH.Type or nil
					if RH and rH[RH] then
						if RH == "Case" or RH == "Package" then
							local rH = F.typeOf(cH.Skin)
							if rH then
								return rH
							end
						end
						return RH
					end
					return c.classOf(cH.Name) or "Weapon"
				end
				local function rH(cH)
					local RH = yH
					if RH == nil then
						return true
					end
					local RH, eH = SH(cH), yH
					if eH == "Capsule" then
						return RH == "Charm Capsule" or RH == "Sticker Capsule"
					end
					cH = yH
					return RH == cH
				end
				local function cH(RH)
					return n[SH(RH)] == true
				end
				local function RH(eH)
					local GH = c.schema(eH.Name, eH.Skin)
					return d[typeof(GH) == "table" and GH.rarity or nil] or 99
				end
				local function d(eH)
					return typeof(eH) == "table"
						and typeof(eH._id) == "string"
						and string.sub(eH._id, 1, 4) == "col|"
				end
				local function eH(GH)
					return typeof(GH) == "table"
						and typeof(GH._id) == "string"
						and string.sub(GH._id, 1, 4) == "won|"
				end
				local function GH(qH)
					if typeof(qH) ~= "table" then
						return
					end
					if eH(qH) then
						H.remove(y.wonIdOf(qH._id))
						pcall(b.pump)
					elseif qH.Type == "Charm" then
						local wH = y.wonCharmIdOf(qH._id)
						if wH then
							w.remove(wH)
						else
							f.remove(qH.Skin, qH.Pattern)
						end
						pcall(b.pump)
					elseif d(qH) then
						o.remove(SH(qH), qH.Skin, qH._count or 1)

				local function O(r, k)
					local z = SH(k)

						l, D = "", (c.rarityColor(nil))
						for C, V in ipairs(c.charms()) do
							if V.name == k.Skin then
								C = tonumber(k.Pattern) or V.patterns and V.patterns[1]
								l, D =
									V.images and C and V.images[C] or "", c.rarityColor({ rarity = V.rarity })
								break
							end
						end
					else
						if z == "Badge" then
							local z = c.schema("Badge", k.Skin)
							l, D = z and c.image(z, 0) or "", c.rarityColor(z)
						else
							local z = F.byName(k.Skin)
							local C = typeof(z) == "table" and z.caseRarity or nil
							D = F.rarityColor(C)
							l = typeof(z) == "table" and typeof(z.imageAssetId) == "string" and z.imageAssetId
								or ""
						end
					end
					R.setTexture(r, typeof(l) == "string" and l or "")
					r.caption.Text = tostring(k.Skin or k.Name or "")
					r.rarity.BackgroundColor3 = D
					S.unpaint(r.rarity)
					r.rarity.Visible = true
					r.charmIcon.Visible = false
					r.item = k
				end
				local r =
					{ Case = true, Package = true, ["Charm Capsule"] = true, ["Sticker Capsule"] = true, Badge = true }
				local function k()
					local z, l = {}, {}
					for D, D in pairs(y.union()) do
						table.insert(z, D)
						if r[D.Type] then
							l[SH(D) .. "|" .. tostring(D.Skin)] = true
						end
					end
					for D, D in ipairs(o.displayItems()) do
						if not l[tostring(D.Type) .. "|" .. tostring(D.Skin)] then
							table.insert(z, D)
						end
					end
					return z
				end
				local function z()
					local l, D, C, V, N = {}, iH:lower(), y.attachedCharmIds(), ipairs, p[14](k())
					for k, GH in V(p:oh(N)) do
						local p, QH =
							typeof(GH.Name) == "string" and GH.Name or "",
							GH.Type == "Charm" and C[GH._id] == true
						k = p ~= "" and not QH and rH(GH)
						if k then
							QH = PH == nil or p == PH
							if QH then
								local k = typeof(GH.Skin) == "string" and c.displayName(GH.Skin) or ""
								if
									D == ""
									or p:lower():find(D, 1, true) ~= nil
									or k:lower():find(D, 1, true) ~= nil
								then
									table.insert(l, GH)
								end
							end
						end
					end
					C, N = {}, {}
					for p, k in ipairs(l) do
						if r[k.Type] then
							p = tostring(k.Type) .. "|" .. tostring(k.Skin)
							V = N[p]
							if V then
								V._count = V._count + 1
							else
								V = {
									_id = "col|" .. tostring(k.Type) .. "|" .. tostring(k.Skin),
									Type = k.Type,
									Name = k.Name,
									Skin = k.Skin,
									_count = 1,
								}
								N[p] = V
								table.insert(C, V)
							end
						else
							table.insert(C, k)
						end
					end
					N = bH
					if N == "rarity" then
						table.sort(C, function(p, r)
							local k, l = RH(p), RH(r)
							if k == l then
								return tostring(p.Name) < tostring(r.Name)
							end
							return k > l
						end)
					else
						table.sort(C, function(p, r)
							local k, l = tostring(p.Name), tostring(r.Name)
							if k == l then
								return tostring(p.Skin) < tostring(r.Skin)
							end
							return k < l
						end)
					end
					return C
				end

				local function r()
					local k = yH
					local l = n[k] == true
					OH.Visible = l
					if not l then
						return
					end
					local D, C = {}, { "All" }
					for V, V in pairs(y.union()) do
						l = typeof(V.Name) == "string" and V.Name or ""
						if l ~= "" and SH(V) == k and not D[l] then
							D[l] = true
							table.insert(C, l)
						end
					end
					table.sort(C, function(y, V)
						if y == "All" ~= (V == "All") then
							return y == "All"
						end
						return y < V
					end)
					l = PH ~= nil and not D[PH]
					if l then
						PH = nil
					end
					for y, V in ipairs(C) do
						local N = oH[y]
						l = not N
						if l then
							N = w(OH, V, function()
								local l = N.frame.Text
								PH = l == "All" and nil or l
								r()
								p()
							end)
							oH[y] = N
						else
						end
						N.frame.Text = V
						N.frame.LayoutOrder = y
						N.frame.Visible = true
						N.setActive(V == "All" and PH == nil or V == PH)
					end
					D, k = #C + 1, #oH
					for y = D, k, 1 do
						oH[y].frame.Visible = false
					end
				end

					local k = B + m + g

					local l = uH
					l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, k)
					l = uH

					local k = uH

						return
					end
					r()

					local l, D = z(), {}
					for z, C in ipairs(l) do
						k = tostring(C._id)

							R.paint(N, C, nil, true)
						else
							O(N, C)

_registry["ui/skins/loadout"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/skins/card")
				local O = p("ui/connect")
				local u = p("ui/create")
				local F = p("ui/skins/layer")
				local f = p("services/loadout")
				local o = p("core/log")
				local Z, i = p("core/service"), p("ui/skins/slot")
				local y = p("ui/theme")
				local P = p("ui/font")
				local p, b, I, h, A, T, r, S, c, R, e, G =
					Z.get("RunService"),
					{},
					{ "Pistols", "Mid Tier", "Rifles" },
					5,
					6,
					8,
					18,
					13,
					0.35,
					{},
					0,
					false
				local function Z(q, w, H, Q, Y)
					local E = (H + Q + (w - 1) * Y) / w
					return 1 / w, -E, (q - 1) / w, H + (q - 1) * (Y - E)
				end
				local function q()
					if not J.showing() then
						return
					end
					local w = os.clock()
					local H = w - e
					if H < c then
						return
					end
					e = w
					H = f.selected()
					for c, Q in ipairs(I) do
						c = R[Q]
						if c then
							for Y = 1, h, 1 do
								w = f.weapon(H, Q, Y)
								c[Y].team = H
								local H, E = pcall(i.paint, c[Y], w, "empty")
								local c = not H and not G
								if c then
									G = true
									o.fail("skins/loadout", "%s %d: %s", Q, Y, tostring(E))
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
				b.build = function()
					local c = J.rightPane()
					if not c then
						return false
					end
					for J, w in ipairs(I) do
						local H, Q, Y, E = Z(J, #I, A, A, T)
						J = u.new(
							"Frame",
							{
								Name = w,
								Size = UDim2.new(H, Q, 1, -A * 2),
								Position = UDim2.new(Y, E, 0, A),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								ZIndex = F.PANE,
								Parent = c,
							}
						)
						y.follow(
							u.new(
								"TextLabel",
								{
									Name = "Header",
									Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, r),
									BackgroundTransparency = 1,
									FontFace = P.face(),
									TextSize = S,
									TextColor3 = y.get(),
									TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
									Text = w,
									ZIndex = F.ART,
									Parent = J,
								}
							),
							"TextColor3"
						)
						Q = {}
						for u = 1, h, 1 do
							local F, y, P, I = Z(u, h, r, 0, T)
							Q[u] = i.new(J, UDim2.new(1, 0, F, y), UDim2.new(0, 0, P, I))
						end
						R[w] = Q
					end
					f.onChange(function()
						e = 0
					end)
					O.signal(p.Heartbeat, function()
						local p, J = pcall(q)
						local O = not p and not G
						if O then
							G = true
							o.fail("skins/loadout", "sync failed: %s", tostring(J))
						end
					end, "skins/loadout")
					return true
				end
				b.reset = function()
					table.clear(R)
					e, G = 0, false
				end
				return b
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/skins/mannequin"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/create")
				local O = p("services/agentrig")
				local u = p("core/log")
				local F = p("game/modules")
				local f, o = p("services/modelsource"), {}
				local p = CFrame.new(0, 0.2, -8) * CFrame.Angles(0, -3.141592653589793, 0)
				local Z, i, y, P = CFrame.new(0, 0.025, 0.4), 0.85, 1.12, 40
				local b, I = Vector3.new(-0.34, 0.1, -1).Unit, 0.5
				local function h(A)
					local T = F.get("Database", "Custom", "GameStats", "Character", "Viewport")
					if typeof(T) ~= "table" then
						return nil
					end
					local F = T.VIEWPORT_CHARACTER_CONFIG
					if typeof(F) ~= "table" then
						return nil
					end
					return F[A == "Terrorists" and "T" or "CT"]
				end
				local function F(A)
					local T = A:FindFirstChildOfClass("AnimationController")
						or A:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					T = if not T then J.new("AnimationController", { Parent = A }) else T
					if not T then
						return nil
					end
					return T:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or J.new("Animator", { Parent = T })
				end
				local function A(T, r)
					if typeof(r) ~= "table" or typeof(r.IdleAnimation) ~= "string" then
						return nil
					end
					local S = F(T)
					if not S then
						return nil
					end
					T = J.new("Animation", { AnimationId = r.IdleAnimation })
					if not T then
						return nil
					end
					local F, r = pcall(S.LoadAnimation, S, T)
					if not F or not r then
						return nil
					end
					r.Looped = true
					pcall(function()
						r:Play()
					end)
					return r
				end
				o.new = function(F)
					if typeof(F) ~= "Instance" then
						return nil
					end
					return {
						viewport = F,
						world = nil,
						camera = nil,
						rig = nil,
						track = nil,
						team = nil,
						wantTeam = nil,
						framedX = nil,
						framedY = nil,
						framedBox = nil,
						agent = nil,
						source = nil,
						ref = nil,
						dressed = nil,
						nextTry = 0,
					}
				end
				local function F(T)
					if T.agent then
						O.drop(T.agent)
						T.agent = nil
					end
					T.dressed = nil
					T.track = nil
					T.rig = nil
					for r, r in ipairs(T.viewport:GetChildren()) do
						r:Destroy()
					end
					T.world = nil
					T.camera = nil
					T.viewport.CurrentCamera = nil
				end
				local function T(r)
					F(r)
					local S = r.wantTeam
					local c = O.templateFor(S)
					if not c then
						return false
					end
					local R = J.new("WorldModel", { Name = "Stage", Parent = r.viewport })
					if not R then
						pcall(function()
							c:Destroy()
						end)
						return false
					end
					local e = h(S)
					c.Name = "Rig"
					c.Parent = R
					pcall(function()
						c:PivotTo(typeof(e) == "table" and e.CharacterOffset or Z)
					end)
					local Z = J.new(
						"Camera",
						{
							Name = "Eye",
							CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable,
							FieldOfView = P,
							CFrame = typeof(e) == "table" and e.CameraOffset or p,
							Parent = r.viewport,
						}
					)
					if not Z then
						pcall(function()
							R:Destroy()
						end)
						return false
					end
					r.world = R
					r.camera = Z
					r.rig = c
					r.team = S
					r.viewport.CurrentCamera = Z
					r.framedX = nil
					r.framedY = nil
					r.framedBox = nil
					r.track = A(c, e)
					r.dressed = nil
					return true
				end
				local function p(J)
					local Z = J.viewport.AbsoluteSize
					if Z.X <= 0 or Z.Y <= 0 then
						return
					end
					local h, A, r = pcall(function()
						local S, c = J.rig:GetBoundingBox()
						return S, c
					end)
					if not h or not A or not r then
						return
					end
					h = math.floor(r.X * 10 + 0.5)
						+ math.floor(r.Y * 10 + 0.5) * 4096
						+ math.floor(r.Z * 10 + 0.5) * 16777216
					if J.framedX == Z.X and J.framedY == Z.Y and J.framedBox == h then
						return
					end
					J.framedX = Z.X
					J.framedY = Z.Y
					J.framedBox = h
					local S, c, R, e =
						math.max(r.Y * i, 0.1), math.max(r.X, r.Z, 0.1), math.tan(math.rad(P) / 2), Z.X / Z.Y
					h, Z =
						math.max(S * 0.5 / R, c * 0.5 / (R * e)) * y,
						A.Position + Vector3.new(0, r.Y * (0.5 - i * 0.5), 0)
					J.camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Z - b * h, Z)
				end
				o.setTeam = function(J, Z)
					if not J then
						return
					end
					if J.wantTeam == Z then
						return
					end
					J.wantTeam = Z
					J.nextTry = 0
				end
				o.setAgent = function(J, Z, i)
					if not J then
						return
					end
					if J.source == Z and J.ref == i then
						return
					end
					J.source = Z
					J.ref = i
					J.dressed = nil
					if J.agent then
						O.drop(J.agent)
						J.agent = nil
					end
				end
				o.kind = function(J)
					if not J or not J.agent then
						return nil
					end
					return J.agent.kind
				end
				o.step = function(J)
					if not J or not J.viewport or not J.viewport.Parent then
						return
					end
					if J.wantTeam == nil then
						return
					end
					if J.rig == nil or J.rig.Parent == nil or J.team ~= J.wantTeam then
						local Z = os.clock()
						if Z < J.nextTry then
							return
						end
						J.nextTry = Z + I
						if not T(J) then
							return
						end
					end
					p(J)
					if J.source == nil then
						if J.agent then
							O.drop(J.agent)
							J.agent = nil
							J.dressed = nil
						end
						return
					end
					if not J.agent then
						if f.request(J.source, J.ref) == "ready" and J.dressed ~= true then
							local p = f.clone(J.source, J.ref)
							if p then
								J.agent = O.apply(J.rig, p, J.world)
								J.dressed = true
								if not J.agent then
									u.warn("mannequin", "could not dress the %s rig", tostring(J.team))
								end
							end
						end
						return
					end
					if not O.step(J.agent) then
						O.drop(J.agent)
						J.agent = nil
						J.dressed = nil
					end
				end
				o.setPlaying = function(p, J)
					if not p or not p.track then
						return
					end
					pcall(function()
						if J then
							if not p.track.IsPlaying then
								p.track:Play()
							end
						else
							p.track:Stop()
						end
					end)
				end
				o.drop = function(p)
					if not p then
						return
					end
					F(p)
					p.viewport = nil
					p.wantTeam = nil
					p.team = nil
					p.source = nil
					p.ref = nil
				end
				return o
			end
end)()

					J("UIPadding", p)
					O.signal(s:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"), function()

						K = not K
						v.Text = K and "rarity  ^" or "rarity  v"
