					m = y(b, 0.38, 0.62, "grid", function()
						P(not z)
					end)
					p = S + c + e * 2
					B = u.new(
						"ScrollingFrame",
						{
							Name = "Skins",
							Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -p),
							Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, p),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							ScrollBarThickness = 3,
							skin = { ScrollBarImageColor3 = "hard" },
							CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
							ZIndex = F.SHEET_ART,
							Parent = b,
						}
					)
					function Z.onOpen()
						s.Text = ""
						D = ""
						h()
						o()
						if typeof(T.onOpen) == "function" then
							pcall(T.onOpen)
						end
					end
					return true
				end
				T.onOpen = nil
				T.reset = function()
					E, s, v, m, B = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
					table.clear(I)
					g, k, z, l, D, K = {}, nil, true, false, "", false
					T.onPick = nil
					T.onOpen = nil
				end
				return T
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/skins/preview"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/connect")
				local O = p("ui/create")
				local u = p("game/guard")
				local F = p("features/inventory")
				local f = p("ui/skins/layer")
				local o = p("services/loadout")
				local Z = p("ui/metrics")
				local i = p("game/modules")
				local y, P = p("core/service"), p("ui/skins/sheet")
				local b = p("ui/skin")
				local I = p("services/skindb")
				local h = p("ui/font")
				local p = y.get("ReplicatedStorage")
				local A, T, r, S, c, R, e, G, q, w, H, Q, Y, E, s =
					y.get("UserInputService"),
					{},
					1.35,
					40,
					9,
					0.009,
					1.3962634015954636,
					0.20943951023931956,
					0.12,
					0.45,
					2.4,
					2.2,
					0.55,
					1.5,
					70
				local function y(v)
					local m = v and v.Y > 0 and v.X / v.Y or 1
					return math.deg(2 * math.atan(math.tan(math.rad(s / 2)) / math.sqrt(1 + m * m)))
				end
				local s, v, m, B, g, k, z, l, D, K, C =
					2, 0.08, "NamePlate", { "FAMAS", "AK-47", "M4A1-S", "Glock-18", "USP-S" }
				local a, j, V = false
				local N, W, U, _, x, d, L = Vector3.zero, 10, 0, G, 1, false, false
				local n, M = Vector2.zero
				local t, X, pH = false, false, 0
				local function JH()
					return i.get("Database", "Components", "Libraries", "Skins")
				end
				local function OH(...)
					local uH, FH = { ... }, p
					for p, p in ipairs(uH) do
						FH = FH and (FH:FindFirstChild(p))
						if not FH then
							return nil
						end
					end
					return FH
				end
				local function p(uH)
					if typeof(uH) ~= "string" or uH == "" then
						return false
					end
					return OH("Assets", "Weapons", uH, "Camera") ~= nil
				end
				local function uH()
					local FH = D
					if FH then
						pcall(function()
							D:Destroy()
						end)
						D = nil
					end
					FH = l
					if FH then
						pcall(function()
							l:Destroy()
						end)
						l = nil
					end
					K, C, j, V = nil, nil, nil, nil
				end
				T.proxyOptions = function()
					local FH, fH = {}, { "Melee", "Weapon" }
					for oH, oH in ipairs(fH) do
						for fH, fH in ipairs(I.modelsOf(oH) or {}) do
							if p(fH) then
								table.insert(FH, fH)
							end
						end
					end
					return FH
				end
				local function FH(fH)
					local oH = p(M)
					if oH then
						local oH = M
						return oH
					end
					if typeof(fH.GetBaseWeaponModel) ~= "function" then
						return B[1]
					end
					for oH, ZH in ipairs(B) do
						oH = fH.GetBaseWeaponModel(ZH, "Camera")
						if oH then
							oH:Destroy()
							return ZH
						end
					end
					return B[1]
				end
				local function B(fH, oH, ZH, iH, yH)
					if typeof(fH.GetGloves) ~= "function" then
						return
					end
					if typeof(ZH) ~= "string" or ZH == "" then
						return
					end
					local PH = fH.GetGloves(ZH, iH, yH)
					if not PH then
						return
					end
					ZH = i.get("Database", "Components", "Common", "AttachGlovesToViewmodel")
					if typeof(ZH) == "function" then
						ZH(PH:GetChildren(), oH)
					end
					pcall(function()
						PH:Destroy()
					end)
				end
				local function fH()
					local oH = o.selected()
					local ZH, iH = o.gloves(oH), I.model(oH, "Glove")
					iH = if typeof(iH) ~= "string" or iH == ""
						then typeof(ZH) == "table" and ZH.Name or nil
						else iH
					if typeof(iH) ~= "string" or iH == "" then
						return nil
					end
					local yH, PH = I.get(oH, iH), typeof(ZH) == "table" and ZH.Name == iH
					local oH, bH =
						if typeof(yH.skin) == "string" and yH.skin ~= ""
							then yH.skin
							else if PH
									and typeof(ZH.Skin) == "string"
									and ZH.Skin ~= ""
								then ZH.Skin
								else nil,
						tonumber(yH.float)
					return iH, oH or "Stock", if not bH and PH then ZH.Float else bH
				end
				local function oH(ZH, iH)
					if o.selected() == "Counter-Terrorists" then
						local yH = i.get("Classes", "WeaponComponent", "Classes", "Viewmodel")
						if typeof(yH) == "table" and typeof(yH.attachSleeves) == "function" then
							pcall(yH.attachSleeves, { Model = ZH }, workspace:GetAttribute("CTCharacter"))
						end
					end
					local i = OH("Assets", "WeaponAnimations", iH, "CameraAnimations")
					K = i and i:FindFirstChild("Inspect") or nil
					iH = i and (i:FindFirstChild("Idle") or i:FindFirstChild("Equip"))
					C = iH or nil
					iH = ZH:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if iH and (iH:IsA("BasePart")) then
						iH.Transparency = 1
						iH.CastShadow = false
					end
					a = true
				end
				local function i(ZH, iH, yH, PH, bH, IH)
					if typeof(ZH.GetCameraModel) ~= "function" then
						return nil
					end
					local hH = ZH.GetCameraModel(iH, yH, PH, bH, nil, IH)
					if not hH then
						return nil
					end
					B(ZH, hH, fH())
					oH(hH, iH)
					return hH
				end
				local function fH(ZH, iH, yH, PH)
					if typeof(ZH.GetCameraModel) ~= "function" then
						return nil
					end
					local bH = FH(ZH)
					M = bH
					local FH = ZH.GetCameraModel(bH, "Stock")
					if not FH then
						return nil
					end
					B(ZH, FH, iH, yH, PH)
					oH(FH, bH)
					return FH
				end
				local function B(FH, oH)
					if not FH or typeof(oH) ~= "string" or oH == "" then
						return
					end
					local ZH = FH:FindFirstChild(m, true)
					if not ZH or not ZH:IsA("Attachment") then
						return
					end
					local m = OH("Assets", "Other", "NamePlate")
					if not m then
						return
					end
					local OH = m:Clone()
					OH:PivotTo(ZH.WorldCFrame)
					pcall(function()
						OH.Screen.SurfaceGui.TextLabel.Text = oH
					end)
					OH.Parent = FH
				end
				local function m()
					local OH = JH()
					local JH = P.current()
					if typeof(OH) ~= "table" or JH.weapon == "" then
						return nil
					end
					local FH = JH.weapon
					local oH = JH.float
					local ZH = JH.skin
					if typeof(ZH) ~= "string" or ZH == "" then
						ZH = "Stock"
					else
					end
					local iH, yH, PH = I.charmOf(o.selected(), FH)
					local o = JH.item
					local bH = iH and { _id = iH, Position = PH, Skin = iH, Pattern = yH }
						or (typeof(o) == "table" and o.Charm or nil)
					local yH = typeof(o) == "table" and o.Stickers or nil
					iH = I.schema(FH, ZH)
					local IH
					if JH.statTrak and I.supportsStatTrak(iH) then
						IH = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(JH.kills) or 0))
					else
					end
					PH = JH.nameTag ~= "" and JH.nameTag or nil
					a = false
					iH, o = F.bypass(u.callAsGame, function()
						if JH.class == "Glove" then
							return fH(OH, FH, ZH, oH)
						end
						local u = t and p(FH)
						if u then
							local I = i(OH, FH, ZH, oH, IH, bH)
							if I then
								return I
							end
						end
						if typeof(OH.GetWorldModel) == "function" then
							u = OH.GetWorldModel(FH, ZH, oH, IH, nil, bH, yH)
							if u then
								return u
							end
						end
						if typeof(OH.GetCharacterModel) == "function" then
							u = OH.GetCharacterModel(FH, ZH, oH, IH, nil, bH, yH)
							if u then
								return u
							end
						end
						if typeof(OH.GetBaseWeaponModel) == "function" then
							return OH.GetBaseWeaponModel(FH, "World")
								or OH.GetBaseWeaponModel(FH, "Character")
						end
						return nil
					end)
					if not iH or typeof(o) ~= "Instance" then
						return nil
					end
					B(o, PH)
					pcall(F.fitStatTrak, o)
					return o
				end
				local function u()
					local F = l
					if not F then
						return nil
					end
					F = l:FindFirstChild("Stats")
					if not F then
						return nil
					end
					local o = F:FindFirstChild("Default")
					local i = F:FindFirstChild("Rotation")
					if not o or not i then
						return nil
					end
					local F, I = pcall(function()
						local B = i.Value
						return CFrame.Angles(B.X, B.Y, B.Z) * CFrame.new(o.Value)
					end)
					if not F then
						return nil
					end
					return I
				end
				local function F()
					local o = l
					if not o then
						return
					end
					o = a
					if o then
						j = u()
						local u = j
						if u then
							local u = k and g
							if u then
								local u = k
								u.FieldOfView = y(g.AbsoluteSize)
							end
							return
						end
						a = false
					end
					o = k
					if o then
						k.FieldOfView = S
					end
					local u, o, i = pcall(function()
						local I, B = l:GetBoundingBox()
						return I, B
					end)
					if not u or not o or not i then
						return
					end
					N = o.Position
					W = i.Magnitude / 2 / math.tan(math.rad(S / 2)) * r
				end
				local function u()
					local o = l
					if not o then
						return
					end
					o = not K and not C
					if o then
						return
					end
					o = l:FindFirstChildOfClass("AnimationController")
					if not o then
						return
					end
					local i = o:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
					if not i then
						return
					end
					local function o(I)
						if not I then
							return nil
						end
						local r, B = pcall(function()
							return i:LoadAnimation(I)
						end)
						return r and B or nil
					end
					local i = o(C)
					if i then
						i.Looped = true
						i.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle
						pcall(function()
							i:Play()
						end)
					end
					local i = o(K)
					if not i then
						return
					end
					local o = l
					i.Looped = false
					i.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
					J.signal(i.Stopped, function()
						task.delay(s, function()
							local I = not P.isOpen() or l ~= o
							if I then
								return
							end
							pcall(function()
								i:Play()
							end)
						end)
					end, "skins/preview/gesture")
					pcall(function()
						i:Play()
					end)
				end
				local function o()
					uH()
					local i = m()
					if not i then
						return false
					end
					l = i
					i = K or C
					if i then
						D = O.new("WorldModel", { Name = "PreviewWorld", Parent = g })
						l.Parent = D
					else
						l.Parent = g
					end
					u()
					F()
					return true
				end
				local function u()
					return os.clock() % c / c * 3.141592653589793 * 2
				end
				local function F()
					local i = not k or not P.isOpen()
					if i then
						return
					end
					i = a
					if i then
						local I = j and l
						if I then
							pcall(l.PivotTo, l, j)
						end
						I = g
						if I then
							local r = g.AbsoluteSize
							local c = r.Y > 0 and r ~= V
							if c then
								V = r
								local c = k
								c.FieldOfView = y(r)
							end
						end
						I = k
						I.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 0, (x - 1) * Q)
						return
					end
					i = d and U or u()
					local y, I =
						CFrame.Angles(0, i, 0) * CFrame.Angles(-_, 0, 0) * Vector3.new(0, 0, W * x), k
					I.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(N + y, N)
				end
				local function i()
					local y = g
					if not y then
						return false
					end
					local y, I, r = g.AbsolutePosition, g.AbsoluteSize, A:GetMouseLocation()
					return r.X >= y.X and r.X <= y.X + I.X and r.Y >= y.Y and r.Y <= y.Y + I.Y
				end
				local function y()
					J.signal(g.InputBegan, function(I)
						if not P.isOpen() then
							return
						end
						local r = a
						if r then
							return
						end
						if I.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
							return
						end
						r = not d
						if r then
							U, d = u(), true
						end
						L = true
						n = A:GetMouseLocation()
					end, "skins/preview/down")
					J.signal(A.InputChanged, function(u)
						if not P.isOpen() then
							return
						end
						local I = u.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel
						if I then
							if not i() then
								return
							end
							local i, r, c, Q = a and Y or w, a and E or H, math.clamp, x
							x = c(Q - u.Position.Z * q, i, r)
							return
						end
						I = L
						if not I then
							return
						end
						if u.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
							return
						end
						I = A:GetMouseLocation()
						u = I - n
						n = I
						I = U
						U = I - u.X * R
						local i, I = math.clamp, _
						_ = i(I - u.Y * R, -e, e)
					end, "skins/preview/move")
					J.signal(A.InputEnded, function(u)
						local i = u.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
						if i then
							L = false
						end
					end, "skins/preview/up")
				end
				T.invalidate = function()
					X = true
				end
				T.proxy = function()
					local u = M
					return u
				end
				T.canHandHold = function()
					local u = P.current()
					return u.class ~= "Glove" and p(u.weapon)
				end
				T.handHeld = function()
					local u = t
					return u
				end
				T.setHandHeld = function(u)
					u = u == true
					local i = t
					if i == u then
						return false
					end
					t = u
					T.invalidate()
					return true
				end
				T.setProxy = function(u)
					if typeof(u) ~= "string" or u == "" then
						return false
					end
					local i = M
					if u == i then
						return false
					end
					if P.current().class ~= "Glove" then
						return false
					end
					if not p(u) then
						return false
					end
					M = u
					T.invalidate()
					return true
				end
				T.refreshHand = function()
					local p = z
					if not p then
						return
					end
					p = T.canHandHold()
					z.Visible = p
					if not p then
						return
					end
					z.Text = t and "view model" or "free look"
				end
				T.recentre = function()
					U, _, x, d, L = 0, G, 1, false, false
					local p = k
					if p then
						k.FieldOfView = S
					end
				end
				T.build = function()
					local p = P.previewPane()
					if not p then
						return false
					end
					g = O.new(
						"ViewportFrame",
						{
							Name = "Weapon",
							Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, P.VIEW_RATIO, -4),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							Active = true,
							Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 190),
							LightColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
							LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, -0.6),
							ZIndex = f.SHEET_ART,
							Parent = p,
						}
					)
					k = O.new("Camera", { FieldOfView = S, Parent = g })
					g.CurrentCamera = k
					z = O.new(
						"TextButton",
						{
							Name = "Hand",
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(78, 18),
							Position = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 6),
							AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
							skin = { BackgroundColor3 = "raised" },
							BackgroundTransparency = 0.15,
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							AutoButtonColor = false,
							FontFace = h.face(),
							TextSize = 11,
							TextColor3 = b.get("dim"),
							Text = "free look",
							Visible = false,
							ZIndex = f.SHEET_TOP,
							Parent = p,
						}
					)
					local p, u = O.new, {}
					u.CornerRadius, u.Parent = UDim.new(0, Z.corner), z
					p("UICorner", u)
					J.signal(z.MouseEnter, function()
						local p = z
						p.TextColor3 = b.get("text")
					end, "skins/preview/hand-in")
					J.signal(z.MouseLeave, function()
						local p = z
						p.TextColor3 = b.get("dim")
					end, "skins/preview/hand-out")
					J.signal(z.MouseButton1Click, function()
						local p = T.setHandHeld(not t)
						if not p then
							return
						end
						T.refreshHand()
					end, "skins/preview/hand")
					y()
					return true
				end
				T.step = function()
					local p = g
					if not p then
						return
					end
					p = X and os.clock() - pH >= v
					if p then
						X = false
						pH = os.clock()
						pcall(o)
						pcall(P.refreshHeader)
					end
					pcall(F)
				end
				T.reset = function()
					uH()
					g, k, z, a, j, V = nil, nil, nil, false, nil, nil
					N, W, U, _, x, d, L, M, t, X, pH =
						Vector3.new(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), 10, 0, G, 1, false, false, nil, false, false, 0
				end
				return T
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/skins/sheet"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/skins/card")
				local O = p("ui/connect")
				local u = p("ui/create")
				local F = p("features/inventory")
				local f = p("ui/skins/layer")
				local o = p("services/loadout")
				local Z = p("core/log")
				local i = p("ui/skin")
				local y = p("services/skindb")
				local P = p("ui/skins/slot")
				local b, I, h, A, T = p("ui/font"), {}, 30, 8, 0.4
				I.VIEW_RATIO = 0.6
				local p, r, S, c, R, e, G
				local q, w =
					false,
					{ item = nil, weapon = "", class = nil, skin = "Stock", float = nil, statTrak = false, kills = 0, nameTag = "" }
				I.onOpen = nil
				I.onChange = nil
				I.listPane = function()
					local H = c
					return H
				end
				I.settingsPane = function()
					local H = R
					return H
				end
				I.previewPane = function()
					local H = e
					return H
				end
				I.isOpen = function()
					local H = q
					return H
				end
				I.bodyPane = function()
					local H = G
					return H
				end
				I.current = function()
					local H = {
						item = w.item,
						weapon = w.weapon,
						class = w.class,
						skin = w.skin,
						float = w.float,
						statTrak = w.statTrak,
						kills = w.kills,
						nameTag = w.nameTag,
					}
					return H
				end
				I.invalidate = function()
					O.thread(function()
						if typeof(I.onChange) == "function" then
							pcall(I.onChange)
						end
						pcall(J.showRest)
					end)
				end
				I.setSkin = function(H)
					if typeof(H) ~= "string" or H == "" then
						return
					end
					local Q = y.isReleased(o.selected(), w.weapon)
					local Y = H == w.skin and not Q
					if Y then
						return
					end
					w.skin = H
					Q = y.schema(w.weapon, H)
					if Q then
						Y = w
						Y.float = y.floatRange(Q)
					end
					Q = o.selected()
					y.set(Q, w.weapon, "skin", H)
					y.set(Q, w.weapon, "float", w.float)
					y.setReleased(Q, w.weapon, false)
					Y = w.class == "Melee" or w.class == "Glove"
					if Y then
						y.setModel(Q, w.class, w.weapon)
					end
					y.setLastEdited(Q, w.weapon)
					pcall(F.pump)
					I.invalidate()
				end
				I.setFloat = function(H)
					if typeof(H) ~= "number" then
						return
					end
					w.float = H
					y.set(o.selected(), w.weapon, "float", H)
					I.invalidate()
				end
				I.setStatTrak = function(H)
					w.statTrak = H and true or false
					y.set(o.selected(), w.weapon, "statTrak", w.statTrak)
					I.invalidate()
				end
				I.killCap = function()
					local H = y.classOf(w.weapon) == "Melee" and 9999 or 999999
					return H
				end
				I.setKills = function(H)
					local Q = w
					Q.kills = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(H) or 0), 0, I.killCap())
					y.set(o.selected(), w.weapon, "kills", w.kills)
					I.invalidate()
				end
				I.setNameTag = function(H)
					local Q = w
					Q.nameTag = typeof(H) == "string" and H or ""
					y.set(o.selected(), w.weapon, "nameTag", w.nameTag ~= "" and w.nameTag or nil)
					I.invalidate()
				end
				I.setCharm = function(H, Q)
					local Y, E = o.selected(), typeof(H) == "string" and H ~= ""
					y.set(Y, w.weapon, "charm", E and H or nil)
					local H, s, v = y.set, w.weapon, E and (tonumber(Q) or 1)
					H(Y, s, "charmPattern", v or nil)
					I.invalidate()
				end
				I.setCharmSlot = function(H)
					H = tonumber(H)
					y.set(o.selected(), w.weapon, "charmSlot", H and H ~= 1 and H or nil)
					I.invalidate()
				end
				local function H(Q)
					local Y, E, s =
						y.get(o.selected(), w.weapon), typeof(Q) == "table" and Q.Name == w.weapon, w
					s.skin = (
						if typeof(Y.skin) == "string" and Y.skin ~= ""
							then Y.skin
							else if E
									and typeof(Q.Skin) == "string"
									and Q.Skin ~= ""
								then Q.Skin
								else nil
					) or y.defaultSkin(w.weapon)
					s = tonumber(Y.float)
					if s then
						local v = w
						v.float = tonumber(Y.float)
					elseif E then
						local v = w
						v.float = Q.Float
					else
						w.float = nil
					end
					s = w
					s.statTrak = Y.statTrak == true
					Q = w
					Q.kills = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(Y.kills) or 0), 0, I.killCap())
					E = w
					E.nameTag = typeof(Y.nameTag) == "string" and Y.nameTag or ""
				end
				I.setModel = function(Q)
					if typeof(Q) ~= "string" or Q == "" then
						return false
					end
					local Y = w.weapon
					if Q == Y then
						return false
					end
					Y = w.class
					if Y ~= "Melee" and Y ~= "Glove" then
						return false
					end
					w.weapon = Q
					y.setModel(o.selected(), Y, Q)
					y.setReleased(o.selected(), Q, false)
					pcall(F.pump)
					H(w.item)
					I.invalidate()
					return true
				end
				local function F()
					local Q = r
					if not Q then
						return
					end
					Q = r
					Q.Text = w.weapon
					Q = y.schema(w.weapon, w.skin)
					local Y, E = Q and y.wearName(Q, w.float) or nil, S
					E.Text = Y and ("%s   %s"):format(y.displayName(w.skin), Y) or y.displayName(w.skin)
				end
				I.refreshHeader = function()
					pcall(F)
				end
				I.close = function()
					local Q = q
					if not Q then
						return
					end
					q = false
					J.pushBack(false)
				end
				I.open = function(Q)
					local Y = p
					if not Y then
						Z.warn("skins/sheet", "the layer was never built")
						return false
					end
					if typeof(Q) ~= "table" then
						Z.warn("skins/sheet", "empty slot")
						return false
					end
					Y = tostring(Q.Name or "")
					if Y == "" then
						Z.warn("skins/sheet", "item without a name")
						return false
					end
					w.item = Q
					local Z = w
					Z.class = y.classOf(Y)
					local Z, E = w.class == "Melee" or w.class == "Glove", w
					E.weapon = Z and y.model(o.selected(), w.class) or Y
					H(Q)
					F()
					q = true
					J.pushBack(true)
					I.invalidate()
					if typeof(I.onOpen) == "function" then
						pcall(I.onOpen)
					end
					return true
				end
				I.build = function()
					p = J.overlayHost()
					local F = p
					if not F then
						return false
					end
					r = u.new(
						"TextLabel",
						{
							Name = "Title",
							Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 17),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							FontFace = b.face(),
							TextSize = 15,
							skin = { TextColor3 = "text" },
							TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
							Text = "",
							ZIndex = f.SHEET,
							Parent = p,
						}
					)
					S = u.new(
						"TextLabel",
						{
							Name = "Subtitle",
							Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 13),
							Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 16),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							FontFace = b.face(),
							TextSize = 11,
							skin = { TextColor3 = "muted" },
							TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
							Text = "",
							ZIndex = f.SHEET,
							Parent = p,
						}
					)
					local o = u.new(
						"TextButton",
						{
							Name = "Close",
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22),
							Position = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0, 0),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							AutoButtonColor = false,
							FontFace = b.face(),
							TextSize = 18,
							skin = { TextColor3 = "dim" },
							Text = utf8.char(215),
							ZIndex = f.SHEET,
							Parent = p,
						}
					)
					O.signal(o.MouseEnter, function()
						o.TextColor3 = i.get("text")
					end, "skins/sheet/close-in")
					O.signal(o.MouseLeave, function()
						o.TextColor3 = i.get("dim")
					end, "skins/sheet/close-out")
					O.signal(o.MouseButton1Click, I.close, "skins/sheet/close")
					F = u.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "Body",
							Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -h),
							Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, h),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							ZIndex = f.SHEET_BODY,
							Parent = p,
						}
					)
					G = F
					c = u.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "List",
							Size = UDim2.new(T, -A / 2, 1, 0),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							ZIndex = f.SHEET_BODY,
							Parent = F,
						}
					)
					e = u.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "Preview",
							Size = UDim2.new(1 - T, -A / 2, 1, 0),
							Position = UDim2.new(T, A / 2, 0, 0),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							ZIndex = f.SHEET_BODY,
							Parent = F,
						}
					)
					J.gridBackdrop(e, { size = UDim2.new(1, 0, I.VIEW_RATIO, -A / 2), zIndex = f.SHEET_BODY })
					R = u.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "Settings",
							Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1 - I.VIEW_RATIO, -A / 2),
							Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, I.VIEW_RATIO, A / 2),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							ZIndex = f.SHEET_BODY,
							Parent = e,
						}
					)
					J.onScrimClick = nil
					P.each(function(J)
						J.onClick = function(J)
							I.open(J.item)
						end
					end)
					return true
				end
				I.reset = function()
					p, r, S, c, R, e, G, q, w =
						nil,
						nil,
						nil,
						nil,
						nil,
						nil,
						nil,
						false,
						{
							item = nil,
							weapon = "",
							class = nil,
							skin = "Stock",
							float = nil,
							statTrak = false,
							kills = 0,
							nameTag = "",
						}
					I.onOpen = nil
					I.onChange = nil
				end
				return I
			end
end)()

					local f, A, T, q, w, H, Q =

_registry["ui/skins/spinner"] = (function()

local Runtime = { [14] = table.pack }
function Runtime:oh(values) return table.unpack(values, 1, values.n) end
function Runtime:Wh(destination, offset, ...)
    local values = table.pack(...)
    table.move(values, 1, values.n, offset + 1, destination)
end
function Runtime:Lh(destination, offset, values)
    table.move(values, 1, values.n, offset + 1, destination)
    destination.n = offset + values.n
end

local p = Runtime

return function(J)
				local O = J("ui/connect")
				local u = J("ui/create")
				local F = J("core/log")
				local f = J("ui/ring")
				local o, Z = J("core/service"), J("ui/theme")
				local J, i, y, P, b, I =
					o.get("AssetService"),
					{ ARC = 0.25, SPEED = 1.15, GRACE = 0.12, TIMEOUT = 8, RESCUE_MAX = 24, PROOF = 1 },
					{},
					0,
					{}
				local o = {}
				local function h(A)
					local T = I ~= nil
					if T then
						local r = I
						return r
					end
					T = f.new(A, i.ARC)
					A = not T
					if A then
						I = false
						return false
					end
					f.paint(T, i.ARC)
					I = T
					T = I
					return T
				end
				i.new = function(f, A)
					A = A or {}
					local T = A.side or 22
					local r = h(T)
					if not r then
						return nil
					end
					local h = {
						label = Z.follow(
							u.new(
								"ImageLabel",
								{
									Name = "Spinner",
									Size = UDim2.fromOffset(T, T),
									Position = A.position or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
									AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
									BackgroundTransparency = 1,
									ImageContent = r.content,
									ImageColor3 = Z.get(),
									Visible = false,
									ZIndex = A.zIndex or 1,
									Parent = f,
								}
							),
							"ImageColor3"
						),
						watch = A.watch,
						mirror = A.mirror,
						pending = nil,
						texture = nil,
						tried = false,
					}
					table.insert(o, h)
					return h
				end
				local function u(f, Z)
					f.watch.ImageContent = Z.content
					if f.mirror then
						f.mirror.ImageContent = Z.content
					end
					f.pending = nil
					f.label.Visible = false
				end
				i.begin = function(f, Z)
					if not f then
						return
					end
					f.texture = Z
					f.tried = false
					f.label.Visible = false
					local h = Z and y[Z]
					if h then
						u(f, h)
						return
					end
					f.pending = Z ~= nil and Z ~= "" and os.clock() or nil
				end
				local function f(Z)
					return typeof(Z) == "string" and Z:match("^rbxassetid://%d") ~= nil
				end
				local function Z(h)
					local A = h
					while A do
						if A:IsA("LayerCollector") then
							return A.Enabled
						end
						if A:IsA("GuiObject") and not A.Visible then
							return false
						end
						A = A.Parent
					end
					return false
				end
				local function h(A)
					local T = A.texture
					if typeof(T) ~= "string" or T == "" then
						return
					end
					if b[T] then
						return
					end
					if not f(T) then
						return
					end
					if y[T] then
						u(A, y[T])
						return
					end
					local f = P
					if f >= i.RESCUE_MAX then
						F.warn(
							"skins/spinner",
							"rescue cap reached (%d), leaving %s spinning",
							i.RESCUE_MAX,
							T
						)
						return
					end
					P += 1
					O.thread(function()
						local O, f = pcall(function()
							local r = p[14](Content.fromUri(T))
							return J:CreateEditableImageAsync(p:oh(r))
						end)
						if not O or not f then
							F.warn("skins/spinner", "rescue failed for %s: %s", T, tostring(f))
							return
						end
						local p, J = pcall(function()
							return Content.fromObject(f)
						end)
						if not p or not J then
							return
						end
						y[T] = { image = f, content = J }
						if A.texture ~= T then
							return
						end
						u(A, y[T])
						i.prove(T)
					end)
				end
				i.prove = function(p)
					task.delay(i.PROOF, function()
						if b[p] then
							return
						end
						local J, O = false, false
						for u, u in ipairs(o) do
							if u.texture == p then
								J = true
								if u.watch and u.watch.IsLoaded then
									O = true
									break
								end
							else
							end
						end
						if not J or O then
							return
						end
						b[p] = true
						y[p] = nil
						F.warn(
							"skins/spinner",
							"o resgate de %s nao desenhou; voltando para a rota de textura",
							p
						)
						for J, J in ipairs(o) do
							if J.texture == p and J.watch then
								J.watch.Image = p
								if J.mirror then
									J.mirror.Image = p
								end
								J.pending = os.clock()
								J.tried = true
							end
						end
					end)
				end
				i.stop = function(p)
					if not p then
						return
					end
					p.pending = nil
					p.label.Visible = false
				end
				i.drop = function(p)
					if not p then
						return
					end
					for J = #o, 1, -1 do
						if o[J] == p then
							table.remove(o, J)
						end
					end
				end
				i.spin = function(p, J)
					if not p then
						return
					end
					p.free = J and true or nil
					p.label.Visible = J and true or false
				end
				i.step = function()
					local p = os.clock()
					local J = p * i.SPEED * 360 % 360
					for O, u in ipairs(o) do
						O = u.watch
						if u.free then
							if u.label.Visible then
								u.label.Rotation = J
							end
						elseif u.pending and O then
							local F, f = p - u.pending, O.IsLoaded
							local b = F >= i.GRACE and not f
							if b ~= u.label.Visible then
								u.label.Visible = b
							end
							if b then
								u.label.Rotation = J
							end
							if f then
								u.pending = nil
							elseif not u.tried and F >= i.TIMEOUT then
								if not Z(O) then
									u.pending = p
								else
									u.tried = true
									h(u)
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
				i.reset = function()
					table.clear(o)
					table.clear(y)
					P, I = 0, nil
				end
				return i
			end
end)()

function Runtime:oh(values) return table.unpack(values, 1, values.n) end
function Runtime:Wh(destination, offset, ...)
    local values = table.pack(...)
    table.move(values, 1, values.n, offset + 1, destination)
end
function Runtime:Lh(destination, offset, values)
    table.move(values, 1, values.n, offset + 1, destination)
    destination.n = offset + values.n
end

_registry["ui/theme"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local p, J, O = {}, setmetatable, { __mode = "k" }
				local u, F = J({}, O), {}
				local J = Color3.fromRGB(255, 125, 247)
				local function O(f, o, Z)
					if typeof(o) == "function" then
						pcall(o, f, Z)
					else
						pcall(function()
							f[o] = Z
						end)
					end
				end
				p.follow = function(f, o)
					if not f or not o then
						return f
					end
					u[f] = o
					O(f, o, J)
					return f
				end
				p.unfollow = function(f)
					if f then
						u[f] = nil
					end
				end
				p.onChange = function(f)
					if typeof(f) ~= "function" then
						return function() end
					end
					table.insert(F, f)
					return function()
						for o, Z in ipairs(F) do
							if Z == f then
								table.remove(F, o)
								return
							end
						end
					end
				end
				p.get = function()
					local f = J
					return f
				end
				p.set = function(f)
					if typeof(f) ~= "Color3" then
						return
					end
					J = f
					for f, o in pairs(u) do
						O(f, o, J)
					end
					for O, O in ipairs(F) do
						pcall(O, J)
					end
				end
				p.count = function()
					local J = 0
					for O in pairs(u) do
						J += 1
					end
					return J
				end
				return p
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/thumb"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local p
				p = {
					SIZE = 48,
					headshot = function(J)
						if not J then
							return ""
						end
						return string.format(
							"rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=%d&w=%d&h=%d",
							J,
							p.SIZE,
							p.SIZE
						)
					end,
				}
				return p
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/toast"] = (function()

local Runtime = { [14] = table.pack }
function Runtime:oh(values) return table.unpack(values, 1, values.n) end
function Runtime:Wh(destination, offset, ...)
    local values = table.pack(...)
    table.move(values, 1, values.n, offset + 1, destination)
end
function Runtime:Lh(destination, offset, values)
    table.move(values, 1, values.n, offset + 1, destination)
    destination.n = offset + values.n
end

local p = Runtime

return function(J)
				local O = J("ui/connect")
				local u = J("ui/create")
				local F = J("services/frame")
				local f = J("ui/icon")
				local o = J("ui/library")
				local Z = J("ui/shadow")
				local i = J("ui/skin")
				local y = J("ui/theme")
				local P = J("ui/font")
				local b = J("ui/chrome/watermark")
				local I, h, A = J("ui/zindex"), { BIND = "hud/toast" }, 12
				local T, r, S, c, R, e, G, q, w, H, Q, Y, E, s, v, m =
					f.shadowSlice() + 24, 8, 296, 36, 24, 15, 6, 8, 12, 18, 14, 10, 2, 10, 10, 2
				local B = b.BRAND_TEXT
				local g = b.STAT_TEXT
				local k = b.STAT_TEXT
				h.LIFE = 7
				h.SPIN = 1.1
				h.SETTLED = 18
				local z, l, D, K, C, a, j, V, N = 0.24, 0.3, 28, 3, 0.96, 0.62, 0.5, false
				local W, U = {}
				local function _()
					local x = N and N.Parent
					if x then
						local d = N
						return d
					end
					x = o.base
					if not x then
						return nil
					end
					N = u.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "Toasts",
							AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
							Position = UDim2.new(1, -A, 0, b.MARGIN + b.HEIGHT + T),
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(S, c),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							ZIndex = I.HUD,
							Parent = x,
						}
					)
					for o, o in ipairs(W) do
						U(o)
						o.piece = false
					end
					x = N
					return x
				end
				local function o(b)
					local A = if b.open and b.body then G * 2 + #b.body * e else 0
					return (b.head or c) + 1 + A + R
				end
				J = string.char(34)
				local b = "closes in <font color=" .. J .. "%s" .. J .. ">%ds</font>, click to hold"
				local A = "<font color=" .. J .. "%s" .. J .. ">held open</font>, close it with the x"
				local T = "<font color=" .. J .. "%s" .. J .. ">working</font>, this closes when it is done"
				local function J(x)
					local d, L, n =
						math.floor(x.R * 255 + 0.5),
						math.floor(x.G * 255 + 0.5),
						p[14](math.floor(x.B * 255 + 0.5))
					return ("rgb(%d,%d,%d)"):format(d, L, p:oh(n))
				end
				local function p(x)
					local d, L, n =
						u.new(
							"Frame",
							{
								Name = "Line",
								AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
								Size = UDim2.fromOffset(S, c + 1 + R),
								BackgroundTransparency = 0,
								skin = { BackgroundColor3 = "window" },
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								ClipsDescendants = true,
								ZIndex = x,
								Parent = N,
							}
						),
						u.new,
						{}
					n.CornerRadius, n.Parent = UDim.new(0, q), d
					L("UICorner", n)
					L = u.new("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1, Transparency = j, Parent = d })
					i.paint(L, { Color = "border" })
					local q, M, t =
						u.new(
							"ImageLabel",
							{
								Name = "Mark",
								Position = UDim2.fromOffset(w, (c - H) // 2),
								Size = UDim2.fromOffset(H, H),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								ZIndex = x + 1,
								Parent = d,
							}
						),
						u.new(
							"TextLabel",
							{
								Name = "Title",
								AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
								Position = UDim2.new(0, w + H + s, 0, c // 2),
								Size = UDim2.new(1, -(w * 2 + H + s + Q * 2 + Y + v), 0, m * B * 2),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								Text = "",
								TextSize = B,
								skin = "text",
								FontFace = P.face(true),
								TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
								TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
								TextWrapped = true,
								TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
								ZIndex = x + 1,
								Parent = d,
							}
						),
						u.new(
							"TextButton",
							{
								Name = "Close",
								AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
								Position = UDim2.new(1, -w, 0, c // 2),
								Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Q, Q),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								AutoButtonColor = false,
								Text = "",
								ZIndex = x + 1,
								Parent = d,
							}
						)
					local v, m =
						u.new(
							"ImageLabel",
							{
								Name = "Mark",
								Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								skin = "faint",
								ZIndex = x + 2,
								Parent = t,
							}
						),
						f.get("close")
					if m then
						v.ImageContent = m
					end
					m = u.new(
						"TextButton",
						{
							Name = "Chevron",
							AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
							Position = UDim2.new(1, -(w + Q + Y), 0, c // 2),
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Q, Q),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							AutoButtonColor = false,
							Text = "",
							Visible = false,
							ZIndex = x + 1,
							Parent = d,
						}
					)
					local B, X =
						u.new(
							"ImageLabel",
							{
								Name = "Mark",
								AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
								Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
								Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								skin = "faint",
								ZIndex = x + 2,
								Parent = m,
							}
						),
						f.get("chevron")
					if X then
						B.ImageContent = X
					end
					X, n =
						u.new(
							"Frame",
							{
								Name = "Rule",
								Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, c),
								Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
								skin = { BackgroundColor3 = "line" },
								BackgroundTransparency = a,
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								ZIndex = x + 1,
								Parent = d,
							}
						),
						u.new(
							"TextButton",
							{
								Name = "Band",
								Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, c + 1),
								Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, R),
								skin = { BackgroundColor3 = "rowGlow" },
								BackgroundTransparency = C,
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								AutoButtonColor = false,
								Text = "",
								ClipsDescendants = true,
								ZIndex = x + 1,
								Parent = d,
							}
						)
					local pH, JH, OH =
						u.new(
							"Frame",
							{
								Name = "Body",
								Position = UDim2.fromOffset(w, G),
								Size = UDim2.new(1, -w * 2, 0, 0),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								ClipsDescendants = true,
								ZIndex = x + 2,
								Parent = n,
							}
						),
						u.new,
						{}
					OH.SortOrder, OH.Parent = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, pH
					JH("UIListLayout", OH)
					local JH, OH, uH, FH =
						u.new(
							"TextLabel",
							{
								Name = "Clock",
								AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
								Position = UDim2.new(0, w, 1, 0),
								Size = UDim2.new(1, -w * 2, 0, R),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								RichText = true,
								Text = "",
								TextSize = g,
								skin = "faint",
								FontFace = P.face(),
								TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
								ZIndex = x + 2,
								Parent = n,
							}
						),
						u.new(
							"Frame",
							{
								Name = "Wick",
								AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
								Position = UDim2.new(0, w, 1, 0),
								Size = UDim2.new(1, -w * 2, 0, E),
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								ZIndex = x + 3,
								Parent = d,
							}
						),
						u.new,
						{}
					FH.CornerRadius, FH.Parent = UDim.new(0.5, 0), OH
					uH("UICorner", FH)
					local g = {
						root = d,
						edge = L,
						mark = q,
						title = M,
						chevron = m,
						chevronMark = B,
						close = t,
						closeMark = v,
						rule = X,
						band = n,
						body = pH,
						clock = JH,
						wick = OH,
						shade = Z.attach(d, x),
					}
					O.signal(t.MouseButton1Click, function()
						local q = g.entry
						if q then
							q.dead = true
						end
					end, "hud/toastclose")
					O.signal(m.MouseButton1Click, function()
						local q = g.entry
						if not q or not q.body then
							return
						end
						q.open = not q.open
						if q.open then
							q.held = true
						end
					end, "hud/toastopen")
					O.signal(n.MouseButton1Click, function()
						local O = g.entry
						if O then
							O.held = true
						end
					end, "hud/toasthold")
					return g
				end
				U = function(O)
					if not O.piece then
						return
					end
					pcall(function()
						O.piece.root:Destroy()
					end)
					if O.piece.shade then
						pcall(function()
							O.piece.shade:Destroy()
						end)
					end
					O.piece = nil
				end
				local function O(q, v)
					if v then
						return math.max(0, 1 - v / l)
					end
					if q < z then
						return q / z
					end
					return 1
				end
				local function q(v, m, B, g, z)
					local x = v.piece
					if v.lastX ~= B or v.lastY ~= g then
						v.lastX = B
						v.lastY = g
						x.root.Position = UDim2.new(1, B, 0, g)
					end
					B = v.head or c
					if v.lastHead ~= B then
						v.lastHead = B
						x.mark.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(w, (B - H) // 2)
						x.title.Position = UDim2.new(0, w + H + s, 0, B // 2)
						x.close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -w, 0, B // 2)
						x.chevron.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(w + Q + Y), 0, B // 2)
						x.rule.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, B)
						x.band.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, B + 1)
						v.lastH = nil
					end
					if v.lastH ~= z then
						v.lastH = z
						x.root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(S, z)
						x.band.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.max(0, z - B - 1))
						x.body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -w * 2, 0, math.max(0, z - B - 1 - R - G * 2))
					end
					if v.lastLit == m then
						return
					end
					v.lastLit = m
					g = 1 - m
					x.root.BackgroundTransparency = g
					x.edge.Transparency = 1 - (1 - j) * m
					x.rule.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - (1 - a) * m
					x.band.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - (1 - C) * m
					x.title.TextTransparency = g
					x.mark.ImageTransparency = g
					x.closeMark.ImageTransparency = g
					x.chevronMark.ImageTransparency = g
					x.clock.TextTransparency = g
					x.wick.BackgroundTransparency = g
					if x.shade then
						x.shade.ImageTransparency = 1 - (1 - Z.TRANSPARENCY) * m
					end
				end
				local function Z()
					local S = os.clock()
					for G = #W, 1, -1 do
						local Q = W[G]
						if (Q.held or Q.pending) and not Q.dying then
							Q.born = S - math.min(S - Q.born, Q.life - l - 0.01)
						end
						if not Q.dying and (Q.dead or S - Q.born >= Q.life) then
							Q.dying = S
						end
						if Q.dying and S - Q.dying >= l then
							U(Q)
							table.remove(W, G)
						end
					end
					local G = 0
					for Q, Y in ipairs(W) do
						if Y.piece then
							if Y.head == false then
								Y.head = nil
							elseif not Y.head then
								Q = Y.piece.title.TextBounds.Y
								if Q > 0 then
									Y.head = math.max(c, Q + c - H)
								end
							end
							local H = S - Y.born
							local Q, s = O(H, Y.dying and S - Y.dying or nil), o(Y)
							Y.y = Y.y + (G - Y.y) * 0.25
							Y.h = Y.h + (s - Y.h) * 0.3
							s = math.floor(Y.h + 0.5)
							q(
								Y,
								math.floor(Q * 100 + 0.5) / 100,
								math.floor(D * (1 - Q) + 0.5),
								math.floor(Y.y + 0.5),
								s
							)
							if Y.body and Y.lastOpen ~= Y.open then
								Y.lastOpen = Y.open
								Y.piece.chevronMark.Rotation = Y.open and 180 or 0
							end
							Q = math.max(0, Y.life - H)
							H = (Y.held or Y.pending) and 1 or math.clamp(Q / Y.life, 0, 1)
							Y.piece.wick.Size = UDim2.new(H, -w * 2 * H, 0, E)
							if Y.pending then
								Y.piece.mark.Rotation = S / h.SPIN * 360 % 360
							end
							H = Y.pending and T:format(J(i.get("text")))
								or (
									Y.held and A:format(J(i.get("text")))
									or b:format(J(i.get("text")), math.max(1, math.ceil(Q)))
								)
							if Y.said ~= H then
								Y.said = H
								Y.piece.clock.Text = H
							end
							G = G + s + r
						else
						end
					end
					S = N
					if S then
						local J = N
						J.Visible = #W > 0
					end
				end
				h.push = function(J)
					if typeof(J) ~= "table" then
						return h
					end
					local O = J.text
					if typeof(O) ~= "string" or O == "" then
						return h
					end
					local o = if typeof(J.body) == "table" and #J.body > 0 then J.body else nil
					if #W >= K then
						local b = W[#W]
						if not b.dying then
							b.dead = true
						end
					end
					local b = {
						text = O,
						bad = J.bad and true or false,
						body = o,
						born = os.clock(),
						life = typeof(J.life) == "number" and J.life or h.LIFE,
						pending = J.pending and true or false,
						open = false,
						held = false,
						dead = false,
						dying = nil,
						y = 0,
						h = c + 1 + R,
						piece = false,
					}
					table.insert(W, 1, b)
					return b
				end
				h.settle = function(J, O)
					if typeof(J) ~= "table" or not J.pending then
						return h
					end
					O = if typeof(O) ~= "table" then {} else O
					J.pending = false
					J.born = os.clock()
					J.life = typeof(O.life) == "number" and O.life or h.SETTLED
					if typeof(O.text) == "string" and O.text ~= "" then
						J.text = O.text
						if J.piece then
							J.piece.title.Text = O.text
							J.head = false
						end
					end
					J.bad = O.bad and true or false
					J.said = nil
					if J.piece then
						local O, o =
							f.get(J.bad and "badRing" or "okRing"), J.bad and i.get("danger") or y.get()
						if O then
							J.piece.mark.ImageContent = O
						end
						J.piece.mark.Rotation = 0
						J.piece.mark.ImageColor3 = o
						J.piece.wick.BackgroundColor3 = o
					end
					return h
				end
				local function J(O)
					for o, b in ipairs(W) do
						if b.piece == false then
							o = p(O)
							b.piece = o
							o.entry = b
							o.title.Text = b.text
							local p = b.bad and i.get("danger") or y.get()
							o.wick.BackgroundColor3 = p
							o.mark.ImageColor3 = p
							local i, y = f.get, b.pending and "refresh" or (b.bad and "badRing" or "okRing")
							p = i(y)
							if p then
								o.mark.ImageContent = p
							end
							if b.body then
								o.chevron.Visible = true
								for f, i in ipairs(b.body) do
									p = tostring(i):sub(1, 1) == "+"
									u.new(
										"TextLabel",
										{
											Name = "L" .. f,
											LayoutOrder = f,
											Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, e),
											BackgroundTransparency = 1,
											Text = tostring(i),
											TextSize = k,
											skin = p and "add" or "remove",
											FontFace = P.face(),
											TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
											TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
											ZIndex = O + 3,
											Parent = o.body,
										}
									)
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
				h.enable = function(p)
					p = p and true or false
					local O = V
					if p == O then
						return h
					end
					V = p
					O = not p
					if O then
						F.stop(h.BIND)
						for p, p in ipairs(W) do
							U(p)
						end
						table.clear(W)
						local p = N
						if p then
							N.Visible = false
						end
						return h
					end
					F.onDraw(h.BIND, function()
						if not _() then
							return
						end
						J(I.HUD)
						Z()
					end)
					return h
				end
				h.reset = function()
					h.enable(false)
					table.clear(W)
					local p = N
					if p then
						pcall(function()
							N:Destroy()
						end)
						N = nil
					end
				end
				return h
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/tooltip"] = (function()

return function(p)
				local J = p("ui/connect")
				local O = p("ui/create")
				local u = p("ui/metrics")
				local F = p("ui/motion")
				local f = p("ui/icon")
				local o = p("ui/popup")
				local Z = p("ui/shadow")
				local i = p("ui/font")
				local y, P, b, I, h =
					p("ui/zindex"),
					{ DWELL = 0.45, OFFSET = 8, SLIDE = 6, MAX_WIDTH = 220, PAD_X = 7, SURFACE = "raised", TEXT = "body" }
				local p, A = false, 0
				local function T()
					local r = b and b.Parent
					if r then
						local S = b
						return S
					end
					r = o.host
					if not r then
						return nil
					end
					b = O.new(
						"TextLabel",
						{
							Name = "Tooltip",
							AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
							AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							Text = "",
							TextSize = u.textSize - 1,
							skin = { BackgroundColor3 = P.SURFACE, TextColor3 = P.TEXT },
							TextWrapped = true,
							TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
							FontFace = i.face(),
							TextTransparency = 1,
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Visible = false,
							ZIndex = y.TOOLTIP,
							Parent = r,
						}
					)
					local i, S = O.new, {}
					S.CornerRadius, S.Parent = UDim.new(0, u.corner), b
					i("UICorner", S)
					O.new("UIStroke", { Thickness = u.stroke, skin = "border", Transparency = 1, Parent = b })
					O.new(
						"UIPadding",
						{
							PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4),
							PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4),
							PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, P.PAD_X),
							PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, P.PAD_X),
							Parent = b,
						}
					)
					i, S = O.new, {}
					S.MaxSize, S.Parent = Vector2.new(P.MAX_WIDTH, 1 / 0), b
					i("UISizeConstraint", S)
					h = Z.attach(b, y.TOOLTIP)
					i, S = f.dimensions("tooltipArrow")
					I = O.new(
						"ImageLabel",
						{
							Name = "TooltipArrow",
							AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(i or 7, S or 12),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							ImageContent = f.get("tooltipArrow"),
							skin = P.SURFACE,
							ImageTransparency = 1,
							Visible = false,
							ZIndex = y.TOOLTIP + 1,
							Parent = r,
						}
					)
					i = b
					return i
				end
				local function O(u, f, i, y)
					local r = I
					if not r then
						return
					end
					r = I.Size.X.Offset
					if y then
						local y = I
						y.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(u + i + r / 2 - 1, f)
						I.Rotation = 180
					else
						local i = I
						i.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(u - r / 2 + 1, f)
						I.Rotation = 0
					end
					I.Visible = true
				end
				local function u(f)
					local i = f and F.HOVER_IN or F.HOVER_OUT
					local y, r =
						F.to(
							b,
							i,
							{ BackgroundTransparency = f and 0.05 or 1, TextTransparency = f and 0 or 1 }
						),
						b:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
					if r then
						local S, c = F.to, {}
						c.Transparency = f and 0 or 1
						S(r, i, c)
					end
					r = I
					if r then
						local r, S, c = F.to, I, {}
						c.ImageTransparency = f and 0.05 or 1
						r(S, i, c)
					end
					Z.fade(h, f, i)
					return y
				end
				local function f(Z)
					local i = o.host
					if not i or not Z then
						return
					end
					local y, h, r = i.AbsolutePosition, Z.AbsolutePosition, Z.AbsoluteSize
					local S, c = h.X - y.X + r.X + P.OFFSET, h.Y - y.Y + r.Y / 2
					Z = S + b.AbsoluteSize.X > i.AbsoluteSize.X
					S = if Z then h.X - y.X - b.AbsoluteSize.X - P.OFFSET else S
					h = b.AbsoluteSize
					return S, c, Z, h.X
				end
				local function Z()
					A += 1
					local i = p
					if not i then
						return
					end
					p = false
					local i, y = u(false), A
					local function h()
						b.Visible = false
						local r = I
						if r then
							I.Visible = false
						end
					end
					if i then
						i.Completed:Once(function()
							local i = y == A and not p
							if i then
								h()
							end
						end)
					else
						h()
					end
				end
				local function i(y, h)
					if not T() then
						return
					end
					A += 1
					local T = A
					J.thread(function()
						task.wait(P.DWELL)
						local r = A
						if T ~= r then
							return
						end
						if o.blocks(y) then
							return
						end
						b.TextWrapped = false
						r = b
						r.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
						r = b
						r.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
						b.Text = h
						b.Visible = true
						task.wait()
						r = T ~= A
						if r then
							b.Visible = false
							return
						end
						r = b.TextBounds.X + P.PAD_X * 2 > P.MAX_WIDTH
						if r then
							local h = b
							h.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
							b.TextWrapped = true
							h = b
							h.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(P.MAX_WIDTH, 0)
							task.wait()
							h = T ~= A
							if h then
								b.Visible = false
								return
							end
						end
						local h, T, S, c = f(y)
						if not h then
							return
						end
						O(h, T, c, S)
						local O, f, y = S and P.SLIDE or -P.SLIDE, I.Position.X.Offset, b
						y.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(h + O, T)
						c = I
						c.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(f + O, T)
						p = true
						u(true)
						O, y, S, r = F.to, b, F.HOVER_IN, {}
						r.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(h, T)
						O(y, S, r)
						S, O, y, r = F.to, I, F.HOVER_IN, {}
						r.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(f, T)
						S(O, y, r)
					end)
				end
				P.attach = function(O, u)
					if not O or typeof(u) ~= "string" or u == "" then
						return
					end
					J.signal(O.InputBegan, function(F)
						if F.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
							if o.blocks(O) then
								return
							end
							i(O, u)
						end
					end, "tooltip/enter")
					J.signal(O.InputEnded, function(J)
						if J.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
							Z()
						end
					end, "tooltip/leave")
				end
				P.dismiss = function()
					local J = b
					if not J then
						return
					end
					A += 1
					p = false
					pcall(function()
						b.Visible = false
						b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
						b.TextTransparency = 1
						local p = I
						if p then
							I.Visible = false
							I.ImageTransparency = 1
						end
					end)
				end
				return P
			end
end)()

					if u then
						return
					end
					local f, o = q, w
					if f == o then
						return
					end
					f = math.min(O or 0.016666666666666666, 0.1) / p.FADE
					q = if w > q then math.min(q + f, w) else math.max(q - f, w)
					F.apply(G, q)
					u, f, O, o = S, UDim2.new, -p.PAD, H
					u.Position = f(1, O, 0, o - p.RISE * q)
					u = q >= 1
					if u then
						S.Visible = false
					end
				end
				p.reset = function()
					pcall(J.close)
					r, S, R, G, Q, c, Y, e, q, w = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, {}, {}, false, 1, 1
				end
				return p
			end
end)()

							skin = "raised",
							ZIndex = y.MODAL + 1,
							Parent = b,
						}
					)
					o, Z = O.new, {}
					Z.CornerRadius, Z.Parent = UDim.new(0, u.corner + 2), I
					o("UICorner", Z)
					O.new("UIStroke", { Thickness = u.stroke, skin = "border", Parent = I })
					T = O.new(
						"UIListLayout",
						{
							SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
							HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
							Padding = UDim.new(0, p.GAP),
							Parent = I,
						}
					)
					O.new(
						"UIPadding",
						{
							PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, p.PAD),
							PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, p.PAD),
							PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, p.PAD),
							PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, p.PAD),
							Parent = I,
						}
					)
					h = O.new(
						"TextLabel",
						{
							Name = "Message",
							LayoutOrder = 1,
							Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
							AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Text = "",
							TextSize = u.textSize,
							FontFace = i.face(),
							TextWrapped = true,
							RichText = true,
							skin = "text",
							ZIndex = y.MODAL + 2,
							Parent = I,
						}
					)
					A = O.new(
						"Frame",
						{
							Name = "Choices",
							LayoutOrder = 2,
							Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, p.BUTTON_H),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							ZIndex = y.MODAL + 1,
							Parent = I,
						}
					)
					Z, o =
						O.new,
						{
							FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
							HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
							SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
						}
					o.Padding, o.Parent = UDim.new(0, p.GAP), A
					Z("UIListLayout", o)
					J.signal(T:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"), function()
						p.resize()
					end, "warning/size")
					o = b
					return o
				end
				p.resize = function()
					local J = not I or not T
					if J then
						return
					end
					J = T.AbsoluteContentSize.Y
					if J <= 0 then
						return
					end
					local O = I
					O.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(p.WIDTH, J + p.PAD * 2)
				end
				p.answer = function(J)
					local O = S
					local u = O
					S = nil
					p.hide()
					if u then
						task.spawn(u, J)
					end
				end
				p.hide = function()
					local J = b
					if not J then
						return
					end
					F.to(b, F.HOVER_OUT, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
					local J, O, u, o = F.to, I, F.HOVER_OUT, {}
					o.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, p.RISE)
					J(O, u, o)
					task.delay(F.HOVER_OUT.Time, function()
						local J = b and not S
						if J then
							b.Visible = false
						end
					end)
				end
				local function J(O, u)
					local o = b
					if not o then
						return nil
					end
					pcall(f.closeAll)
					o = r
					for f, f in ipairs(o) do
						f:Destroy()
					end
					r = {}
					o = h
					o.Text = tostring(O or "")
					for f, o in ipairs(u) do
						c(f, o.label, o.primary, o.value)
					end
					b.Visible = true
					b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					O = I
					O.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, p.RISE)
					p.resize()
					F.to(b, p.INFO, { BackgroundTransparency = p.VEIL })
					local O, u, f, o = F.to, I, p.INFO, {}
					o.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
					O(u, f, o)
					S = coroutine.running()
					return coroutine.yield()
				end
				p.alert = function(O)
					return J(O, { { label = p.OK, primary = true, value = true } })
				end
				p.confirm = function(O)
					return J(
						O,
						{ { label = p.NO, primary = false, value = false }, {
							label = p.YES,
							primary = true,
							value = true,
						} }
					)
				end
				p.isOpen = function()
					local J = S
					return J ~= nil
				end
				p.reset = function()
					P, b, I, h, A, T, r, S = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, {}, nil
				end
				return p
			end
end)()


_registry["ui/zindex"] = (function()

return function(p)
				return {
					HUD = 1,
					BUBBLE = 8,
					WORLD = 10,
					WINDOW = 20,
					WIDGET = 30,
					POPUP = 50,
					POPUP_CONTENT = 60,
					POPUP_NESTED = 65,
					POPUP_NESTED_CONTENT = 70,
					TOOLTIP = 80,
					MODAL = 90,
					TOP = 100,
				}
			end
end)()


return requireModule('core/entry')
